chapters.title: Chapter 1
paragraphs: The Violent Young Man from Jiang City
“Ouch... My whole body hurts.” Chen Yun covered his head and heard the knock on the door. He got out of bed and opened the door.
This!
Chen Yun looked at the person at the door and his eyes widened. He subconsciously swallowed a mouthful of saliva.
“Are you Chen Yun?”
“It’s me, Mr. Policeman. Why are you looking for me?”
Hm?
The two people at the door looked at each other before looking at Chen Yun. “Don’t you remember what happened last night?”
“Last night? I drank too much last night. Could it be?”
Could it be that he got into trouble after drinking last night?
Otherwise, why would the police be here!
Chen Yun’s hair immediately stood on end. All these years, he had been honest and dutiful. He did not expect something to go wrong after drinking.

A policeman patted him on the shoulder. “You remember now, right? You young people are really brave. However, you’re not allowed to do this next time. It’s very dangerous. Sometimes, you have to protect yourself first. Do you hear me?”
Hm?
For a moment, Chen Yun was dumbfounded.
Then, he saw a silk banner being sent to him. It had the words “did a righteous deed” written on it!
“Alright, we’re leaving. Thank you anyway.”
The door closed.
Chen Yun was holding the silk banner when his phone rang. He took out his phone and saw that he had more than 99 unread messages.
“Brother Yun, you’re amazing!”
“You’re on the news!”
“Brother Yun, hurry up and search for the violent young man from Jiang City. You’re going to be popular.”
Hm?
Chen Yun opened the browser and searched.

[Shocking! A young man from Jiang City was robbed after getting drunk. After the robber checked his balance, he laughed and threw 100 yuan back at the young man. The young man attacked in anger and subdued the robber alone!]
[You won’t know if you don’t read this! Breaking down the violent past of the violent young man from Jiang City!]
[It’s real! The young man from Jiang City has a special ability. When he drinks, he has extraordinary strength. He subdued the knife-wielding criminal alone!]

[Exclusive revelation! The violent young man from Jiang City actually had an improper relationship with the criminal. The criminal gave the young man 100 yuan after the incident. However, the young man beat him up because he was dissatisfied with the money!]
Chen Yun was speechless.
Who was he?
Where was he?
Why was he called the violent young man?
After asking these three questions, what happened last night slowly surfaced.
After a long silence, he looked at the silk banner and the news in his hand. Chen Yun finally remembered.

He drank too much at his high school reunion last night and went back to his university dormitory alone. In the end, he was robbed. The other party laughed after seeing his balance and threw him 100 yuan. He couldn’t remember what happened after that. He seemed to have beaten that guy up.
“Heh! Who are you insulting!” Chen Yun’s smile gradually froze as he flipped through the news.
Who were they scamming?!
Only the first article was serious!
What were the rest of the articles saying?!
What special ability?! What did they mean by receiving too little money?!
The media nowadays were really full of nonsense.
He didn’t know what right they had to insult a hero who acted bravely!
Right?
However, there were a few pieces of news that were right. After the criminal saw his balance, he really threw money at him.
That balance was hard to explain in a few words.

Putting away the silk banner, Chen Yun sighed. “The money I’ve earned from work can only be distributed the day after tomorrow. Tell me, there’s no reward for doing a heroic deed. It looks like I’ll have to eat dirt these few days.”
He slumped in his chair. “Food doesn’t fall from the sky either. Just smash me to death.”
It felt like heaven when he received his pay, but felt like hell at the end of the month.
This was difficult.
In the next moment, the things around Chen Xuan became illusory, making him rub his eyes fiercely. However, his vision didn’t improve.
“Could it be that the alcohol hasn’t worn off?”
As he asked this question, Chen Yun saw a flash.
[The Tycoon Check-In System is binding.]
[Binding Progress: 0%]
[Binding Progress: 100%]
“The Tycoon Check-in System?” Chen Yun asked. Was he really hallucinating? Could it be that he had been hit in the head by the criminal yesterday?
On the other side, the screen was still popping up.
[Binding successful.]
[Name: Chen Yun]
[Height: 183 cm]
[Appearance: 82 (Out of 100)]
[Balance: 7.41 yuan]
[Skills: None]
[Host, please complete your first check-in!]
Chen Yun looked at the check-in button in front of him and pressed it.
[First check-in successful. Countdown to the next check-in: 23:59:59]
[Reward distribution]
[You have received the Exiled Immortal’s Handsome Face. The transformation will be completed in a month!]
[You have received 100,000,000 yuan!]
[Skill: Full of Luck!]
“Heh, what are you talking about?” Chen Yun was disdainful. However, the next moment, he looked at the text message from the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China.
“A hundred thousand, a million, ten million, a hundred million! It’s really a hundred million!”
“Is this real?”
Chen Yun really believed it this time. After all, would the bank lie to him?
However, other than obtaining looks and money, he could also obtain skills. He seemed to have obtained a skill called “Full of Luck”.
As Chen Xuan was thinking, his phone suddenly lit up.
“Congratulations to User [Cloud Death] for winning the first prize of the Million Shark Fin Feedback Event. One million shark fins have been sent to your account.”
“Even someone like me can win the first prize?” Chen Yun was shocked!
One had to know that millions of people were participating in the Million Shark Fin Feedback Event!
The probability of winning the first prize was one in a million!
Furthermore, shark fins were the virtual currency of the Flying Fish live-streaming platform.
One shark fin cost one yuan.
Thus, one million shark fins was equivalent to one million yuan!
Could this be the power of the “Full of Luck” skill?
The app notification popped up again.
[Congratulations to User Cloud Death for participating in the event and winning the first prize. You have won one inner court ticket to Wang Menghan’s concert!]
[Congratulations to User Cloud Death for obtaining a one-year iQiyi membership.]
[Congratulations to User Cloud Death for obtaining a 15-yuan McLaren discount coupon.]
Chen Yun was confused.
These people played around all day. If ordinary people could afford a McLaren, why would they still need this 15-yuan discount coupon?
Could he be said to be “full of luck”?
In that case, Chen Yun was already very lucky. He had even drawn a 20-yuan discount coupon for a Boeing 737 in the past.
With this coupon, it would be a waste not to use it. Just as Chen Yun was about to set off for a car dealership, a screen popped up.
[Check-In Mission: Please check-in at Wang Menghan’s concert at 10 pm tonight.]
[Mission Reward: Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion Villa No. 3.]
The Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion!
Chen Yun was momentarily stunned. Everyone in Jiang City knew about the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion.
That was the most luxurious villa area in Jiang City!
Each villa was worth at least a hundred million yuan and was priceless!

The reason was very simple. It was surrounded by mountains and rivers. One could see the misty Yangtze River in front and the misty mountains behind. Moreover, it introduced the most advanced smart home system in the country.
Of course, Chen Yun had only seen these things in advertisements.
Just thinking about that villa made Chen Yun excited. However, he still had to complete the check-in mission first.

chapters.title: Chapter 2
paragraphs: Full of Luck!
As for Wang Menghan, she was a legendary figure.
At the age of 18, she had just entered university when she was discovered by a talent scout. From then on, she could not be stopped. After releasing an album, she became popular!
Chen Yun had been paying attention to her since she debuted.

Wang Menghan and Chen Yun were both in their early twenties. However, Wang Menghan was already very popular. Moreover, in her first year of fame, she had donated three million yuan to the mountain area, which was equivalent to her annual income. Later on, after a fire, she even donated a lot of money to rebuild Hope Primary School.
She was comparable to a school-building maniac.
There was no need to mention her songs. From gentle songs to rock and rap, there was simply nothing that she could not control. It had to be said that her talent was extraordinary.
Chen Yun sat on the chair and looked at
Damai
. At the end of this concert, there would be a lottery to obtain autographs and souvenirs. The lottery tickets would be sold at the venue at 12 noon sharp today.
“I’ll go to take a look.” Chen Yun didn’t care about anything else. It was more important to complete the check-in mission first.

When he arrived at the venue, there were only about ten people queuing up in front of Chen Yun. After all, it was only 9 am. In addition, they were all university students. How could university students wake up so early nowadays?
Chen Yun played with his phone and quietly waited for the lottery tickets to be sold.
Slowly, there were more and more people behind him. Chen Yun looked and saw that there were bound to be people who could not buy the lottery tickets.

This time, there were only 300 lottery tickets. Each ticket was sold for 300 yuan. If it was for the sake of making money, such a method would have long been criticized on the Internet. However, this time, be it the money from selling concert tickets or lottery tickets, they would all be donated to Hope Primary School. The Internet did not comment on such a method of selling.
The tickets were sold at 12 noon sharp.
When it was Chen Yun’s turn, he was about to step forward when a young man stepped in front of Chen Yun. “Ticket seller, give me a lottery ticket.”
“Hey, hey, hey, brother, can’t you line up?” Chen Yun was instantly annoyed. How could there be such a person?
“How petty. I’m just cutting the line in front of you. Why are you making so much noise?” The young man turned around and snorted. Then, he turned back. “Take my money. I want one lottery ticket.”
“I’m sorry, sir. Please line up at the back. Don’t disturb the order.”
The ticket seller looked at the young man and spoke helplessly.
“I told you to line up. What’s wrong with you? Go there obediently.” Chen Yun glanced at him and deliberately shouted, “Auntie, how many lottery tickets are left?”
“Hello, there are 291 tickets left.”
Splat!
For a moment, many people laughed.
They all looked at Chen Yun awkwardly.
This was really awkward.
If there were only three or two tickets left, he could have bought them all to punish the young man. However, there were still 291 cards left. Those were worth nearly 90,000 yuan!
Many people became interested and prepared to watch Chen Yun’s show.
“Hey, brother, what’s wrong? Do you mean that you want to buy everything?”
“Brother, you’re awesome!”
“Come, brother. Since you’re buying everything, you can’t indulge such a person!”
As the crowd spoke, a mocking expression appeared on their faces as they watched Chen Yun make a fool of himself.

Meanwhile, the young man who had just been kicked out of the line snorted. “What are you talking about? Can’t you see his attire? He’s just an ordinary student. Aren’t you making things difficult for him?”
“It’s fine, brother. There are still so many tickets left. I’m not in a hurry, hehe.”
Chen Yun looked at him and smiled. Then, he took out a card. “Auntie, I’ll take all of these lottery tickets.”
This sentence stunned the people who were queueing up behind Chen Yun and mocking him.
Chen Yun took a stack of lottery tickets and showed them to everyone. Then, he swaggered to the side.
He left a group of stunned people behind.
“Hey, brother, why did you actually buy all the tickets?”
“Don’t run!”
“D*mn, how awesome. He’s a tycoon!”
For a moment, some people were advocating for him, some chased after him, and some stood rooted to the ground in regret.
However, those who were chasing after Chen Yun could not catch up to him. How could they catch up to Chen Yun, who was halfway through Jiang City?
After a quick lunch, Chen Yun walked into the welfare lottery shop.
“Give me a two-color ball.”
“Here you go. The prize will be revealed tonight.”
Chen Yun looked at the welfare lottery ticket in his hand and put it in his pocket. He was just waiting for the prize to be opened tonight.
After strolling around for the entire afternoon, the concert started on time at night.

Wang Menghan stood on the stage in a snow-white dress. Her tall figure and long dress were simply a perfect match. Coupled with her face that was like a popular flower, it was as if Wang Menghan would probably be very successful if she stopped singing one day to act.
The sound of nature echoed in the air, causing everyone to scream and celebrate from time to time.
With the wave of the light sticks, the entire venue was like a rumbling sea. The atmosphere was simply wonderful.
On stage, Wang Menghan sang one song after another, constantly leading the venue to the next climax.
At the same time, this concert was also broadcasted on various major live-streaming or video platforms, such as Flying Fish and Bilibili...
The number of viewers rose to two million!
Chen Yun sat in the inner court, waving the light stick in his hand.
At 9.45 pm, the two-colored ball was rolled. Chen Yun looked at the number and chuckled. As expected, he was full of luck!
It was a prize of five million yuan!
However, this five million yuan was nothing to Chen Yun. He was not too excited.
He stayed up until 10 pm.
Then, a screen popped up.
[Do you want to check in?]
Chen Yun pressed the check-in button.
[Check-in successful. Congratulations to the host for obtaining Villa No. 3 of Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion.]
Just as Chen Yun was checking in, the singing on stage ended. Wang Menghan wiped her sweat.
“Next is our exciting lottery draw. Everyone with lottery tickets, are you ready!”
With that, only ten people present took out their lottery tickets.
Nine of them were trembling as they held a lottery ticket.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun trembled as he held 291 tickets.
Damn it, there were too many tickets!
“We will draw a total of ten winners and give out my signed records, signed earphones, and signed photo books...”
“Let’s draw the first prize. The big screen will show the numbers.”
“Three, two, one! Stop!”
“Alright, let’s invite our friend Number 18 on stage to receive the award.”
Number 18!
Chen Yun stood up and waved at the air. The camera accurately captured him.

Chen Yun walked on stage and stood beside Wang Menghan. He was still a little excited. After all, he had been listening to Wang Menghan’s songs and silently following her online. Now, he could actually see her in person and at such a close distance.
“Congratulations.” Wang Menghan looked at Chen Yun’s face and was stunned. His face was comparable to a popular young hunk. Was he a student from the performing arts department?
“Thank you.” Chen Yun took the signed record and hugged Wang Menghan.
“Sir, you can draw the next award.” Wang Menghan handed the microphone to Chen Yun.
“Begin!”
“Stop!”
It was Number 73!
Wang Menghan took the microphone and said, “To our friend who has lottery ticket Number 73, please come on stage.”
“Sorry, it’s still me.”
Wang Menghan was confused.
Millions of viewers were also confused.
“Oh, oh, so this gentleman bought more than one lottery ticket. I thank you on behalf of the children in the mountains. In that case, you can draw the next award.”
“Begin!”
“Stop!”
“Sorry, it’s still me.”
“Sorry, it’s me again.”
“It’s me...”
“Haha, I’m so sorry. My luck tonight is too good.”

Damn it, there were too many tickets!
“We will draw a total of ten winners and give out my signed records, signed earphones, and signed photo books...”
“Let’s draw the first prize.
The big screen will show the numbers.”
“Three, two, one!
Stop!”
“Alright, let’s invite our friend Number 18 on stage to receive the award.”
Number 18!
Chen Yun stood up and waved at the air.
The camera accurately captured him.
Chen Yun walked on stage and stood beside Wang Menghan.
He was still a little excited.
After all, he had been listening to Wang Menghan’s songs and silently following her online.
Now, he could actually see her in person and at such a close distance.
“Congratulations.” Wang Menghan looked at Chen Yun’s face and was stunned.
His face was comparable to a popular young hunk.
Was he a student from the performing arts department?
“Thank you.” Chen Yun took the signed record and hugged Wang Menghan.
“Sir, you can draw the next award.” Wang Menghan handed the microphone to Chen Yun.
“Begin!”
“Stop!”
It was Number 73!
Wang Menghan took the microphone and said, “To our friend who has lottery ticket Number 73, please come on stage.”
“Sorry, it’s still me.”
Wang Menghan was confused.
Millions of viewers were also confused.
“Oh, oh, so this gentleman bought more than one lottery ticket.
I thank you on behalf of the children in the mountains.
In that case, you can draw the next award.”
“Begin!”
“Stop!”
“Sorry, it’s still me.”
“Sorry, it’s me again.”
“It’s me...”
“Haha, I’m so sorry.
My luck tonight is too good.”

chapters.title: Chapter 3
paragraphs: It’s Just That I Bought Too Much
“These ten awards have been given to me. How can I be so shameless?”
Chen Yun shook his head and opened his arms. Wang Menghan was stunned. She suspected that Chen Yun was here to cheat her of hugs.
Meanwhile, the Internet exploded.
“Evil creature, let go of my goddess!”
“Ahhh, even if you’re more handsome than me, you can’t hug my goddess!”
“No, I think there must be an inside story. Otherwise, how could it be him every time!”
“That’s right, there’s an inside story!”
For a moment, there were all kinds of comments on the screen. They were all condemning Chen Yun.
On the stage.
Wang Menghan looked at Chen Yun. “Sir, congratulations.”
Chen Yun took the microphone and faced the camera. “Actually, I know some friends are saying that there’s a conspiracy. What can I do? I’m also in despair, but I... I really bought too much.”
As he spoke, Chen Yun took out two stacks of lottery tickets from his pocket.
Everyone was silent!
The comments were filled with ellipses.
Even Wang Menghan’s mouth twitched when she saw Chen Yun and his two stacks of lottery tickets.
He was ruthless! He was really ruthless!
Soon, the comments began to discuss.
“D*mn, this brother is a true fan. Those lottery tickets cost about 90,000 yuan in total. He doesn’t look like he’s dressed well, but I didn’t expect him to be an invisible tycoon.”
“Ninety thousand yuan is two years’ worth of my salary.”
“Furthermore, did you see that? He even walked out of the inner court. That means that he spent a lot of money on his tickets. It’s good to be rich.”
Seeing the silence, Chen Yun took out a piece of paper from his pants pocket again.
“I know how hard it is for the children in the mountains, and I hope to do my part for them. This is the first prize of tonight’s welfare lottery. I will donate it to the children in the mountains.”
At this moment, the camera shifted to the lottery ticket in Chen Yun’s hand.
The number, time, and date were clear as day.
Someone immediately started investigating.
“F*ck, it’s real! A lottery ticket worth more than five million yuan was donated just like that!”
“I worship him. I worship him!”
“This is truly inhumane! Look at him, he’s truly enlightened!”
“I’m not sore anymore.”
With a turn of the tide, Chen Yun’s move received a flood of good reviews online.
Even Wang Menghan sent her regards to Chen Yun.
There was even a burst of applause.
“Mr. Chen, why don’t you sing the last song with me?”
“Alright, then I won’t refuse.”
Chen Yun took the microphone from the staff beside him.
“We’ll sing ‘Hummingbird’ for everyone.”

Then, Wang Menghan’s melodious voice sounded. Although Chen Yun did not have Wang Menghan’s skills, he did not go out of tune. Coupled with his deep and sonorous voice, when the two of them sang this song together, there was a different flavor to the song.
Even Wang Menghan was surprised by the effect of singing with Chen Yun.

After the concert, Chen Yun was brought backstage and handed the lottery ticket to Wang Menghan. “You’re free to choose whether to donate, but you donated out of goodwill. Thank you for everything you’ve done for the mountain area over the years.”
Wang Menghan took a deep breath. “Thank you too, Mr. Chen. Can we add each other on WeChat? I want to be friends with a loving person like you.”
“Okay.” After adding her on WeChat, Chen Yun did not stay any longer. He could tell that Wang Menghan was tired. It was no wonder. Who could stand singing for a few hours?
Looking at the time, it was almost 11 pm. Chen Yun was too lazy to go to the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion and went straight back to his dormitory.
The next day, when he turned on his phone, another link appeared.
[Exclusive revelation! The tycoon at Wang Menghan’s concert last night is linked to the violent young man from Jiang City!]
[The rumor has been dispelled! It’s impossible for the violent young man from Jiang City to have a conflict with the criminal because he received too little money!]
[A logical problem! What did the criminal see that night when he checked the balance?!]

[Shocking! The violent young man from Jiang City is suspected to be a masochist. He deliberately showed his balance to maintain an improper relationship with the criminal. The honest criminal threw 100 yuan in anger to break free and was beaten up instead!]
Puff!
When he saw the last piece of news, Chen Yun could no longer remain calm!
The media was so unscrupulous. Oh, how unscrupulous!
Most importantly, the last piece of news had the most views. Public morals were truly degenerating with each passing day.

He looked at his phone. It was a WeChat message from Wang Menghan. She would set off today and directly transfer the donations to the various Hope Primary Schools that she donated to, including Chen Yun’s first prize.
Chen Yun also sent a message on WeChat to tell Wang Menghan to be careful. The latter replied almost instantly. After chatting for a while, Chen Yun got out of bed and washed up.
[It is time to check in. Do you want to check in?]
He clicked on the check-in button.
[Sign-in successful. Congratulations to the host for obtaining the skill: God of Racing.]
[God of Racing Skill: Become a God when driving. The host becomes one with their car. Their nickname when driving other passengers becomes ‘Veteran of Welding Car Doors’.]

“Oh, no wonder they gave the nickname ‘Veteran of Welding Car Doors’. They’re probably afraid that I’ll throw the passenger out when I’m about to change direction.” Chen Yun was deep in thought. However, he only had a title now and didn’t have a car.
That was right!
He still had a 15-yuan McLaren discount coupon!
He would be a fool not to take advantage of it!
The happiness of the rich was so plain and boring.
Chen Yun took out his coat, put it on, and walked out!
Passing by the lottery shop, Chen Yun first went in to buy two lottery tickets and sent them home. After all, his parents were at home. Thus, it was easy to justify this purchase.
He was full of luck. What could they do?
Nothing, right?
He hailed a taxi and arrived at the McLaren car dealership. He had to admit that the environment alone was different from other car dealerships.
At the entrance of the shop, a few service staff said goodbye to the man in front of them.
After the man left, they sighed in unison.
“Manager Zhou, this deal didn’t go through,” said a girl to another girl beside her, her face full of disappointment.

“It’s fine, it’s fine. How many people in Jiang City can afford a McLaren? This car is not suitable for those old and successful people to drive. It’s fine.” Zhou Jingyi patted the shoulder of the girl beside her. “You guys go eat first. It’s almost noon. Don’t starve.”
“Okay.”
“Manager Zhou, don’t you want to join us?”
Zhou Jingyi waved her hand. “I brought some food. I’ll just eat here later.”
Most importantly, she saw Chen Yun walking over. Although she did not think that Chen Yun had the money to buy a luxury car, she had heard of a story.

A Rolls-Royce salesman made 36,000 phone calls to clients every year. In total, 28,800 clients would pick up, 11,520 clients would listen to him, 4,008 clients would be interested, 1,843 clients would come to see the cars, 737 clients would consider, 294 clients would be interested, 117 clients would negotiate, and 47 clients would want to buy a car. In the end, he closed 18 deals, which earned him two million yuan.
He concluded that he would earn 55.55 yuan per call.
People in sales had to have such spirit! Perseverance in doing the right thing translated to production value!
She looked at Chen Yun and quickly walked over. “Sir, are you going to buy a car? I wonder if you have any intention of buying a McLaren sports car?”
Oh?
Chen Yun sized up the girl in front of him. She looked like she had just graduated from university.

Her long hair was tied up at the back, and her temperament was outstanding. She had light makeup on, and the smile on her face made people feel like they were bathing in the spring breeze, giving off a very otherworldly feeling.
In particular, her work suit was very appropriate and made others feel that she was very capable.
“Let’s go in and take a look.”

“Alright, follow me.” Zhou Jingyi explained to Chen Yun as she walked. “Sir, this is a McLaren 720S. It only takes 2.7 seconds for it to accelerate from 0 kilometers per hour to 100 kilometers per hour. It also has a butterfly door that reflects the style of the supercar...”
Along the way, Chen Yun felt that this car was not bad.
“How much is this car?”
“It costs 3.7 million. Based on my authority, I can give you a discount. It only costs 3.4 million.”
“Okay, swipe my card. I’ll take this car.”

Chen Yun held out his card, causing Zhou Jingyi to be stunned. However, she quickly took it and could not help but smile. “Sir, I’ll get you some coffee. Please sit here and wait for a moment. I’ll settle it for you.”
“Wait.”
Eh? Zhou Jingyi suddenly turned around, her heart tightening. Could it be that he had gone back on her word?
Chen Yun took out his phone. “I still have a 15-yuan discount coupon. Can I use it?”
Zhou Jingyi was speechless.
These evil rich people!

paragraphs: However, she still smiled. “Of course, Mr. Chen.”
After a while, Zhou Jingyi came back and handed the car keys to Chen Yun. “Sir, do you want me to handle the license plate and insurance, or should I go to the DMV with you now?”
Afraid that Chen Yun would be confused, Zhou Jingyi explained, “I’ll go with you. We can get you a better license plate.”
“Then let’s go now.”
“Okay.”
Chen Yun drove the McLaren sports car and brought Zhou Jingyi to the DMV.
On the way.
“Mr. Chen, this is my business card. If anything happens to this car, you can call me immediately to help you deal with it,” said Manager Zhou as she placed a business card beside Chen Yun.
When they arrived at the DMV, they stopped the car. Zhou Jingyi quickly got out of the car and went to Chen Yun’s side to help open the car door. “Mr. Chen, please don’t rush.”
While Zhou Jingyi was helping Chen Yun to open the door, people kept greeting her.
“Manager Zhou, you’re here.”
“Hello, Manager Zhou.”
When the surrounding people saw this scene, they understood.
Who was Zhou Jingyi? She was the manager of McLaren’s car dealership, yet she was at this young man’s beck and call. It could be seen how important this young man was.
Chen Yun looked at the reaction of these people towards Zhou Jingyi and nodded. Zhou Jingyi was quite interpersonal and was a good talent. It was no wonder she became a manager at such a young age.
When they arrived at the license plate lottery, Zhou Jingyi looked at Chen Yun. “Mr. Chen, please wait a moment. I’ll notify them.”
“There’s no need. I’ll just draw the numbers normally.”
“Well ...”
Zhou Jingyi stood on her tiptoes and leaned into Chen Yun’s ear. “Mr. Chen, we can arrange a good license plate for you. If you choose your own number, I’m afraid it will be unsatisfactory.”
“Don’t worry, I believe in my luck.” Chen Yun didn’t care at all.
After all, the “Full of Luck” skill was not a joke.
Seeing Chen Yun like this, Zhou Jingyi did not say anything and stood beside him.
Those who knew Zhou Jingyi were stunned to see her accompanying Chen Yunyao.
“Look, isn’t that McLaren’s Manager Zhou?”
“Yes, that’s right. She can definitely just notify them. Why is he drawing for numbers?”
“I think Manager Zhou wanted to notify them just now, but this young man didn’t let her do so. We really don’t understand the lives of rich people.”
“Heh, just you wait. Most of them have number plates with
fours
today. There aren’t many good numbers. I want to see if this rich second-generation heir will beg for a change after drawing that number plate.”
“Heheh, that’ll be interesting. Who asked him to show off?”
A few staff members whispered among themselves. They wanted to see what would happen in the future and treated it as entertainment in their boring lives.
On the other side.
“Mr. Chen, it’s our turn to draw numbers.”

To be honest, Zhou Jingyi had already thought of how she could help Chen Yun change the license number after he got a bad number. After all, there were no good numbers in the pool. Those good numbers had been taken away by a few big car dealerships.
Chen Yun rubbed his hands and acted as if he was taking this very seriously.
Many people couldn’t help but laugh. This was as if it was real.
Even the people in the queue at the back came over. After all, they were all here to get a license number. They had nothing to do and came over to take a look.
When Chen Yun pressed the button, everyone couldn’t help but take a deep breath, especially Zhou Jingyi. Her beautiful eyes looked at the screen.
“This, this, this!”
“F*ck, how heartless!”
“Why is this license plate number in the pool? It doesn’t make sense!”
The number that appeared on the screen was Jiang A66666!
“The number is 666666!”
“How
impressive
“What kind of luck is this? How was he able to get such a number? Could it be that I have to rub my hands together before drawing a number?”
Even the staff were dumbfounded. “This doesn’t make sense!”
“No way! Are all rich people lucky?!”
“I’ve learned something. I’ve really learned something.”
The few people who were watching the commotion shook their heads in disbelief.

Even Zhou Jingyi was stunned. Then, she looked at Chen Yun. He had a calm expression, as if he knew that he would get such a number plate. When Chen Yun saw Zhou Jingyi looking at him, he chuckled. “The license number is not bad. My luck is not bad.”
Zhou Jingyi was speechless. This was not just “not bad”. He was simply too lucky!
He must be the reincarnation of the God of luck!
Could it be that a handsome and rich person would have more luck?
Many people behind looked at the license plate and looked for Chen Yun. “Young man, how about this? I’ll pay 80,000 yuan to buy this license plate!”
“Stop fighting, stop fighting. I’ll pay 300,000 yuan! Is there anyone higher than me!”

A middle-aged man with a big belly walked over. His words made everyone shut up. He walked in front of Chen Yun and said, “Young man, I’ll pay 300,000 yuan. My S-Class Mercedes-Benz is missing a license plate.”
If he hung this license plate and went out to discuss business, his success rate would be at least 10% higher.
The man was full of confidence and looked confident. Zhou Jingyi, who was beside him, could not help but smile. “Uncle, I’m afraid that your S-Class Mercedes-Benz won’t match this license plate.”
Did she say that his car wouldn’t match this license plate?
That was a million-dollar car!
“Hehe, if my car won’t match this license plate, will yours? What kind of car do you have to be so arrogant?”
“It’s a supercar.” Zhou Jingyi chuckled.

“If you don’t want to sell it, then don’t. Why are you talking about supercars? You’re just bluffing,” said the middle-aged man resentfully when he saw that the other party had no intention of selling it.
Chen Yun did not comment and looked to the side. “Manager Zhou, help me settle this.”
“Alright, Mr. Chen.” Zhou Jingyi nodded. It did not take long for her to get the license plate.
Just as the two of them were about to go and settle the license plate with the staff, the middle-aged man from before chased after them.
“Young man, I’ll add another 80,000 yuan. I’ll pay 380,000. Can you give me the license plate?”
Chen Yun touched his nose. “Uncle, to be honest, your S-Class Mercedes-Benz really doesn’t match this license plate. I’m not bluffing. It’s better for this license plate to hang on my car.”
Then, Chen Yun pressed the car key. Not far away, the headlights of a black McLaren sports car flashed. “Uncle, if you don’t believe me, you can compare our cars.”
Was it really a supercar?!
“Look, I said it doesn’t match your car, right?”

“This... Haha, that’s true.” The middle-aged man looked embarrassed. He looked at Chen Yun and handed him his business card. “I didn’t expect you to be so young and promising. My name is Wang Dalong, and I’m the manager of Donghai City. If you have time to come to my place for dinner, I’ll give you a discount.”
[Check-in Mission: Donghai City. Time: Today, 1 pm.]
[Check-in Reward: Extreme Figure.]
[Extreme Figure: Including but not limited to eight-pack abs, balanced body fat...]

Chen Yun looked at Wang Dalong and said, “Don’t say that. I’m a person who can’t wait until tomorrow. I’ll go later. Manager Zhou, you haven’t eaten lunch yet, right? Manager Wang, you too. Come, let’s have a meal together.”
“Okay.”
“In case, sorry to bother you, Mr. Chen.”

Zhou Jingyi stood on her tiptoes and leaned into Chen Yun’s ear.
“Mr.
Chen, we can arrange a good license plate for you.
If you choose your own number, I’m afraid it will be unsatisfactory.”
“Don’t worry, I believe in my luck.” Chen Yun didn’t care at all.
After all, the “Full of Luck” skill was not a joke.
Seeing Chen Yun like this, Zhou Jingyi did not say anything and stood beside him.
Those who knew Zhou Jingyi were stunned to see her accompanying Chen Yunyao.
“Look, isn’t that McLaren’s Manager Zhou?”
“Yes, that’s right.
She can definitely just notify them.
Why is he drawing for numbers?”
“I think Manager Zhou wanted to notify them just now, but this young man didn’t let her do so.
We really don’t understand the lives of rich people.”
“Heh, just you wait.
Most of them have number plates with
fours
today.
There aren’t many good numbers.
I want to see if this rich second-generation heir will beg for a change after drawing that number plate.”
“Heheh, that’ll be interesting.
Who asked him to show off?”
A few staff members whispered among themselves.
They wanted to see what would happen in the future and treated it as entertainment in their boring lives.
On the other side.
“Mr.
Chen, it’s our turn to draw numbers.”
To be honest, Zhou Jingyi had already thought of how she could help Chen Yun change the license number after he got a bad number.
After all, there were no good numbers in the pool.
Those good numbers had been taken away by a few big car dealerships.
Chen Yun rubbed his hands and acted as if he was taking this very seriously.
Many people couldn’t help but laugh.
This was as if it was real.
Even the people in the queue at the back came over.
After all, they were all here to get a license number.
They had nothing to do and came over to take a look.
When Chen Yun pressed the button, everyone couldn’t help but take a deep breath, especially Zhou Jingyi.
Her beautiful eyes looked at the screen.
“This, this, this!”
“F*ck, how heartless!”
“Why is this license plate number in the pool?
It doesn’t make sense!”
The number that appeared on the screen was Jiang A66666!
“The number is 666666!”
“How
impressive
“What kind of luck is this?
How was he able to get such a number?
Could it be that I have to rub my hands together before drawing a number?”
Even the staff were dumbfounded.
“This doesn’t make sense!”
“No way!
Are all rich people lucky?!”
“I’ve learned something.
I’ve really learned something.”
The few people who were watching the commotion shook their heads in disbelief.
Even Zhou Jingyi was stunned.
Then, she looked at Chen Yun.
He had a calm expression, as if he knew that he would get such a number plate.
When Chen Yun saw Zhou Jingyi looking at him, he chuckled.
“The license number is not bad.
My luck is not bad.”
Zhou Jingyi was speechless.
This was not just “not bad”.
He was simply too lucky!
He must be the reincarnation of the God of luck!
Could it be that a handsome and rich person would have more luck?
Many people behind looked at the license plate and looked for Chen Yun.
“Young man, how about this?
I’ll pay 80,000 yuan to buy this license plate!”
“Stop fighting, stop fighting.
I’ll pay 300,000 yuan!
Is there anyone higher than me!”
A middle-aged man with a big belly walked over.
His words made everyone shut up.
He walked in front of Chen Yun and said, “Young man, I’ll pay 300,000 yuan.
My S-Class Mercedes-Benz is missing a license plate.”
If he hung this license plate and went out to discuss business, his success rate would be at least 10% higher.
The man was full of confidence and looked confident.
Zhou Jingyi, who was beside him, could not help but smile.
“Uncle, I’m afraid that your S-Class Mercedes-Benz won’t match this license plate.”
Did she say that his car wouldn’t match this license plate?
That was a million-dollar car!
“Hehe, if my car won’t match this license plate, will yours?
What kind of car do you have to be so arrogant?”
“It’s a supercar.” Zhou Jingyi chuckled.
“If you don’t want to sell it, then don’t.
Why are you talking about supercars?
You’re just bluffing,” said the middle-aged man resentfully when he saw that the other party had no intention of selling it.
Chen Yun did not comment and looked to the side.
“Manager Zhou, help me settle this.”
“Alright, Mr.
Chen.” Zhou Jingyi nodded.
It did not take long for her to get the license plate.
Just as the two of them were about to go and settle the license plate with the staff, the middle-aged man from before chased after them.
“Young man, I’ll add another 80,000 yuan.
I’ll pay 380,000.
Can you give me the license plate?”
Chen Yun touched his nose.
“Uncle, to be honest, your S-Class Mercedes-Benz really doesn’t match this license plate.
I’m not bluffing.
It’s better for this license plate to hang on my car.”
Then, Chen Yun pressed the car key.
Not far away, the headlights of a black McLaren sports car flashed.
“Uncle, if you don’t believe me, you can compare our cars.”
Was it really a supercar?!
“Look, I said it doesn’t match your car, right?”
“This...
Haha, that’s true.” The middle-aged man looked embarrassed.
He looked at Chen Yun and handed him his business card.
“I didn’t expect you to be so young and promising.
My name is Wang Dalong, and I’m the manager of Donghai City.
If you have time to come to my place for dinner, I’ll give you a discount.”
[Check-in Mission: Donghai City.
Time: Today, 1 pm.]
[Check-in Reward: Extreme Figure.]
[Extreme Figure: Including but not limited to eight-pack abs, balanced body fat...]
Chen Yun looked at Wang Dalong and said, “Don’t say that.
I’m a person who can’t wait until tomorrow.
I’ll go later.
Manager Zhou, you haven’t eaten lunch yet, right?
Manager Wang, you too.
Come, let’s have a meal together.”
“Okay.”
“In case, sorry to bother you, Mr.
Chen.”

chapters.title: Chapter 5
paragraphs: Extreme Figure
Chen Yun drove Zhou Jingyi and Wang Dalong to Donghai City.

Donghai City was the only five-star hotel in Jiang City. It was located in the center of Jiang City and was surrounded by business districts. Just based on this location alone, no matter what business they did, they would definitely make a profit.
As the saying went, in the eye of the storm, even a pig could take off.
Let alone Donghai City.

When they stepped into Donghai City, the huge crystal chandelier hung above the hall. At this moment, the sunlight outside shone in and shone on the chandelier, emitting seven-colored light and making the hall seem like a dream.
Just this appearance was created with money.
A waitress looked at them and quickly walked over. “Manager Wang.”

“Arrange for the Tenghai Chamber,” said Wang Dalong to the waitress in an unquestionable tone. Chen Yun and Zhou Jingyi couldn’t help but think highly of him. Manager Wang’s status in Donghai City wasn’t low.
When they walked into Tenghai Chamber, they could see the prosperity of Jiang City from afar.
Wang Dalong walked to Chen Yun’s side. “Mr. Chen, the scenery during the day is not good. If we come at night, we can take in the night view of Jiang City and the bustling streets.”
“Oh.”
Chen Yun responded. When he turned around, Wang Dalong quickly pulled the main seat out. “Mr. Chen, please.”
Then, the waitress brought over three menus.
“See if there’s anything you want to eat and order first. I’ll add on later.” Chen Yun put down the menu and looked at the two of them.
“How expensive!”
Zhou Jingyi opened the menu. Even though she knew that Donghai City was a five-star hotel, she was still shocked by the price.
It was really too expensive!
A casual dish cost hundreds!
Not to mention those ferocious seafood dishes!
“It’s fine. Order whatever you want.” Chen Yun didn’t care at all. If this was in the past, he might not have dared to look, but now, he didn’t care about the money.
Last night, he gave a first prize to the children in the mountains. Today, he gave two first prizes to his parents. Would he care about this bit of money?
“Then... I’ll have three Australian lobsters.” Zhou Jingyi took a look. They sold the lobsters individually for 888 yuan a piece.
Even though she was the manager of McLaren’s car dealership, she did not dare to order more.
As for Wang Dalong, he did not open the menu.
“Alright, I’ll do it.”
Chen Yun opened the menu. He ordered shark fin, Australian abalone, French foie gras, white truffle...
With this assortment of dishes, this meal cost about 100,000 yuan.
“By the way, give us another bottle of red wine. That’s all.”
Chen Yun tapped on the menu, and the waitress walked over. “Sir, would you like this Castle Margot 2003 Dry Red Wine?”
“Yes.”
Hiss!
Hearing this, Wang Dalong could not help but gasp. How rich was this young man? Just that bottle of wine alone cost 20,000 yuan. In total, this entire meal had already exceeded 100,000 yuan!
How was he an ordinary rich second-generation heir?!
Moreover, Chen Yun’s face was not red and his heart did not skip a beat throughout the entire process. It was as if he had spent two yuan on a lollipop.
Such a mentality and temperament made others blush with shame.
Wang Dalong recalled the process of buying the license plate with Chen Yun. It was simply ridiculous.
What a joke!
[It’s time to check in. Host, please check in.]
[Successfully checked in and obtained an Extreme Figure!]
[The transformation will be completed within an hour.]
Then, a warm current ran through Chen Yun’s body.
The three of them ate with great relish for more than an hour. It was extremely comfortable.
After the meal, Wang Dalong looked at Chen Yun. “Mr. Chen, why don’t we take a look at the ingredient tank below?”
“Is there anything there?” Zhou Jingyi asked.
“Manager Zhou, there’s seafood shipped from all over the world and many rare items there.”
Oh?
When Chen Yun heard Wang Dalong’s words, he was also interested. “Let’s go and take a look.”
When they arrived at the tank area, Chen Yun widened his eyes. Huge water tanks were placed in this area, and all kinds of fresh seafood were swimming around.
There were sharks and crocodiles.
They were not the only ones there. There were also many customers enjoying the view.
Chen Yun and the others walked to a small water tank and looked at the lobsters that had been tied up inside.
The lobsters were colorful and were as long as a forearm.
“Mr. Chen, this is the ornate spiny lobster from Hainan.”
Chen Yun took off his coat, and Zhou Jingyi quickly took it from him.
He rolled up his sleeves.
Then, he grabbed an ornate spiny lobster.
In the next moment, the huge tail of the ornate spiny lobster turned, and a large amount of water splashed on Chen Yun’s face and body.
“Oh my God!”
This shocked Wang Dalong. He quickly asked the waiter beside him to bring some tissue over.
Chen Yun wiped his face and put his hair back to make it look like a slicked-back hairstyle.
Not far away, many people looked at Chen Yun and began to whisper.
“Nini, look at the handsome guy over there. Look at his chest and abs. Look at his face too. He’s so handsome when he reveals his forehead.”
“What a great figure!”
The wet shirt stuck to Chen Yun’s body, revealing his muscles. He didn’t have a lot of muscles, but every muscle appeared just right, as if it was naturally carved.
Many girls beside him were starry-eyed.
Even Zhou Jingyi was stunned at this moment. This figure was too good.
He had a handsome and rich figure.
It was so perfect that there was no room for criticism!
“Mr. Chen, come with me. Don’t catch a cold.”
“Oh.”
After taking a shower and changing his clothes, Chen Yun looked at the time. “Alright, Manager Zhou. I’ll send you back.”

Seeing that Chen Yun was about to leave, Wang Dalong walked all the way to the door and handed over a card. “Mr. Chen, you’ve spent more than 100,000 yuan here. You’re already our VIP. With a VIP card, you can get a 20% discount.”
“Okay, thanks.”
After Chen Yun sent Manager Zhou home, he went to the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion.
The sound of the McLaren had long been noticed by the property management staff.
Seeing Chen Yun come, the security guard quickly opened the door. “Sir, please come in.”
“Thanks.”
Chen Yun’s words instantly stunned the security guard. He was so rich yet approachable. The rich people from before barely glanced at them.
After walking in, a pretty girl in her twenties stood up. “Sir, what can I do for you?”
“I’m here to get the keys to Villa No. 3.”
Villa No. 3!
Upon hearing this term, everyone was shocked!
Villa No. 3 was one of the largest villas in the entire Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion. It was extremely luxurious. Back then, it was said that the cost of building it was close to 200 million!
Furthermore, it used the most advanced smart home system and home robots that integrated global technology.
Unexpectedly, the owner of that villa was a young man.
“Are you Mr. Chen Yun?”
Chen Yun took out his identity card. “That’s me.”
“Alright, I’ll bring you to Villa No. 3.” The girl walked out of the front desk and brought Chen Yun to the tour bus towards Imperial Dragon Heavenly Pavilion.
The Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion was really too big. It was so big that it was a five-minute drive from the entrance to Villa No. 3.
Standing in front of Villa No. 3, Chen Yun finally knew what kind of mansion he had taken over!

chapters.title: Chapter 6
paragraphs: Imperial Dragon Pavilion!

The white wooden fence and the maroon roof were romantic and dignified. Meanwhile, the tall entrance hall, the grand entrance, the round arched windows, and the stone bricks around the corner were all very elegant.
After entering, Chen Yun stepped on the carpet and looked at the surrounding scenery. Every part of the scenery was exquisite, and every inch was made with a huge sum of money!
The living room was brightly lit. The girl walked over with Chen Yun.
“Mr. Chen, please record your biological information here.”
“Please record your fingerprints, voiceprints, pupils...”
Chen Yun entered the information one by one. After that, the home system of the entire house was fully activated.
A few robots in the corner were activated and began to clean the house automatically.

“Mr. Chen, you can give them an order now. These are all home robots that have fused with the most advanced technology in the world. They can clean the house, entertain guests, and so on,” said the girl with envy in her eyes.
Who wouldn’t be envious!
This was a mansion that occupied thousands of square meters!
It implemented top-notch renovation materials and designs by top-notch renovation designers.
It had an extremely luxurious interior!
It even had the world’s top home robot!
It was not an exaggeration to say that this was heaven on Earth!
It was a preview of human life in 50 or 100 years!
The young man in front of her would enjoy the life of the future so many years in advance.

Chen Yun looked at the villa and was extremely excited. It was no wonder that the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion was known as the most luxurious district in Jiang City. Just the location and configuration were worthy.
This neighborhood was probably ranked among the top in the entire country.
“Serve some tea.”
As soon as he said this, the robot in front of him moved. It placed a teacup in front of Chen Yun and the girl respectively before pouring tea.
“Mr. Chen, I don’t need tea...”
“It’s fine. Drink it. If you don’t want tea, there should be coffee.”
Chen Yun waved his hand and stood up, looking at the scenery not far away.
The Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion was located on the mountainside. One could see a river in front and a mountain behind. Such a scenery really made one feel good.
The girl left after a while. Chen Yun sat on the sofa and looked at his phone. At noon, a brown robot came to Chen Yun. “Master, this is the menu. You can order and we’ll cook.”
“The recipes of top Michelin chefs have been added into our system. Don’t worry.”
After eating and drinking his fill, Chen Yun lay on the bed.
He did not have the habit of taking an afternoon nap, but this bed was just too soft!
It simply made people feel like they were in the clouds. What could he do? He was also in despair!
In the next moment, a screen flashed and words appeared on it.
[It is time to check in. Host, please check in.]
“Another check-in? Didn’t I just check in this morning?”
[The check-in timings and missions are irregular. They might appear a few times a day or not even once a month.]
“I see.” Chen Yun nodded to himself. He looked at the check-in button on the screen in front of him and pressed it.
[Check-in successful. Congratulations to the host for obtaining the Random Double skill.]
[Random Double: A skill that can be upgraded. It can be upgraded based on one’s spending. This skill can multiply the rewards obtained from checking in.]
[Level-1 (0/10,000,000): Rewards are multiplied by one to two times. The multiplier is random.]
[Level-2 (0/100,000,000): Rewards are multiplied by one to four times. The multiplier is random.]
Looking at the introduction, Chen Yun’s heart skipped a beat. Wasn’t this forcing him to spend money? One had to know that this skill complemented his “Full of Luck” skill!
To him, the multiplier would not be random. Since he was “Full of Luck”, he would obtain the maximum multiplier!
Even if he signed in for 100 million, after doubling it, it would still be hundreds of millions!
This was simply a bug!
Chen Yun immediately stood up like a carp and wanted to try it out.
Now that it was late and the shops outside were about to close, he might as well try it on his phone.
Coincidentally, he had a million shark fins that he had obtained from the Flying Fish platform. He could try using the skill on these items.
He would look for a candidate.
He opened his account and scrolled through the streamers he used to follow.

Many of the streamers that Chen Yun followed were not well-known. This was because when Chen Yun followed streamers, he also paid attention to the characters of the streamers. Occasionally, he would reward them with a small amount of shark fins he had obtained from lucky draws.
If the other party was someone who insulted the national anthem and the country, wouldn’t his tips be meaningless?

Most importantly, Chen Yun did not spend money previously. He relied on the shark fins he obtained to tip others. He did not even hear those big streamers thanking him. It was like a stone sinking into the sea.
It was better to hear a sweet “thank you” from a small streamer.
As he was searching, Chen Yun happened to find a streamer, who he liked previously, streaming.
It was Jiang City’s Xiao Xin!
Xiao Xin was considered a part-time streamer.
While attending university, she earned her living expenses. Although it was not much, she could still be self-sufficient and satisfy her daily expenses.

However, the difference between being streamers now was too great. For example, those big streamers could earn hundreds of thousands or millions a day. As for her, she could earn more than a hundred a day. When her earnings were low, she wouldn’t even be able to buy a melon if she did not livestream for a few hours.
Logically speaking, that shouldn’t be the case.
‘She was now 20 years old and was in the modeling department of the Jiang City Art Academy. Her looks were considered outstanding and could sing and dance well.

Whether it was her looks, figure, or voice, she was much better than those big streamers. Moreover, her appearance was natural. Those people either had plastic surgery or used various makeup, filters, and beauty enhancements.
The fans who tipped Sister Qiao the most should have a deep understanding of this.
However, later on, she got over it. After all, she wasn’t frivolous enough. She would not act coquettishly and was not full of dirty jokes or boasting.
Moreover, those streamers either had a sugar daddy or a team behind them.
As the saying went, every successful person had a powerful team behind them.
This was true.

“Sigh, at the end of the day, why haven’t any rich people found me?” As she spoke, Xiao Xin leaned on the table, looked at the screen, and asked the few people in the live-stream what song to sing next.
Looking at the gifts backstage, it was simply difficult to explain them in a few words. Needless to say, she wouldn’t even be able to buy half a melon today, let alone a whole melon.
“It’s so hard for me.”

Sighing, Xiao Xin looked at her phone. She would probably have to ask her family for money this month. She had just told her parents a few days ago that she didn’t have to worry about food and clothing, and now...
She wondered if her brother, Xiao Hao, had recovered in the hospital.
When she thought of her brother, her eyes welled up with tears, but she couldn’t cry during the live-stream.
“Everyone, let’s end today’s live-stream first. I’m going offline.”
Xiao Xin was also afraid that she would not be able to control her emotions.
As soon as she said this, a few comments appeared in the live-stream.
“Don’t go.”
“Sing another song. If you sing another song, I’ll send you rockets.”
Haha!
Could she trust them? Those big liars!
That’s what they all said every time she was about to go offline!
Just as she was about to go offline, she suddenly saw a name pop up on the screen.
“The Violent Young Man from Jiang City has entered the live-stream room.”
Puff!
She had also seen the news about the violent young man in Jiang City recently. She did not expect that a counterfeit would appear so quickly.
She naturally did not believe that this was Chen Yun.
“Host, sing another song. How about this? Sing one song and I’ll send you a super rocket.”
A super rocket cost 2,000 yuan!
Chen Yun’s words were like a torpedo that instantly blew up the few live-stream viewers.
“Who are you? You even claimed that you would send a super rocket for each song. Brother, look at your account. You haven’t even tipped before, right? You don’t even have any fan points.”
“Tsk tsk, you’re really lying.”
“I’m impressed. What kind of people are they nowadays? They’re still willing to pretend when they don’t have money. Is there any point?”
“If you have the ability, don’t talk nonsense.”

Xiao Xin looked at the debate on the screen and quickly interrupted them. “Don’t argue, don’t argue. If you have the ability, then donate. If not, then forget it. It’s good enough that everyone can watch my live-stream. How about this? You guys can choose a song. I’ll sing another one.”
Xiao Xin had been tired all day and was in a bad mood. Her eyelids were about to close, but looking at the situation in the live-stream, she sighed...
It was also a favor to freeload in her live-stream. She would continue the live-stream for a while longer.
As soon as she finished speaking, she saw a super rocket soar into the sky on the screen.
Xiao Xin, who had lost control of her emotions, suddenly froze. She was stunned.
It was a super rocket!
It was really a super rocket that cost 2,000 yuan!
This was the first time someone had given her a super rocket!

sentences.text: Imperial Dragon Pavilion!
The white wooden fence and the maroon roof were romantic and dignified.
Meanwhile, the tall entrance hall, the grand entrance, the round arched windows, and the stone bricks around the corner were all very elegant.
After entering, Chen Yun stepped on the carpet and looked at the surrounding scenery.
Every part of the scenery was exquisite, and every inch was made with a huge sum of money!
The living room was brightly lit.
The girl walked over with Chen Yun.
“Mr.
Chen, please record your biological information here.”
“Please record your fingerprints, voiceprints, pupils...”
Chen Yun entered the information one by one.
After that, the home system of the entire house was fully activated.
A few robots in the corner were activated and began to clean the house automatically.
“Mr.
Chen, you can give them an order now.
These are all home robots that have fused with the most advanced technology in the world.
They can clean the house, entertain guests, and so on,” said the girl with envy in her eyes.
Who wouldn’t be envious!
This was a mansion that occupied thousands of square meters!
It implemented top-notch renovation materials and designs by top-notch renovation designers.
It had an extremely luxurious interior!
It even had the world’s top home robot!
It was not an exaggeration to say that this was heaven on Earth!
It was a preview of human life in 50 or 100 years!
The young man in front of her would enjoy the life of the future so many years in advance.
Chen Yun looked at the villa and was extremely excited.
It was no wonder that the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion was known as the most luxurious district in Jiang City.
Just the location and configuration were worthy.
This neighborhood was probably ranked among the top in the entire country.
“Serve some tea.”
As soon as he said this, the robot in front of him moved.
It placed a teacup in front of Chen Yun and the girl respectively before pouring tea.
“Mr.
Chen, I don’t need tea...”
“It’s fine.
Drink it.
If you don’t want tea, there should be coffee.”
Chen Yun waved his hand and stood up, looking at the scenery not far away.
The Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion was located on the mountainside.
One could see a river in front and a mountain behind.
Such a scenery really made one feel good.
The girl left after a while.
Chen Yun sat on the sofa and looked at his phone.
At noon, a brown robot came to Chen Yun.
“Master, this is the menu.
You can order and we’ll cook.”
“The recipes of top Michelin chefs have been added into our system.
Don’t worry.”
After eating and drinking his fill, Chen Yun lay on the bed.
He did not have the habit of taking an afternoon nap, but this bed was just too soft!
It simply made people feel like they were in the clouds.
What could he do?
He was also in despair!
In the next moment, a screen flashed and words appeared on it.
[It is time to check in.
Host, please check in.]
“Another check-in?
Didn’t I just check in this morning?”
[The check-in timings and missions are irregular.
They might appear a few times a day or not even once a month.]
“I see.” Chen Yun nodded to himself.
He looked at the check-in button on the screen in front of him and pressed it.
[Check-in successful.
Congratulations to the host for obtaining the Random Double skill.]
[Random Double: A skill that can be upgraded.
It can be upgraded based on one’s spending.
This skill can multiply the rewards obtained from checking in.]
[Level-1 (0/10,000,000): Rewards are multiplied by one to two times.
The multiplier is random.]
[Level-2 (0/100,000,000): Rewards are multiplied by one to four times.
The multiplier is random.]
Looking at the introduction, Chen Yun’s heart skipped a beat.
Wasn’t this forcing him to spend money?
One had to know that this skill complemented his “Full of Luck” skill!
To him, the multiplier would not be random.
Since he was “Full of Luck”, he would obtain the maximum multiplier!
Even if he signed in for 100 million, after doubling it, it would still be hundreds of millions!
This was simply a bug!
Chen Yun immediately stood up like a carp and wanted to try it out.
Now that it was late and the shops outside were about to close, he might as well try it on his phone.
Coincidentally, he had a million shark fins that he had obtained from the Flying Fish platform.
He could try using the skill on these items.
He would look for a candidate.
He opened his account and scrolled through the streamers he used to follow.
Many of the streamers that Chen Yun followed were not well-known.
This was because when Chen Yun followed streamers, he also paid attention to the characters of the streamers.
Occasionally, he would reward them with a small amount of shark fins he had obtained from lucky draws.
If the other party was someone who insulted the national anthem and the country, wouldn’t his tips be meaningless?
Most importantly, Chen Yun did not spend money previously.
He relied on the shark fins he obtained to tip others.
He did not even hear those big streamers thanking him.
It was like a stone sinking into the sea.
It was better to hear a sweet “thank you” from a small streamer.
As he was searching, Chen Yun happened to find a streamer, who he liked previously, streaming.
It was Jiang City’s Xiao Xin!
Xiao Xin was considered a part-time streamer.
While attending university, she earned her living expenses.
Although it was not much, she could still be self-sufficient and satisfy her daily expenses.
However, the difference between being streamers now was too great.
For example, those big streamers could earn hundreds of thousands or millions a day.
As for her, she could earn more than a hundred a day.
When her earnings were low, she wouldn’t even be able to buy a melon if she did not livestream for a few hours.
Logically speaking, that shouldn’t be the case.
‘She was now 20 years old and was in the modeling department of the Jiang City Art Academy.
Her looks were considered outstanding and could sing and dance well.
Whether it was her looks, figure, or voice, she was much better than those big streamers.
Moreover, her appearance was natural.
Those people either had plastic surgery or used various makeup, filters, and beauty enhancements.
The fans who tipped Sister Qiao the most should have a deep understanding of this.
However, later on, she got over it.
After all, she wasn’t frivolous enough.
She would not act coquettishly and was not full of dirty jokes or boasting.
Moreover, those streamers either had a sugar daddy or a team behind them.
As the saying went, every successful person had a powerful team behind them.
This was true.

“Sigh, at the end of the day, why haven’t any rich people found me?” As she spoke, Xiao Xin leaned on the table, looked at the screen, and asked the few people in the live-stream what song to sing next.
Looking at the gifts backstage, it was simply difficult to explain them in a few words.
Needless to say, she wouldn’t even be able to buy half a melon today, let alone a whole melon.
“It’s so hard for me.”
Sighing, Xiao Xin looked at her phone.
She would probably have to ask her family for money this month.
She had just told her parents a few days ago that she didn’t have to worry about food and clothing, and now...
She wondered if her brother, Xiao Hao, had recovered in the hospital.
When she thought of her brother, her eyes welled up with tears, but she couldn’t cry during the live-stream.
“Everyone, let’s end today’s live-stream first.
I’m going offline.”
Xiao Xin was also afraid that she would not be able to control her emotions.
As soon as she said this, a few comments appeared in the live-stream.
“Don’t go.”
“Sing another song.
If you sing another song, I’ll send you rockets.”
Haha!
Could she trust them?
Those big liars!
That’s what they all said every time she was about to go offline!
Just as she was about to go offline, she suddenly saw a name pop up on the screen.
“The Violent Young Man from Jiang City has entered the live-stream room.”
Puff!
She had also seen the news about the violent young man in Jiang City recently.
She did not expect that a counterfeit would appear so quickly.
She naturally did not believe that this was Chen Yun.
“Host, sing another song.
How about this?
Sing one song and I’ll send you a super rocket.”
A super rocket cost 2,000 yuan!
Chen Yun’s words were like a torpedo that instantly blew up the few live-stream viewers.
“Who are you?
You even claimed that you would send a super rocket for each song.
Brother, look at your account.
You haven’t even tipped before, right?
You don’t even have any fan points.”
“Tsk tsk, you’re really lying.”
“I’m impressed.
What kind of people are they nowadays?
They’re still willing to pretend when they don’t have money.
Is there any point?”
“If you have the ability, don’t talk nonsense.”
Xiao Xin looked at the debate on the screen and quickly interrupted them.
“Don’t argue, don’t argue.
If you have the ability, then donate.
If not, then forget it.
It’s good enough that everyone can watch my live-stream.
How about this?
You guys can choose a song.
I’ll sing another one.”
Xiao Xin had been tired all day and was in a bad mood.
Her eyelids were about to close, but looking at the situation in the live-stream, she sighed...
It was also a favor to freeload in her live-stream.
She would continue the live-stream for a while longer.
As soon as she finished speaking, she saw a super rocket soar into the sky on the screen.
Xiao Xin, who had lost control of her emotions, suddenly froze.
She was stunned.
It was a super rocket!
It was really a super rocket that cost 2,000 yuan!
This was the first time someone had given her a super rocket!

chapters.title: Chapter 7
paragraphs: Shocking the Internet!
Furthermore!
Most importantly!
There was more than one super rocket!
There were ten of them!
The number of super rockets was still rising!
Super rockets were still being sent!
One had to know that she could get half of the money of a super rocket, which was 1,000 yuan!
This wave of super rockets simply made the entire live-stream silent!
The people who had just mocked Chen Yun were stunned when they saw the super rockets being sent. Their hands that were typing on the keyboard began to tremble.
Once there was a disagreement, he simply started to spam tips!
This... was too terrifying!

In an instant, many viewers entered Xiao Xin’s live-stream after seeing the global announcement about the super rockets. They were prepared to grab rewards. The entire screen was instantly filled with comments of
As a large number of users surged in, the popularity of the live-stream increased.
However, the increase in the number of people could not compare to the increase in Chen Yun’s tips!
Each super rocket that flew into the sky cost 2,000 yuan!
Everyone who entered the live-stream all watched Chen Yun send super rockets.
Their eyes widened and their hearts beat faster and faster!
He had sent 100 super rockets!
They were worth 200,000 yuan!
He was still sending rockets!
Two hundred!
Three hundred!
Five hundred!
These super rockets cost one million yuan!
As there were hundreds of thousands of people entering the live-stream, and it was still increasing, the entire screen was painted white with comments.
“What kind of person is this?! He’s so rich to send super rockets like this!”
“What’s a tycoon? This is a tycoon! In a few minutes, he tipped a million yuan!”
“This is even better than those big streamers! It can simply turn those rich people into country bumpkins.”
“Do you think that the streamer is operating this by herself? However, this method is ruthless. This person is really willing to tip!”

Xiao Xin saw every comment. Others might not know, but she knew very well. How could she have the money to operate this by herself? If she had that money, she would have treated her brother long ago. Why would she have to work so hard to earn living expenses?
She had been sent 500 super rockets!
They were worth one million yuan!
She could get hundreds of thousands of yuan!
It was enough, absolutely enough!
For a moment, Xiao Xin felt grateful. Chen Yun was her benefactor and her talent scout!
“Thank you, thank you brother, thank you...” Xiao Xin didn’t know what to say and could only keep thanking him.
However, compared to the popularity of the live-stream and the surprise in Xiao Xin’s heart, Chen Yun’s heart fell to the bottom.
F*ck you!
He had tipped a million shark fins, but he hadn’t earned any spending points!
Wasn’t this a scam?
The next moment, Chen Yun suddenly frowned. He had earned one million shark fins for free. Could it be...
At that moment, Chen Yun simply topped up his account!
He would top up 10,000 yuan first to test the waters!
When Chen Yun topped up the money, everyone’s hearts began to calm down. They knew that this wave of madness was over. Everyone was also fighting for rewards. They were overjoyed.
Backstage, Xiao Xin’s manager also contacted Xiao Xin on WeChat.
[Manager: Xiao Xin, you’ve found a financial backer. Congratulations.]
[Xiao Xin: Manager, I’ll need you to take care of me in the future.]
[Manager: That’s for sure. I’ll give you a recommended spot when I come back. However, you have to contact this financial backer and seize the opportunity.]
Manager Liu Bo looked at the data and nodded in satisfaction. Not bad, not bad. This time, he had another streamer succeed under him. He could get more commission this time.
The other managers, who were playing mahjong with him, also noticed this wave of tips that was worth one million yuan. They congratulated Liu Bo one after another, making him feel proud.

Of course, those managers also had middle- and upper-level streamers under them. They were simply surprised by the million-dollar wave of tips and laughed on the spot. They immediately continued playing mahjong, but they did not realize the importance of the matter.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun had already topped up his account and tipped five more super rockets.
[Obtained 2,000 spending points.]
[Obtained 2,000 spending points.]
[Obtained 2,000 spending points.]
This was really useful!
Chen Yun immediately topped up more money and continued to tip.
The entire screen was filled with super rockets again.
“Again? He’s really a tycoon!”
“Just how much is he going to tip? He’s already tipped a million yuan! What else does he want?!”
“Tycoon, are you lacking in people to sponsor? Can you include me?”
“I have a chicken tile.”
“Two of a kind!” After one of the managers announced this, he heard the beeping sound of his phone and turned on the screen. “Hey, Liu Bo, look. Xiao Xin’s financial backer is starting to tip again.”
“He’s really rich. Damn, he’s already tipped hundreds of thousands.”
“Wait, let’s stop, let’s stop. The number of super rockets has reached 500. Another one million yuan has been tipped!”
Upon hearing this, all the managers put down their tiles and turned on their phones to pay attention to the situation.
“He sent a thousand super rockets! That’s worth two million!”
“Three million!”
“Four million!”
In a short period of time, the managers, who had been chatting happily, read out the numbers. Their voices gradually trembled, their faces gradually turned pale, and cold sweat gradually seeped out.
It was too terrifying!

The entire Flying Fish website was also swept by this wave of craze. One by one, the big streamers stopped their live-streams and paid attention to the craze. They could not help but shout in their hearts, “Why didn’t this big sponsor look for me!”

“He tipped more than nine million yuan! Including the previous one million yuan, he’s now tipped a total of ten million yuan!” A manager was about to take a sip of tea to calm himself down when his hand trembled and the teacup shattered.
They had been managers for so many years, but they had never seen such a terrifying scene.
Chen Yun had now broken the record for the highest amount of tips by an individual user on the entire Flying Fish platform!
The entire Flying Fish platform was witnessing this frenzy!
They were lucky enough to witness this in their lifetime!
In the end, the number stopped at 5,000 super rockets!
This was worth ten million yuan!
Including the previous one million, he had tipped a total of eleven million!!!
“I’m too tired to spam. Let’s stop here.”
Chen Yun’s words were extremely domineering!
The public chat in Xiao Xin’s live-stream instantly fell into chaos, causing the FPS of many users to drop!
The manager were silent for a long time. In the end, a manager slammed the table and stood up. “Liu Bo! You’ve undoubtedly been promoted this time. Bring us to supper later. You’ll treat us!”
“Alright, alright, alright. I’ll treat everyone.” Liu Bo smiled like a flower.
However, even if he agreed to treat them, it did not make the managers feel any less jealous.
With such a big financial backer, this streamer would definitely be able to rise. Meanwhile, Liu Bo would also be able to get a lot of money. How could they not be jealous?
Xiao Xin, who was sitting in front of the screen, was also stunned. She had received so much money!
If it wasn’t for tonight, she might not have seen this amount for the rest of her life!
She quickly sent a private message to Chen Yun, wanting to add him as a friend. After all, Chen Yun had saved her brother. Regardless of whether he needed it or not, she had to thank him.

Moreover, Xiao Xin did not hide anything. She also wanted to seize the opportunity. She had been buried at the bottom for too long. Even if it was a beam of light, she would not hesitate to grab it, let alone meet a talent scout like Chen Yun.
He was like a sun that illuminated the sky!
However, there was no response to her private message. It was not that Chen Yun did not respond on purpose, but he did not have the time to pay attention.
At this moment, his attention was focused on the screen.
[Congratulations to the host for upgrading the Random Double skill to Level-2.]
[Level-2 (10 million/100 million): Rewards are multiplied by one to four times. The multiplier is random.]
“How comfortable!”
Chen Yun lay on the bed. It was too comfortable!

chapters.title: Chapter 8
paragraphs: Very Perceptive
Then, Chen Yun saw the private message from Xiao Xin. After chatting for a while, Xiao Xin realized that Chen Yun was also in Jiang City.
[Xiao Xin: Brother Yun, let me treat you to a meal tomorrow to express my gratitude to you. Thank you so much.]
[Chen Yun: Alright, you can decide on a place. Send me your location tomorrow and I’ll pick you up.]
After the two of them confirmed their meeting, they realized that they had many common topics to talk about, so they chatted for a long time before lying down and preparing to sleep.
Early the next morning.
The first thing he did every day when he woke up was to hurry up and check in!
[Check-in successful. Reward: 100,000,000 yuan and one blue-and-white porcelain vase.]
He received a hundred million yuan and one blue-and-white porcelain vase!
[Random Double Skill activated!]
A dice appeared and stopped at 4!
[Check-in successful. Reward: 400,000,000 yuan and four blue-and-white porcelain vases.]
He had received 400 million yuan!

The bank notification sounded. Then, light circulated and four one-foot-tall blue-and-white porcelain vases appeared in front of Chen Yun. Chen Yun looked at the blue-and-white porcelain vases in front of him. They were incomparably exquisite. The body of the vase was delicate and white, and the enamel was moist and bright. Meanwhile, the blue and white color was rich and gorgeous. The pattern was mainly made up of winding and broken branches, and it was decorated with vines. It was complicated, full, and skillful.
It was a top-notch piece of blue and white porcelain!

He searched online. In recent years, the blue-and-white porcelain vases auctioned at Sotheby’s Auction House had been sold for tens of millions each. Moreover, their conditions were not as complete as the ones he had.
In other words, the blue-and-white porcelain vases in Chen Yun’s hands were worth at least tens of millions, or possibly hundreds of millions!
Furthermore, they were priceless treasures!
Chen Yun took a look. Then, he placed a few vases on the tables opposite the main door and some on the shelves of the study.
For a moment, the style of the entire villa improved again!
What a joke. These were cultural relics worth hundreds of millions!
Any one of them could be kept in the Palace Museum!
“Mm, not bad!”
After setting up the vases, Chen Yun picked up his phone and looked at the message Xiao Xin sent him.
[Xiao Xin: Brother Yun, where are we going for lunch today?]
[Chen Yun: I’ll pick you up first.]
[Xiao Xin: Okay, I’ll send you my location and wait for you.]
Chen Yun looked at the location. It was Jiang City University of the Arts. He drove the McLaren out of the garage and headed towards his destination.

Along the way, Chen Yun really did not face too much traffic. Moreover, he could tell that the surrounding cars were very far away from him. They were probably afraid that they would not be able to afford it if they touched his car.
Chen Yun arrived at the place quickly. He found a place to stop and called Xiao Xin.
