chapters.title: Chapter 9
paragraphs: Red Wine Worth 100,000 Yuan!
On the other side, Xiao Xin opened the door of the McLaren. She was excited. She had never sat in such a good sports car in her life.
At the entrance of the campus, many girls whispered, their eyes filled with jealousy.
Many girls looked at Chen Yun’s face, figure, and car. Their bodies could not help but heat up.
“Did you see that handsome guy? He’s so handsome and rich,” said a girl as she pulled her best friend aside.
“Don’t pull me. Let me take another look. He’s too handsome.”
“I want to give birth to his child.”
“Stop acting coquettishly. Why don’t you take a look at whether they want you or not?”
As many girls spoke, they could not help but clamp their legs together, their eyes sparkling.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun sat in the driver’s seat.
Just as they were about to leave, someone suddenly knocked on the glass.
Chen Yun rolled down the car window. There was another long-haired beauty outside.
“Hello, what’s the matter?” Chen Yun could not help but sigh. The quality of this beauty from the University of Art was too high.
“Handsome, can I add you on WeChat?” This beauty’s motive was self-evident. If everything went well, she could ask Chen Yun out for a drive.
Upon hearing the beauty’s words, Xiao Xin couldn’t help but raise her head, her eyes filled with nervousness.
Although she did not know why, it was as if she was threatened.
“Sorry, I don’t like to add strangers on WeChat. Sorry.” After Chen Yun finished speaking, Xiao Xin heaved a sigh of relief.
Then, Chen Yun closed the car window and left with Xiao Xin.
The beauty stomped her feet and said unwillingly, “What’s the big deal? Isn’t it just a McLaren supercar? I don’t care.”
The beauty was so angry.
However, she stomped her feet and looked enviously at the taillights of the McLaren sports car.
Women simply didn’t mean what they said.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun held the steering wheel with one hand and did not panic at all.
There was no need to tell him about prioritizing safety or following the rules.
He was now a man with the title of “God of Racing”. When had one ever seen an experienced driver fail?
The thunderous sound waves reverberated throughout the campus, attracting a series of gazes.
“How old are you?” Chen Yun asked Xiao Xin as he drove.
“I just turned 20. I’m in my sophomore year. What’s wrong?” Xiao Xin took out a piece of chocolate from her bag, opened it, and fed Chen Yun one.
Chen Yun looked at Xiao Xin’s calm and composed appearance, and instantly adapted to it. He smiled. “I’m not asking about your
age

Xiao Xin, who had been leaning against the seat and eating chocolate peacefully, suddenly blushed. Her ears were red. Then, she looked out of the window. “I don’t understand, I don’t understand. Um...”
As she spoke, Xiao Xin stuck out her tongue at Chen Yun.
For a moment, Chen Yun could not help but laugh. This girl.

“Brother Yun, let’s go to East Sea City to eat. Thank you for last night.” Xiao Xin looked at her phone and a pained expression appeared on her face. She had compared many restaurants last night and knew that Chen Yun was a rich man. She couldn’t embarrass him, so she chose East Sea City in the end.
Although she only had a few thousand yuan on her now, at most, she could borrow some money from her roommates and the credit lending software.
In any case, it would embarrass him if she dragged him to eat at a stall.
“It’s fine, it’s fine. The gift money will be transferred in a few days.” Xiao Xin comforted herself.
“Alright.” Chen Yun nodded when he heard that they were going to East Sea City.
The two of them arrived at East Sea City and entered a private room.
Xiao Xin handed the menu to Chen Yun. “Brother Yun, hurry up and order. Just order anything. It’s my treat.”
“Then I’ll rip you off.”
Chen Yun smiled. Then, looking at Xiao Xin’s pained expression, the smile on his face deepened.
Who asked a little girl like her to spend so much money?
Although he knew that the gift money wouldn’t arrive so quickly, he still liked to see her act tough.
It couldn’t be helped. The life of a rich person was so ordinary and boring.
“Then, give me this set meal and this bottle of red wine.”
Not long after, three or four exquisite dishes were served. Xiao Xin looked at these dishes and gently patted her voluptuous chest.
These were all ordinary dishes. There were no high-end seafood like lobsters and abalones.
She felt that she could do it again.
She could float again.
At the table, Xiao Xin and Chen Yun chatted as if they had endless topics to talk about. Chen Yun poured red wine for Xiao Xin. After drinking the red wine, Xiao Xin became more talkative.
However, Chen Yun did not drink.
After all, he drove here. How could he drink?
After eating, the two of them left the private room and entered the hall.
“How much is it?” Chen Yun asked. Xiao Xin, who was beside him, rushed forward and said, “I’ve already said that it’s my treat. You’re not allowed to snatch the bill.”
“Okay, you do it.”
The waiter looked at Xiao Xin. “Hello, Madam. The total cost is 115,650 yuan. I’ll charge you 115,600 yuan.”
The meal cost 115,600 yuan!
There were only a few dishes! Why were they so expensive?!

“I want to see the bill. Is it alright?” Xiao Xin, who was originally very stubborn and wanted to pay the bill, suddenly felt discouraged. She asked for the bill aggrievedly. The price of the dishes was fine.
However, that bottle of wine was 114,888 yuan!
It was a bottle of Latour Red Wine!
Xiao Xin was about to cry. It was no wonder she said that the wine was so delicious.
How could a bottle of wine that cost 100,000 yuan not taste good!
A bottle of wine was worth the money her entire family earned in a year!
She was in pain! She felt a heartache! Every part of her body hurt!
It was so painful that she could not breathe!
“Ummm, could you wait for a while for me to pay?” Xiao Xin looked at the waiter. She needed to make a few calls and do a few things to replenish her funds.
After making a few calls, she finally gathered enough money from her roommates and the official credit lending platform. It was not easy.
When Xiao Xin went back to pay the bill, the staff smiled and said, “Miss, this gentleman has already paid the bill.”
“Huh?”
This time, Xiao Xin was stunned for a moment. Then, a greedy look appeared in her eyes.
This time, she wouldn’t have to lose everything.
“Didn’t I say I’ll treat you? I’ve already gathered the money.”
Chen Yun looked at Xiao Xin and knew that she had gone to gather money. Of course, he did not pay the bill at the beginning because he wanted to tease her.
“We’re friends. What do you mean by treating me? It doesn’t matter.”
In the past, Chen Yun loved to make friends and never cared whether the other party was rich or not. In any case, the other party would be richer than him.
Now, he also liked to make friends. However, he didn’t care if the other party was rich or not. Anyway, the other party wasn’t as rich as him.
“Let’s go. I want to buy some clothes. Help me take a look.”
“Hey, Brother Yun, wait for me. I’ll get someone to pack the unfinished red wine first.”
That was 100,000 yuan worth of red wine! Previously, Xiao Xin had left 40% of the wine for the sake of her reputation. Shouldn’t she take it away now?

Previously, Xiao Xin had left 40% of the wine for the sake of her reputation.
Shouldn’t she take it away now?

chapters.title: Chapter 10
paragraphs: Brilliant, Really Brilliant!
After getting into the car, Chen Yun looked at Xiao Xin beside him and didn’t know whether to laugh or cry. “Why are you hugging that bottle of wine so tightly?”

“You make it sound so easy. This is a bottle of wine that costs 100,000 yuan per bottle. I’ve never drunk it before. The most expensive red wine I drank previously was Zhang Yu’s dry red wine. It’s not top-notch. I have to taste this properly again when I go back.”

As Xiao Xin spoke, she looked at the bottle of wine. Especially after knowing the price of this bottle of wine, the more she looked at it, the more exquisite it became. She believed that when she brought it back, she would definitely be able to taste something purer than noon.

“Right, right, I forgot to return the money I borrowed from my roommate.” As Xiao Xin spoke, she took out her phone and quickly transferred the money. She even transferred some additional money to everyone as interest.
She also quickly returned the money to the lending platform.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun brought Xiao Xin to Jiang City’s Century City.
Jiang City’s Century City was the largest commercial city in Jiang City.
This place was wider and had more international brands than Wanda Plaza.
After the two of them got out of the car, they went straight to the fifth floor. The fifth floor sold clothes. There were all kinds of brands and it was very big.
Many international brands could be seen here.
There were sports brands such as Adidas and Nike.
In addition, there were brands like Versace, Givenchy, Armani, and so on.
They were all luxury brands worldwide.
Of course, there were more women’s clothing brands here.
As they walked among the various brands, Chen Yun and Xiao Xin chatted casually. “Do you think I look better in a slim-fit shirt or a coat?”
After Xiao Xin answered, not far from her, two girls holding hands looked at Xiao Xin and were suddenly stunned. “Xiao Xin, why are you here?”
“Jingjing, Lin Yu, are you shopping?” Liu Xin looked at the two girls. They were her roommates from university, Zhang Jing and Lin Yu.
The two girls had just greeted Liu Xin when they looked at Chen Yun and were stunned.
How handsome!
It was as if a celestial being had walked out of a painting, untainted by the mortal world.
Zhang Jing pursed her lips and looked at Liu Xin. “Xiao Xin, I was wondering why you dressed up so early in the morning and went out. It turns out that you have a boyfriend. Why didn’t you tell us!”
“What are you talking about? This is Chen Yun. Brother Yun, these are my two roommates, Zhang Jing and Lin Yu.” Liu Xin quickly introduced them. Chen Yun also greeted them.

These two girls were about 1.7 meters tall and were about the same height as Liu Xin. Although their faces were not as beautiful as Liu Xin’s, they could still score above 85 points. They were definitely above the standard for beauties.
After greeting them, Zhang Jing pulled Liu Xin aside.
“Xiao Xin, where did you get to know such a handsome man? Be honest, is he your boyfriend?”
“Jingjing, he really isn’t. We just met last night when he tipped me.”
“Really?”
“Really!”

Zhang Jing raised her eyebrows. “Xiao Xin, how about this? I’ll treat you to a meal when I come back. Give me this handsome man’s WeChat. You might now know about this, but at first glance, I even thought of our child’s name in the future.”
“Cough, cough!”
Lin Yu suddenly coughed and looked at them. “Look at how disappointing the two of you are. And you, Xiao Xin. You followed him out without even knowing his background.”
“Tell me, did you borrow money from us just now because of him?”

“Let me tell you, the more handsome a man is, the higher the probability of him being a scumbag. Look at the entertainment industry. There’s so much blood and tears. People trick others into having sex and cheat people of their money. The two of you, be careful not to be cheated and even give money to others.” Lin Yu lectured the two of them like a big sister.
“He won’t cheat me of my money, Lin Yu. Don’t worry.” Liu Xin stuck out her tongue. What car did Chen Yun drive? He drove a McLaren!
It was worth more than three million yuan!
Not to mention the car, just the license plate alone was impressive!
It was Jiang A66666!
This license plate number definitely had enough sixes!
Moreover, he had spent 11 million yuan last night!
That was more than ten million yuan!
Seeing that Xiao Xin had no idea about the situation she was in, Lin Yu pouted. “We’ll be watching you this afternoon. Don’t let your brain get tricked by someone else.”
When Zhang Jing heard this, she nodded repeatedly. “Yes, we’re not going anywhere. We’ll just watch you.”
The next moment, Zhang Jing was slapped on the head. “Are you looking at her? You’re craving the body of the handsome man beside her. You’re cheap.”
Zhang Jing pulled back her head. She was unable to defend herself.
She was greedy! That was right!
Lin Yu sighed. These two roommates of hers really didn’t know how evil people could be.
“Oh, are you guys going shopping as roomies? That’s great.”
At the side, a girl walked out holding the hand of the man beside her. The girl was also tall and slender. It was obvious that she was also a model.
However, Xiao Xin and the others were not too enthusiastic when they saw this girl.
This was because they really couldn’t get enthusiastic about this person.
She was pretentious. When she bought something more expensive, she would take a photo and post it on her Moments.
Most importantly, she didn’t use her money. After all, she had to apply for financial assistance in the past.
Looking at the middle-aged man standing beside her, the source of her branded clothes were self-evident.
Actually, there was no shortage of such girls in the University of Art. This was their choice. Lin Yu and the rest also respected them.
After all, it had nothing to do with them.
However, Yu Yi, who was in front of them, often disgusted them. She showed off and posted all kinds of photos. She even tagged them sometimes.
This was too much.
She benefited from being a whore, yet she wanted to assert her chastity, afraid that others would not know about it.
Not only did they have such an attitude, but the other students also had the same attitude towards her.
“Why are you just standing outside the shop? Let’s go in and take a look. It doesn’t cost anything to take a look.” Yu Yi looked at the three of them and sneered.

The middle-aged man next to her looked at the three of them and his eyes almost popped out. They were three beauties, especially Xiao Xin. She had a golden ratio figure, a slender body, and curvaceous curves. Meanwhile, her long legs were simply a natural cannon.
With this face and figure, it was worth it no matter how much it cost.
“Xiao Xin, did you meet another friend?” Chen Yun walked over with his hands in his pockets. Yu Yi’s eyes lit up.
He was simply too handsome!
If not for the fact that she was afraid that the man beside her would be unhappy and cut off her source of income, she would have immediately asked for Chen Yun’s WeChat.
It would be convenient to ask him out in the future.
“Brother Yun, you must be anxious. I’m sorry.” Xiao Xin was afraid of neglecting Chen Yun, so she quickly apologized.
At this moment, the man also saw Chen Yun. Seeing that he was so close to the three girls and that Xiao Xin was passionate about him, the corners of his mouth twitched.
His eyes were filled with disgust, but he still forced a smile.

“Hello, you’re all Yu Yi’s classmates, right? I’m Xiu Zhifeng, the manager of the Human Resources Department at Zhiyuan Trade. If you want to intern or work here in the future, you can contact me. My contact information is here.”
The meaning of this sentence was self-evident.
It was easy for them to look for him and ask him to arrange a job for them, but there was always a price to pay.
How could the three girls not know what he meant? They did not know whether to accept it or not.
The next moment, a hand grabbed the few business cards.

“Manager Xiu, you’re so proficient in your speech. It seems like you’ve done a lot of similar things. Brilliant, really brilliant. I’ve learned something.” Chen Yun looked at the business cards and balled them up in his hand before pocketing them.

chapters.title: Chapter 11
paragraphs: Since You’re Not Buying It, Why Are You Pretending?
Seeing Chen Yun’s actions, Xiu Zhifeng’s face suddenly darkened.
As the manager of the Human Resources Department at Zhiyuan Trade, no one had dared to treat him like this.
However, Xiu Zhifeng couldn’t fly into a rage in front of the three beauties. He was still waiting for them to look for him.
“Young man, don’t be so angry. Otherwise, you’ll suffer in society.” Xiu Zhifeng looked at Chen Yun and sneered.
“It’s not my turn to suffer a loss. You don’t have to worry about it.”

When Xiu Zhifeng heard Chen Yun’s words, he nodded. His eyes were filled with malice. When he returned, he would definitely ask Yu Yi about this kid’s background. No one had ever dared to disrespect him like this in his entire life.
After asking around, he would get to work. After all, who didn’t have a few brothers in society? It might seem as if Xiu Zhifeng didn’t dare to touch him, but this might not be the case in secret.
At that moment, he pulled Yu Yi into a Louis Vuitton shop. “Let’s go buy a bag.”
This sentence was meant not only for Yu Yi, but also for Chen Yun and the others to hear.
Especially the three beauties.
If they followed him, not only would they have a good job, but they would also receive these material rewards.
Yu Yi held Xiu Zhifeng’s arm and looked at everyone. “Liu Xin, Zhang Jing, why don’t you go in and take a look? It’s not good to keep looking outside. You’re disturbing other people’s business.”
“You!” Zhang Jing couldn’t help but scold her. “Yu Yi, what do you mean!”

“What? Did I say something wrong? Look at the few of you. Your clothes are so cheap. Tsk, tsk, tsk. You’re all women. Can’t you live more exquisitely? Why do you have to buy clothes at a big market? Go to more places like this. It’s good to broaden your horizons.”
Yu Yi looked at them and sneered.
For a moment, Liu Xin and the others felt disgusted as if they had been fed a fly.
When Chen Yun heard this, he looked at Liu Xin. “Let’s go in and take a look.”
With that, he put his hands in his pockets and walked into the Louis Vuitton store.
When Liu Xin saw Chen Yun enter, she was stunned. Then, she was pulled in by Zhang Jing. “Who can’t go into the store? What are you being so arrogant for?!”
However, Zhang Jing had to admit that this society despised poverty but not prostitution.
When they walked in, the three girls opened their eyes. There were branded bags inside, each costing tens of thousands.
Chen Yun looked at these things and smiled.
The price of these bags was like a fifty-cent lollipop to him. It did not matter how many he bought.
He turned his head and glanced at Yu Yi and Xiu Zhifeng.
Yu Yi was holding Xiu Zhifeng’s hand, acting like a spoiled child and wanting to buy the pink bag in front of her.
Chen Yun walked over and looked at the price. It cost 330,000 yuan!
Furthermore, it was a limited edition bag!
He reached out and took the bag in front of him. Then, he weighed it in his hand. “Are you two buying this?”

“Why? Even if we don’t buy it, can you afford it?” Yu Yi looked at Chen Yun weighing the bag. Even when faced with Chen Yun’s handsome face, which she had been stunned by previously, she was not in a good mood now.
“That’s right. You’re still a child, and you want to spend so much money?” Xiu Zhifeng also curled his lips. At the same time, the corners of his mouth twitched. This bag cost 330,000 yuan!
Even if he was a manager, with his annual salary of hundreds of thousands, buying this bag was equivalent to cutting off his flesh!
It was simply heartbreaking!
Chen Yun looked at them and sneered. Spend big money? Did he need to do that?
“I thought you were going to buy it, but you’re not.”
“Since you’re not buying it, why are you pretending?”
“You’re so poor, yet you still looked for a college student to spend on. Ha.”
Chen Yun sneered and shook his head.
“In that case, from your tone, do you want to buy it?” Xiu Zhifeng snorted.
Chen Yun glanced at him and handed the bag to the salesperson. “Hello, help me wrap this bag.”
“Brother Yun, do you really want to buy it?” Liu Xin looked at Chen Yun and walked over. The price of this bag was not low.
Beside them, Zhang Jing also walked to Chen Yun’s side and whispered, “Don’t be angered by them. That’s a bag worth 330,000 yuan. It’s not worth a few hundred or a few thousand yuan.”
“Let’s go.”
Seeing that Chen Yun wanted to buy a bag, Lin Yu whispered.
Xiao Xin’s two roommates looked at Chen Yun. He didn’t have any branded clothes on him. If he bought this bag, wouldn’t he have to suffer a loss?
Looking at the three girls, Chen Yun chuckled.
Did he lack this money?
What a joke. Moreover, he would even earn spending points. Why not?
“Xiao Xin, that bag is for you.”
“Ah? Brother Yun, are you serious?” Xiao Xin was also stunned. Had such an expensive bag been given to her?
“The two of you, choose a bag each.”
This sentence made the two of them stand rooted to the ground in silence for a long time.

Chen Yun looked at their expressions and pointed at the two bags beside the salesperson. “Hello, help me wrap those two as well. Also, wrap three of the most expensive limited-edition bracelets over there for me.”
The salesperson immediately became excited.
Those two bags were both limited editions worth eighty to ninety thousand yuan each.
Thus, the three bags totaled nearly 500,000 yuan!
In addition to the bracelets, the total cost was almost a million yuan!
He was too rich!
This time, she could get a lot of commission.
The payment was completed and the goods were handed over to Chen Yun.
Zhang Jing looked at Chen Yun with her eyes wide open.
The action of paying was simply too cool!
She subconsciously clamped her legs together and blushed.
Opposite her, Yu Yi’s face turned pale.
She had just said that Chen Yun could not afford the bag.
However, right now, not only did Chen Yun buy it, but he also bought two more bags!
He also bought limited edition bracelets. Every one of them was embedded with real diamonds!
The total cost was nearly a million yuan!
What was this?
This was the difference between them!

For a moment, Yu Yi was both envious and jealous. She did not expect that Chen Yun was not only handsome, but also rich. If she had known earlier, she would have rushed forward to ask for Chen Yun’s WeChat.

Beside her, Xiu Zhifeng’s expression was dark and gloomy. His face turned both blue and pale at the same time. Chen Yun’s actions were no different from a tight slap on his face. The pain was scorching.
“Here, this is yours.”
“This is yours.”
“Xiao Xin, this is yours.”
After dividing the bags and bracelets, the three women waved their hands at the same time. “No, no, we can’t take it.”
“It’s too expensive.”

“Brother Yun, this... this is a bag worth about 100,000 yuan. Even if we bring it out, we’re afraid of being robbed.” Xiao Xin was the fiercest to refuse the goods. She originally wanted to invite Brother Yun out for a meal today, but he had also paid for the meal. If she still wanted to take the bag now, wouldn’t she be a beast?
Chen Yun stuffed the things into their hands. “Are these things valuable?”
Were they valuable?
What did the people say?

“Money is something that you can’t bring with you when you’re alive, and something that you can’t bring with you when you’re dead. Isn’t the saddest thing in life the fact that you can’t spend money when you’re dead?”
Xiao Xin was speechless. Most importantly, she was even more afraid of not having money when she was still alive.

Meanwhile, Zhang Jing pursed her lips and could not resist the temptation. She was the first to take the bag. “Thank you, Brother Yun. Brother Yun, you’re too handsome. Let’s add each other on WeChat.”
Just as she spoke, Lin Yu knocked her on the head.
“You little money-grubber, little love-struck fool!”
“You two should take the goods too.” Chen Yun looked at them and chuckled.
“Then... Thank you, Brother Yun.”
“Thank you, Brother Yun.”
The three of them thanked him in unison and held the items with satisfied expressions.
They received a bag worth hundreds of thousands!
They also received a bracelet worth more than a hundred thousand yuan!
It made them feel like they were in heaven!
All of this was simply too wonderful!
“Let’s go. Help me buy a few more sets of clothes.”
“Okay!” Xiao Xin was the first to agree.
“Brother Yun, I’ll follow you!” Zhang Jing smiled. Then, she looked at Lin Yu’s eyes and quickly pulled Xiao Xin along. “I mean, we’ll definitely help you choose your clothes.”
Lin Yu was helpless as well, but she was filled with motivation and was ready to help Chen Yun pick out some clothes. After all... He had given her such an expensive bag and bracelet.
Furthermore, who didn’t like a tall, rich, and handsome guy?

Chen Yun glanced at him and handed the bag to the salesperson.
“Hello, help me wrap this bag.”
“Brother Yun, do you really want to buy it?” Liu Xin looked at Chen Yun and walked over.
The price of this bag was not low.
Beside them, Zhang Jing also walked to Chen Yun’s side and whispered, “Don’t be angered by them.
That’s a bag worth 330,000 yuan.
It’s not worth a few hundred or a few thousand yuan.”
“Let’s go.”
Seeing that Chen Yun wanted to buy a bag, Lin Yu whispered.
Xiao Xin’s two roommates looked at Chen Yun.
He didn’t have any branded clothes on him.
If he bought this bag, wouldn’t he have to suffer a loss?
Looking at the three girls, Chen Yun chuckled.
Did he lack this money?
What a joke.
Moreover, he would even earn spending points.
Why not?
“Xiao Xin, that bag is for you.”
“Ah?
Brother Yun, are you serious?” Xiao Xin was also stunned.
Had such an expensive bag been given to her?
“The two of you, choose a bag each.”
This sentence made the two of them stand rooted to the ground in silence for a long time.
Chen Yun looked at their expressions and pointed at the two bags beside the salesperson.
“Hello, help me wrap those two as well.
Also, wrap three of the most expensive limited-edition bracelets over there for me.”
The salesperson immediately became excited.
Those two bags were both limited editions worth eighty to ninety thousand yuan each.
Thus, the three bags totaled nearly 500,000 yuan!
In addition to the bracelets, the total cost was almost a million yuan!
He was too rich!
This time, she could get a lot of commission.
The payment was completed and the goods were handed over to Chen Yun.
Zhang Jing looked at Chen Yun with her eyes wide open.
The action of paying was simply too cool!
She subconsciously clamped her legs together and blushed.
Opposite her, Yu Yi’s face turned pale.
She had just said that Chen Yun could not afford the bag.
However, right now, not only did Chen Yun buy it, but he also bought two more bags!
He also bought limited edition bracelets.
Every one of them was embedded with real diamonds!
The total cost was nearly a million yuan!
What was this?
This was the difference between them!
For a moment, Yu Yi was both envious and jealous.
She did not expect that Chen Yun was not only handsome, but also rich.
If she had known earlier, she would have rushed forward to ask for Chen Yun’s WeChat.
Beside her, Xiu Zhifeng’s expression was dark and gloomy.
His face turned both blue and pale at the same time.
Chen Yun’s actions were no different from a tight slap on his face.
The pain was scorching.
“Here, this is yours.”
“This is yours.”
“Xiao Xin, this is yours.”
After dividing the bags and bracelets, the three women waved their hands at the same time.
“No, no, we can’t take it.”
“It’s too expensive.”
“Brother Yun, this... this is a bag worth about 100,000 yuan.
Even if we bring it out, we’re afraid of being robbed.” Xiao Xin was the fiercest to refuse the goods.
She originally wanted to invite Brother Yun out for a meal today, but he had also paid for the meal.
If she still wanted to take the bag now, wouldn’t she be a beast?
Chen Yun stuffed the things into their hands.
“Are these things valuable?”
Were they valuable?
What did the people say?
“Money is something that you can’t bring with you when you’re alive, and something that you can’t bring with you when you’re dead.
Isn’t the saddest thing in life the fact that you can’t spend money when you’re dead?”
Xiao Xin was speechless.
Most importantly, she was even more afraid of not having money when she was still alive.
Meanwhile, Zhang Jing pursed her lips and could not resist the temptation.
She was the first to take the bag.
“Thank you, Brother Yun.
Brother Yun, you’re too handsome.
Let’s add each other on WeChat.”
Just as she spoke, Lin Yu knocked her on the head.
“You little money-grubber, little love-struck fool!”
“You two should take the goods too.” Chen Yun looked at them and chuckled.
“Then...
Thank you, Brother Yun.”
“Thank you, Brother Yun.”
The three of them thanked him in unison and held the items with satisfied expressions.
They received a bag worth hundreds of thousands!
They also received a bracelet worth more than a hundred thousand yuan!
It made them feel like they were in heaven!
All of this was simply too wonderful!
“Let’s go.
Help me buy a few more sets of clothes.”
“Okay!” Xiao Xin was the first to agree.
“Brother Yun, I’ll follow you!” Zhang Jing smiled.
Then, she looked at Lin Yu’s eyes and quickly pulled Xiao Xin along.
“I mean, we’ll definitely help you choose your clothes.”
Lin Yu was helpless as well, but she was filled with motivation and was ready to help Chen Yun pick out some clothes.
After all...
He had given her such an expensive bag and bracelet.
Furthermore, who didn’t like a tall, rich, and handsome guy?

chapters.title: Chapter 12
paragraphs: Waving a Million!
After leaving the Louis Vuitton store, they went to Gucci to buy clothes.
Chen Yun bought a set of slim-fit clothes, a coat, a crocodile belt, and a pair of white leather shoes.
He also bought a few shirts.
They cost a total of 480,000!
They were all limited editions worldwide!
The entire process, from entering to exiting the store, did not take long.
Chen Yun was like a natural clothes rack. With his height of 183 cm and his “Extreme Figure”, he looked good in anything.
During the process of buying clothes, Chen Yun attracted the attention of countless girls.
His abs and chest muscles under his clothes were faintly discernible. Coupled with his fairy-like appearance, the salesperson was so distracted that she forgot her job.
The surrounding salespeople also glanced over from time to time, envious of the salesperson who had taken the initiative to serve Chen Yun.
After that, Chen Yun went to the Vacheron Constantin Watch shop.
A watch from the Traversing Four Seas series was worth 800,000!
Chen Yun’s way of swiping his card simply stunned all the girls.
It wasn’t that the salespeople hadn’t seen rich people before, but they had never seen someone so straightforward.
It was worth 800,000 yuan!
It was as if he had bought half a kilogram of vegetables. When did Jiang City have such a rich young master?!
Walking out of the watch shop, Lin Yu did some calculations.
“One million yuan for the bags and bracelets, 500,000 yuan for the clothes, and 800,000 yuan for the watch.”
“Oh my god, he spent more than two million yuan in less than an hour!”
He could also buy a house in Jiang City!
Furthermore, he would be able to buy a good house!
Even after spending such a huge sum of money, Chen Yun’s expression was still calm. Moreover, his eyes were still looking at the specialty store beside him, as if he had not spent enough.
“Sir, why don’t you take a look at the Nike store? Your figure is suitable for sportswear.”
“Hello, sir. Would you like to take a look at the Armani store?”
Many passersby had never seen such a scene.
Who had ever seen the salespeople of specialty stores solicit customers at the entrance of their store?

However, this time, they really put away their shame. After Chen Yun bought the watch, the news of him spending more than two million yuan in a short period of time had already spread throughout the entire fifth floor.
The current Chen Yun was simply a walking God of Wealth.
“Is there anything you want?”
“No, no.” Xiao Xin quickly shook her head. Beside her, Zhang Jing and Lin Yu also waved their hands.
Chen Yun looked at his phone. It was a little late, and he was too lazy to shop.
“Brother Yun, are you busy?” Xiao Xin looked at Chen Yun’s expression and asked.
“Let’s stop here for today. Do you still want to shop?”
“No, let’s go too.” Zhang Jing shook her head.
Everyone went down together and headed for the underground parking lot.
When they reached the parking lot, Yu Yi and Xiu Zhifeng were about to get into the car when they saw Chen Yun and the others.
It couldn’t be helped. Handsome men and beautiful women were especially eye-catching wherever they went.
The next moment, the two of them looked at the things in Chen Yun and the others’ hands, Their eyes widened.
They simply couldn’t believe what they were seeing!
There were a few Gucci bags!
There was a Vacheron bag!
There was also a Louis Vuitton gift bag!

There was no need for much. Just the Vacheron bag alone was enough to make them gasp. That was a world-famous watch brand. It was something rich people played with. Any one of their watches would cost hundreds of thousands!
Chen Yun was actually so rich.
Xiu Zhifeng’s face darkened. However, the next moment, he looked at Chen Yun’s car and his face darkened.
Beside him, Yu Yi also exclaimed softly.
“It’s a McLaren!”
“This model should cost at least three million yuan!”
Yu Yi was simply about to cry. If she could hook up with Chen Yun, she would live the rest of her life in luxury!
Xiu Zhifeng looked at the McLaren and the license plate with “Jiang A66666” on it. Just the license plate alone was enough to show how powerful his relationships were!
At that moment, his legs began to tremble. He was shocked at what kind of person he had provoked today.
This was a truly rich man!
Zhang Jing and Lin Yu covered their mouths in shock when they saw the king-like sports car. They had never seen a sports car so close to them!
“Xiao Xin, shall I send you back?”
“Brother Yun, I won’t trouble you anymore. If you have something to do, go ahead. We will take a taxi back.”
Chen Yun got into the car and rolled down the window. “Be careful. Let’s go out together when we have time.”
“Yes, yes. Goodbye, Brother Yun.”
Zhang Jing and Lin Yu quickly waved their hands. “Brother Yun, have a safe trip.”
“Bye, Brother Yun.”
With the roar of the supercar, Zhang Jing and Lin Yu looked at the taillights of the McLaren car in a daze.
After Chen Yun drove away, Zhang Jing finally reacted and pinched Liu Xin’s face.
“Ah! Why are you pinching me!”
“I’m checking if this is the reality.” Zhang Jing looked at Liu Xin’s reaction, then hugged the Louis Vuitton bag in her arms. “Tell me, tell me, where did you get to know Brother Yun?”
“Didn’t I do a live-stream yesterday? Brother Yun tipped me yesterday.”
“Huh? If he tipped you, does it mean that he’s interested in you?” Lin Yu asked.
Liu Xin waved her hand. “Don’t joke around. Why would Brother Yun be interested in me? I’m not worthy of him.”
She shrank her head and did not tell them what happened last night.
“That’s not necessarily true. With your face, figure, and big chest, which man wouldn’t be interested in you?”
“They’re preparing to lay their hands on you!”
Liu Xin rolled her eyes at Zhang Jing.
“If you don’t want him, I’ll contact Brother Yun. Anyway, I’ve already gotten Brother Yun’s WeChat.” Zhang Jing looked at her phone and threatened her.
Beside her, Lin Yu heard Zhang Jing’s words. “Jingjing, um... give me Brother Yun’s WeChat. I’ll add him too.”
“Wow, Big Sister, didn’t you say that Brother Yun was swindling money and women? What’s wrong now?”

“You talk too much. Your understanding of someone will deepen over time. It’s too superficial to judge them by their cover. After all, a man has many sides. However, you won’t understand even if I tell the two of you about this.”
“Besides, even someone like me has some knowledge about these kinds of things!”
“I understand men too.”

Zhang Jing broke free and glanced at Lin Yu. Then, she pulled Liu Xin and said, “Sister Yu, if you’re really capable, why don’t you hook up with Brother Yun and show off your knowledge to us two single dogs? Right, Xiao Xin?”
Liu Xin also laughed out loud. She pulled Zhang Jing and ran. If she didn’t run, she would be beaten up!

chapters.title: Chapter 13
paragraphs: The Winds Howl Around the Highest Peaks!

After returning home, Chen Yun changed into a few outfits and looked at himself in the full-length mirror. Indeed, a person with an “Extreme Figure” would look exceptionally energetic no matter what he wore.
Picking up his phone, Chen Yun realized that Wang Menghan had sent him another message. She reported the distribution of the millions of donations to him.
Each donation was made especially clear, making Chen Yun feel at ease.

At the same time, he had a good impression of Wang Menghan. After all, some idols were pre-packaged and relied on public relations, while others were actually made. Some examples were Wang Menghan and the famous singer, Fat Auntie, who had been dedicated to donating for so many years.
Over the past few days, Chen Yun and Wang Menghan had chatted a lot, so he knew her better.
Upon seeing her message, Chen Yun made a call.
The two of them greeted each other.

“Chen Yun, I’m sorry that I didn’t reply to your message yesterday. Yesterday, I played with the children at Hope Primary School until it was late. It was dark and the roads were muddy, so we slept on the tables in the classroom for the entire night. In addition, we were tired and didn’t have the Internet, so don’t be angry.” Wang Menghan apologized.
Chen Yun was shocked. How was this something a celebrity would do? She slept on the tables of Hope Primary School!
Not to mention celebrities, even ordinary people did not treat themselves like this.
“Are you back in town now?”

“Yes, I’m going back tomorrow. I’ve distributed the items over the past few days. The money to repair the school and roads has also been handed over to someone who is trustworthy. I’m useless here.” Wang Menghan sighed. She had originally planned to use the celebrity effect to bring some joy to the children.
After all, there was no internet in the mountains. No one knew who she was, let alone her songs.
However, she was still very happy to play with the children over the past few days.

Later on, when Chen Yun heard that Wang Menghan was going to land at Jiang City Airport, he asked, “Shall I pick you up at Jiang City Airport tomorrow? It just so happens that you’re not from Jiang City. I’ve been in Jiang City for a few years and am quite familiar with it. I can bring you around Jiang City to play.”

“Hmm, that’s fine too. Coincidentally, my new song has just been released and I don’t have any tasks to do. I can use this opportunity to relax. Perhaps I can compose a better song.” Wang Menghan thought about it and agreed.
“Then I really have to look forward to it.”
“Chen Yun, I’m really lucky to have a caring fan like you. Thank you.”
After chatting for a few days, the two of them had already become friends. After chatting with Wang Menghan for a while, Chen Yun put down the phone.
[Check-in Mission: Please check in 300 meters east of the East Port of Jiang City at 1 pm the day after tomorrow.]
[Remark: Bringing three girls to check in with you will give you an additional reward.]
Chen Yun looked at the check-in mission that appeared in front of him and was stunned. This was a little too showy.
There was an additional reward for bringing three girls to check in.
It seemed that he had to go out to sea. Jiang City was located by the East Sea. The Yangtze River passed through the city and entered the East Sea, which was why this place was called Jiang City.
Chen Yun found Zhou Jingyi’s number and made a call.
“Mr. Chen, what can I do for you?”
“Just call me Chen Yun. Do you have any channels to buy a yacht? I want a luxury yacht.”
A luxury yacht!

For a moment, even Zhou Jingyi was stunned. A luxury yacht cost at least five million yuan. What kind of person was this? He had just bought a McLaren sports car worth three million yuan, and now he wanted to buy a luxury yacht.
“I have a friend in East Sea Harbor whom I can contact. I can contact him immediately.”
“Alright, thanks for your hard work.”
After a while, Zhou Jingyi called back.
“Chen Yun, there’s a luxury yacht, but it’s a little expensive. The other party offered a price of six million yuan. I’ve already sent you a photo of the yacht on WeChat.”

Chen Yun opened the picture and looked at the luxurious yacht pictured. He could not help but be speechless. The hull was more than ten meters long, and it was snow-white and heavy. It was incomparably clean, and the interior could be said to be luxurious. All the facilities were complete.
“Six million, right? I’ll transfer the money to you. Help me purchase it. I’m going to sea the day after tomorrow.”
“Okay.”
Zhou Jingyi did not expect Chen Yun to agree so readily.
That was six million yuan!
A total of six million yuan!
She could get a commission again.
“By the way, are you free the day after tomorrow?”
Hearing Chen Yun’s invitation, Zhou Jingyi was simply flattered and blushed.
Could it be that...
However, she did not have much experience. She had been working hard since she was in school and did not have time to fall in love.
“I’ll talk to my leader tomorrow and bring my leave forward to the day after tomorrow. There shouldn’t be any problems. I’ll have time then. Shall we contact each other then?”
“Alright.” Chen Yun nodded and hung up. Then, he counted.

He would bring along Xiao Xin and Zhou Jingyi. If he could pull Wang Menghan along, he would have three beauties whose looks exceeded 90 points. These three people were the most beautiful people he knew.
Although the mission didn’t state any requirements for the girls to be as beautiful as possible, who knew if there would be a higher bonus?
Chen Yun seemed to be collecting cards now. It was inexplicably interesting.
After transferring six million yuan, the other party activated the electronic contract. After signing, it was marked that the Haitian Yacht was under Chen Yun’s name.
Chen Yun then contacted the other party and asked them to add some diving suits and diving equipment.
The other party had no objections. After all, Chen Yun was a big client in their eyes. He bought the luxury yacht without any negotiation or hesitation.
Other than that, the other party had also added many additional entertainment facilities for Chen Yun. Their service was good.
After dealing with these matters, Chen Yun took out his phone and saw that Xiao Xin had already started streaming.
On Flying Fish live-streaming platform, the number of viewers in Liu Xin’s streaming room had increased from 10 to 20 yesterday to hundreds of thousands, but Liu Xin wasn’t happy at all!

After all, it was said that the winds howled around the highest peaks. She became famous yesterday and successfully signed a new contract with the platform. Everything seemed to be fine, but that was not the case.

Jealousy was followed by hatred. There were only so many recommended spots on the live-streaming platform. Thus, every recommended spot was very important. After all, as streamers, as long as their conditions were not bad, they did not have to worry about earning money if they were in a recommended spot.
Originally, the recommended spots on the Flying Fish live-streaming platform were already very stable. With the few streamers taking turns to be recommended, everyone was already used to this model.
However, the commotion in her and Chen Yun’s live-stream yesterday had directly boosted her popularity.
It allowed her to become someone who could compete with those big streamers for a recommended spot.

The recommended spots were originally stable. However, now that such a person had suddenly been added, the recommended spot naturally had to be given to Liu Xin. Originally, there was no enmity between them, but once their own interests were involved, they were naturally unwilling.

This was especially so for those female streamers. Due to Liu Xin’s sudden rise, their interests were inevitably affected. It was as if they had coincidentally picked a time to bring their fans over for a ward round.

If they wanted to observe her, so be it. However, all of them were openly and covertly slandering Liu Xin, saying things like, “How can her live broadcast become so popular? It’s just that her face and figure are better.” What they meant was that there was definitely a problem with Liu Xin becoming popular. Perhaps she had given some benefits to the executives of the platform.
This was the world. There were many keyboard warriors and internet trolls, and many of them were paid by these streamers.
Therefore, more than half of the 200,000 fans in today’s live-stream were anti-fans. They did not send gifts but kept nitpicking.

One moment, they would say that the host was dressed too conservatively and was not open at all. The next moment, they would say that the host’s singing was not nice at all and was even seriously out of tune. In any case, Liu Xin was useless in their opinion. It was better to turn off the live-stream and go home!
Liu Xin was a newbie to begin with. Although she was a legend now, she really didn’t know anything.
Even though she was confident in her looks and singing, it was the truth.

However, she really did not know what to do in the face of those people who were scolding her. The little girl’s mental endurance was not high to begin with. Now that she was being led like this, she could not take it anymore.
The reason why she was still streaming was because she knew that other than those haters, there were actually many people who really liked her.
“Liu Xin, you have to be strong. The more they lead the way, the more you can’t show them your weakness!” She silently encouraged herself in her heart and clenched her fists under the table.
“How can so many people bully a girl? You guys are too much!”
“That’s right, that’s right. What’s wrong with our Xiao Xin? We like our Xiao Xin!”
“No, we just don’t like her!”
“Don’t watch her stream if you don’t like her!”

“What’s wrong? Does your family own Flying Fish? If I want to watch, I’ll watch. If I don’t want to watch, I won’t watch. If I want to scold her, I’ll scold her. Otherwise, what’s the point of leaving the comments open? I might as well cancel the Flying Fish platform.”
There were still quite a number of viewers who were Liu Xin’s fans. Although there weren’t many of them, when they saw their favorite streamer being criticized, they did their best to resist.
However, they were outnumbered. Those keyboard warriors were all submissive people in reality but attacked others heavily on the Internet.
All of them were skilled at scolding others. It wasn’t a problem for them to throw in a few profanities.
The keyboard warriors attacked Liu Xin wildly from all directions.
It was simply explosive!
“Xiao Xin, don’t listen to what others say. What you have to do is stream properly and let them see your strength!”
Chen Yun also stood up directly. “So many of you are bullying a girl. How shameless!”
The moment Chen Yun came out, Liu Xin’s expression changed drastically.

“Brother Yun! Brother Yun, what song do you want to listen to? Xiao Xin will sing it for you!” Liu Xin looked at Chen Yun and seemed to have found someone to rely on. Her face also revealed a happy expression.
“Don’t sing yet. I’ll suppress these trolls first!” Chen Yun didn’t believe that he couldn’t suppress these trolls.
After Chen Yun said that, the entire live-stream room fell silent for a few seconds. Then, many people mocked Chen Yun.
“Who are you? Why are you standing up for her?”
“That’s right. You act like a big shot. Who do you think you are?”
“Who do you think you are?”

sentences.text: The Winds Howl Around the Highest Peaks!
After returning home, Chen Yun changed into a few outfits and looked at himself in the full-length mirror.
Indeed, a person with an “Extreme Figure” would look exceptionally energetic no matter what he wore.
Picking up his phone, Chen Yun realized that Wang Menghan had sent him another message.
She reported the distribution of the millions of donations to him.
Each donation was made especially clear, making Chen Yun feel at ease.
At the same time, he had a good impression of Wang Menghan.
After all, some idols were pre-packaged and relied on public relations, while others were actually made.
Some examples were Wang Menghan and the famous singer, Fat Auntie, who had been dedicated to donating for so many years.
Over the past few days, Chen Yun and Wang Menghan had chatted a lot, so he knew her better.
Upon seeing her message, Chen Yun made a call.
The two of them greeted each other.
“Chen Yun, I’m sorry that I didn’t reply to your message yesterday.
Yesterday, I played with the children at Hope Primary School until it was late.
It was dark and the roads were muddy, so we slept on the tables in the classroom for the entire night.
In addition, we were tired and didn’t have the Internet, so don’t be angry.” Wang Menghan apologized.
Chen Yun was shocked.
How was this something a celebrity would do?
She slept on the tables of Hope Primary School!
Not to mention celebrities, even ordinary people did not treat themselves like this.
“Are you back in town now?”
“Yes, I’m going back tomorrow.
I’ve distributed the items over the past few days.
The money to repair the school and roads has also been handed over to someone who is trustworthy.
I’m useless here.” Wang Menghan sighed.
She had originally planned to use the celebrity effect to bring some joy to the children.
After all, there was no internet in the mountains.
No one knew who she was, let alone her songs.
However, she was still very happy to play with the children over the past few days.
Later on, when Chen Yun heard that Wang Menghan was going to land at Jiang City Airport, he asked, “Shall I pick you up at Jiang City Airport tomorrow?
It just so happens that you’re not from Jiang City.
I’ve been in Jiang City for a few years and am quite familiar with it.
I can bring you around Jiang City to play.”
“Hmm, that’s fine too.
Coincidentally, my new song has just been released and I don’t have any tasks to do.
I can use this opportunity to relax.
Perhaps I can compose a better song.” Wang Menghan thought about it and agreed.
“Then I really have to look forward to it.”
“Chen Yun, I’m really lucky to have a caring fan like you.
Thank you.”
After chatting for a few days, the two of them had already become friends.
After chatting with Wang Menghan for a while, Chen Yun put down the phone.
[Check-in Mission: Please check in 300 meters east of the East Port of Jiang City at 1 pm the day after tomorrow.]
[Remark: Bringing three girls to check in with you will give you an additional reward.]
Chen Yun looked at the check-in mission that appeared in front of him and was stunned.
This was a little too showy.
There was an additional reward for bringing three girls to check in.
It seemed that he had to go out to sea.
Jiang City was located by the East Sea.
The Yangtze River passed through the city and entered the East Sea, which was why this place was called Jiang City.
Chen Yun found Zhou Jingyi’s number and made a call.
“Mr.
Chen, what can I do for you?”
“Just call me Chen Yun.
Do you have any channels to buy a yacht?
I want a luxury yacht.”
A luxury yacht!
For a moment, even Zhou Jingyi was stunned.
A luxury yacht cost at least five million yuan.
What kind of person was this?
He had just bought a McLaren sports car worth three million yuan, and now he wanted to buy a luxury yacht.
“I have a friend in East Sea Harbor whom I can contact.
I can contact him immediately.”
“Alright, thanks for your hard work.”
After a while, Zhou Jingyi called back.
“Chen Yun, there’s a luxury yacht, but it’s a little expensive.
The other party offered a price of six million yuan.
I’ve already sent you a photo of the yacht on WeChat.”
Chen Yun opened the picture and looked at the luxurious yacht pictured.
He could not help but be speechless.
The hull was more than ten meters long, and it was snow-white and heavy.
It was incomparably clean, and the interior could be said to be luxurious.
All the facilities were complete.
“Six million, right?
I’ll transfer the money to you.
Help me purchase it.
I’m going to sea the day after tomorrow.”
“Okay.”
Zhou Jingyi did not expect Chen Yun to agree so readily.
That was six million yuan!
A total of six million yuan!
She could get a commission again.
“By the way, are you free the day after tomorrow?”
Hearing Chen Yun’s invitation, Zhou Jingyi was simply flattered and blushed.
Could it be that...
However, she did not have much experience.
She had been working hard since she was in school and did not have time to fall in love.
“I’ll talk to my leader tomorrow and bring my leave forward to the day after tomorrow.
There shouldn’t be any problems.
I’ll have time then.
Shall we contact each other then?”
“Alright.” Chen Yun nodded and hung up.
Then, he counted.
He would bring along Xiao Xin and Zhou Jingyi.
If he could pull Wang Menghan along, he would have three beauties whose looks exceeded 90 points.
These three people were the most beautiful people he knew.
Although the mission didn’t state any requirements for the girls to be as beautiful as possible, who knew if there would be a higher bonus?
Chen Yun seemed to be collecting cards now.
It was inexplicably interesting.
After transferring six million yuan, the other party activated the electronic contract.
After signing, it was marked that the Haitian Yacht was under Chen Yun’s name.
Chen Yun then contacted the other party and asked them to add some diving suits and diving equipment.
The other party had no objections.
After all, Chen Yun was a big client in their eyes.
He bought the luxury yacht without any negotiation or hesitation.
Other than that, the other party had also added many additional entertainment facilities for Chen Yun.
Their service was good.
After dealing with these matters, Chen Yun took out his phone and saw that Xiao Xin had already started streaming.
On Flying Fish live-streaming platform, the number of viewers in Liu Xin’s streaming room had increased from 10 to 20 yesterday to hundreds of thousands, but Liu Xin wasn’t happy at all!
After all, it was said that the winds howled around the highest peaks.
She became famous yesterday and successfully signed a new contract with the platform.
Everything seemed to be fine, but that was not the case.
Jealousy was followed by hatred.
There were only so many recommended spots on the live-streaming platform.
Thus, every recommended spot was very important.
After all, as streamers, as long as their conditions were not bad, they did not have to worry about earning money if they were in a recommended spot.
Originally, the recommended spots on the Flying Fish live-streaming platform were already very stable.
With the few streamers taking turns to be recommended, everyone was already used to this model.
However, the commotion in her and Chen Yun’s live-stream yesterday had directly boosted her popularity.
It allowed her to become someone who could compete with those big streamers for a recommended spot.
The recommended spots were originally stable.
However, now that such a person had suddenly been added, the recommended spot naturally had to be given to Liu Xin.
Originally, there was no enmity between them, but once their own interests were involved, they were naturally unwilling.
This was especially so for those female streamers.
Due to Liu Xin’s sudden rise, their interests were inevitably affected.
It was as if they had coincidentally picked a time to bring their fans over for a ward round.
If they wanted to observe her, so be it.
However, all of them were openly and covertly slandering Liu Xin, saying things like, “How can her live broadcast become so popular?
It’s just that her face and figure are better.” What they meant was that there was definitely a problem with Liu Xin becoming popular.
Perhaps she had given some benefits to the executives of the platform.
This was the world.
There were many keyboard warriors and internet trolls, and many of them were paid by these streamers.
Therefore, more than half of the 200,000 fans in today’s live-stream were anti-fans.
They did not send gifts but kept nitpicking.
One moment, they would say that the host was dressed too conservatively and was not open at all.
The next moment, they would say that the host’s singing was not nice at all and was even seriously out of tune.
In any case, Liu Xin was useless in their opinion.
It was better to turn off the live-stream and go home!
Liu Xin was a newbie to begin with.
Although she was a legend now, she really didn’t know anything.
Even though she was confident in her looks and singing, it was the truth.
However, she really did not know what to do in the face of those people who were scolding her.
The little girl’s mental endurance was not high to begin with.
Now that she was being led like this, she could not take it anymore.
The reason why she was still streaming was because she knew that other than those haters, there were actually many people who really liked her.
“Liu Xin, you have to be strong.
The more they lead the way, the more you can’t show them your weakness!” She silently encouraged herself in her heart and clenched her fists under the table.
“How can so many people bully a girl?
You guys are too much!”
“That’s right, that’s right.
What’s wrong with our Xiao Xin?
We like our Xiao Xin!”
“No, we just don’t like her!”
“Don’t watch her stream if you don’t like her!”
“What’s wrong?
Does your family own Flying Fish?
If I want to watch, I’ll watch.
If I don’t want to watch, I won’t watch.
If I want to scold her, I’ll scold her.
Otherwise, what’s the point of leaving the comments open?
I might as well cancel the Flying Fish platform.”
There were still quite a number of viewers who were Liu Xin’s fans.
Although there weren’t many of them, when they saw their favorite streamer being criticized, they did their best to resist.
However, they were outnumbered.
Those keyboard warriors were all submissive people in reality but attacked others heavily on the Internet.
All of them were skilled at scolding others.
It wasn’t a problem for them to throw in a few profanities.
The keyboard warriors attacked Liu Xin wildly from all directions.
It was simply explosive!
“Xiao Xin, don’t listen to what others say.
What you have to do is stream properly and let them see your strength!”
Chen Yun also stood up directly.
“So many of you are bullying a girl.
How shameless!”
The moment Chen Yun came out, Liu Xin’s expression changed drastically.
“Brother Yun!
Brother Yun, what song do you want to listen to?
Xiao Xin will sing it for you!” Liu Xin looked at Chen Yun and seemed to have found someone to rely on.
Her face also revealed a happy expression.
“Don’t sing yet.
I’ll suppress these trolls first!” Chen Yun didn’t believe that he couldn’t suppress these trolls.
After Chen Yun said that, the entire live-stream room fell silent for a few seconds.
Then, many people mocked Chen Yun.
“Who are you?
Why are you standing up for her?”
“That’s right.
You act like a big shot.
Who do you think you are?”
“Who do you think you are?”

chapters.title: Chapter 14
paragraphs: The Big Streamers Suppress the Scene!
These few words simply caused a storm in the entire live-stream.
“It’s the tycoon. You country bumpkins don’t even recognize the tycoon. Why are you still talking here?!”
“You don’t even know our tycoon, yet you’re still spouting nonsense here. I’m really impressed!”

This user was “The Violent Young Man from Jiang City”. Those who didn’t watch the live-stream yesterday might not be familiar with this ID, but those who had experienced yesterday’s frenzy knew that this was the tycoon from yesterday!
What tycoon?
Many haters looked at what the people in the live-stream were saying. These people were so inexperienced. They randomly called someone a tycoon.
However, in the next moment, they looked at Chen Yun’s fan points and their eyes widened. They simply could not believe what they were seeing!
How many digits were there?
After a rough count, that amount of fan points actually required more than ten million yuan worth of tips to obtain!
What kind of person was this?
Many trolls immediately felt like they had fallen into an icy river. It was as if their entire bodies were frozen.
The hands of the trolls, who had been calling Chen Yun a nobody, began to tremble crazily.
It was as if they had Parkinson’s Disease.
As soon as Chen Yun came online, there was another rain of super rockets.
He easily spent hundreds of thousands of yuan!

This time, although it was not as much as the previous time, it still attracted the attention of the entire platform, especially some big streamers. After all, they had never seen a big financial backer like Chen Yun.
Moreover, Chen Yun was clearly supporting Liu Xin. They would naturally make her live-stream even better.
They immediately pulled their fans over to cheer for Liu Xin.
“Sister Xiao Xin, I’ll tip you a few super rockets. Do your best in your live-stream!”
“Sister Xiao Xin, if anyone bullies you in the future, tell me. My fans are not to be trifled with!”
“That’s right. We’ll definitely take care of you.”
A few big streamers came with millions of fans and completely suppressed the trolls!
There was no room for retaliation. Moreover, their private messages kept increasing. Now, they were a little afraid that they would be exposed.
It was too terrifying!
Some of the trolls were not mentally strong. They simply turned off their computers and huddled up, trembling!

She had a financial backer who tipped tens of millions protecting her. Furthermore, a few top female streamers on the Flying Fish platform helped her make her live-stream even better. Such treatment was unprecedented!
The streamers who had paid for the trolls behind the scenes also had extremely gloomy expressions. Their hearts were trembling, afraid that they would be exposed.
“Thank you, Brother Yun!”
Xiao Xin was not stupid. She naturally knew why so many big streamers had rushed over.

No words could compare to this sincere thank you! To be honest, at that moment, Liu Xin thought a lot, but all the words seemed to be stuck in her throat. She didn’t know what to say, nor did she know how to say it. Anyway, at this moment, she was so shocked that she didn’t know what to say!
Xiao Xin took out her phone and sent a WeChat message. “Brother Yun, don’t tip me so much. You’ve already given me enough. I don’t even know how to repay you.”
“It’s fine. Just focus on your live-stream,” said Chen Yun. He was not short of money anyway.
“By the way, I’m going out to sea the day after tomorrow. Come with me.”
Looking at Chen Yun’s WeChat message, Liu Xin agreed without hesitation.
With Chen Yun’s tips just now, millions of people gathered in Xiao Xin’s live-stream again.

Liu Xin didn’t let Chen Yun down and simply started streaming. Her originally sweet voice, coupled with her good looks of more than 90 points, simply attracted countless fans, and the number of people following her skyrocketed.

Backstage, Xiao Xin’s supervisor, Liu Bo, looked at the terrifying data. His hands that were holding his glasses began to tremble, and he was extremely excited. It seemed that Xiao Xin had already caught this big financial backer.
One had to know that he was only a newbie manager. At that moment, he quickly gave all the resources in his hands to Liu Xin and gave her several recommended spots at the same time.
This caused Liu Xin’s number of fans to skyrocket.
Moreover, this time, no streamer dared to cause trouble in her live-stream.
Who would dare to do so!
Everyone had seen Chen Yun’s actions just now. He had already made it clear that he was covering for this streamer!
Moreover, several top streamers on Flying Fish platform expressed their stance in unison. Millions of fans were escorting Liu Xin!
Who would dare to go to Liu Xin’s live-stream to cause trouble?
Wouldn’t they be asking for a scolding?
After that, Chen Yun also went to the streamers who supported Liu Xin just now and tipped them more than 100,000 yuan each. The streamers immediately beamed with joy and thanked him repeatedly.
Meanwhile, the streamers who had put on airs and did not go to Xiao Xin’s live-stream were filled with regret. Their brains were simply fried!

chapters.title: Chapter 15
paragraphs: Blinding Everyone!
He went to bed early.
The next morning, Chen Yun woke up.
[Host, please check in.]
[Check-in successful.]
[Congratulations to the host for having your physical fitness doubled.]
[Name: Chen Yun]
[Height: 183 cm]
[Appearance: 88 (Out of 100)]
[Physical Fitness: 10 (Adult average: 10)]
[Balance: 4,787,000,000 yuan]
[Skills: Full of Luck, Random Double]
The dice appeared and steadily showed the number four!
His physical fitness was multiplied by four!
The increase was applied to his physical fitness, strength, agility...
All aspects were enhanced!
In an instant, Chen Yun’s physical fitness reached 80!
The average adult man had a physical fitness of 10. Chen Yun could already beat the world boxing champion now!
Chen Yun clenched his fists. He felt that he could even lift his McLaren sports car off the ground with one hand!

He got up, put on his clothes, and walked to the mirror. Chen Yun looked at himself in the mirror. His appearance had clearly improved. After all, although he had obtained the face of an Exiled Immortal, the transformation would still take a month to complete.
It was hard to imagine what he would become if a month really passed.
He would simply be a walking hormone diffuser.
Looking at the time, it was time to pick up Wang Menghan, who had just returned from the mountains.
It was not easy for a big star to stay in the mountains for so many days.

Chen Yun thought to himself as he drove the McLaren sports car out of the district. The security guard looked at the license plate with “Jiang A66666” printed on it and his heart skipped a beat. This was the person from Villa No. 3!
There was no need for the security guard to lift the barrier. The smart system identified the license plate and automatically lifted the barrier for Chen Yun to pass.
The security guards immediately bowed to the sports car and watched Chen Yun leave.
At Jiang City International Airport.
At this moment, in the business class cabin of a plane in the air.
Wang Menghan was eating breakfast.
At the side, a manager about her age looked out of the window. “We’re almost there. We’re finally back. I’ve been through so much these past few days.”
“Xiaozi!” Wang Menghan glanced at Zhang Xiaozi. This roommate of hers had been like this since university. There had not been much change even after she became her manager.

Zhang Xiaozi looked at Wang Menghan’s gloomy face and smiled awkwardly. “I’m just complaining about the hardships in the mountains. I’m not complaining, I’m not complaining. How would I dare to complain about Beauty Wang? Tsk tsk tsk.”
Her words were filled with dissatisfaction.
Wang Menghan did not know whether to laugh or cry. If she was dissatisfied, so be it. Anyway, she was forced to go this time. It was reasonable for her to complain.
“If the children in the mountains can keep up with the education, many of them should be able to leave the mountains and find their own world.” Wang Menghan sighed.
With that, Zhang Xiaozi stopped talking.
“By the way, Xiaozi, you should go back to the company first. I’m going to stay here for a few days and I’m going to meet a friend.”
“Huh?” Zhang Xiaozi’s eyes widened when she heard that. She had been with Wang Menghan for four years in university, but she had never heard of her having friends in Jiang City.
“Is it your boyfriend?”
“Nonsense. We’re just friends.”
“It’s really a man. Who is it? I have to check on you. After all, you’re a public figure.”
After getting off the plane, Zhang Xiaozi constantly followed Wang Menghan closely, making Wang Menghan feel helpless.
Her best friend was not good at anything else but gossip.
“Chen Yun, I’m out of the airport. Where are you?”
She dragged her suitcase and made a call. Then, she saw a figure get out of a sports car.
Zhang Xiaozi followed Wang Menghan’s gaze.
She was instantly stunned!
It was a McLaren sports car!
It was Jiang A66666!
Most importantly, the person who walked over was wearing a set of slim-fit clothes and a pair of sunglasses, and drove a luxury car. He looked like a domineering CEO in an idol drama.
It was even better than that!
He was holding a bouquet of white roses in his hand.
He was too handsome!
She could not help but be infatuated!
When Chen Yun got out of the car, many people looked over. For a moment, many people stopped in their tracks.
“Look at that handsome guy, his aura, and that sports car!”
“I want to go up and ask for his WeChat. Does anyone want to come with me?”
“How handsome! Ahhhh...”
Some people even started to shout.
Wang Menghan, who was covered up tightly, pursed her lips when she saw this scene. Who exactly was the celebrity?
Chen Yun walked up to Wang Menghan and took off his sunglasses. For a moment, Zhang Xiaozi felt as if she had been struck by lightning.
He wore a set of slim-fit clothes from Gucci, a watch from Vacheron Constantin’s Traversing Four Seas series, and a pair of Armani sunglasses...
His outfit definitely exceeded a million yuan!
Furthermore, he had a luxury car worth three million yuan!
He was undoubtedly a tycoon!
Even Wang Menghan was shocked by Chen Yun’s outfit. He was too handsome!
He was much more handsome compared to when he was on stage previously.
Chen Yun handed over the flowers in his hand. “You’ve worked hard this time.”
“Thank you.” Wang Menghan took the flowers. Then, she looked at the murderous gazes of the girls beside her and stuck out her tongue. “Aren’t you trying to provoke me?”
Beside them, Zhang Xiaozi looked at the two of them and felt her heart ache.

“Menghan, you guys have fun. I’m going back to the company first.” Zhang Xiaozi then looked at Chen Yun and took out her phone. “Handsome, let’s add each other on WeChat. If I have something urgent and can’t find Menghan, I can look for you too. Come on, come on.”
Even Wang Menghan did not know whether to laugh or cry. “Hurry up and leave. I’ll give you Chen Yun’s WeChat ID when I go back.”
She glanced at her best friend. Everyone knew what she was thinking.
Zhang Xiaozi looked at Wang Menghan. Hmph! This was fake sisterhood! Even if Wang Menghan wanted to eat the meat, she had to give Zhang Xiaozi some soup!
She left!
Seeing Zhang Xiaozi leave angrily, Wang Menghan looked helpless.
“Let’s go. I’ll help you carry your suitcase.”
“Okay.”
After getting into the car, Chen Yun brought Wang Menghan to the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion.
“Chen Yun, you really shocked me. You’re too handsome in this outfit.”
“The clothes I bought yesterday didn’t cost much, but they’re pretty good.”
Wang Menghan was speechless.
Did he say that the clothes didn’t cost much?
His outfit was worth millions!
Did he think that this price was only alright?
He was probably not interested in money either!
As they traveled, Wang Menghan realized that Chen Yun was driving in the wrong direction. “Where are you taking me? Aren’t you going to send me to the hotel first?”
“Since my friend is here, why are we still going to the hotel? Leave your luggage at my house first. If you think my house is inferior to the hotel, I’ll send you back.”
“Then why are you driving out of the city?”
Chen Yun smiled. “My house isn’t in the city. Have you heard of the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion?”
The Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion!
It was the most luxurious district in Jiang City!
Any villa in the district would cost tens of millions.
Wang Menghan’s eyelids twitched. She didn’t expect Chen Yun to be so rich.
To be honest, she had never entered the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion before. This time, she could be considered to have gone in to take a look.
When they arrived at the entrance of Villa No. 3, Wang Menghan’s expression changed.
Did this villa cost tens of millions?
One might not even be able to buy a swimming pool and garage with this amount!
This villa would cost at least a few hundred million!
How rich was Chen Yun?!
