Chen Yun looked at himself in the mirror.
His appearance had clearly improved.
After all, although he had obtained the face of an Exiled Immortal, the transformation would still take a month to complete.
It was hard to imagine what he would become if a month really passed.
He would simply be a walking hormone diffuser.
Looking at the time, it was time to pick up Wang Menghan, who had just returned from the mountains.
It was not easy for a big star to stay in the mountains for so many days.
Chen Yun thought to himself as he drove the McLaren sports car out of the district.
The security guard looked at the license plate with “Jiang A66666” printed on it and his heart skipped a beat.
This was the person from Villa No.
There was no need for the security guard to lift the barrier.
The smart system identified the license plate and automatically lifted the barrier for Chen Yun to pass.
The security guards immediately bowed to the sports car and watched Chen Yun leave.
At Jiang City International Airport.
At this moment, in the business class cabin of a plane in the air.
Wang Menghan was eating breakfast.
At the side, a manager about her age looked out of the window.
“We’re almost there.
We’re finally back.
I’ve been through so much these past few days.”
“Xiaozi!” Wang Menghan glanced at Zhang Xiaozi.
This roommate of hers had been like this since university.
There had not been much change even after she became her manager.
Zhang Xiaozi looked at Wang Menghan’s gloomy face and smiled awkwardly.
“I’m just complaining about the hardships in the mountains.
I’m not complaining, I’m not complaining.
How would I dare to complain about Beauty Wang?
Tsk tsk tsk.”
Her words were filled with dissatisfaction.
Wang Menghan did not know whether to laugh or cry.
If she was dissatisfied, so be it.
Anyway, she was forced to go this time.
It was reasonable for her to complain.
“If the children in the mountains can keep up with the education, many of them should be able to leave the mountains and find their own world.” Wang Menghan sighed.
With that, Zhang Xiaozi stopped talking.
“By the way, Xiaozi, you should go back to the company first.
I’m going to stay here for a few days and I’m going to meet a friend.”
“Huh?” Zhang Xiaozi’s eyes widened when she heard that.
She had been with Wang Menghan for four years in university, but she had never heard of her having friends in Jiang City.
“Is it your boyfriend?”
“Nonsense.
We’re just friends.”
“It’s really a man.
Who is it?
I have to check on you.
After all, you’re a public figure.”
After getting off the plane, Zhang Xiaozi constantly followed Wang Menghan closely, making Wang Menghan feel helpless.
Her best friend was not good at anything else but gossip.
“Chen Yun, I’m out of the airport.
Where are you?”
She dragged her suitcase and made a call.
Then, she saw a figure get out of a sports car.
Zhang Xiaozi followed Wang Menghan’s gaze.
She was instantly stunned!
It was a McLaren sports car!
It was Jiang A66666!
Most importantly, the person who walked over was wearing a set of slim-fit clothes and a pair of sunglasses, and drove a luxury car.
He looked like a domineering CEO in an idol drama.
It was even better than that!
He was holding a bouquet of white roses in his hand.
He was too handsome!
She could not help but be infatuated!
When Chen Yun got out of the car, many people looked over.
For a moment, many people stopped in their tracks.
“Look at that handsome guy, his aura, and that sports car!”
“I want to go up and ask for his WeChat.
Does anyone want to come with me?”
“How handsome!
Ahhhh...”
Some people even started to shout.
Wang Menghan, who was covered up tightly, pursed her lips when she saw this scene.
Who exactly was the celebrity?
Chen Yun walked up to Wang Menghan and took off his sunglasses.
For a moment, Zhang Xiaozi felt as if she had been struck by lightning.
He wore a set of slim-fit clothes from Gucci, a watch from Vacheron Constantin’s Traversing Four Seas series, and a pair of Armani sunglasses...
His outfit definitely exceeded a million yuan!
Furthermore, he had a luxury car worth three million yuan!
He was undoubtedly a tycoon!
Even Wang Menghan was shocked by Chen Yun’s outfit.
He was too handsome!
He was much more handsome compared to when he was on stage previously.
Chen Yun handed over the flowers in his hand.
“You’ve worked hard this time.”
“Thank you.” Wang Menghan took the flowers.
Then, she looked at the murderous gazes of the girls beside her and stuck out her tongue.
“Aren’t you trying to provoke me?”
Beside them, Zhang Xiaozi looked at the two of them and felt her heart ache.
“Menghan, you guys have fun.
I’m going back to the company first.” Zhang Xiaozi then looked at Chen Yun and took out her phone.
“Handsome, let’s add each other on WeChat.
If I have something urgent and can’t find Menghan, I can look for you too.
Come on, come on.”
Even Wang Menghan did not know whether to laugh or cry.
“Hurry up and leave.
I’ll give you Chen Yun’s WeChat ID when I go back.”
She glanced at her best friend.
Everyone knew what she was thinking.
Zhang Xiaozi looked at Wang Menghan.
Hmph!
This was fake sisterhood!
Even if Wang Menghan wanted to eat the meat, she had to give Zhang Xiaozi some soup!
She left!
Seeing Zhang Xiaozi leave angrily, Wang Menghan looked helpless.
“Let’s go.
I’ll help you carry your suitcase.”
“Okay.”
After getting into the car, Chen Yun brought Wang Menghan to the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion.
“Chen Yun, you really shocked me.
You’re too handsome in this outfit.”
“The clothes I bought yesterday didn’t cost much, but they’re pretty good.”
Wang Menghan was speechless.
Did he say that the clothes didn’t cost much?
His outfit was worth millions!
Did he think that this price was only alright?
He was probably not interested in money either!
As they traveled, Wang Menghan realized that Chen Yun was driving in the wrong direction.
“Where are you taking me?
Aren’t you going to send me to the hotel first?”
“Since my friend is here, why are we still going to the hotel?
Leave your luggage at my house first.
If you think my house is inferior to the hotel, I’ll send you back.”
“Then why are you driving out of the city?”
Chen Yun smiled.
“My house isn’t in the city.
Have you heard of the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion?”
The Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion!
It was the most luxurious district in Jiang City!
Any villa in the district would cost tens of millions.
Wang Menghan’s eyelids twitched.
She didn’t expect Chen Yun to be so rich.
To be honest, she had never entered the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion before.
This time, she could be considered to have gone in to take a look.
When they arrived at the entrance of Villa No.
3, Wang Menghan’s expression changed.
Did this villa cost tens of millions?
One might not even be able to buy a swimming pool and garage with this amount!
This villa would cost at least a few hundred million!
How rich was Chen Yun?!

chapters.title: Chapter 16
paragraphs: At Your Service!
“Do you really live here?” Wang Menghan was still in a daze as she looked at the mansion in front of her. She had never seen such a mansion before.
Seeing that she was in a daze, Chen Yun stood at the door.
The pupil recognition was activated!
The front door opened.
“Welcome home, master.”
A heavy electronic voice sounded. That reassuring voice made Wang Menghan feel relieved.
It seemed that this was indeed Chen Yun’s home.
“Let’s go.” Chen Yun dragged Wang Menghan’s suitcase in and placed it in the guest room.
“Is it okay if you rest here first?” Chen Yun looked into the room. A robot was still cleaning the room.
Wang Menghan looked at the room in front of her. Why not?
Just this guest room alone was more than 50 square meters large!
Furthermore, the facilities were extremely complete.

“Okay.” Wang Menghan did not want to trouble Chen Yun, but seeing such a modern mansion, she could not help but agree. Then, Chen Yun brought Wang Menghan to the door of the guest room and recorded her biological information into this room. This meant that the robot in this room was temporarily under Wang Menghan’s control.
Chen Yun taught her some basic operations. Then, he said, “Menghan, you’ve been tired in the mountains these few days. Rest for a while.”
Wang Menghan really didn’t dislike Chen Yun calling her by her name.
She did not know why. Was it because of Chen Yun’s handsome face? Did Chen Yun give her a sense of security? Or was it because of his luxurious house and wealth?
While she was thinking, Chen Yun had already closed the door and left.
Wang Menghan was left alone in the room.
Wang Menghan was speechless. Had he just left without even looking back?
She was even starting to doubt her charm.
Could it be that she had been staying in the mountains for too long recently and had not bathed for a day?
She sniffed herself.
She didn’t smell.
She was covered in high-grade perfume.
Forget it!
“Let’s take a shower first.” Wang Menghan muttered to herself. Then, she heard the sound of the curtains being drawn, while the water heater in the bathroom began to work.
“Master, the curtains have been drawn for you to protect your privacy.”
“The water temperature is 42 degrees Celsius. Please take a bath.”
“If you need anything, you can ask me. Both milk and petal baths are available.”
“I’ll be at your service.”
This was too advanced!
Just how much would it cost to decorate this high-tech facility, let alone this room?
After taking a shower, Wang Menghan changed her clothes and walked out of the room. In the next moment, she was hooked by a fragrance.
It was too fragrant. What kind of delicacy could emit such a fragrance?!
As she walked down the stairs, Chen Yun heard the sound and put down the plate in his hand. He looked over and his eyes lit up.
His eyes were filled with amazement.
There was a girl standing upstairs. She was wearing a pure white dress and had a slender figure. Her long hair reached her waist.
Her eyes were bright and her lips were like peaches and plums.
Her skin was like ice and her bones were like jade. She was so beautiful that she did not seem human.
She was simply... unbelievably beautiful...
In particular, her gentle and weak temperament simply made one want to protect her.
It was Wang Menghan, who had just come out of the shower. There were still some water droplets on her hair.
Chen Yun nodded. Compared to Wang Menghan, Xiao Xin’s looks and figure were not much different.
However, Xiao Xin’s personality could not match with Wang Menghan’s.
Xiao Xin was lively, while Wang Menghan was steady and elegant, as if she had practiced her actions many times.
She was like a young lady from a wealthy family in the past. Her etiquette was very good.
“What are you doing?”
Wang Menghan looked at Chen Yun in surprise. Chen Yun was actually placing food on the table.
“You’re just in time. Come and eat.” Chen Yun turned around and entered the kitchen, preparing to take out the remaining dishes.
“Can he cook too?”
Wang Menghan was in disbelief!
Wasn’t he a tycoon?
However, after thinking about it carefully, there was really no rule that tycoons could not cook.
Some rich people were very talented.
She felt that Chen Yun was one example.
The dishes were served one after another, stunning Wang Menghan again.
There was smoked steak, steamed cod, boiled asparagus with egg whites, almond cake...
They were all the signature dishes of Michelin restaurants!
There were also Longyin Strawberries!
Any dish would be sold at an extremely high price!
Moreover, just from their appearance, Chen Yun’s cooking looked comparable to a Michelin chef’s.
“It smells good.”
Wang Menghan could not help but be intoxicated by the fragrance.
“Is Romanee-Conti okay?” Chen Yun picked out a bottle of red wine from the wine cabinet.
Wang Menghan’s eyelids twitched.
Was it okay?
Of course!
It was a bottle of red wine that cost hundreds of thousands of yuan!
“It’s too expensive.” Wang Menghan waved her hand.
“We’ll drink this.” Chen Yun summoned a robot and handed the red wine to it for it to serve the wine.
“Come on, let’s eat.”
Wang Menghan picked up her knife and fork and tasted a piece of steak.
Her beautiful eyes widened. This taste!
The dishes were perfect!
It was even comparable to a Michelin chef’s cooking!
It was too delicious!
Unexpectedly, Chen Yun’s culinary skills had already reached this level!

“Chen Yun, with your culinary skills, you can become a Michelin star chef!” Wang Menghan was full of praises. The Western food and special red wine made her face slightly red, making her look extremely alluring.
Chen Yun listened to Wang Menghan.
He was confused.
When did he say that he was the one who made these dishes?
This kind of rough work could be left to the robots!
Besides, he only knew how to stir-fry some home-cooked dishes and cook instant noodles!
However, the feeling of being worshiped like this was not bad.
He would reluctantly take credit for the robot.

chapters.title: Chapter 17
paragraphs: Great Scenery!
After eating and drinking to her heart’s content, Wang Menghan did not wait for the robot to take action and took the initiative to clean up the dishes in the dining room.
At the same time, Chen Yun’s phone rang.
“Hello, Mom.”
A dialect with a rich rustic aura was heard.
“Xiao Yun, did you know that we won the lottery with the two lottery tickets you sent us? They’re both first prize tickets. We received a total of more than ten million yuan after tax!”

“Oh, oh, I won a lot too, but they’re all second or third prizes. I analyzed these using big data. They’re very accurate.” Chen Yun beat his mother to it. Anyway, his mother didn’t know much about these high-tech things. She usually just played with WeChat. These things were enough to scare her.
“By the way, Mom, how do you plan to use this money?”

“How do I plan to use this money? You bought the tickets, so I’ll give it all to you. In the future, if you want to buy a house or a car in the big city, or find a wife, you’ll have many things to spend money on.”

When Chen Yun heard his mother’s voice, she laughed. “Alright, Mom. You can spend the ten million yuan with my dad and Mengmeng. You don’t have to worry about me. I won a few million yuan in the previous season, let alone the next season.”

When his mother heard this, she immediately sucked in a breath of cold air. She did not expect that the lottery could be predicted like this. It was no wonder that those old people studied at the lottery shop every day. It turned out that they were not just acting as if they were very serious about it.
“By the way, Xiao Yun, Mengmeng wanted to look for you today.”
As soon as she finished speaking, a voice squeezed in. “Brother, I’m going to Jiang City to look for you.”

“Stop fooling around. Aren’t you going to Tianjing to prepare for the art exam? Why come to Jiang City? Be good and go do what you need to do.” Chen Yun chuckled. His biological sister really made him worry.

“I’m going to Jiang City to look for you. Besides, the Jiang City University of Art, the Tianjing University of Art, and the Central University of Art are also known as the three top art universities in China. It doesn’t matter where I go. I don’t care. I’ve already made up my mind and changed my choice. In a few days, I’ll prepare to go to the Jiang City University of Art for the examination.”
“Of course, I’m not doing it for you.”
“Go ahead and be arrogant. I heard that arrogant girls can’t get married.”
“Who said that!” The other party suddenly became noisy, making Chen Yun’s head hurt. “Alright, alright, alright. Call me when you come. I’ll pick you up. Give the phone to our mother.”

“Mom, use this money to go on a trip with Dad and start a small business. Don’t work anymore. You’re not young anymore. Don’t tire yourself out,” said Chen Yun. He knew that his mother loved to travel, but she didn’t have time or money. Now that she was rich, she naturally had to fulfill her dream.
After settling these matters at home, Chen Yun hung up the phone and looked at Wang Menghan’s strange gaze.
“What’s wrong?”
“What are you talking about, fellow countryman?”
This familiar dialect instantly stunned Chen Yun. “Are you from Yanwei too?”
“My grandfather was from Yanwei. Later, my father moved out of there.”
“What a coincidence.”
As the saying went, when a fellow countryman saw a fellow countryman, tears would well up in their eyes.

Wang Menghan simply sat down and listened to Chen Yun talk about Yanwei’s development in recent years and the past. The two of them talked for the entire afternoon. The eaten snacks and dried fruit shells filled up half the table.
“Let’s go out to sea tomorrow.” Chen Yun looked at Wang Menghan and said, “You moved from Yanwei to the mainland. You haven’t seen the sea in a long time, right?”
“Okay, but I’m going out to buy some clothes later. I don’t have a swimsuit yet.”
Hearing Wang Menghan’s words, Chen Yun lowered his head and a smug smile appeared on his face.
At night, Chen Yun added the people he had invited into a WeChat group. They arranged their schedules and prepared the things for tomorrow. Then, they chatted until late at night.
During this period of time, they joked around and turned on their cameras for a while. They got to know each other.
Early the next morning, Chen Yun contacted everyone and set off.
He drove the McLaren with Wang Menghan, while Zhou Jingyi drove her little Beetle to Jiang City University of Art to pick up Liu Xin. The two cars headed towards the East Port.
At this moment, a few men were waiting at the East Port. When they saw the two cars approaching, they quickly went forward to welcome them.

“Manager Zhou, you’re here.” The middle-aged man then looked at Chen Yun, who got off the McLaren, and quickly went up to him. “You must be Mr. Chen. I’ve heard a lot about you. I’m Zhang Hai, the manager of the ship rental and sales here.”
“Hello, take me to see it. I haven’t seen the real thing yet.”
“Oh, oh, alright. This way, please. Just park the cars here. We will definitely help you look after them.” Zhang Hai’s body was slightly bent, and his expression was respectful.
He did not dare to be disrespectful. What kind of person was this!
He had bought a yacht worth six million yuan!
He didn’t even look at the real thing and bought it at full price!
He was simply a walking God of Fortune!

“Mr. Chen, we’ve placed fishing rods, parasols, and swimming equipment on your yacht. We’ve also placed drinks, fruits, and seasonings in the refrigerator according to your requirements. If you need anything, please call me. I’ll sail a boat out to sea immediately.” Zhang Hai took out his business card from his pocket and handed it over with both hands.
“Okay, thanks.”
They arrived at the luxury yacht.
Even Chen Yun could not help but be amazed. This thing was much more magnificent and luxurious than the one in the photo.
“Chen Yun, is this yours?”
“I bought it a few days ago. I’ll take you guys out to sea.” Chen Yun waved. “Let’s go. Get on the boat.”
After a simple lesson, Chen Yun, who was known as the God of Racing, learned the ropes very quickly. In just a few minutes, he had mastered the technique of driving a yacht.
“Mr. Chen, don’t worry. I know you’re going out to sea today. I’ve cleared the area. Don’t worry, I’ve arranged everything. No one will check your documents.” Zhang Hai patted his chest and promised.
This made Chen Yun smile. It was said that money talked. With money, he could establish connections.
“You’ve worked hard.”
“Not at all, not at all. Mr. Chen, I wish you a good time with the beauties,” said Zhang Hai as he led his men off the yacht.
As for Chen Yun, he drove the yacht towards the check-in location.
As time passed, the air gradually became hot. The transition from spring to summer only took a day or two.
The temperature in Jiang City was close to 30 degrees Celsius.
The air started to heat up.
Xiao Xin was the first to change into a swimsuit. She lay on the deck recliner with a drink in her mouth, looking especially relaxed.
Meanwhile, Wang Menghan and Zhou Jingyi also changed their clothes.
For a moment, the entire deck was filled with great scenery.
There were three pairs of snow-white long legs that were straight and slender.

Xiao Xin’s bikini was cute. It was a light purple swimsuit with a thin strap around her back and tied around her neck. There was a big blue bow tied around the waist of the swimsuit. Her hair was tied into a high ponytail, making her look youthful and energetic. However, her swimsuit couldn’t hide her plump chest.
Wang Menghan was more conservative, but she also showed a lot of skin. Meanwhile, Zhou Jingyi was the most mature and sexy.
The three of them each had their own merits. Any one of them was enough to make people go crazy.
Chen Yun was driving the yacht. Looking at the scenery, he touched his chin and smiled.

Don’t work anymore.
You’re not young anymore.
Don’t tire yourself out,” said Chen Yun.
He knew that his mother loved to travel, but she didn’t have time or money.
Now that she was rich, she naturally had to fulfill her dream.
After settling these matters at home, Chen Yun hung up the phone and looked at Wang Menghan’s strange gaze.
“What’s wrong?”
“What are you talking about, fellow countryman?”
This familiar dialect instantly stunned Chen Yun.
“Are you from Yanwei too?”
“My grandfather was from Yanwei.
Later, my father moved out of there.”
“What a coincidence.”
As the saying went, when a fellow countryman saw a fellow countryman, tears would well up in their eyes.
Wang Menghan simply sat down and listened to Chen Yun talk about Yanwei’s development in recent years and the past.
The two of them talked for the entire afternoon.
The eaten snacks and dried fruit shells filled up half the table.
“Let’s go out to sea tomorrow.” Chen Yun looked at Wang Menghan and said, “You moved from Yanwei to the mainland.
You haven’t seen the sea in a long time, right?”
“Okay, but I’m going out to buy some clothes later.
I don’t have a swimsuit yet.”
Hearing Wang Menghan’s words, Chen Yun lowered his head and a smug smile appeared on his face.
At night, Chen Yun added the people he had invited into a WeChat group.
They arranged their schedules and prepared the things for tomorrow.
Then, they chatted until late at night.
During this period of time, they joked around and turned on their cameras for a while.
They got to know each other.
Early the next morning, Chen Yun contacted everyone and set off.
He drove the McLaren with Wang Menghan, while Zhou Jingyi drove her little Beetle to Jiang City University of Art to pick up Liu Xin.
The two cars headed towards the East Port.
At this moment, a few men were waiting at the East Port.
When they saw the two cars approaching, they quickly went forward to welcome them.
“Manager Zhou, you’re here.” The middle-aged man then looked at Chen Yun, who got off the McLaren, and quickly went up to him.
“You must be Mr.
Chen.
I’ve heard a lot about you.
I’m Zhang Hai, the manager of the ship rental and sales here.”
“Hello, take me to see it.
I haven’t seen the real thing yet.”
“Oh, oh, alright.
This way, please.
Just park the cars here.
We will definitely help you look after them.” Zhang Hai’s body was slightly bent, and his expression was respectful.
He did not dare to be disrespectful.
What kind of person was this!
He had bought a yacht worth six million yuan!
He didn’t even look at the real thing and bought it at full price!
He was simply a walking God of Fortune!
“Mr.
Chen, we’ve placed fishing rods, parasols, and swimming equipment on your yacht.
We’ve also placed drinks, fruits, and seasonings in the refrigerator according to your requirements.
If you need anything, please call me.
I’ll sail a boat out to sea immediately.” Zhang Hai took out his business card from his pocket and handed it over with both hands.
“Okay, thanks.”
They arrived at the luxury yacht.
Even Chen Yun could not help but be amazed.
This thing was much more magnificent and luxurious than the one in the photo.
“Chen Yun, is this yours?”
“I bought it a few days ago.
I’ll take you guys out to sea.” Chen Yun waved.
“Let’s go.
Get on the boat.”
After a simple lesson, Chen Yun, who was known as the God of Racing, learned the ropes very quickly.
In just a few minutes, he had mastered the technique of driving a yacht.
“Mr.
Chen, don’t worry.
I know you’re going out to sea today.
I’ve cleared the area.
Don’t worry, I’ve arranged everything.
No one will check your documents.” Zhang Hai patted his chest and promised.
This made Chen Yun smile.
It was said that money talked.
With money, he could establish connections.
“You’ve worked hard.”
“Not at all, not at all.
Mr.
Chen, I wish you a good time with the beauties,” said Zhang Hai as he led his men off the yacht.
As for Chen Yun, he drove the yacht towards the check-in location.
As time passed, the air gradually became hot.
The transition from spring to summer only took a day or two.
The temperature in Jiang City was close to 30 degrees Celsius.
The air started to heat up.
Xiao Xin was the first to change into a swimsuit.
She lay on the deck recliner with a drink in her mouth, looking especially relaxed.
Meanwhile, Wang Menghan and Zhou Jingyi also changed their clothes.
For a moment, the entire deck was filled with great scenery.
There were three pairs of snow-white long legs that were straight and slender.
Xiao Xin’s bikini was cute.
It was a light purple swimsuit with a thin strap around her back and tied around her neck.
There was a big blue bow tied around the waist of the swimsuit.
Her hair was tied into a high ponytail, making her look youthful and energetic.
However, her swimsuit couldn’t hide her plump chest.
Wang Menghan was more conservative, but she also showed a lot of skin.
Meanwhile, Zhou Jingyi was the most mature and sexy.
The three of them each had their own merits.
Any one of them was enough to make people go crazy.
Chen Yun was driving the yacht.
Looking at the scenery, he touched his chin and smiled.

chapters.title: Chapter 18
paragraphs: Showing Off!
When they arrived at the designated location, Chen Yun stopped the luxury yacht and walked out with a plate of fruits.

At this moment, on the deck, Xiao Xin leaned close to Zhou Jingyi. “Sister Jingyi, you have a good figure. You’re curvy and don’t have any fat at all. Also, this swimsuit is so mature. It’s simply not the same as me.”
“I’m only two years older than you.” Zhou Jingyi saw that Wang Menghan wasn’t looking in their direction and reached out to touch Xiao Xin.
“You’re a D cup.”
Xiao Xin bit her lips and almost cried out. Then, she looked at Zhou Jingyi angrily.
How could she suddenly attack her!
She wanted to attack back too!
For a moment, the two of them were having fun.

Beside them, Wang Menghan was lying on a recliner, enjoying the gentle sea breeze. The weather was really good today. The temperature was suitable and it was calm. The warm breeze blew on her face, making her feel like she was on vacation.
It was nice.
“Sister Menghan, come and help me!”
Wang Menghan turned to look at the two of them and saw Zhou Jingyi hugging Liu Xin. Xiao Xin simply had no strength to resist.
“Alright, have some fruits.”
Chen Yun walked out of the cockpit and placed the fruits on the table.
It was not time to check in yet. He could stop and play.
Especially with these three stunning beauties!
Today, Chen Yun was wearing a short-sleeved shirt and loose pants. He looked like a handsome man on the beach.
Chen Yun sat down and looked at the three of them.
They were eye-catching!
“Menghan, how is it? How’s the sea here compared to the sea at Yanwei?”
“The seabed near the shore at Yanwei extends out bit by bit, but it’s different here. Moreover, the seawater here is quite clear. Why don’t we dive down later?”
“Ah? I don’t know how to dive.” Liu Xin stuck out her tongue.
“It’s fine. It’s easy to learn.” Chen Yun led the three girls to the back. Then, they put on their diving suits and equipment.
Chen Yun took off his shirt.
The next moment, the eyes of the three girls lit up. Zhou Jingyi had seen Chen Yun’s wet upper body before, so she was still better off.
However, Liu Xin and Wang Menghan could no longer remain calm!
He had a six-pack! His body was well-defined!
He also had two strong chest muscles!
His arms were also well-defined!
The muscles on his entire upper body looked as if they had been carved with an axe. They were incomparably perfect!
It could be called a work of art from the heavens!
Furthermore, Chen Yun had good looks. His muscles could be seen just by raising his hand. As a result, he was endlessly charming!

“Your figure is too good.” Wang Menghan couldn’t help but cover her mouth in shock. Liu Xin, who was beside her, also nodded repeatedly. “If you participate in a bodybuilding competition, you might be able to win the first prize.”
Although Chen Yun did not train his figure, the proportions of his body were simply too good. It was as if he had a peerless body that was bestowed by the heavens.

Wang Menghan’s face gradually turned red as she looked at him. Her long legs crossed slightly. Afraid that she would lose her composure, she quickly said to everyone, “Let’s quickly change into swimsuits and go down to see the underwater world.”
After changing, Chen Yun entered the water first. The water was warm and comfortable.
However, unlike the girls, he took an extra net bag and headed towards the bottom of the water.
After entering the water, even Chen Yun was shocked by the quality of the water here. The water below was extremely clear, and there were many fish swimming.
The girls also entered the water one after another. They were like three mermaids in the sea. Their figures were very tempting.
Compared to swimming, Chen Yun preferred to go to the beach and collect seafood. After all, he did not ask Zhang Hai to prepare the ingredients for lunch.
Since they were here, they would eat the freshest seafood.
“It’s an orchid crab!”
Wearing gloves, Chen Yun grabbed the palm-sized orchid crab and threw it into the net.
There were also scallops and oysters.
This place was like an unexplored paradise. There were all kinds of seafood. In a short period of time, Chen Yun picked up one kilogram of seafood.
After swimming for a while, the three girls saw Chen Yun’s actions and understood. They quickly went over to help.
After a while, Xiao Xin came over. She held a sea cucumber the size of a forearm in one hand and a large abalone in the other. Then, he placed the seafood in Chen Yun’s net.
Wang Menghan and Zhou Jingyi were not to be outdone. The two of them even worked together to catch a small octopus.
The next moment, Wang Menghan glanced around and couldn’t help but suck in a mouthful of oxygen.
She patted Chen Yun and pointed to the other side.
The other two girls also turned around and glared at what Wang Menghan was pointing at.
“Oh my God!”
There was a huge lobster!
It was as long as an arm!
Moreover, its body was colorful!
It was an ornate spiny lobster!
It was hard to imagine that an ornate spiny lobster could grow to such a size!
Chen Yun was about to go over when Wang Menghan stopped him.
Shaking her head, Wang Menghan smiled bitterly. This thing was not something they could catch.

The pair of large pincers that the huge lobster had were like iron pincers. If they were clamped by these pincers, it was possible to break their fingers and wrists. She didn’t want anything to happen to Chen Yun.
However, Chen Yun waved his hand and handed the net to Wang Menghan.
Then, he swam towards the ornate spiny lobster.
As it approached, the ornate spiny lobster seemed to sense danger and raised its two pincers threateningly.
Its pair of large pincers was wider than a palm.

If this was in the past, Chen Yun would definitely not dare to attack. After all, this thing was not a joke. These wild beasts were ferocious to begin with. Coupled with their huge bodies, it was easy for them to break human bones.
But now...
With an eight times increase in physical fitness, Chen Yun’s reaction, speed, and strength had reached an extremely terrifying level.
In the next moment, Chen Yun suddenly reached out and grabbed the back of the lobster’s neck.
He picked it up and swam towards the surface.
The three girls were also excited when they saw this and followed behind Chen Yun.
After getting on the boat, Wang Menghan helped Chen Yun hold down the lobster with a clamp. Chen Yun found a rope and quickly wrapped the two pincers of the lobster.
This lobster was only left with the ability to slap the deck.
After changing their clothes, the three of them quickly took out their phones and took photos of today’s “trophy.”
There were many close-ups, especially of the lobster.
The four of them also took a lot of photos together, including some scenes of the luxury yacht.
The three girls posted on their Moments as if they were trying to start a war.
[Lin Yu: Xiao Xin, are you on Brother Yun’s luxury yacht? Oh my god, does Brother Yun have such a good figure?]
[Zhang Jing: Wow, why didn’t you bring me along? Why?! I’m just hungry for lobsters!]
[Lin Yu: You know what you’re craving for!]
Meanwhile, Wang Menghan was also bombarded by her manager, Zhang Xiaozi, on WeChat.
“Why didn’t you call me when you went out to sea?”
“Ahhh, I’m going to change my male idol today. He has such a handsome face and a great figure. Menghan, I want all his information within three minutes!”
“Menghan, take a few more photos. I need more angles, please!”
“Answer me!!! Ahhh!!!”
“We’re no longer friends!”
“We’re no longer friends, really!”
Zhou Jingyi’s colleagues were also envious and jealous of her. This was too hateful!
After all, she had gone out to sea with such a handsome man and so many delicacies!
Only handsome men and delicious food would not let one down!
The three of them each held their phones. Meanwhile, Chen Yun stood at the bow of the ship and looked at the screen in front of him.
[It is time to check in. Host, please check in.]

chapters.title: Chapter 19
paragraphs: 80% Shares!
It was time to check in!
The chance was finally here!
Chen Yun looked at the check-in button in front of him. He was looking forward to it.
He pressed the button.
[Congratulations to the host for completing the check-in mission.]
[You have obtained 20% of Sacred Heaven Entertainment’s shares.]
A dice appeared in front of Chen Yun, and the Random Double skill was activated.
Without a doubt, another four appeared!
[You have obtained 80% of Sacred Heaven Entertainment’s shares.]
He had obtained 80% of the shares!
Chen Yun looked at the screen in front of him and gasped. Then, he quickly took out his phone and searched.
Sacred Heaven Entertainment was located in Jiang City. It was one of the top five entertainment companies in the entire country. Its market value was more than ten billion!
In other words, Chen Yun had 80% of their shares, which meant that he had eight to nine billion yuan in his hands!
This was too ruthless!
At the same time, the light screen flickered.
[Distributing shares!]
[Modifying information!]
[Modification complete!]
Hm?
The next moment, a call came in.
“Hello.” Chen Yun picked it up.

“Hello, Director. I’m the professional manager hired by Sacred Heaven Entertainment, Ma Ke. I just received news that you’ve bought the shares that originally belonged to the Lu Family and are now the largest shareholder of Sacred Heaven Entertainment. I would like to ask you about your next strategic plan for Sacred Heaven Entertainment.” The deep and sonorous voice had a heavy feeling.
It made one feel at ease.
At the same time, Chen Yun also understood the effect of the system. The system actually bought the shares directly.
The person who called should be the person who temporarily helped manage Sacred Heaven Entertainment.
He was a professional manager.
He was someone with professional managerial competencies who engaged in management work for the benefit of enterprises or other economic bodies.
In other words, he was a high-ranking manager. To put it bluntly, CEOs were mostly in this profession.
Thus, he managed the company for Chen Yun. If he could profit, he could continue working. If he couldn’t he had to leave. This was the job of a professional manager.
This was also the reason why the other party was so respectful to Chen Yun.
“I don’t have a strategic plan for the next stage yet. I’ll just follow your previous plan. If I have time in the near future, I’ll go over and inspect the situation.”
“Okay, Director Chen.” After hearing Chen Yun’s words, Ma Ke immediately responded and hung up.
On the other side.
Beside a glass wall of the 100-story tall building that housed Sacred Heaven Entertainment.
Ma Ke looked out at the prosperity of Jiang City and sighed silently. His heart was in turmoil. He almost thought that he had called the wrong number.
Judging from the other party’s voice, he was just a young person.
However, right now such a young person actually owned 80% of Sacred Heaven Entertainment’s shares!
Moreover, he had bought them from the Lu family!
One had to know that this was not just about money!
He also had to have a good background!
He had thought that Chen Yun would make drastic changes to the organization upon taking charge, but the other party did not say anything.
Forget it!
No matter what, he was a professional manager!
Although he was a CEO, he worked for others and earned money for them.
If he couldn’t earn money for Chen Yun, he wouldn’t have to work anymore.
Therefore, he had to work hard for the new director!
On the yacht.
Chen Yun held the back of his neck with both hands and quickly calmed down. He realized that his temperament was rapidly improving.
He believed that not long after, he would be able to maintain a calm face while his heart was in turmoil.
Meanwhile, Wang Menghan and the other two played with their phones for a while before going to take a shower.
After taking a shower, they changed into casual clothes and walked into the kitchen. An extremely delicious smell assaulted their senses.
It simply made them drool!

“Come and eat. I just processed the seafood a little. I didn’t add too many seasonings. Only then can I ensure that the seafood maintains its original taste.” Chen Yun said. Then, he took out a crab from a metal pot, opened the shell, and ate the crab roe.
It was abnormally delicious and filled with bliss!
The two pots of seafood, including the ornate spiny lobster, were boiled after being processed slightly.
If it didn’t taste good enough, they could dip it in garlic paste.
This was the correct way to eat seafood.
For example, eating seafood with chili or
mala
, which was done in the mainland, simply covered up the taste of the seafood.
Most importantly, Chen Yun wondered if they used a heavy taste to cover up the stench because the seafood was not fresh enough when it was shipped to the mainland.
When the girls saw Chen Yun start eating, they quickly sat down and took the seafood.
As soon as the seafood entered their mouths, it popped. The juice was delicious!
This was a true delicacy!
“It’s so delicious!”
“I used to eat seafood with garlic, but I didn’t expect that just boiling the seafood will make it several times better than eating it with garlic!”
“It’s incredible.”
Wang Menghan looked at Chen Yun and shook her head. She had really learned from Chen Yun what it meant to not waste ingredients.
After the three of them ate for a while, they took out their phones and posted the food on their Moments.
For a moment, the people’s resentment boiled.
This was simply attracting hatred!
Lin Yu, Zhang Jing, and Wang Menghan’s manager, Zhang Xiaozi, were all green with envy. They wished they were on the yacht right now.
After eating, the three girls lay on recliners and basked in the sun.
Xiao Xin rubbed her round belly with a satisfied expression.
The other two girls did the same. Their stomachs bulged slightly.
This was getting out of hand.
It was difficult to even turn over.
However, they believed that if they were given another pot of seafood, they would be able to finish it.
After the four of them played for a while, they sailed back to the dock.
Zhang Hai, who was playing poker with a few people, saw the luxury yacht coming back. He threw the cards in his hand and walked out with a smile.
“Mr. Chen, you’re back. Are you satisfied with this trip? Did you encounter any trouble?”
“No, everything’s fine. I’ll leave my yacht with you.”

“Oh, alright. Mr. Chen, don’t worry. I’ll get someone to clean it for you every day. I guarantee that it will be brand new whenever you come.” Zhang Hai patted his chest and took out a Zhonghua cigarette from his pocket. “Mr. Chen, do you want one?”
“I don’t smoke.”
Then, Chen Yun smiled. “Then I’ll have to trouble you. We’ll work together again when we have time.”
“Alright, alright.”
Zhang Hai watched the two cars drive away. This was the life of a rich young master. He had a luxury car, beautiful women, and a lot of money. Zhang Hai was so envious.
His brothers beside him were also ashamed of their inferiority.
“Brother Hai, tell me, how much money does this master have? He probably has tens of millions.”
“Ten million? Do you see the watch on his wrist? That small item costs seven to eight hundred thousand yuan! The car costs three million yuan! Furthermore, the yacht behind costs six million yuan!”

“Moreover, when the contract for the yacht was signed, he didn’t even come to take a look. He didn’t care at all. Do you know how much money he has? He’s different from people like us who sell and rent boats.”
These few words shocked the brothers. Their eyes widened. They simply could not believe what they had heard. This was too shocking!
“We can’t compare with him. Let’s go back and play cards.” Zhang Hai shook his head.

[Distributing shares!]
[Modifying information!]
[Modification complete!]
Hm?
The next moment, a call came in.
“Hello.” Chen Yun picked it up.
“Hello, Director.
I’m the professional manager hired by Sacred Heaven Entertainment, Ma Ke.
I just received news that you’ve bought the shares that originally belonged to the Lu Family and are now the largest shareholder of Sacred Heaven Entertainment.
I would like to ask you about your next strategic plan for Sacred Heaven Entertainment.” The deep and sonorous voice had a heavy feeling.
It made one feel at ease.
At the same time, Chen Yun also understood the effect of the system.
The system actually bought the shares directly.
The person who called should be the person who temporarily helped manage Sacred Heaven Entertainment.
He was a professional manager.
He was someone with professional managerial competencies who engaged in management work for the benefit of enterprises or other economic bodies.
In other words, he was a high-ranking manager.
To put it bluntly, CEOs were mostly in this profession.
Thus, he managed the company for Chen Yun.
If he could profit, he could continue working.
If he couldn’t he had to leave.
This was the job of a professional manager.
This was also the reason why the other party was so respectful to Chen Yun.
“I don’t have a strategic plan for the next stage yet.
I’ll just follow your previous plan.
If I have time in the near future, I’ll go over and inspect the situation.”
“Okay, Director Chen.” After hearing Chen Yun’s words, Ma Ke immediately responded and hung up.
On the other side.
Beside a glass wall of the 100-story tall building that housed Sacred Heaven Entertainment.
Ma Ke looked out at the prosperity of Jiang City and sighed silently.
His heart was in turmoil.
He almost thought that he had called the wrong number.
Judging from the other party’s voice, he was just a young person.
However, right now such a young person actually owned 80% of Sacred Heaven Entertainment’s shares!
Moreover, he had bought them from the Lu family!
One had to know that this was not just about money!
He also had to have a good background!
He had thought that Chen Yun would make drastic changes to the organization upon taking charge, but the other party did not say anything.
Forget it!
No matter what, he was a professional manager!
Although he was a CEO, he worked for others and earned money for them.
If he couldn’t earn money for Chen Yun, he wouldn’t have to work anymore.
Therefore, he had to work hard for the new director!
On the yacht.
Chen Yun held the back of his neck with both hands and quickly calmed down.
He realized that his temperament was rapidly improving.
He believed that not long after, he would be able to maintain a calm face while his heart was in turmoil.
Meanwhile, Wang Menghan and the other two played with their phones for a while before going to take a shower.
After taking a shower, they changed into casual clothes and walked into the kitchen.
An extremely delicious smell assaulted their senses.
It simply made them drool!
“Come and eat.
I just processed the seafood a little.
I didn’t add too many seasonings.
Only then can I ensure that the seafood maintains its original taste.” Chen Yun said.
Then, he took out a crab from a metal pot, opened the shell, and ate the crab roe.
It was abnormally delicious and filled with bliss!
The two pots of seafood, including the ornate spiny lobster, were boiled after being processed slightly.
If it didn’t taste good enough, they could dip it in garlic paste.
This was the correct way to eat seafood.
For example, eating seafood with chili or
mala
, which was done in the mainland, simply covered up the taste of the seafood.
Most importantly, Chen Yun wondered if they used a heavy taste to cover up the stench because the seafood was not fresh enough when it was shipped to the mainland.
When the girls saw Chen Yun start eating, they quickly sat down and took the seafood.
As soon as the seafood entered their mouths, it popped.
The juice was delicious!
This was a true delicacy!
“It’s so delicious!”
“I used to eat seafood with garlic, but I didn’t expect that just boiling the seafood will make it several times better than eating it with garlic!”
“It’s incredible.”
Wang Menghan looked at Chen Yun and shook her head.
She had really learned from Chen Yun what it meant to not waste ingredients.
After the three of them ate for a while, they took out their phones and posted the food on their Moments.
For a moment, the people’s resentment boiled.
This was simply attracting hatred!
Lin Yu, Zhang Jing, and Wang Menghan’s manager, Zhang Xiaozi, were all green with envy.
They wished they were on the yacht right now.
After eating, the three girls lay on recliners and basked in the sun.
Xiao Xin rubbed her round belly with a satisfied expression.
The other two girls did the same.
Their stomachs bulged slightly.
This was getting out of hand.
It was difficult to even turn over.
However, they believed that if they were given another pot of seafood, they would be able to finish it.
After the four of them played for a while, they sailed back to the dock.
Zhang Hai, who was playing poker with a few people, saw the luxury yacht coming back.
He threw the cards in his hand and walked out with a smile.
“Mr.
Chen, you’re back.
Are you satisfied with this trip?
Did you encounter any trouble?”
“No, everything’s fine.
I’ll leave my yacht with you.”
“Oh, alright.
Mr.
Chen, don’t worry.
I’ll get someone to clean it for you every day.
I guarantee that it will be brand new whenever you come.” Zhang Hai patted his chest and took out a Zhonghua cigarette from his pocket.
“Mr.
Chen, do you want one?”
“I don’t smoke.”
Then, Chen Yun smiled.
“Then I’ll have to trouble you.
We’ll work together again when we have time.”
“Alright, alright.”
Zhang Hai watched the two cars drive away.
This was the life of a rich young master.
He had a luxury car, beautiful women, and a lot of money.
Zhang Hai was so envious.
His brothers beside him were also ashamed of their inferiority.
“Brother Hai, tell me, how much money does this master have?
He probably has tens of millions.”
“Ten million?
Do you see the watch on his wrist?
That small item costs seven to eight hundred thousand yuan!
The car costs three million yuan!
Furthermore, the yacht behind costs six million yuan!”
“Moreover, when the contract for the yacht was signed, he didn’t even come to take a look.
He didn’t care at all.
Do you know how much money he has?
He’s different from people like us who sell and rent boats.”
These few words shocked the brothers.
Their eyes widened.
They simply could not believe what they had heard.
This was too shocking!
“We can’t compare with him.
Let’s go back and play cards.” Zhang Hai shook his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 20
paragraphs: Money Is Power
Chen Yun brought Wang Menghan home. After a simple meal, Chen Yun fell asleep.
The next day, there was no check-in mission.
Without a check-in mission on the next day, he started to miss it.
Chen Yun went out to run around the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion in the morning. When he came back, he felt refreshed.
Wang Menghan had not woken up yet. She must have been tired from playing yesterday and felt relaxed during her vacation.
“It’s time to go to Sacred Heaven Entertainment today.” Chen Yun thought about it. The next moment, his phone rang.
“Mengmeng, what’s wrong?”
“Brother, you didn’t expect this, right? Guess where I am now.”
“Huh?” Chen Yun was stunned. “Have you already come to Jiang City?”

“That’s right. My classmates formed a team and came here to prepare for the exam. I can see the Yangtze River now.” Chen Mengmeng leaned against the glass and looked at the Yangtze River outside. It was simply vast.
It was no wonder everyone said that there was a dragon in China called the Yangtze River.
The pride in her heart could not help but overflow as she crossed the bridge over the river.
She was proud to be a descendant of China.
At the same time, many students leaned against the train window and watched the situation outside.

“Girl, why didn’t you tell me in advance? You only remembered me when you’re almost at the station. I’ll pick you up at the station later.” Chen Yun’s words made Chen Mengmeng shake her head repeatedly.

“It’s okay, Brother. I’ll just go to the hotel with my best friend. Besides, aren’t you studying in Jiang City? Where are you going to take me? Are we going to the dormitory?” Chen Mengmeng said sweetly, “I’ll come and play with you after I settle down.”
Chen Mengmeng was about to hang up when Chen Yun said slowly, “Your brother has bought a new house. It’s big enough for you to live in.”
“Really?”

Chen Mengmeng was also stunned. However, when she thought of the two first-prize lottery tickets that her brother had sent home, she believed it without a doubt. “Alright, Brother. See you at Jiang City Station later.”
After hanging up, Chen Yun looked at his phone and smiled bitterly. This girl was about to go to university, but she was still like a child.
Chen Yun doted on his sister very much. After all, how many older brothers did not dote on their younger sisters?

Speaking of which, Chen Yun and Chen Mengmeng had inherited excellent genes from the previous generation, especially Chen Mengmeng. She was nearly 1.7 meters tall. Coupled with her looks, she was simply excellent.

In particular, her etiquette, which she had picked up from being sent for etiquette classes since she was young, gave her a considerable advantage in terms of temperament. If one did not know her situation, they might have treated her as a mistress of a large family.
However, in front of her family, her appearance was different.
It was precisely because she had advantages in all aspects that Chen Mengmeng had the confidence to enter the acting department of Jiang City University of the Arts.
She wasn’t one of the top school belles of Yanwei No. 1 High School for no reason.
It had been a long time since they last met. Chen Yun missed this little girl.
After putting down the phone, Chen Mengmeng hugged Han Xue beside her. “Xiao Xue, my brother bought a house in Jiang City. We don’t need to stay in a hotel anymore. Let’s go to his place.”
Chen Mengmeng’s excited look attracted the attention of many students.
Especially the male students.
“Wow, my goddess is smiling so happily.”
“Your goddess? She’s everyone’s goddess.”
“Hehe, you country bumpkins can only look at her. Chen Mengmeng will be Brother Qiang’s sooner or later.”
A few boys in fashionable clothes looked at the others and sneered.
The other boys listened to them and did not dare to refute.
These people were all Xu Wenqiang’s lackeys. Xu Wenqiang was one of the most famous young masters in their class, or even the entire school.
His family owned a chain bathhouse. It was said that they had assets worth tens of millions!
Moreover, it was said that Xu Wenqiang had been wooing Chen Mengmeng recently, but Chen Mengmeng ignored him.
At this moment, Xu Wenqiang was playing poker with a few friends. His Nike shoes were placed on the seat opposite him.
He looked disgusted.
“F*ck, you guys only know how to come up with bad ideas. The train keeps bumping along the way. My butt is about to crack. I might as well fly over.”
“Brother Qiang, calm down. We suggested it because we remembered that Chen Mengmeng is also taking the train.”
“Brother Qiang, we’re thinking of you. You should appreciate it.”

“I know, I know.” Xu Wenqiang waved his hand. Then, he stood up and said loudly, “Classmates, I’ve already booked rooms at the Riverfront Hotel in Jiang City. It’s a three-star hotel. I’ve paid the room fee. You can’t embarrass me here. If you don’t come, I won’t be happy.”
When everyone heard this, they were stunned. F*ck!
He was too rich!
It was a three-star hotel! A room would probably cost a few hundred yuan. With so many people, it would cost him more than ten thousand yuan a night!
Furthermore, they would take many days to prepare for the exam. He might even spend 100,000 yuan!
For a moment, Xu Wenqiang’s call was met with hundreds of responses!
“Brother Qiang is mighty!”
“You’re so rich!”
“How awesome! Brother Qiang is generous!”
When Chen Mengmeng heard Xu Wenqiang’s words, she pursed her lips and looked at Han Xue. “Xiao Xue, come with me. If you don’t come, I’ll be so bored.”
As she spoke, she acted like a spoiled child. Even Han Xue could not take it anymore. “Alright, alright, alright. I’ll give in, I’ll give in.”
“Hehe, you’re the best!” Chen Mengmeng hugged Han Xue happily.
However, when the news reached Xu Wenqiang, his face darkened.
Everyone knew that he was so generous just to show off in front of Chen Mengmeng. However, Chen Mengmeng had a temper. By not going, she simply offended Xu Wenqiang.
Xu Wenqiang suddenly stood up and walked towards Chen Mengmeng.

“Chen Mengmeng, I’ve already booked rooms based on the number of people present. Are you guys complaining that the three-star hotel I booked isn’t good?” Xu Wenqiang came over and looked at Chen Mengmeng with a faint smile.
“I’m sorry, my brother is in Jiang City. He just bought a house. Since I’m here, isn’t it good to go to his place?” Chen Mengmeng explained.

“Hahaha, your brother?” Xu Wenqiang sneered when he heard Chen Mengmeng mention Chen Yun. “Chen Mengmeng, who are you trying to fool? Isn’t your brother still in university? It’s not like I haven’t seen him before. He doesn’t even have a branded item on him. He looks so poor. Besides, who doesn’t know about your parents and your family’s situation? How can you buy a house for your brother in Jiang City? Do you know the housing price in Jiang City? If you find a reason, find one that’s more decent!”
“Who are you calling poor?!”
Previously, Chen Mengmeng felt embarrassed for disrespecting Xu Wenqiang, but when she heard him mention her brother, she slammed the table and stood up. “Who are you talking about!”
“Don’t you just have a little money? How can you look down on others?”
Xu Wenqiang saw that Chen Mengmeng looked like she was going to bite someone and narrowed his eyes. “Chen Mengmeng, I’ll give you one more chance. Are you coming with us?”
“I said I’m going to look for my brother. Don’t you understand?!” Chen Mengmeng spoke angrily.
Seeing that Chen Mengmeng did not give him face, Xu Wenqiang’s expression turned ugly. The boys beside him saw this and quickly stood up.
“Brother Qiang, calm down. We’re all classmates.”
“That’s right, Brother Qiang. Don’t lower yourself to her level.”
“She isn’t blessed enough to enjoy a three-star hotel.”
A few boys went forward to comfort him, afraid that Xu Wenqiang would not bring them to stay in the three-star hotel in a fit of anger. That way, they would have to spend a lot more money.
Xu Wenqiang shook off the crowd and looked at Chen Mengmeng. “Alright, alright. Chen Mengmeng, you’re giving me a hard time, right? When we get back to Yanwei, just wait and see.”
With that, he turned around angrily.
When the girls beside her saw this situation, they either sneered or were jealous.
“Hehe, isn’t she just a little good-looking? She’s quite arrogant.”

“She actually dares to go against Xu Wenqiang. Tsk tsk, what kind of conditions does her family have? Look at her. She’s just a poor person. Why doesn’t she take a look at her own shortcomings before criticizing others? Who does she think she is?”
“That’s right. Just wait. When she goes to society in the future, she will suffer.”
“This time, she provoked Xu Wenqiang, right? Just wait. Any random big sister will be able to teach her a lesson. It’s enough to make her suffer.”
When Chen Mengmeng heard these words, she was so angry that she was about to cry.
For a moment, she and Han Xue were isolated by the entire class.
They had no choice. After all, money was power.

chapters.title: Chapter 21
paragraphs: Damn It!
Han Xue looked at Chen Mengmeng and patted her. “Don’t be afraid, Mengmeng. If he dares to find someone to bully you, I’ll tell my father. Don’t forget who my father is.”
“I’ll ask my father to give him some handcuffs.”
Han Xue’s words instantly made Chen Mengmeng stick out her tongue. “I love you to death.”
“Hmph, you won’t be able to say that when you have a boyfriend.” Han Xue patted Chen Mengmeng’s head and looked at her classmates beside them with disgust.
Nowadays, they had yet to learn good things. Instead, they were currying favor with the rich and powerful in society, raising their status and stepping on the poor.
How interesting!

When the train arrived at Jiang City Station, the students picked up their luggage and stood up. Xu Wenqiang was the first to walk out. Many students were arrogant and respectful to him. They were like his lackeys.
It couldn’t be helped. After all, he was paying for their rooms!
With money, he was the boss!
“Let’s go, Mengmeng.” Han Xue stood up and led Chen Mengmeng out with her luggage.
“Hiss!”
The next moment, a few girls who were carrying their suitcases simply pushed them against Chen Mengmeng’s arm. It was so painful that she frowned.
“Oh my, oh my, I’m sorry, I’m sorry.” A girl looked at Chen Mengmeng and smiled insincerely. “We wanted to go to the three-star hotel, so we were a little anxious.”
“That’s right, school belle. You’re not going to the hotel Brother Xu booked. Don’t be anxious. Let us go first.”
“That’s right. It won’t be good if we bump into each other.”
Their words were filled with mockery as they looked at Chen Mengmeng coldly.
Han Xue pulled Chen Mengmeng behind her. “You guys go first.”
The few of them looked at Han Xue and snorted before walking forward.
They laughed as they walked.
“Tell me, is there something wrong with her brain? She chose not to stay in a three-star hotel and went to squeeze in a house with her brother.”
“Oh, that’s not necessarily the case. Perhaps they bought a big house.”
“A big house? Do you know the housing prices in Jiang City? Even outside Third Ring Road, the housing prices are close to 31,000 yuan per square meter. How much do her parents earn in a year?”
“They might work themselves to death for a year and not even be able to buy a toilet. A big house? What a joke.”
Every sentence seemed like a joke, but it was extremely loud. After all, they deliberately spoke for the two of them to hear.
Chen Mengmeng blew her fringe angrily.
“Alright, you’re really angry. If they say so, let them say so. You’re the one who’s hurt by being angry like this. You’re so silly.”
“I’m just too angry!”
“Then why don’t you turn around and anger them to death!” Han Xue rubbed Chen Mengmeng’s chubby face.
Chen Mengmeng took out a mirror and combed her fringe.
“I need to check how my makeup looks. I haven’t met Brother Yun many times since he went to university.” Han Xue also came over to take a look. Then, the two of them walked out of the train.
Jiang City Station was the terminal. By the time the two of them got off, almost all the passengers in the train had left.
At this moment, a few messages popped up on their phones.
Their classmates had already boarded the bus from the hotel. Many of them took photos and even tagged them.
The meaning of their messages was self-evident.
The two of them immediately blocked the messages and headed outside.
At this moment, Chen Yun was at the entrance of the station. He saw a group of students getting on a bus. He glanced at them but did not see his sister.
“Huh? These people should also be art students. Are they from other provinces and cities?”
“That’s not right either. Some of them speak the Yanwei dialect.”
“Maybe she’s at the back.”
Chen Yun thought to himself. He looked at the flowers, milk tea, and snacks in his hand and smiled. When this little girl came out later, she would probably be quite surprised.
After a while, the bus drove away, but Chen Mengmeng was still nowhere to be seen. Chen Yun was about to make a call when she saw two girls leisurely walking out of the train station.
They were even snacking.
Wasn’t that his sister?
The two of them looked at each other. Chen Mengmeng looked at Chen Yun and her eyes instantly lit up as she observed Chen Yun. Then, she looked at the side, as if she was looking for someone.
Chen Yun was speechless.
Damn it! Couldn’t she recognize her own brother?!

chapters.title: Chapter 22
paragraphs: Women = Enemies!
“Ahhh... A sports car!”
Chen Yun said, “Are you going to perform?! You gave me a fright!”
“Furthermore, I told you to learn more about recognizing cars. You could tell that this is a sports car, but you don’t know what brand it is!”
These words made Chen Yun pout. Her sister had no image to speak of in front of him.
On the outside, she was like an icy goddess.
However, in front of him, she was a silly goddess.
Meanwhile, Han Xue looked at the McLaren sports car in front of her and her eyes widened. She simply could not believe what she was seeing and felt her face turn red with excitement.
It was a sports car!
It was a real sports car!
“This is a McLaren 720S. This should cost close to four million,” muttered Han Xue, making Chen Yun nod. Finally, someone knew about such things.
Chen Mengmeng reached out to touch the car and quickly retracted her hand.
“What’s wrong?”
“I’m afraid of scraping off the paint.”
Chen Yun laughed. “It’s fine if the paint scrapes off. I’ll buy one for you in the future too. Your brother is different now.”
“When you get a driver’s license, I’ll buy you whatever you want.”
“Okay. Thank you, Brother.”
“Let’s go. I’ll get you a cab.”
Chen Yun placed their suitcases in the car, ignoring the dust on the wheels of the suitcases. Han Xue’s heart ached when she saw this.
After hailing a taxi, Chen Yun looked at the driver.
“Master, bring them to the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion. Just drop them off at the entrance. I’ll come back and inform the security guards. Thank you.”
Where did he tell the driver to go?
The Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion?
F*ck!
After driving, the driver lit a cigarette and looked at the two girls, who were eating, in the rearview mirror.
“Girls, that person just now... Who is he to you?”
“He’s my brother. What’s wrong, Uncle?”
“You guys must be rich kids.”
“Huh?” This time, both of them were stunned. “How so?”
“That young man asked me to bring you to the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion.”

Han Xue could also tell that the name “Imperial Dragon Heavenly Pavilion” was something special. She immediately said, “Master, what’s with the Imperial Dragon Heavenly Pavilion? It’s our first time in Jiang City, so we’re not too sure.”

“This Imperial Dragon Heavenly Pavilion is the most luxurious district in Jiang City. It’s surrounded by a river and mountains. It’s extremely luxurious. Only the high-ranking officials and nobles of Jiang City can live there.”
“Furthermore, it’s a villa complex.”
The uncle opened the window to prevent the smoke from drifting to the back. “I really envy you guys. You were born with a golden spoon in your mouth.”
The two of them did not speak. They did not know what to say. They could only imagine the villa in their minds.
However, they did not have any connections. The only thing they could think of was a two-story house in North America.
It was an exquisite little house.
When they were about to reach the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion, the two girls were already attracted by the scenery outside the window.
They saw the morning fog above the river, the mountain scenery, the carefully trimmed trees on both sides of the road, and the pond where water birds were playing.
It was too beautiful!
At the entrance of the district, they looked at the outermost villa.
Only then did they realize that poverty had limited their imagination.
“Hello, are you Miss Chen Mengmeng and Miss Han Xue?” The security guard asked.
“Yes, it’s us.”
“It’s like this. Mr. Chen Yun asked me to take you to Villa No. 3. Please alight from the car. Taxis are not allowed inside.”
The taxi driver was slightly embarrassed.
However, it was understandable. After all, this was such a place.
After collecting the fare, he left.
Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue sat on the tour bus and headed towards Villa No. 3. Along the way, the two of them realized that the further they went, the bigger and more luxurious the villas became.
When they arrived at the entrance of Villa No. 3, a McLaren had just stopped. Chen Yun was about to walk in with their suitcases.
“You guys are quite fast,” said Chen Yun as he looked at the two of them. Then, he smiled and nodded at the security guard. “Sorry to trouble you.”
“Mr. Chen, this is what we should do. You’re welcome.” The security guard was flattered and quickly bowed.
“Come, let’s take a look at our new home.” Chen Yun pulled Chen Mengmeng.
Chen Mengmeng pinched Chen Yun’s waist.
“What are you doing!”
“I’m seeing whether I’m dreaming.”
Chen Yun was speechless. He was impressed. Why didn’t she pinch herself? Didn’t she know that he was her brother? How rude.
Just as he was about to educate this girl, he saw that she had already pulled Han Xue and ran in.
There was a swimming pool! A garden! A garage! A storage room!
After walking around the villa, the two of them were panting. At the same time, they took many photos.
“Let’s enter the main villa first. We’ll take our time to take a look after eating.”
“Okay!” Chen Mengmeng walked to Chen Yun’s side. “Brother, did you suffer a lot to have all these things?”
“Sigh, only through hardship can one rise above others. Mengmeng, I fought for everything myself. How can one not suffer? If I suffer, you don’t have to suffer.”
Chen Yun stroked Chen Mengmeng’s head. Her words made her eyes turn red.
She was on the verge of tears.
Chen Yun sneered in his heart. Did he suffer a lot to check in every day?
They simply didn’t know how hard it was for him, who had no interest in money! Only he knew!
At this moment, a fragrance spread out from the kitchen.
The three of them walked to the kitchen and saw a beautiful figure frying bread slices and eggs.
There were still some water droplets on her hair. She must have just taken a shower.
It was Wang Menghan. At this moment, Wang Menghan turned her head when she heard the voice. “Chen Yun, you’re back. Sit for a while. Breakfast will be ready soon.”
“I woke up late today. I’m too tired after we played yesterday. I was exhausted from tossing about.”
Wang Menghan’s words stunned Chen Mengmeng and the others.
Did she say that she was too tired from playing?!
What did they play?!
Tossing about?!
Chen Mengmeng looked at this familiar face but could not remember who she was. However, she stared at Wang Menghan’s back figure!
She was a woman!
She was a woman who had just taken a shower!
She was a beautiful woman who lived together with Chen Yun and had just taken a shower!
She was an enemy!
For a moment, she had locked onto the enemy!
However, before she could speak, Han Xue, who was beside her, screamed, “Wang, Wang, Wang... Wang Menghan!”
“Are you Sister Wang Menghan?!” Han Xue looked excited.
“Yes, it’s me.” Wang Menghan looked at Han Xue, wiped her hands on her apron, and shook her hand. “Hello.”
“Hello, Sister. I’m your fan. Can you sign an autograph for me?”
She was Wang Menghan, a big singer!
Oh my God!
Chen Mengmeng was also excited. The hostility from before was swept away.
“Sister Menghan, are you my sister-in-law?”
“Ahem, don’t talk nonsense.” Chen Yun pinched Chen Mengmeng’s little face. “Go over and wait. After eating, she’ll sign autographs and take pictures with you guys.”
“Okay.”

After chasing the two of them away, Chen Yun walked to Wang Menghan’s side. “My sister and her best friend came to Jiang City for the art exam. They like to spout nonsense. Don’t mind them, but they’re all your fans. They quite like you.”
“I don’t mind.” Wang Menghan bit her lip and glanced at Chen Yun. She hadn’t even explained just now. Why was he so anxious?
Moreover, she did not intend to explain. Even if this was a misunderstanding, it was a beautiful misunderstanding.

chapters.title: Chapter 23
paragraphs: Wetting His Pants!
After cooking, they sat down. Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue ate especially quickly.
Wang Menghan also smiled and put down her chopsticks to take photos with the two of them.

“Brother, come quickly. Let’s take photos together!” Chen Mengmeng hugged Chen Yun’s arm and forcefully pulled him out. When they were taking photos, she even leaned in front of him and posed as if she was holding flowers. She was very cute.
After taking photos, Chen Yun helped to allocate Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue to their rooms and recorded their biological information.
In any case, he had the overall control of the house. He could erase the biological information of anyone other than him at will.
At this moment, Han Xue was looking at her room.
The room was 50 to 60 square meters large!
It was extremely luxurious!
It was like a real princess’s room!
There were also many high-end machines!
It was as if she had transmigrated into the future!
The next moment, she looked at her phone and saw that Chen Mengmeng had posted. She chose nine of the best photos to fill up nine grids.
She posted photos of the McLaren sports car, the main villa, the luxurious interior, a photo with Wang Menghan, Wang Menghan’s autograph, a photo with Chen Yun...
In this day and age, it was enough to show off one’s car and house. Why would she show off her brother?
How old was she? She was still like a child.

“Okay.”

“Now that she has angered Xu Wenqiang, Sister Luo, you have a chance. If you get together with Brother Qiang, the rest of your life will be simply comfortable.”

As for Chen Mengmeng, she would work hard for half of her life only to be mediocre.
After all, she was given a chance, but she didn’t seize it!
Haha!

There was a swimming pool!
There was a sports car!
They saw luxurious decorations!
They saw a picture of superstar Wang Menghan!

There were nine pictures!

“Look at this license plate, Jiang A66666! It’s an angel number! This license plate is not something ordinary people can have!”
“There’s also Wang Menghan. She’s a big singer with millions of fans!”

F*ck!

It was a top-notch mansion!
If Riverfront Hotel was a three-star hotel, then Chen Yun’s villa was close to a seven-star hotel!
Only Dubai’s tycoons had this level of power!
Moreover, who was her brother? How could he know a big star like Wang Menghan?!

It was as if someone had poured a basin of ice water over his head.
Cold air surged!

He was done for!
Oh no, oh no!
What was going on with her brother? Why was he doing so well now?!
He had a luxury spots car, and his license plate number was an angel number!
He could even invite a beautiful singer!
He was either rich or a local tyrant!
Furthermore, he had even said such harsh words to Chen Mengmeng in her territory.

“Are you not going to take the exam anymore?!”
“I can’t get in anyway. If I’m still here, I might even lose my life!”
Xu Wenqiang pushed the boy away.
“Brother Qiang, you have to help us with the room fee. You promised.”
“Help you? If you can afford it, you can stay. If you can’t afford it, stay in a small roadside hotel. Get lost! Don’t block me!”
Seeing Xu Wenqiang flee, everyone’s hearts sank to the bottom.
What the f*ck!
What about the room fees?
They could only stay in a youth hotel!
Who could bear the difference between a three-star hotel and a youth hotel?!
Moreover, if they slept well here, no one could guarantee that Chen Mengmeng would not take revenge on them.
They were in a very difficult situation and couldn’t get any help.
Even Xu Wenqiang had run away. They were panicking and their legs were trembling.
Even Chen Mengmeng, who was lying on the bed and playing with her phone, did not expect that her post would cause such a huge commotion!
Everyone was on tenterhooks!
It even made Xu Wenqiang piss his pants and roll back to Yanwei!
If she knew about this, she would explode from happiness!
