chapters.title: Chapter 24
paragraphs: Heading to Sacred Heaven!
Chen Mengmeng slept from afternoon to night. When Chen Yun woke her up for dinner, she was sleepy-eyed.
It couldn’t be helped. Everything about this room was good, but the bed was magical. It made her feel like she was in the clouds when she lay down. It was extremely comfortable.

“Brother, let me serve the food.” Chen Mengmeng rushed to serve the dishes. Han Xue was the same. After all, Chen Yun lived in such a luxurious house. How could they have the cheek to sit and let others serve them?
As they ate, Wang Menghan looked at the two of them. “Mengmeng, Xiao Xue, are you going to the Jiang City University of the Arts to take the art exam?”

“That’s right, Sister Menghan.” Chen Mengmeng nodded. “Actually, I was planning to go to Tianjing University of the Arts, while Xiao Xue was planning to come to Jiang City University of the Arts. However, my mother felt that with my brother here, we could take care of each other, so she insisted that I come.”
As Chen Mengmeng spoke, she lowered her voice guiltily. It was actually her idea to come to Jiang City University of the Arts. After all, she could be with her brother.
Moreover, the Jiang City University of the Arts and the Tianjing University of the Arts were on the same level.

“In that case, you guys are going to be my juniors.” Wang Menghan chuckled. “I’m still a third-year student in the Music Department at the Jiang City University of the Arts. It’s just that I don’t go to school often. They know my situation. Help me if you can. It will help me graduate successfully.”
“By the way, which department are you going to?”
“We’re all preparing to go to the Acting Department,” said Han Xue. Actors were so good.
They earned a lot.
If they became popular celebrities, how much would they earn after filming an episode of a television drama or a variety show?!
When Chen Yun heard Wang Menghan’s words, he looked at the two of them. “Aren’t you going to call her Senior?”
“Hello, Senior!”
“Hello, Senior!”
The two of them cried out.

“Alright, alright. It’s indeed difficult to enter the Acting Department. It is very complex. Many of the unspoken rules of entering society are taught in school. How about this? I know a few professors in the Acting Department. I’ll tell them when I come back. Even if you make a mistake, they’ll give you the green light.”
Han Xue’s eyes suddenly lit up. “Really, Sister Menghan? Thank you.”
At night, Chen Yun brought them to the Jiang City Music Space Karaoke.
It was a private room on the top floor!
It was the best karaoke chain in Jiang City. Thus, their best rooms naturally had the best equipment!
These decorations and equipment shocked Wang Menghan, let alone the two little girls who had never seen the world.
Of course, good things were priced well.
A reservation of a few hours cost close to 100,000 yuan!
This was under the premise that there were no additional services!
Wang Menghan sang a few songs by other singers. Compared to the original singers, she was even better!
Meanwhile, Han Xue and Chen Mengmeng also sang a few songs. However, after listening to Wang Menghan’s songs, the two of them paled in comparison.

At night, after returning home and waiting for the three of them to sleep, Chen Yun found a room and moved the things out with the robots. He was going to set aside the room as Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue’s practice room.
He was busy until the second half of the night.
“Brother, what are you doing? You scared me.”
Chen Yun had just walked out of the practice room when he almost bumped into Chen Mengmeng, who was hugging a white teddy bear and wearing wrinkled pajamas.
“You’re the one who’s scaring people at night. Why aren’t you sleeping?”

“I was going to ask you what you’re doing.” Chen Mengmeng stuck her head into the room and looked at the spacious room that was 70 to 80 square meters large. “It’s so noisy. I thought there was a thief in the house.”

“Don’t worry. Mosquitoes might be able to enter this district, but thieves definitely can’t.” Chen Yun patted Chen Mengmeng. “Go to sleep. I’ve finished tidying up the room. This will be your practice room. You guys can prepare here. It’s more convenient.”
Huh?
Had he worked until so late just for this?
“Brother, go to sleep quickly. It’s already so late. My heart aches so much!”
Chen Yun looked at Chen Mengmeng’s anxious expression and was pushed back to his room.
This little girl.
The next day.
[Host, please check in.]
Oh?
A check-in mission had finally arrived.
After pressing the button.
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining 1,000,000,000 yuan!]
He had obtained one billion!
Then, the Random Double dice appeared.
A four appeared!
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining 4,000,000,000 yuan!]
He had obtained four billion yuan!
In addition to his previous balance and the shares from Sacred Heaven Entertainment, Chen Yun’s total assets now exceeded ten billion yuan!

After tidying up, Chen Yun changed into a black suit with gold trimmings. Compared to his slim figure when he wore a set of slim-fit clothes, this suit gave off a more stable feeling. For a moment, he changed from a rich young master to a CEO.
He had already told Ma Ke that he would go to the headquarters of Sacred Heaven Entertainment today.
When he walked out and went downstairs, the three of them were already sitting at the dining table. Wang Menghan was pouring milk into four glasses and waiting for Chen Yun.
The moment he came down, the eyes of the three girls lit up.
“Why are you guys like this? Have you never seen a handsome man before?”
Wang Menghan smiled bitterly. “I’ve never seen you in such a formal suit. You really look good in everything.”
After dinner, Chen Yun drove the McLaren sports car to Sacred Heaven Entertainment. In the distance, he saw Sacred Heaven Entertainment’s hundred-story building standing there like a landmark.
The glass wall reflected the sunlight and looked luxurious.
After all, this building was a masterpiece from a few years ago.
At that time, the manpower and resources needed to do this were immeasurable.
However, he now controlled 80% of Sacred Heaven Entertainment’s shares. He had the final say in the company.
Before the meeting time of 8 am, Ma Ke led a group of middle and high-level executives downstairs, leaving many employees speechless.
“Did you see that? CEO Ma brought the middle and higher-ups to wait downstairs.”
“Does anyone know what happened?”
“I don’t know.”
“I think I got some news.”
A person spoke softly. Then, he was surrounded by everyone. “What happened?”
“It seems that Sacred Heaven Entertainment has changed owners. The Sacred Heaven Entertainment shares that belonged to the Lu family have been acquired.”
What?
Had their shares been acquired?
This!
This was impossible!
“How much was that?!”

“I remember that the Lu family originally had 80% shares in Sacred Heaven Entertainment. Moreover, Sacred Heaven Entertainment is still rising. It seems like they are going to compete with the previous veteran giants. Why would they sell the shares?”
“How rich is the new owner! Moreover, I’m afraid it’s not just about money.”
Everyone was shocked.
In fact, not only were they shocked, but even the upper echelons of Sacred Heavens who were standing behind Ma Ke were also in turmoil.
They were all nervous, filled with anticipation and uneasiness.
They were all waiting for the arrival of the new director.
Many celebrities looked at the entrance and did not dare to enter the Sacred Heaven Building. They waited in the parking lot.
In the next moment, a black sports car came through the door, and the sound of it echoed.
In the parking lot, a popular young hunk was about to come to Sacred Entertainment to sign a contract. When he saw the sports car, he immediately sneered.
“Who is this? He’s still so ostentatious in Sacred Heaven.”

“I don’t know, but he’s driving so fast in Sacred Heaven. He really doesn’t know the rules. Usually, it’s fine, but today, hehe, Sacred Heaven’s middle and upper echelons are all here. I’m afraid this person is going to suffer.”
Many actors also had smiles on their faces as they prepared to see which unlucky person in the entertainment industry was it.
However, in the next moment, all the middle and upper echelons of Sacred Heavens walked forward. Ma Ke even jogged to the parked sports car and opened the door to welcome a young man respectfully.
All the middle and higher-ups bowed collectively!
“Hello, Director Chen!”
Their voices reverberated in the courtyard, causing all the celebrities’ hearts to tremble!
“Oh my God!”

Many actors also had smiles on their faces as they prepared to see which unlucky person in the entertainment industry was it.
However, in the next moment, all the middle and upper echelons of Sacred Heavens walked forward.
Ma Ke even jogged to the parked sports car and opened the door to welcome a young man respectfully.
All the middle and higher-ups bowed collectively!
“Hello, Director Chen!”
Their voices reverberated in the courtyard, causing all the celebrities’ hearts to tremble!
“Oh my God!”

chapters.title: Chapter 25
paragraphs: Check-in Mission!
This was!
As soon as the voice sounded!
The ordinary staff upstairs, the artists standing in the parking lot, and the managers beside them were all shocked!
That young man was actually the new director of Sacred Heaven Entertainment!
He was the legendary person who bought 80% of Sacred Heaven’s shares from the Lu Family!
The young hunk who was sneering just now turned pale. He looked around and heaved a sigh of relief when he saw that there was no one nearby.
Who was the other party?
He was the leader of the entire Sacred Heaven!
If his words were to spread, it wouldn’t be something that could be solved by banning him!
Many celebrities walked towards the entrance of the Sacred Heaven Building, preparing to see Chen Yun’s elegance.
Meanwhile, Ma Ke was half a step behind Chen Yun. The middle and high-level officials split into two rows to make way for the two of them and bowed respectfully.
“There’s no need to be so polite, everyone. Go back to work.” Chen Yun waved his hand. Everyone straightened up and looked at Chen Yun.
The next moment, everyone’s eyes lit up.
In particular, the female managers were even more amazed by Chen Yun’s looks and temperament!
He had the face of an immortal and a steady aura. Coupled with the golden edges on his suit, he was exceptionally charming.
It could not help but make one’s heart flutter.

When everyone heard Chen Yun’s words, they quickly returned to their posts to ensure that the entire Sacred Heaven Entertainment operated normally. Meanwhile, Ma Ke followed behind Chen Yun and kept introducing the staff to him.
“Hello, Director Chen. Hello, CEO Ma.”
“Hello, Director Chen.”
“Director Chen, you’re here.”

As they walked through Sacred Heaven, everyone bowed to Chen Yun. After all, they were not fools. Previously, they had more or less received some news. In addition, Ma Ke was now following behind Chen Yun.
Furthermore, Ma Ke was walking behind him, not by his side!
There was no need to elaborate on this person, who could make CEO Ma so respectful.
They walked past the departments one by one. Chen Yun nodded. In the entire Sacred Heavens, almost 80% of the staff were newcomers. Everyone seemed to be full of vitality and were efficient.
This meant that this was not a place for people to retire.
Only in such a place would there be vigor and vitality.
“Okay, here it is.”
“Director Chen, please follow me to your office.”

On the top floor, beyond the CEO’s office was Chen Yun’s office. It was in a simple style. Through the glass wall, one could see the prosperity of Jiang City. The streets and alleys were filled with traffic.
Even the view at East Sea City, a five-star hotel in Jiang City, couldn’t compare to this scene.
Ma Ke brought Chen Yun a cup of coffee. Then, he began to report his recent results and work.
Chen Yun sat in the boss chair and looked at Ma Ke.
It had to be said that the person in front of him, who looked to be in his thirties, had actually become such a powerful senior manager.
Moreover, at a glance, he could only be described with one word — capable!
Compared to the appearance of a middle-aged man with a big belly, this made Chen Yun have a good impression of Ma Ke.
He listened to the report and asked Ma Ke if there were any terms he didn’t understand. Ma Ke naturally told him everything he knew and answered Chen Yun.
“Ma Ke, sit down and report. You’re not an outsider. There’s no need to be distant. In the future, you’ll have to help me take care of Sacred Heaven.”
“Alright, Director Chen.” Ma Ke had been standing for more than an hour and was a little tired. In addition, Chen Yun’s words made him even happier. It seemed that he had passed Chen Yun’s review.

The two of them communicated for a total of three hours. Ma Ke explained the contracts of Sacred Heaven, the filming progress of variety shows, movies, and television dramas, and the endorsements of their artists.
[Check-in Mission]
[10 days later at 12 noon. Location: Clear Sky Island.]
[If the host leads 500 people who really want to go there to check in, you will obtain the opportunity to summon a supreme-grade spinner wheel.]
This!
Chen Yun looked at the screen in front of him and was a little stunned. It was a supreme-grade spinner wheel!
What was that?
Chen Yun had never seen such a term before, but he was still shocked.
The word ‘supreme-grade’ had never appeared on the screen before!
However, this additional condition was a little difficult.

One had to know what kind of place Clear Sky Island was. It was an uninhabited island. Although the scenery was not bad, it was located in the subtropical region. There were many poisonous insects on the island, and it was humid and hot. From time to time, typhoons would pass through it.
Who would really want to go to such an environment?
Chen Yun fell into deep thought.
Beside him, Ma Ke was facing his file as he reported and had yet to observe Chen Yun’s expression.
“Director Chen, please take a look. This is the next season of films and variety shows that we’ve been preparing recently. Do you have any suggestions for these?”
Ma Ke handed the file to Chen Yun, who took it and read the names and introductions for each item.
Chen Yun looked at each item and stopped when he saw a variety show.
“Let’s change this.”

“This?” Ma Ke quickly came over and looked at the item that Chen Yun was pointing at. It was a celebrity variety show where celebrities tore apart each other’s name tags, interspersed with funny plots. This kind of program had been quite popular in recent years. As long as there was a celebrity, it could guarantee the viewership ratings. It was a guaranteed profit.
After explaining a little, Ma Ke looked at Chen Yun. “Director Chen, how do you think we should change it?”
“I think our entertainment industry will have a greater impact on the new generation. If our show is filled with young hunks fooling around, the impact on the next generation can be imagined.”
“For example, other countries have deliberately created some tough celebrities.”
“Although we don’t have to be that deliberate, we have to change our shows. This is also our social responsibility.”
Ma Ke listened to Chen Yun’s words and nodded. “Director Chen, what do you think? How should we change the program?”
“Let’s change it to this. We’ll go to an island to do a wilderness survival variety show.”
“A total of 500 celebrities, as well as people who have passed an audition, will participate. Of course, to ensure good ratings, there have to be some handsome men and beautiful women.”
“Furthermore, the safeguards need to be in place.”
“Let’s go to the uninhabited Clear Sky Island for the first episode.”
“The first episode of the live broadcast will begin in ten days.”

Chen Yun explained one by one, making Ma Ke think. This was an unprecedented large-scale survival variety show. As long as there were enough gimmicks, it would definitely have a good viewership rating.
However, such a large-scale program would require a lot in terms of funding.

Chen Yun looked at Ma Ke’s frown and instantly smiled. “This can be considered a test for me. I’ll personally invest a billion yuan. Even if the show fails, it won’t affect the profits of the other shareholders. If it becomes popular, everyone will be happy. No one will object now, right?”
Chen Yun had invested a billion yuan because he wanted to upgrade the Random Double skill to Level-3. That way, he could have a higher multiplier.
With the Level-3 Random Double skill and the Full of Luck skill, his rewards would be multiplied by eight every time!
Meanwhile, Ma Ke looked stunned.
One billion!
He suddenly sat up straight and looked at Chen Yun. That was one billion yuan!
Why did it sound like Chen Yun had thrown five yuan at him to buy a roasted sweet potato?
He didn’t care at all!
How rich was he?!
“Ask the finance department to come and get the money from me. However, I want to see the perfect proposal within a day,” said Chen Yun as he took a sip of coffee.
Ma Ke also stood up. “Alright, Director Chen. I’ll arrange for someone to do it immediately.”
Since Chen Yun had already given his instructions, Ma Ke had to execute them beautifully. If he could not fire the first shot, his reputation in Chen Yun’s heart would plummet.
He could not let this happen!

chapters.title: Chapter 26
paragraphs: Random Double Skill Level Up
Chen Yun looked at his watch. It was almost noon.
“Director Chen, why don’t we have lunch together?” Ma Ke asked. Chen Yun nodded and said, “There’s no need to trouble yourself. Let’s just eat at the company.”
“It’s a good time for me to try our restaurant too.”
“Okay.” Ma Ke stood up and extended his hand. “Director Chen, please.”
The two of them went down. Many people looked at them and greeted them warmly. When they reached the restaurant, there were not many people.
Since there were more staff members at Sacred Heaven Entertainment, they were divided into different batches based on their departments to eat in the canteen. This way, it did not seem crowded.
“Director Chen, this is the main food area, followed by the meat, vegetable, dessert, and fruit areas.”
Ma Ke introduced the canteen to him, making Chen Yun like him even more. It seemed that Ma Ke often went to the canteen to eat. It was hard to imagine a CEO eating in a company restaurant.
Chen Yun ordered three dishes and ate with Ma Ke.
At the side, pairs of eyes looked over.
“Look, that’s Director Chen. He came to our place this morning and shook my hand. I still can’t bear to wash my hands.”
“Guess how old he is.”
“He’s about 20 years old, but his temperament is so steady and mature. He’s even better than CEO Ma. He’s simply like the president of the abstinence department.”

As the beautiful female employees ate, they kept glancing at Chen Yun and naturally discussed. Even some popular female celebrities received the news today and came to the restaurant to see Chen Yun’s figure.

However, at a glance, even if they had seen handsome men in the entertainment industry, they could not help but fall for Chen Yun. From time to time, they would look at Chen Yun. Even their meal seemed especially delicious today.
During this period, many bold female celebrities simply went up to toast with Chen Yun.
Chen Yun used tea as a substitute for wine, while the female celebrities drank their wine until their cups were dry.
Who would dare to blame Chen Yun!
Who would dare to not drink until their cups were dry!
When they returned to the director’s office, the secretary was already waiting inside.
“Director Chen, CEO Ma.” The girl handed over the proposal in her hand. “This is the proposal that the planning department rushed out this afternoon. Please take a look.”
How fast!
Chen Yun looked at his watch. Only two hours had passed. Had such a thick proposal already been completed?
After opening the proposal, Chen Yun kept nodding. They were thorough in all aspects, but there were some things that were different from what Chen Yun was thinking.
“It’s well-written and thorough.” Chen Yun nodded. “However, there’s still some flaws.”
As Chen Yun spoke, the secretary immediately took out her notebook and placed it on the table, preparing to record Chen Yun’s words.

“First, we need to increase the difficulty of the audition. Even the celebrities will go through the same audition. We’ll put quality before quantity. If the young celebrities can’t pass the audition, we’ll use newbies. For us, it’s not difficult to create stars.”
“Second, increase the security and ensure their safety. There are few people on that island. Thus, there might be ferocious beasts.”
“Thirdly, this reward amount is a little too small.”
Ma Ke came over to take a look. Winning in this wilderness survival show depended on who could survive on the deserted island for a longer time and collect more survival cards.

Survival cards were first scattered on Clear Sky Island by a helicopter. The 500 participants could collect them. Furthermore, additional time could be added during the final calculation. This way, it would prevent people from setting up camp and not moving, reducing the interest of the viewers.
What puzzled him the most was Chen Yun’s comment about the prize. The prize money this time was already high enough!

One participant would receive the first prize of 20 million yuan, while two participants would receive the second prize of 10 million yuan each. Meanwhile, three participants would receive the third prize of five million yuan each. There were also participation prizes. Just the total cost of the prizes alone had exceeded 100 million yuan!
How was this too small?
In that case, what was considered a big amount?!
From the looks of it, even Ma Ke wanted to participate!

Chen Yun looked at the little secretary. “Tell the planning department to change the proposal according to my instructions. Everyone who passes the audition will be rewarded with 100,000 yuan. Of course, they have to be examined in all aspects, including their looks, character, and performance. They will not be judged just based on their looks and physical strength.”
“Participants in the 10th to 100th places will each be rewarded with a million yuan.”
“Then, there will be six third prizes of 20 million yuan each.”
“There will be two second prizes of 50 million yuan each.”
“There will be one first prize of 100 million yuan.”
This!
For a moment, the little secretary’s hands began to tremble.
It wasn’t just her. Even Ma Ke’s eyes widened. He simply couldn’t believe what he was hearing!
A hundred million!
The first prize was 100 million!
One person would receive 100 million!
Oh my God!
“Director... Director Chen, if we do this, I’m afraid we won’t be able to recover our capital. If the rewards alone are worth so much, with the equipment and staff...”
“Ma Ke.” Chen Yun looked at Ma Ke. “Do you think we’ll make a loss?”

“In the wilderness survival show, we can airdrop supplies and all kinds of goods. In addition, we can take this opportunity to create a new batch of stars among the participants and commentators. In addition, I don’t need to say much about the benefit to our company’s image, right?”

Chen Yun’s words made Marco admit how much investments these goods could bring. Furthermore, there was no need to elaborate further on the profits from the new stars, the social benefits that the company would gain, and the improvement of the company’s image.
Moreover, this program could also become a large-scale publicity platform that could promote their new movies and other variety activities.

After this show, Sacred Heaven Entertainment should be able to take another step forward. It was only a matter of time before they could compare to those big entertainment companies that had been established for 100 years.
“There’s a billion yuan on this card. Let the finance department collect it.”
“Once you’re done writing your notes, go ahead and implement the changes.”
“Alright, Director Chen.” The secretary carried the ultra-thin notebook and left. Then, the finance department came to collect the funds.
One billion!
One billion was spent just like that.
If he didn’t invest a shocking amount, would 500 people be willing to go?
Chen Yun realized that not only did he have to complete the check-in mission, but he also had to complete it to the best of his abilities to obtain the best reward!
It was said that money talked. With such a high reward, those participants would definitely rush to the island.
He might not even be able to stop them.
His spending points suddenly exploded!
[Random Double Skill Upgrade]
[Congratulations to the host for upgrading the Random Double skill to Level-4.]
[Level-4 (1,000,000,000/10,000,000,000): Rewards are multiplied by one to eight times. The multiplier is random.]
The skill upgrade simply skipped Level-3 and arrived at Level-4.
He could obtain four times the rewards at Level-2, six times the rewards at Level-3, and eight times the rewards at Level-4!
A multiplier of eight times was so satisfying!
Chen Yun was looking forward to the next check-in or check-in mission.
However, the spending value needed to upgrade this skill exploded by ten times!
He now needed to spend another nine billion to level up to the next level and increase the multiplier to ten times.
He was in no hurry. He would take his time.

His spending points suddenly exploded!
[Random Double Skill Upgrade]
[Congratulations to the host for upgrading the Random Double skill to Level-4.]
[Level-4 (1,000,000,000/10,000,000,000): Rewards are multiplied by one to eight times.
The multiplier is random.]
The skill upgrade simply skipped Level-3 and arrived at Level-4.
He could obtain four times the rewards at Level-2, six times the rewards at Level-3, and eight times the rewards at Level-4!
A multiplier of eight times was so satisfying!
Chen Yun was looking forward to the next check-in or check-in mission.
However, the spending value needed to upgrade this skill exploded by ten times!
He now needed to spend another nine billion to level up to the next level and increase the multiplier to ten times.
He was in no hurry.
He would take his time.

chapters.title: Chapter 27
paragraphs: God of Wealth
“Ma Ke, you can personally arrange this matter. This way, I can rest assured.” Chen Yun stood up. “Sacred Heaven is in your hands. I feel very at ease.”

These words made Ma Ke feel flattered. He quickly stood up and said, “Director Chen, this is your first instruction since you took over Sacred Heavens. I’ll definitely do it beautifully and get a good start.”
Just as Chen Yun was about to leave, the secretary at the front desk hurried over.
“Director Chen, CEO Ma, someone sent an invitation.”
“It’s for the Lu family.”
Chen Yun took it and looked at it. It was an invitation to board the Deep Sea King.
“What’s this for?” Chen Yun was puzzled.
Ma Ke took over the conversation. “Director Chen, this is the usual practice. Once a year, some young masters or young people from Jiang City will go out to play.”

“The Deep Sea King is considered a top-notch luxury cruise ship. Every year, these young masters will board it together and gamble a few times on the international seas. The trip won’t be long, just two to three days. However, gambling is a small matter, but it’s more important to communicate.”
“Those who go are usually the children of the big bosses. Later on, they will all become people who control the economy of Jiang City. This can be considered as nurturing successors.”
“That’s why everyone supports this kind of event every time. This time, they haven’t received any news that Sacred Heaven has changed owners, so they sent it over.”
It turned out that this was the case.
They would ride on a luxury cruise ship to the open sea and play.
This was interesting.
They would set off the day after tomorrow. Chen Yun would see if there was anything else to attend to tomorrow.

Ma Ke saw that Chen Yun was interested and quickly said, “Director Chen, if you want to go, I have a nephew. He’s the child of Cauldron Dragon Security’s CEO. He’s about the same age as you and can be considered a smart person. I’ll get him to lead the way for you when I get back to avoid any inconvenience during the trip.”
“That works too.”
“Alright, I’ll get him to add you on WeChat.”

Chen Yun left a number for Ma Ke, who respectfully sent Chen Yun downstairs. “Director Chen, I’ll arrange for that variety show to be broadcasted as scheduled. If you have any additional requests, you can tell me at any time. I’ll do it immediately.”
“Okay.”
Chen Yun got into the car and waved to the higher-ups before leaving.

At the entrance of Sacred Heavens Entertainment, even Ma Ke wiped his sweat. He had been very nervous today. He did not dare to slack off in front of Chen Yun at all. Now that he relaxed a little, sweat broke out.
“Director Chen’s temperament is really beyond ordinary people.”
“Hmm, I wonder which family this young master is from.”
“To be able to make the Lu Family submit to him, he might be from Tianjing...”
As the higher-ups spoke, Ma Ke looked at them. Then, they quickly shut up.

“If there’s nothing else, don’t talk about Director Chen. Inform everyone that a meeting will be held in half an hour. All the higher-ups must attend, and the entire planning department must also attend.”
“Okay, CEO Ma.” The secretary beside him quickly bowed and nodded.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun was driving on the road with one hand. He thought about the little girl at home and looked at his sports car.
Then, he said, “Call Zhou Jingyi.”
“Calling Zhou Jingyi.”
An electronic voice sounded.
Beep...
On the other side, Zhou Jingyi was introducing cars to her clients. She took out her phone and saw that it was Chen Yun. She quickly found a girl to take over and picked up the call.
“Chen Yun?”

Ever since she went out to sea last time, she had changed the way she addressed Chen Yun. Moreover, she went to school earlier than Chen Yun. Although she had already graduated, the two of them were still the same age.
“Jingyi, I need a few cars. Help me handle it.”
“Give me two supercars.”
“I need three sedans.”
“Give me three SUVs too.”
“Don’t worry about the money. Find a few more options. We’ll contact each other on WeChat. I’ll transfer the money to you when I come back. I won’t ask about license plate insurance.”
He was too lazy to ask about these small matters.
When Zhou Jingyi heard this, her heart trembled. He had asked for eight cars!
Most importantly, she had grasped the main point. She did not need to care about the money!
In other words, he wanted all of them to be luxury cars!
Come to think of it, Chen Yun bought a luxury yacht worth six million yuan without even looking at the real thing. Why would he care about money!
He requested eight luxury cars. What kind of performance was this!
However, McLaren only had supercars. It seemed like she had to contact the president of the entire car dealership complex.
After agreeing, Chen Yun went to Jiang City’s Century City to shop on the fifth floor.
The moment Chen Yun appeared, all the staff on the fifth floor became excited.
This was the God of Wealth who had spent two million yuan in an hour back then!
“Hello, sir. Armani has a new product that suits you. Would you like to come in and take a look?”
“Sir, this LV limited edition belt is on sale.”
Chen Yun went into a few shops and bought a set of clothes for himself. However, he did not buy them mainly for himself.
“Xiao Xue and Mengmeng should have the same figure.” Chen Yun entered the Armani store. “Hello, you have the same figure as my sister. Can you wear this for me to see?”
If it were anyone else, the salesperson would definitely reject the other party’s request. She might even think that he was being a hooligan.
However, she was facing Chen Yun!
He was handsome and rich!
She was willing to be played like a hooligan!
The salesperson took the clothes and quickly entered the fitting room.
“Yes, not bad. Give me two sets. Can you wear that set for me to see?”
“Alright, give me two sets of this too.”
“Give me three of this limited edition bag.”
“This is a nice necklace.”
“The watch is quite exquisite. Wrap these three up for me.”
The entire mall went crazy again!
As long as Chen Yun entered a shop, the shop would sell at least 200,000 yuan of goods!
The shop with the most sales sold two million yuan worth of products!
In the end, Chen Yun could no longer carry the things in his hands. There were too many!
The supervisors and deputy supervisors on the fifth floor were all shocked and hurried over.
“Sir, we’ll help you carry the bags.”
The two of them took the items and allowed Chen Yun to continue shopping.
This time, Chen Yun spent five million yuan after shopping for an hour!
He bought all kinds of brands!
He bought bags, clothes, accessories, cosmetics, everything!
In the end, even the two supervisors could not hold the bags anymore. Their foreheads were covered in sweat.
Before leaving, Chen Yun bought two packs of Heaven Leaf cigarettes from the cigarette shop below.
After the two of them helped Chen Yun move the bags into the car, Chen Yun handed the cigarettes to them. “It’s been hard on you to help me move my things.”
“This... We can’t accept it. We can’t accept it. It’s already our greatest honor that you can come here to spend money, and that we can help you carry your things.”
“That’s right, that’s right. We’ll feel bad if you do this. This is what we should do.”
Chen Yun shoved the cigarettes to the two of them and got into the car. “I’m going. Thanks.”
They looked at the rear of Chen Yun’s McLaren sports car.”

“How generous. One pack of Heaven Leaf cigarettes costs close to 10,000 yuan.” The deputy supervisor looked at Chen Yun. They had helped Chen Yun carry bags for a while, but they had obtained such a precious thing.

“I never thought that I would be able to smoke such a cigarette one day.” The supervisor wiped the sweat off his forehead and looked excited. “He spent five million yuan in such a short period of time. He’s simply the God of Fortune.”
After sighing for a while, the two of them looked at the cigarettes in their hands.
That person deserved to be so rich.
At this moment, Chen Yun looked at the things beside him. When he returned home, the two little girls would probably be very happy.

chapters.title: Chapter 28
paragraphs: Partition
When he reached home, Chen Yun drove the car to the main villa.

In the practice room, Wang Menghan was guiding the two of them. It was mainly about singing. Nowadays, not only did actors have outstanding acting skills, but most of them also had a good voice and occasionally danced.
Otherwise, was it really that easy to be an actress? Did they just have to be good-looking?
If they relied on their looks, they would only be pretty faces. Only by relying on their own abilities could they break through the rumors of the outside world.
She wanted to teach Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue this principle.
However, she was gratified that these two little girls were really hardworking and talented, especially Chen Mengmeng. She almost skipped all the breaks in between, which exhausted Wang Menghan.
In terms of acting, although Wang Menghan had never acted before, she had seen it before.
After all, even if one hadn’t eaten pork before, they had heard pigs snort.
From time to time, she would give them some pointers. It also enlightened the two of them, making Wang Menghan look like an expert.
Just a little pointer was enough to enlighten people.
In just a day, the two of them had gained a lot of knowledge.
The two of them couldn’t help but sigh. It was still good to have a guide. Otherwise, who knew how long it would take for them to figure it out themselves.
Furthermore, they would even take a detour.
The next moment, a commotion came from outside. Wang Menghan quickly walked over and looked out of the window. “Your brother is back.”
“Menghan, Xiao Xue, Mengmeng, come down and help me move my things.” Chen Yun got out of the car and shouted downstairs.
The three girls looked at the time. It was almost time for dinner, so they quickly walked down.
At this moment, Chen Yun was moving the things in the car to the ground and arranging them.
Down below, Wang Menghan was the first to recognize these brands.
After all, she usually bought them and knew these types of packaging.
Meanwhile, the other two were stunned. The two girls looked at the logos on the gift boxes and bags. Then, they quickly searched for these luxurious brands in their minds.
Louis Vuitton!
Armani!
Chanel!
Vacheron!
Any one of them was enough to make girls go crazy.
Furthermore, there were so many things placed here!
“What are you waiting for? Help me move the things in.” Chen Yun looked at them and smiled.
“Oh-oh.”
Wang Menghan was fine. She had one bag in each hand while Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue were more cautious.
This was too much!
They each held a gift box with their two small hands!
They were afraid that the thing in their hands would melt and shatter!
They cherished the goods very much.
After all, they also knew that these things weren’t cheap!
Chen Yun looked at them and shook his head. If they moved the things like this, how long would it take to move everything?
They placed everything on the sofa.
Then, Chen Mengmeng blinked her big eyes. “Brother, why did you buy so many things?”
“Could it be for me? These are for you girls.”
“Quickly come and have a look.”
Chen Yun waved at them and walked to the gifts.
“These are watches from Vacheron Constantin. The three of you can have one each. Pick one you like.”
“Split these Chanel perfumes among yourselves.”
“Oh right, Mengmeng, I bought a few sets of clothes for you and Xiao Xue. Come and see if they suit you. If they don’t, I’ll bring you guys to buy clothes next time.”
“What are you waiting for? Hurry up and take the goods.” Chen Yun glanced at Chen Mengmeng, who ran over eagerly. She said, “Thank you, brother. I love you.”
“Heh, should I believe you? When you have a boyfriend, let’s see if you can remember your brother.”
“No, I’m not getting married.”
“Alright, alright, alright. Hurry up and get married. I can save some effort that way.”
Chen Yun and Chen Mengmeng chatted and laughed as they took out the clothes from the gift boxes and premium bags.
The things were scattered all over the floor.
“Hurry up and choose. Menghan, choose a watch.”
“Chen Yun, how much is this watch? I remember that this female watch model is a limited model. It’s close to a million yuan, right?”
What?!
Han Xue and Chen Mengmeng were also shocked. Such an expensive watch was thrown on the carpet just like that!
Damn it.
“I don’t remember. I thought you’d like it, so I bought it.”
The three of them were speechless.
There was a type of love called buying things that he thought they would like.
Faced with so many valuable things, Han Xue was about to wave her hand when Chen Mengmeng grabbed her hand and put a watch on her wrist.
“It’s beautiful.”
“Mengmeng, I...”
“We grew up together. We’re all family.” Chen Mengmeng pulled Han Xue. “Let’s go and wear these dresses.”
The two of them carried a few sets of clothes upstairs, leaving Chen Yun and Wang Menghan alone.
“Chen Yun, what are you looking at?”
Wang Menghan looked at the gilded invitation in Chen Yun’s hand and leaned over.
Eh? The Deep Sea King?
That was a top luxury cruise ship!
There were only two types of people who could board that luxury cruise ship.
The first kind of people were high-ranking officials and nobles. They were extremely prominent!
The second kind of people were the staff.
Even celebrity actors and singers like her would not be invited.
“I want to take a look. Do you want to come with me? It shouldn’t take long.” Chen Yun looked at Wang Menghan, making her blush. Wasn’t he asking her to be his female companion?
Still, it was pretty good.
“Okay.”
“Alright, we’ll set off the day after tomorrow.”

According to Ma Ke, the people who went this time were all the younger generation of Jiang City. He wanted to see what these people, who would be in charge of the upper economies of Jiang City in the future, were like.

After dinner, Chen Yun received a WeChat message.

[Jiang Shouheng: Hello, Director Chen. I’m Jiang Shouheng. This time, I’ll accompany you to the Deep Sea King.]
[Chen Yun: Yes, thank you. Shall we contact each other the morning after tomorrow?]
[Jiang Shouheng: Alright, Director Chen.]
The two of them chatted for a while before Chen Yun was dragged to the practice room by Chen Mengmeng to watch their performance.
It had to be said that he had not realized that his sister had such a strong talent for acting.

Even Wang Menghan, who was standing at the side, nodded repeatedly. The two of them were able to perform so well without systematic performance training. If they could successfully enter the Jiang City University of the Arts and receive professional studies and training, their chances of success would be very high.
Moreover, with such a brother, the two of them had a limitless future.
For a moment, Wang Menghan was envious of the two of them.
If she had such a brother back then, would she have had to go through so much trouble when she first started?
The next day, Chen Yun watched the two of them perform for a while before bringing them out to buy clothes.
After all, they were going out to sea.
Chen Yun bought a white suit and white leather shoes. He was dressed in white from top to bottom. Coupled with the longsword brooch at his collar, he looked like a nobleman.

Meanwhile, Wang Menghan chose a navy blue dress and black high heels. She was originally 1.7 meters tall and had heels. Coupled with Chen Yun, they looked like a golden couple. Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue were stunned.
“Brother, why did you and Sister Menghan buy formal clothes?” Chen Mengmeng asked curiously.

“Oh, I forgot to tell you. Sister Menghan and I are going to the luxurious cruise ship, the Deep Sea King, to play at sea for a period of time. It won’t be long, just a day or two. You and Xiao Xue can practice at home.”
Chen Mengmeng was speechless.
Why didn’t he take them with him?!

Seeing his sister’s unwilling expression, Chen Yun chuckled. “This time, it isn’t our home ground. What’s the point of bringing family members along? I’ll take a few photos for you and show them to you when I’m back. Just treat it as if you went to take a look too.”
“It’s not the same! How can photos be the same as the real thing!”
“Are you not taking the arts exam anymore? Are you not going to university?” Chen Yun glanced at her angrily, making her pout with an aggrieved expression.
Seeing that Chen Yun was a little angry, Chen Mengmeng agreed obediently.
This was a habit she had developed in the past. Usually, she would joke around with Chen Yun and be impolite. However, as long as Chen Yun’s face darkened, she would be as obedient as a little sheep.
“Here, this is the card I got for you. The password is your date of birth. When I’m not around, you can get the robot to cook or take Xiao Xue out to eat.”
Chen Mengmeng took the bank card and quietly followed behind Chen Yun, not daring to say a word.
Chen Yun looked at her and shook his head with a bitter smile.
Early the next morning, Chen Yun and Wang Menghan set off. Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue watched them leave from the door and stomped their feet.
“My luxury cruise ship has gone far away.” Chen Mengmeng looked pitiful.
“Come on, he didn’t plan to bring you along anyway.” Han Xue rubbed Chen Mengmeng’s little face. “The art exam is coming up soon. Let’s go and train.”

Meanwhile, Jiang Shouheng was waiting in front of the headquarters of Cauldron Dragon Security, which they had agreed on as their meeting place. Beside him stood a group of Cauldron Dragon Security executives, as well as his father, Jiang Zhengyu.
On the other side of Jiang Shouheng, a girl looked at the scene in front of her and was slightly shocked.
She was only a second-rate actress and had never seen such a scene before.
The person in the lead was her future father-in-law, the CEO of Cauldron Dragon Security!
Furthermore, he and the higher-ups were all waiting anxiously!
They could not stand still!
The atmosphere was especially oppressive!
“Shouheng, just what kind of person are we going to welcome? I’m so nervous.” Zhang Lei looked at the young man beside her.
“The person who will be coming later is the chairman of Sacred Heaven Entertainment, Director Chen. This time, you and I will go to the Deep Sea King.”
“The Director of Sacred Heaven? Isn’t that Old Master Lu of the Lu family?”
“Shh!” Jiang Shouheng glanced at her. “Sacred Heaven has already changed owners. Director Chen has all the Lu family’s shares in his hands. He has 80% of the shares! He has absolute control!”
“If it weren’t for the fact that my father and CEO Ma are close friends, we wouldn’t have known about such a high-level matter, let alone let us accompany them.”
What?
He had 80% of the shares!
How much was that worth?
It was close to ten billion!
This was a rich man!
He was a top tycoon!
When Zhang Lei heard this, her palms were sweating. She bit her lips and thought to herself that she must not say anything wrong later.
Otherwise, she would not be able to bear the consequences!

chapters.title: Chapter 30
paragraphs: Deep Sea King!

While they were talking, a sound wave came from afar. A black McLaren sports car stopped at the entrance of the Cauldron Dragon Security headquarters. Jiang Zhengyu and the group of high-level executives hurriedly went up to welcome Chen Yun.

“Director Chen, I’ve long heard of you. It’s my honor to meet you today!” Jiang Zhengyu held Chen Yun’s right hand with both hands. If one didn’t know what was going on, they would think that they were old friends who had not met for many years.
Chen Yun also chuckled in his heart at Jiang Zhengyu’s words.
Damn it, he had just taken over Sacred Heaven. How could Jiang Zhengyu have heard of him for a long time?
However, looking at this posture, Chen Yun knew who was in front of him. He should be the CEO of Cauldron Dragon Security.
“You must be CEO Jiang. Hello.”
Although Chen Yun did not know his name, it was enough to know his son’s surname.
“Yes, yes, I’m Jiang Zhengyu.”
At the side, many people were talking to Chen Yun fervently. Meanwhile, Jiang Shouheng and Zhang Lei were blocked at the back.
Looking at the high-ranking officials and his father flattering Chen Yun, Jiang Shouheng respected Chen Yun’s status even more.
His father had been in the business world for so many years and considered himself to be steady. He had never shown such an attitude.
Meanwhile, Wang Menghan also got out of the car. Jiang Zhengyu also shook her hand eagerly.
After chatting for a while, Jiang Zhengyu looked at Chen Yun. “Director Chen, why don’t we go in and sit for a while?”
Chen Yun looked at his watch and shook his head. “Forget it. Let’s wait for a chance in the future.”

“Alright. In that case, I’ll definitely prepare top-notch tea leaves and wait for your arrival.” Jiang Zhengyu waved his hand toward the back. “Shouheng, what are you waiting for? Come and meet Director Chen.”
Jiang Zhengyu pulled Jiang Shouheng over with a smile on his face. “Director Chen, this is my son, Jiang Shouheng. I asked him to accompany you this time.”
“Hello, Director Chen.”
“Hello, Director Chen.”
Jiang Shouheng spoke. Zhang Lei also spoke, but her voice was trembling somewhat.
“Oh, hello.” Chen Yun replied. He didn’t seem very interested.
Jiang Zhengyu also saw Chen Yun’s attitude and sighed.
The next moment, Wang Menghan looked at Zhang Lei. “Xiao Lei, why are you here? Didn’t you enter the entertainment industry? Are you still filming?”
“Hey, Menghan.”
Chen Yun looked at Wang Menghan. “Do you know each other?”
“Yes, yes. We were classmates in our first year of high school. We haven’t seen each other for many years, so we didn’t recognize each other just now.”
Wang Menghan held Zhang Lei’s hand and the two of them chatted passionately.
Jiang Zhengyu, who was next to her, saw this sudden situation and was overjoyed. “Leilei, so you’re classmates? That’s good. We can have a good chat along the way.”
“Yes, yes.” Wang Menghan nodded.
“Miss Menghan, Leilei and my son are about to get married. When the time comes, you and Director Chen must come. I’ll toast to you.” Jiang Zhengyu’s words shocked Zhang Lei.
Had his attitude suddenly changed?
Zhang Lei knew her identity. A second-rate actress might look glamorous to ordinary people, but in the eyes of such a big boss, she was just an actress.
Since ancient times, there had always been a saying that prostitutes were heartless, while actresses were meaningless.
Therefore, she also faced many obstacles in her relationship with Jiang Shouheng.
She did not expect her future father-in-law to say such words today!
He acknowledged her directly!
She immediately looked at Chen Yun. She was not stupid and naturally knew why Jiang Zhengyu had changed!
“Well, if there’s time.”
“Director Chen, let’s go. Why don’t I drive? That way, they can catch up in the car. What do you think?”
“Alright.” It just happened that Chen Yun was too lazy to drive.

Jiang Shouheng took the Maybach car key from his father and sat in the driver’s seat, while Zhang Lei sat in the passenger seat. He let Chen Yun and Wang Menghan sit in the back. Then, they headed towards the East Port together.
Along the way, the few of them chatted and became more familiar with one another.
When they arrived at the East Port, Chen Yun got out of the car and looked at the luxurious cruise ship in front of him. He could not help but nod.
It was too luxurious!
It was not an exaggeration to describe it as lavish!

“Director Chen, the Deep Sea King weighs 50,000 tons and can carry 2,000 passengers. It has 100 hot spring cabins, 20 restaurants serving delicacies from various countries, and 500 square feet of outdoor gardens.” Jiang Shouheng introduced the Deep Sea King to Chen Yun.
After verifying their identities, they boarded the cruise ship and looked at the deck in front of them.
In addition to the swimming pool, there was also a huge digital screen and so on. In particular, there was a large banquet hall that occupied 5,500 square feet. It was extremely luxurious!
This arrangement stunned Wang Menghan. Even Jiang Shouheng, who had been here a few times, was shocked to see such a scene again. Just this cruise ship alone cost hundreds of millions!
At this moment, there were already many people standing on the cruise ship. The men were in well-ironed suits, while the women had a gentle temperament.
All of them were well-dressed and wore formal gowns. The women had exquisite makeup and were wearing sparkling jewelry.
Although they might not be very beautiful, their extraordinary temperament showed their status.
Many beauties looked at them carefully, as if they had seen these people on screen.
However, these onlookers were sneering at them.

The men and women who came here were all walking together. Usually, the couples were the young masters and young ladies of the upper echelons of Jiang City. Of course, there were also young masters with female companions who were celebrities in the entertainment industry.
One was a young lady from a wealthy family, and the other was an actress on stage. When the two were compared, such prejudice was not surprising.
“Director Chen, the son of Jiang City Zhenghao Aluminium’s CEO Wu, Wu Zheng, is over there.”
“This is Liu Xuan, the eldest daughter of CEO Liu from Jiang City Zhiyuan Trading.”
As they walked, Jiang Shouheng introduced various people to Chen Yun. However, Chen Yun wasn’t interested in them. “Just enjoy this trip. You don’t need to accompany me the entire time.”
Jiang Shouheng immediately understood what he meant and nodded. “Alright, Director Chen.”
After the two of them left, Wang Menghan took Chen Yun’s arm and admired the scenery from the deck.
Chen Yun was dressed in a white suit. His eyebrows were sharp and his eyes were starry. He was especially eye-catching in the crowd.
“Which family is this young master from?”
“I don’t know. I’ve never seen this person in the upper echelons of the younger generation in Jiang City, but he’s indeed handsome.”
“Hmm, his bearing is also extraordinary.”
Many rich young ladies looked at Chen Yun and instantly fell in love.
However, due to his status, they could only watch from afar and sigh.
If only there was no one around now!
Such a handsome man!
To be honest, as rich princesses, they had seen all kinds of handsome men!
This shouldn’t have happened!
However, Chen Yun was just too handsome!

chapters.title: Chapter 31
paragraphs: Casino!
Many young ladies from rich families were asking the people around them about Chen Yun.
However, no one knew anything. It was as if Chen Yun had suddenly appeared out of nowhere.
At the same time, Chen Yun and Wang Menghan were also admiring the scenery while wandering around in circles.
Listening to the idle chatter of the young generation, Chen Yun was deeply moved.

These rich kids all had their own views on the truth and policies. Furthermore, they were quite unique. Some of them had a strategic position and pointed to the development of Jiang City’s economy and the entire China.
Some seemed to be silent, but could occasionally point out a vital point from time to time.
Some of the comments were about high-level policies that no one knew about or policies that were about to be implemented.
The fathers of these people controlled a large amount of resources. How could ordinary people counterattack them?
Sometimes, these rich second-generation heirs took on more responsibilities and became more mature.
Naturally, there were those who were motivated and those who were not.
Those who were not ambitious typically brought celebrities from the entertainment industry here. They wandered around, eating, drinking, and taking advantage of others. They looked detestable.
Of course, in the eyes of others, Chen Yun was also one of them.

Although Chen Yun brought Wang Menghan along, in the eyes of these young masters and young ladies, although Wang Menghan was a big singer, she still sought public attention. In the end, she was not presentable.
Wealthy families had a natural prejudice against actors and singers.
Not long after, the ship arrived at the open sea, and the casino naturally opened.
“Let’s go and take a look.” Chen Yun brought Wang Menghan to the casino on the third floor.

After entering the casino, Wang Menghan could not help but cover her mouth in surprise. This place was simply too shocking. The venue was so big that it could not be seen at a glance. Not only that, but it was also dazzling.
The top casinos in Macau were just like this.
“What do you want to play?” Chen Yun opened his hand and exchanged 10 million chips. Then, he looked at Wang Menghan.
“I don’t know. I don’t know anything about this kind of stuff.”
“Let’s just watch others play.” Chen Yun shook his head and smiled. He had the Full of Luck skill, so everyone present today was trash.

If Chen Yun wanted to sweep through the casino, he would have already started to gamble. However, he really did not care about this small amount of money. It was like a rich man playing cards with a child. Even if he won, he would not feel the slightest pleasure.
At this moment, a few people were slowly walking over from the door, causing many people to exclaim.
The people near the door looked up. They saw a few young men and women walking in.
The young man in the lead was also wearing a white suit. He had an extraordinary appearance and a tall figure. Although his face was a little pale, he still looked high-spirited.
Next to him, a girl was holding his arm.

She was wearing a fiery-red and deep V-shaped gown that revealed her deep cleavage. She was also wearing crystal high heels and branded jewelry. Her slender waist was like a water snake. With her figure and extraordinary looks, she was simply a peerless beauty!
If an ordinary person was here, they would definitely recognize this A-list Chinese female celebrity, Qu Xinyu.
Qu Xinyu had always been known for being sexy and charming. The roles she played were also quite bold and were major roles.
“Oh my god, Young Master Gai is here too.”
“It’s Young Master Gai’s first time visiting the high seas, right?”
“Their family rented this cruise ship for a long time. They can go out to sea whenever they want. It’s not rare for them anymore.”
As everyone discussed, many young people came forward to flatter him.
Beside these young people, a girl beside a young man pulled the young man.

“Didn’t you bring me here to meet a big shot? There aren’t any higher-ups of entertainment companies here, right? Could it be that you’re talking about Qu Xinyu?” The girl complained to the young man. There was reluctance in their eyes. She thought that there were some higher-ups of entertainment companies here.
“Hmph! You’ll only be a B-list actress for the rest of your life. You have no judgment.”
“The big shot is Young Master Gai Lingjie. Do you know who Young Master Gai is?” The young man asked.

She had given him two million yuan!
The young man sneered. “Is Nanshan Industry not big? It’s a corporation worth one to two billion yuan.”
“Moreover, you knew that he was the young master of Nanshan Industry, but you didn’t know that he was also the cousin of Young Master Su Yuncheng from Huaying Entertainment.”
What?
He was the cousin of Young Master Su from Huaying Entertainment!
This!
She didn’t know about this before!
No wonder, no wonder Qu Xinyu was so willing to accompany him, her body almost touching his.
If she could get in touch with Young Master Su, she would definitely soar!
Huaying Entertainment was a large entertainment company that was almost comparable to Sacred Heaven Entertainment!

“By the way, Young Master Gai likes doing it with two other people. It looks like you and Qu Xinyu will be the ones tonight. You can also prepare to get in touch with Qu Xinyu, hehe.”

Meanwhile, a few young men helped Gai Lingjie block the people around him.
After watching the gambling party for a while, Qu Xinyu looked to the side with suspicion in her eyes. “Huh? Isn’t that Wang Menghan? Why is she here?”

chapters.title: Chapter 32
paragraphs: Are You Not Giving Me Face?
Wang Menghan?
Gai Lingjie suddenly turned around and looked at the two people on the other side.
They were none other than Chen Yun and Wang Menghan!
At this moment, Wang Menghan was holding onto Chen Yun. From Gai Lingjie’s point of view, the two of them were extremely intimate.

Qu Xinyu looked at Gai Lingjie’s expression and pretended to be puzzled. “Eh? I think I heard that Young Master Su once courted her, but she rejected him. I thought she wanted to focus on her career. Why is she here?”
“Furthermore, she’s holding a boy’s arm so intimately.”
These words made the fire in Gai Lingjie’s heart burn even more fiercely.
He and Su Yuncheng were cousins, but in the end, they were cousins. Thus, he treated Su Yuncheng with a fawning attitude and was like a lackey to Su Yuncheng.
Although he was the young master of Nanshan Industry, he was nothing compared to Su Yuncheng, the young master of Huaying Entertainment.
Therefore, Su Yuncheng handed many things to him, including the previous courtship between Su Yuncheng and Wang Menghan.
It was also done by him.
He had made such a big fuss and set up such a grand scene. In the end, Wang Menghan’s words shattered all his efforts.
Later on, he was even scolded by his cousin, Su Yuncheng, and their relationship almost broke down.
He didn’t know how many gifts he had given and how many top-notch beauties he had offered to redeem himself.
How could he not hate Wang Menghan?
He also thought that Wang Menghan was obsessed with her career, but he didn’t expect this!
This b*tch!
She was actually behaving inappropriately with a man here!
“Young Master Gai, have a cigarette. Don’t be angry.” A young man beside Gai Lingjie handed a cigarette to him, but Gai Lingjie ignored him.
Instead, he looked at Chen Yun. “Who is that kid?”
“This...” Everyone’s eyes met. No one could answer Gai Lingjie’s question.
Thud!
Gai Lingjie slammed the table and glared at the people around him. “You are a bunch of trash. Hurry up and investigate!”
A few of them hurried out.

At the side, a young man looked at Chen Yun and said, “Young Master Gai, I’m familiar with everyone in the upper echelons of Jiang City. However, I’ve never seen this person before. Where did he come from?”

“Young Master Gai, look, Wang Menghan and that boy are very intimate. I really don’t know when she met this person. With his appearance, he’s not even comparable to the popular young celebrities of Huaying Entertainment.” Qu Xinyu fanned the flames and said, “You must tell Young Master Su about this.”

She looked at Wang Menghan and sneered. She and Wang Menghan were originally in Huaying Entertainment. After she rose up, all the resources went to her. After that, Wang Menghan also rose up and became a popular person in Huaying, covering up her talents.
If she could defeat Wang Menghan this time, she would be able to obtain more resources.
It meant more money!
Initially, she thought that Wang Menghan had done everything flawlessly. She did not expect Gai Lingjie to catch her red-handed today.

“Hmph, let’s see how you run this time. We’ll let Young Master Su know that you chose a brat and not him. Let’s see what happens to you.” Qu Xinyu narrowed her eyes and shot a sharp gaze at Wang Menghan.
After a while, a few young men returned. “Young Master Gai, this kid came with the Lu family’s invitation.”
“However, I remember that there are no boys in the direct line of the Lu family’s descent. Instead, there are a few boys from the sidelines who are studying abroad.”
“This person probably came here to play after studying abroad. After all, the eldest daughter of the Lu family has never bothered to attend such an occasion.”
“A side branch of the Lu Family?” Gai Lingjie sneered.
Then, he rolled his eyes and said in realization, “Hmph, what a b*tch. What a scheme. This time, she came with the Lu family. She’s going to jump ship from Huaying to Sacred Heaven.”
“It’s really a pity that Cousin used so many resources to nurture her. Good God, what an ingrate.”
“However, Wang Menghan is quite interesting. She gave up on a phoenix and wanted a country bumpkin. She actually looked for a collateral relative of the Lu family.”

How could a mere collateral relative of the Lu Family catch her eye? Not to mention collateral relatives, among the younger generation of the Lu Family, other than the eldest daughter in the direct line of descent, no one else was useful!
“Hmph!” Gai Lingjie stood up and walked towards Chen Yun and Qu Xinyu with a smug smile. Qu Xinyu followed behind him.

He thought, “Hmph, Wang Menghan, Wang Menghan, how stupid are you? Although Huaying is not as good as Sacred Heaven, isn’t the young chairman of Huaying better than a collateral relative of the Lu family?!”
If Young Master Su heard about this, she would be in trouble.
When the other young men saw this situation, they quickly followed.
“Miss Menghan, I didn’t expect to meet you here again.”
At this moment, Wang Menghan was holding Chen Yun’s arm and watching the game at the Texas Hold’em table.
She suddenly heard a voice and looked up in a daze. Then, she saw Gai Lingjie’s cold gaze.
“Master Gai?”
Panic instantly flashed across Wang Menghan’s eyes.
She naturally knew that Gai Lingjie was Su Yuncheng’s lackey. She also knew how Su Yuncheng felt about her.
However, she did not like Su Yuncheng’s style. To him, women were like clothes that could be taken off after wearing them. She was no exception. At most, she was just a good-looking dress to him.
Needless to say, compared to Chen Yun, Su Yuncheng’s behavior was even worse.
“Miss Menghan still remembers me. Why don’t you have a drink with me? There are also a few senior members of Huaying Entertainment over there. After drinking this glass, I’ll bring you to meet them.”
Gai Lingjie held the champagne in his hand and looked at Wang Menghan. Wang Menghan moved back to hide, which made Gai Lingjie’s face turn cold.
“Why? Miss Menghan, are you going to embarrass me, or are you going to embarrass the higher-ups of Huaying?”
His words were extremely threatening.

chapters.title: Chapter 33
paragraphs: I Dare to Cripple You!
Wang Menghan’s actions made Gai Lingjie furious for a moment. There seemed to be flames dancing in his eyes.

At the side, Qu Xinyu looked at this scene and cheered in her heart. However, she didn’t show it on her face. She walked forward and said, “Menghan, is this your friend? Why haven’t I seen him before? Why haven’t you introduced him to us?”
She walked over leisurely with a hint of grace and charm. Her voice was charming. As expected of a femme fatale on the screen.
At this moment, Wang Menghan calmed down and thought about how to deal with them. “Young Master Gai, this is my friend, Chen Yun.”
Then, She looked at Chen Yun. “Chen Yun, this is the eldest son of Nanshan Industry, Gai Lingjie, also known as Young Master Gai.”
She tucked her hair behind her ears and spoke to Chen Yun, deliberately revealing Gai Lingjie’s identity.
In reality, no one introduced others like this. However, Wang Menghan was afraid that Chen Yun would have another conflict with Gai Lingjie.
“Chen Yun?”
When Gai Lingjie heard this, he was stunned. Didn’t this kid come in with the Lu family’s invitation letter? Why was his surname Chen?

However, he suddenly realized that the Lu Family had no interest in such gatherings in the past few years. Last year, they even gave the invitation card to the child of Sacred Heaven’s Director. It was probably the same for the person in front of him.
He was not even a collateral relative of the Lu Family. By calling Chen Yun a country bumpkin, he had truly overestimated Chen Yun’s ability.
“Looking at Mr. Chen’s age, you shouldn’t have graduated yet, right? Are you the young master of some director at Sacred Heaven? What’s your status?” A young man beside him asked with a sneer.
“I haven’t graduated yet. I can’t be called a young master. I’m not from Jiang City. I’m just studying at Jiang City Institute of Technology.” Chen Yun replied calmly.
“Jiang City Institute of Technology?”
For a moment, a disdainful smile appeared on Gai Lingjie’s face.

If he was still afraid that Chen Yun was the child of some director, then the mention of the bullsh*t Jiang City Institute of Technology simply made him laugh his head off. At that moment, Chen Yun’s status in his heart dropped even more.

The young masters and young ladies of Jiang City, as well as the children of the directors in various companies were all from famous schools. There was no need to brag. Their families spent money to give them a degree from a famous university. After all, this represented their reputation.
In Nanshan Industry, even people from Jiang City University, a university under the 985
Project
were common and worthless, let alone people from Jiang City Institute of Technology, a university under the 211
Project
When the young people beside them heard Chen Yun’s words, their eyes were filled with mockery.

If he was the child of Sacred Heaven’s director, even if they used money to get him into a good school, they would put him in a famous foreign university. Why would he study at a university in Jiang City?
He was not even the child of a director. The Lu family really did not think highly of the gathering he had organized!
They allowed the child of an ordinary manager to come!
Damn!
Damn the Lu family!
That damned Sacred Heaven! That damned Wang Menghan!

Looking at Gai Lingjie’s expression, a young man beside him took a step forward. “Young Master Chen, we invited the Lu Family, so please move to the deck. This place is filled with nobles from Jiang City. Your class doesn’t match ours. We’re afraid that you’ll offend our esteemed guests.”
His words were like a sharp sword that pointed straight at Chen Yun.
In other words, Chen Yun had a lowly status and was simply not qualified to be in the same venue as them.
The highest realm of scolding was saying that the other party’s social class was not high enough, and that they were not worthy!
Seeing that Chen Yun did not move, Gai Lingjie sneered, “It looks like Young Master Chen doesn’t understand human language. The few of you, ‘invite’ him out.”
Since his master had something to say, as his lackeys, they naturally had to work for their master.
In an instant, the few young men behind Gai Lingjie rushed toward Chen Yun.
Meanwhile, Gai Lingjie held a wine glass in his hand and held the beauty in his arms. He had a smug expression on his face.
“Young Master Gai!” Wang Menghan looked anxious and was ready to plead with Gai Lingjie.
“B*tch!” Gai Lingjie looked at Wang Menghan. “You’re a whore, yet you still want to show your chastity. Don’t you know who you are? Wang Menghan, I’ll deal with you after I’m done with him.”
These words made Wang Menghan’s face turn pale, but she could not watch Chen Yun be thrown out. She immediately encouraged him, “Young Master Gai, please...”
Before she could finish speaking, Qu Xinyu took a step forward and raised her arm to slap Wang Menghan.
Chen Yun’s eyes turned cold. He pushed Qu Xinyu’s hand away and slapped her face.
Pa!
A crisp sound rang out.
Qu Xinyu covered her face and looked at Chen Yun.
For a moment, everything was silent!
Many people looked over. Anger rose in Gai Lingjie’s eyes, and the young men beside him trembled.
Meanwhile, the people beside them looked at Chen Yun in disbelief.
“How dare you hit her!” A young man looked at Chen Yun, and the corner of his mouth twitched.
Although Qu Xinyu was not from a wealthy family and was just an actress, she was still Young Master Gai’s female companion!
Chen Yun slapping Qu Xinyu in public was equivalent to slapping Young Master Gai hard!
This was a public slap to Young Master Gai’s face!
Gai Lingjie’s expression turned even colder. He could no longer maintain his smile and said in a gloomy voice, “Good! Good! Mr. Chen, Wang Menghan, you’re really bold.”
This sentence was said through gritted teeth.
Wang Menghan was instantly shocked. She knew Gai Lingjie’s status and power. With just one word from him, countless people would want to please him and work for him!
At this moment, Chen Yun’s action was like poking a hornet’s nest!
Meanwhile, Chen Yun took a piece of paper from the side and wiped his hands. Then, he looked at Gai Lingjie.
Then, he sneered.
“If you talk nonsense again, I won’t just beat her up, I’ll cripple you. Do you believe me?”
As soon as these words were spoken, the entire place instantly fell silent!
Everyone was dumbfounded, and Wang Menghan’s face turned pale!
An oppressive atmosphere enveloped the entire place.
