They allowed the child of an ordinary manager to come!
Damn!
Damn the Lu family!
That damned Sacred Heaven!
That damned Wang Menghan!
Looking at Gai Lingjie’s expression, a young man beside him took a step forward.
“Young Master Chen, we invited the Lu Family, so please move to the deck.
This place is filled with nobles from Jiang City.
Your class doesn’t match ours.
We’re afraid that you’ll offend our esteemed guests.”
His words were like a sharp sword that pointed straight at Chen Yun.
In other words, Chen Yun had a lowly status and was simply not qualified to be in the same venue as them.
The highest realm of scolding was saying that the other party’s social class was not high enough, and that they were not worthy!
Seeing that Chen Yun did not move, Gai Lingjie sneered, “It looks like Young Master Chen doesn’t understand human language.
The few of you, ‘invite’ him out.”
Since his master had something to say, as his lackeys, they naturally had to work for their master.
In an instant, the few young men behind Gai Lingjie rushed toward Chen Yun.
Meanwhile, Gai Lingjie held a wine glass in his hand and held the beauty in his arms.
He had a smug expression on his face.
“Young Master Gai!” Wang Menghan looked anxious and was ready to plead with Gai Lingjie.
“B*tch!” Gai Lingjie looked at Wang Menghan.
“You’re a whore, yet you still want to show your chastity.
Don’t you know who you are?
Wang Menghan, I’ll deal with you after I’m done with him.”
These words made Wang Menghan’s face turn pale, but she could not watch Chen Yun be thrown out.
She immediately encouraged him, “Young Master Gai, please...”
Before she could finish speaking, Qu Xinyu took a step forward and raised her arm to slap Wang Menghan.
Chen Yun’s eyes turned cold.
He pushed Qu Xinyu’s hand away and slapped her face.
Pa!
A crisp sound rang out.
Qu Xinyu covered her face and looked at Chen Yun.
For a moment, everything was silent!
Many people looked over.
Anger rose in Gai Lingjie’s eyes, and the young men beside him trembled.
Meanwhile, the people beside them looked at Chen Yun in disbelief.
“How dare you hit her!” A young man looked at Chen Yun, and the corner of his mouth twitched.
Although Qu Xinyu was not from a wealthy family and was just an actress, she was still Young Master Gai’s female companion!
Chen Yun slapping Qu Xinyu in public was equivalent to slapping Young Master Gai hard!
This was a public slap to Young Master Gai’s face!
Gai Lingjie’s expression turned even colder.
He could no longer maintain his smile and said in a gloomy voice, “Good!
Good!
Mr.
Chen, Wang Menghan, you’re really bold.”
This sentence was said through gritted teeth.
Wang Menghan was instantly shocked.
She knew Gai Lingjie’s status and power.
With just one word from him, countless people would want to please him and work for him!
At this moment, Chen Yun’s action was like poking a hornet’s nest!
Meanwhile, Chen Yun took a piece of paper from the side and wiped his hands.
Then, he looked at Gai Lingjie.
Then, he sneered.
“If you talk nonsense again, I won’t just beat her up, I’ll cripple you.
Do you believe me?”
As soon as these words were spoken, the entire place instantly fell silent!
Everyone was dumbfounded, and Wang Menghan’s face turned pale!
An oppressive atmosphere enveloped the entire place.

chapters.title: Chapter 34
paragraphs: Director Chen!
“If you talk nonsense again, I won’t just beat her up, I’ll cripple you. Do you believe me?”
A single sentence, coupled with Chen Yun’s slap on Qu Xinyu’s face, was simply unprecedentedly domineering.
Now, he was directly facing Gai Lingjie!
The eldest son of Nanshan Industry!
How could the crowd not be shocked!

Behind Gai Lingjie was Nanshan Industry. Furthermore, the young master of Huaying Entertainment, Young Master Su Yuncheng, was his cousin. Thus, he also had a place in the upper circle of Jiang City. Otherwise, there wouldn’t be so many young masters and young ladies here.
At this moment, the entire place was silent.
Even Gai Lingjie could not believe what Chen Yun had said.
Good God!
Ever since he was young, no one had dared to say such things to him. Even his cousin and the young master of Huaying Entertainment, Su Yuncheng, had never said such things to him!
Qu Xinyu was slapped and was about to fly into a rage when she was stunned by Chen Yun’s words.
This scene naturally attracted many people to watch, and more and more people came.
The bodyguards in black on the luxury cruise ship also came over.
“This kid is finished this time. Young Master Gai really can’t let him off this time.”
“He might even be thrown into the sea to feed the sharks. After all, this cruise ship was rented by Nanshan Industry.”
“With his face, it’s a pity.”
“What’s the use of having a handsome face? Are you blind?”
There were also people who lamented for Chen Yun, but no one dared to step forward and speak.
Who was that? It was Gai Lingjie, Young Master Gai!
Who would dare to attack him?!
At this moment, Wang Menghan looked at Chen Yun and held his hand. “Chen Yun, don’t be rash.”
Gai Lingjie saw this and sneered.
“Good!”
Gai Lingjie clapped his hands. “Alright, I’ve really broadened my horizons today. I finally know what it means to be ignorant and fearless.”
“Sir, you hit my woman in my territory and even threatened to cripple me. That’s a little unreasonable, right?”
“Tell me, should I take one of your arms or legs, or throw you into the sea for you to swim back?”
When the young men at the side heard Gai Lingjie’s words, they instantly burst out laughing.
“Good thinking, Young Master Gai!”
“That’s right. Throw him overboard. I heard that there are many sharks in this area.”
“Mr. Chen, it’s time to test your swimming skills.”
The surrounding people spoke one after another, their faces filled with mockery.
Wang Menghan looked at Gai Lingjie’s expression and knew that he was not joking.
This was the open sea. Even if there were no sharks, he would die halfway from exhaustion.
Gai Lingjie was trying to kill Chen Yun!
“Young Master Gai! For Young Master Su’s sake...”
“Stupid b*tch!” Gai Lingjie looked at Wang Menghan. “If it weren’t for my cousin, I would have thrown you into the sea to feed the sharks.”
“Security, what are you waiting for? Throw him off the cruise!”
As soon as Gai Lingjie said this, a few burly men in black beside him suddenly stepped forward and glared at Chen Yun.
They pressed forward step by step.
Chen Yun looked around coldly. His indifference shocked all the young masters and young ladies present.
Just as he was about to attack...
There was a sudden commotion outside the door.

“Uncle Gai, I didn’t expect you to be on the ship this time. How is it? You’re working with Cauldron Dragon Security, right? Our people are all professionally trained and can deal with various situations.”
A middle-aged man, a young man, and a young woman walked over slowly.
“Do you think I don’t trust you?” The middle-aged man laughed.
Those who recognized him took a few steps back and made way for him.
This was the CEO of Nanshan Industry, Gai Tianyuan!
He started from scratch and created Nanshan Industry. In this era where finance was booming, it could be said that he had some skills to lead Nanshan Industry to this extent.
Legend had it that Gai Tianyuan was ruthless. When he saw an opportunity, he pounced on it like a hungry wolf, which was why Nanshan Industry was where it was today.
Because of this, the group of young masters and young ladies were especially respectful to Gai Tianyuan and immediately greeted him.
“Uncle Gai, you’re here.”
“Hello Uncle Gai, Young Master Jiang.”
“CEO Gai.”

After Gai Tianyuan greeted them, he looked at Jiang Shouheng. “Shouheng, if you hadn’t come to look for me today, I wouldn’t have known about such a high-level matter. I really didn’t expect such a big shot to come to my home ground.”
“I’ll have to rely on you to recommend me later.”
Jiang Shouheng waved his hand. “Uncle Gai, you’re too polite. I’ve asked my father. He said that we’re not outsiders. He heard that you’re also on the cruise ship, so he’s taking a helicopter over.”
Oh?
Gai Tianyuan nodded as well. Old Jiang was really kind to recommend him personally.
“Let’s meet Mr. Chen first. Otherwise, I’m afraid that Mr. Chen will say that I’m neglecting him.” Gai Tianyuan’s footsteps became even more hurried as he spoke.
When he first heard that the Sacred Heaven had changed owners, he was incomparably shocked.
The original Lu family ran such a huge family business and had a solid background to support Sacred Heaven.

However, someone had bought all the shares of Sacred Heaven Entertainment from the large Lu family in such a short period of time. This meant that the force behind Mr. Chen was not only rich, but also powerful.
Jiang Shouheng guessed that Mr. Chen might be from Tianjing.

The children of Tianjing City were the true nobles and generals. They were truly influential people. In contrast, Gai Tianyuan, was just a small businessman who ran Nanshan Industry. Who was he in comparison?
As the two of them walked, Jiang Shouheng suddenly looked up and saw Chen Yun and Wang Menghan standing there. “Director Chen, you’re here?”
Director Chen?
When Jiang Shouheng said these two words, everyone was stunned. Who was Director Chen? Gai Tianyuan was the only old man here. There was no young master of a director present either.
Who was this?

However, in the next moment, they saw Gai Tianyuan rush over and extend his hands. “Director Chen, I didn’t expect you to lower yourself to participate in this trip organized by me. I’m really flattered. I didn’t know you were coming before. Please don’t blame me, Director Chen.”
Chen Yun looked at Gai Tianyuan’s outstretched hand and ignored it, making Gai Tianyuan feel awkward for a moment. In his heart, he respected Chen Yun even more.
When Jiang Shouheng saw this scene, he quickly came over to explain.
“Director Chen, this is Director Gai Tianyuan of Nanshan Industry.”

“That’s right, that’s right. I was so excited to see you, Director Chen, that I forgot to introduce myself.” Gai Tianyuan’s enthusiasm was far from the cold expression he had when he greeted the young masters and young ladies of the big families.
He looked at Chen Yun with a smile on his face. In the past, he would still be skeptical of Jiang Shouheng’s words. However, from the moment he saw Chen Yun, he no longer had any doubts.
At such a young age, he already had 80% of Sacred Heaven’s shares and ten billion yuan!
There was no need to say how powerful the backing of such a person was!
However, his actions made everyone present turn silent. They did not even dare to breathe loudly.

chapters.title: Chapter 35
paragraphs: Why Are You Still Standing There?
Director Chen?
Why?
Why would Gai Tianyuan, an old man, bow and call him Director Chen?

Although Wang Menghan did not know Gai Tianyuan, she still knew about Nanshan Industry. It was a large industrial group worth one to two billion yuan, and the CEO of such a corporation was actually respectful to Chen Yun!
She wished that she could stick her face to Chen Yun!
Opposite them, Qu Xinyu and the group of youths were stunned.
In particular, Gai Lingjie’s eyes were wide open. He simply could not believe what he was seeing.
“Dad? What are you doing?”
As soon as he said this, Gai Tianyuan turned around and looked at Gai Lingjie. “Lingjie, quickly come and greet Director Chen.”
“Director Chen recently bought 80% of Sacred Heaven Entertainment’s shares and became the youngest director of Sacred Heaven Entertainment.”
“Child, why are you still standing there? Hurry up and greet him.”
He had bought 80% of Sacred Heaven Entertainment’s shares!
He had absolute control!
He was the youngest director!
These few words set off a storm in everyone’s hearts.
What kind of person was this?!
The mocking smiles on their faces gradually froze and turned into bitter expressions.
Some people were trembling in fear because they had mocked Chen Yun just now!
It was as if someone had poured a basin of ice water over their heads, and a chill ran down their spines!
“Eighty percent of Sacred Heaven Entertainment’s shares should be worth close to ten billion.”
“Is the Lu family stupid? They’re guaranteed to earn profits from those shares. Why would they sell the shares?”
“He’s so young, yet he’s already bought so many shares?”
Many people began to discuss, their eyes fixed on Chen Yun. After all, Gai Tianyuan’s words had really frightened them.
This young man should only be 20 years old, but he was already richer than all their fathers combined!
“He bought 80% of Sacred Heaven’s shares...”
It was as if Gai Lingjie’s soul had been stripped away. He stood there in a daze, not saying a word.
Chen Yun, who was at most the child of an executive at Sacred Heaven Entertainment, was simply no bigger than an ant in front of Gai Lingjie.
However, he had never expected Chen Yun to become a towering giant. Gai Lingjie could not even see his head.
Meanwhile, Qu Xinyu was so frightened that she took a step back and fell to the ground.
Beside Chen Yun, Wang Menghan’s heart raced and her face turned red.
She finally knew why Chen Yun could buy Villa No. 3 of Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion.
She finally knew why he could buy a yacht worth millions.
She finally knew why he bought branded goods as if he was buying groceries.
So that was the reason!
He had 80% of the shares!
Chen Yun could definitely become the richest man in Jiang City, or even the entire region!
Jiang Shouheng looked at everyone’s reactions. Then, he looked at his bodyguards standing beside him.
“What exactly happened here? Did you provoke Director Chen?!”

The security guards of Cauldron Dragon naturally recognized Jiang Shouheng. They had also heard Gai Tianyuan’s words. They immediately said with a trembling voice, “Young Master, it’s Young Master Gai. He said that he wanted to take one of Director Chen’s arms or legs, or...”
“Or what?!”
When Jiang Shouheng heard this, his face immediately turned ashen. “Speak! Or what!”

At this moment, he was furious and regretted not following Chen Yun throughout. If Chen Yun cut off Sacred Heaven’s collaboration with Cauldron Dragon because of this, his father would have killed him.
“Speak!”
Jiang Shouheng roared again, his voice echoing throughout the casino.
“He even said to throw Director Chen into the sea to feed the sharks.”
Jiang Shouheng’s eyes almost popped out of their sockets. He turned to look at Gai Lingjie with bloodshot eyes.

If he had come a step later and his family’s security guards had touched Chen Yun, then he could forget about collaborating with Sacred Heaven. The other party would definitely do their best to destroy Cauldron Dragon Security!
Their entire family was going to starve!
With that, he strode forward and simply slapped Gai Lingjie’s face.
Pa!
With a crisp sound, one of Gai Lingjie’s teeth was slapped out.
Meanwhile, when Gai Tianyuan heard the security guard’s words, his vision darkened and he almost fell to the ground.
“Unfilial son! Hurry up and apologize to Director Chen!”
Gai Tianyuan looked at Gai Lingjie and roared.
Gai Lingjie had been slapped by Jiang Shouheng. He covered his face and looked at Chen Yun, his eyes filled with hatred.
After today, how could he stand in the upper circle of Jiang City!
He gritted his teeth and looked at Chen Yun with a murderous gaze.
“Director Chen, I really didn’t know your identity today. Sorry for offending you.”
“However, you’ve also caused trouble for me and hit my woman. How about we settle this? From now on, let’s go our separate ways.”
These two sentences were unusually unyielding.
“Heh.”
Chen Yun sneered.
“Settle this?” Chen Yun shook his head. “I’ve said it before. If you dare to say another word, I’ll cripple you. Do you think I was joking?”
“What is it? Mr. Chen, do you really dare to touch me?!”
Gai Lingjie immediately flared up. However, the next moment, Jiang Shouheng waved his hand. “Are you guys deaf?! Don’t you understand what Director Chen is saying?!”
In an instant, a few burly men surrounded Gai Lingjie and threw punches and kicks at his vital points.
They did not hold back at all!
The entire space reverberated with Gai Lingjie’s howls.
Gai Tianyuan looked at this scene. “Xiao Heng, you...”
“CEO Gai, I’m sorry. We’re not close.” Jiang Shouheng looked at Gai Tianyuan and pressed his hand on his shoulder to stop him from taking another step forward.
This!

“CEO Gai, let me tell you something on behalf of the Jiang family. From now on, the Jiang family will mind our own business and never interact with you.” Jiang Shouheng looked into Gai Tianyuan’s eyes. “Of course, if you want to take any action, Cauldron Dragon Security will definitely accompany you to the end.”
There was only one thing to say about this!
He had made his stand clear!
He had taken sides!
On behalf of the Jiang family and Cauldron Dragon Security, Jiang Shouheng stood on Chen Yun’s side!
He was incomparably firm!
His words shocked everyone present.

One had to know that the security guards of Cauldron Dragon Security were all professionally trained. If the Cauldron Dragon declared war on anyone, it was equivalent to hundreds or thousands of professional fighters declaring war on them!
Who wouldn’t be afraid?
Who dared not be afraid?
As time passed, Gai Lingjie’s screams gradually weakened. In the end, only the sound of fists and feet hitting flesh could be heard.
The group of burly men retreated, revealing Gai Lingjie, who had been beaten so badly that even his parents could not recognize him.
His limbs were also twisted. Needless to say, there were definitely many fractures. He was only left with half a breath, like a dead dog.

When the people at the side saw Gai Lingjie’s appearance, their bodies began to tremble. The few young men who had been helping Gai Lingjie turned pale. They had long collapsed to the ground, scared out of their wits.
Usually, they were the ones who bullied others. Who would dare to say anything to them?
They didn’t expect to land themselves in trouble for doing so today!
It was as if they had kicked a very hard iron plate!
As a result, they were injured!
Jiang Shouheng looked at Gai Lingjie on the ground and snorted.
The next moment, the sound of a helicopter could be heard. Not long after, a figure rushed in.
It was Jiang Zhengyu!
He was the CEO of Cauldron Dragon Security!
At this moment, Jiang Zhengyu strode in hurriedly. It was obvious that he was holding back his anger.
When everyone saw him, they quickly moved aside.
Everyone knew what he was here for!

Jiang Shouheng roared again, his voice echoing throughout the casino.
“He even said to throw Director Chen into the sea to feed the sharks.”
Jiang Shouheng’s eyes almost popped out of their sockets.
He turned to look at Gai Lingjie with bloodshot eyes.
If he had come a step later and his family’s security guards had touched Chen Yun, then he could forget about collaborating with Sacred Heaven.
The other party would definitely do their best to destroy Cauldron Dragon Security!
Their entire family was going to starve!
With that, he strode forward and simply slapped Gai Lingjie’s face.
Pa!
With a crisp sound, one of Gai Lingjie’s teeth was slapped out.
Meanwhile, when Gai Tianyuan heard the security guard’s words, his vision darkened and he almost fell to the ground.
“Unfilial son!
Hurry up and apologize to Director Chen!”
Gai Tianyuan looked at Gai Lingjie and roared.
Gai Lingjie had been slapped by Jiang Shouheng.
He covered his face and looked at Chen Yun, his eyes filled with hatred.
After today, how could he stand in the upper circle of Jiang City!
He gritted his teeth and looked at Chen Yun with a murderous gaze.
“Director Chen, I really didn’t know your identity today.
Sorry for offending you.”
“However, you’ve also caused trouble for me and hit my woman.
How about we settle this?
From now on, let’s go our separate ways.”
These two sentences were unusually unyielding.
“Heh.”
Chen Yun sneered.
“Settle this?” Chen Yun shook his head.
“I’ve said it before.
If you dare to say another word, I’ll cripple you.
Do you think I was joking?”
“What is it?
Mr.
Chen, do you really dare to touch me?!”
Gai Lingjie immediately flared up.
However, the next moment, Jiang Shouheng waved his hand.
“Are you guys deaf?!
Don’t you understand what Director Chen is saying?!”
In an instant, a few burly men surrounded Gai Lingjie and threw punches and kicks at his vital points.
They did not hold back at all!
The entire space reverberated with Gai Lingjie’s howls.
Gai Tianyuan looked at this scene.
“Xiao Heng, you...”
“CEO Gai, I’m sorry.
We’re not close.” Jiang Shouheng looked at Gai Tianyuan and pressed his hand on his shoulder to stop him from taking another step forward.
This!
“CEO Gai, let me tell you something on behalf of the Jiang family.
From now on, the Jiang family will mind our own business and never interact with you.” Jiang Shouheng looked into Gai Tianyuan’s eyes.
“Of course, if you want to take any action, Cauldron Dragon Security will definitely accompany you to the end.”
There was only one thing to say about this!
He had made his stand clear!
He had taken sides!
On behalf of the Jiang family and Cauldron Dragon Security, Jiang Shouheng stood on Chen Yun’s side!
He was incomparably firm!
His words shocked everyone present.
One had to know that the security guards of Cauldron Dragon Security were all professionally trained.
If the Cauldron Dragon declared war on anyone, it was equivalent to hundreds or thousands of professional fighters declaring war on them!
Who wouldn’t be afraid?
Who dared not be afraid?
As time passed, Gai Lingjie’s screams gradually weakened.
In the end, only the sound of fists and feet hitting flesh could be heard.
The group of burly men retreated, revealing Gai Lingjie, who had been beaten so badly that even his parents could not recognize him.
His limbs were also twisted.
Needless to say, there were definitely many fractures.
He was only left with half a breath, like a dead dog.
When the people at the side saw Gai Lingjie’s appearance, their bodies began to tremble.
The few young men who had been helping Gai Lingjie turned pale.
They had long collapsed to the ground, scared out of their wits.
Usually, they were the ones who bullied others.
Who would dare to say anything to them?
They didn’t expect to land themselves in trouble for doing so today!
It was as if they had kicked a very hard iron plate!
As a result, they were injured!
Jiang Shouheng looked at Gai Lingjie on the ground and snorted.
The next moment, the sound of a helicopter could be heard.
Not long after, a figure rushed in.
It was Jiang Zhengyu!
He was the CEO of Cauldron Dragon Security!
At this moment, Jiang Zhengyu strode in hurriedly.
It was obvious that he was holding back his anger.
When everyone saw him, they quickly moved aside.
Everyone knew what he was here for!

chapters.title: Chapter 36
paragraphs: If I Make Cookies Again, I’m a Fool
“Director Chen, I’m late.”
Jiang Zhengyu walked up to Chen Yun. His face was red and green. Then, he looked at Jiang Shouheng with anger in his eyes.
He had asked Jiang Shouheng to protect Chen Yun well, but such a thing happened.
“It’s fine, CEO Jiang. It has nothing to do with him.” Chen Yun’s words made Jiang Zhengyu heave a sigh of relief. Jiang Shouheng was the same. He took a deep breath.
Then, Chen Yun looked up and swept his gaze across the crowd. His eyes were like two sharp arrows that pierced into everyone’s hearts.

Whether it was Qu Xinyu who wanted to slap Wang Menghan, the group of young men who were with Gai Lingjie, or the young masters and young ladies who were helping them, they all lowered their heads, their faces pale.
In particular, Qu Xinyu, an A-list celebrity was now lying on the ground, crying so hard that her makeup was smudged.
“Let’s go.” Chen Yun held Wang Menghan’s hand and walked out.
Jiang Shouheng and Jiang Zhengyu followed behind them.
A group of bodyguards in black led the way, and the surrounding people quickly retreated.
After Chen Yun and the others left, the entire casino was in an uproar. The atmosphere just now was too oppressive, so oppressive that everyone could not breathe.
Now that Chen Yun had left, everyone felt their bodies lighten.
“Oh my god, what kind of aura is this?”
“He has 80% of Sacred Heaven’s shares! It’s too terrifying. Moreover, they have the protection of Cauldron Dragon Security. We can’t afford to offend them!”
“This time, the Gai family is in trouble. I wonder who else will dare to cooperate with them. They’re blind and don’t know their place.”
As that person spoke, he sighed in his heart. Even they did not recognize this great Buddha, let alone Gai Lingjie.
Everyone watched as Gai Tianyuan got someone to quickly carry Gai Lingjie down. They sighed and shook their heads.
“Do you think Young Master Gai will still be so arrogant in the future?”

“Arrogant? How can he be arrogant? After being beaten up like that, it’s already not bad if he can get out of bed and walk in a year. Moreover, the Gai family will decline from now on. Just wait. Gai Lingjie will be removed from the upper circle of Jiang City.”
Meanwhile, Chen Yun and the others walked out and boarded Jiang Zhengyu’s helicopter.
Jiang Shouheng was about to apologize to Chen Yun when Chen Yun patted his arm.
“It’s a small matter. Don’t take it to heart.”
From the beginning to the end, Chen Yun did not even look at Gai Lingjie. A playboy from a rich family was simply a joke in front of him.
Gai Lingjie was like a clown.
Chen Yun quickly calmed down and looked out of the window. “Menghan, look outside. The scenery is not bad.”
“I originally planned for us to come out and play, but I didn’t expect such a thing to happen.”
Wang Menghan also shook her head. As for why Gai Lingjie came looking for her and why he made things difficult for Chen Yun, she knew it all too well.
It was all because of her.
The helicopter stopped directly at the helipad behind the Cauldron Dragon Security Building. Everyone got off the helicopter.
Jiang Zhengyu looked at Chen Yun. “Director Chen, shall we have a chat upstairs?”
Chen Yun looked at his watch. “It’s almost dinner time. Let’s go to East Sea City for dinner. How about that? Call Ma Ke.”
“Alright, that’s naturally good. However, Director Chen, I’ll be the host for this meal. You’re not allowed to snatch it from me.”
Chen Yun smiled. He was fine with anything.

Seeing Chen Yun’s attitude, Jiang Zhengyu was relieved. He immediately glanced at Jiang Shouheng and snorted. When he got into the car, he looked at the taillights of the McLaren sports car in front and said to Jiang Shouheng coldly, “Kid, I’ll deal with you when we get back.”

“Dad, what happened today really has nothing to do with me. Ask Leilei. Director Chen asked us to play by ourselves as he wanted to accompany his female companion. How could I stay there as a third wheel?”
“How the f*ck would I know that scoundrel Gai Lingjie actually provoked Director Chen? My hand was swollen from that slap.”

Jiang Zhengyu looked at Jiang Shouheng’s swollen hand. “However, it’s all thanks to your quick-wittedness this time. This time, our relationship with Sacred Heavens will be even better. Have you heard that Director Chen has just taken over Sacred Heavens and is about to start a big project?”
“What big project?” Jiang Shouheng came over.
“It’s a survival show, Survival on the Uninhabited Island. Director Chen personally invested one billion yuan. I also heard from CEO Ma that Director Chen set the first prize at 100 million yuan.”
What?
“F*ck! Dad, you’re not lying to me, right? Did he invest a billion yuan in a variety show?!”
“The first prize was set at 100 million yuan?!”
“How rich must he be?!”
“He’s burning money!”
Jiang Shouheng’s eyes widened. This was so much money!
How rich was Director Chen?!
It was too terrifying!
At that moment, he also understood how right his decision was!
“This time, Sacred Heaven wants to use many of our people. It’s a big deal. This time, you will personally bring people there. There must be no mistakes,” said Jiang Zhengyu.
“Don’t worry, old man. I’ll definitely do it beautifully. However, I’m so awesome this time. Aren’t you going to give me a reward or something?”
Jiang Zhengyu looked at his son. “Okay, okay, okay. After I’m done with my work, I’ll bring Leilei’s parents over. The two families can have a good talk, okay?”
“Alright!”
For a moment, Jiang Shouheng and Zhang Lei smiled.
When they arrived at East Sea City, the CEO of East Sea City was already waiting at the door.
At night, the hosts and guests had a good time. Ma Ke also showed Chen Yun the revised proposal.
It could be said that there were almost no problems. It was perfect.
Even Chen Yun began to look forward to this check-in mission.
After all, it was a supreme-grade spinner wheel!
When they got home that night, the moment they opened the door, they heard the fire alarm in the kitchen ring. Chen Yun ran to the kitchen and saw two wet girls looking at him with fear.
“Brother, you’re back!” Chen Mengmeng’s eyes widened as she looked at Chen Yun. “Why are you back so early?”
“If I hadn’t come back, wouldn’t the two of you have set the house on fire? What’s going on?”
“I was baking cookies and experimenting. I was going to make them for you, but...” Chen Mengmeng stuck out her tongue.
“Stop fooling around. The two of you should hurry up and take a shower. Don’t catch a cold.”
Chen Yun knocked on their heads before the two of them went to take a shower.
After taking a shower, Chen Mengmeng pulled Chen Yun to the dining table. Han Xue then brought out a plate of biscuits.
“Brother, this is the most successful batch we’ve made. At the very least, the cookies have taken shape. Try it while it’s hot,” said Chen Mengmeng.
However, Chen Yun didn’t dare to compliment the appearance of those black cookies.
Chen Mengmeng’s words alone were scary enough!
This was the most successful batch of cookies, yet they had only taken shape! What about the first few tries? Had the cookies been directly roasted into slag?!
He picked up a piece and placed it in his mouth. After chewing for a while, he swallowed it.
Then, he gave her a thumbs up. “Not bad, not bad. Your chocolate biscuits are simply superb.”
“I made cream cookies. They’re just burnt.”
Chen Yun was silent. He was also in despair and didn’t dare to think about it in detail.
He was afraid of being poisoned.
“Hahaha...” Wang Menghan simply laughed out loud, attracting Chen Mengmeng’s attention.
“Sister Menghan, come and try it too.”
“Hey, Sister Menghan, don’t run!”
“Are you an athlete? Why are you running so fast?”

“Xiao Xue? Brother? Why did you all run away? Come back!” Chen Mengmeng crossed her arms in anger. “All of you... don’t know how to enjoy food. If you don’t want to eat them, I’ll eat them! I already offered all of them to you! Don’t regret it!”
After taking a bite, Chen Mengmeng’s expression changed again and again, becoming paler and paler. “Pfft, if I make cookies again, I’m a fool.”

chapters.title: Chapter 37
paragraphs: Burning the Bridge After Crossing the River!
Early the next morning, Chen Mengmeng got up and went to Chen Yun’s door, ready to wake him up with her loving little fists.
After all, she had done the same thing to him back at home.
She pressed her finger against the doorknob.
“I’m sorry, but you don’t have the highest authority.”
Chen Mengmeng was speechless.
Inside, Chen Yun had already woken up.
[Host, please check in on time.]
There was finally a check-in mission.
He pressed the check-in button.
[Check-in successful.]
[Reward: 100,000,000 yuan.]
[A Beautifying Pill has been given to you.]
Then, the Random Double eight-sided dice appeared. In the end, it steadily landed on the number eight.
[Reward: 800,000,000 yuan.]
[Eight Beautifying Pills have been given to you.]
An amount of 800 million could only cause a small ripple in Chen Yun’s heart.
Then, Chen Yun looked at a small bottle in front of him. After opening it, golden pills rolled out.
“Is this the Beautifying Pill? What does it do?”
[This pill is not as good as the host’s immortal-like appearance, but it can increase the user’s appearance by five points.]
Oh, this thing was not bad either. After all, none of the cosmetics on the market had such an effect. If such a thing was auctioned off, wouldn’t those upper-class ladies fight for it?
Chen Yun took out a pill and walked outside. When he opened the door, he saw Chen Mengmeng standing outside.
“What’s wrong? Why are you looking for me so early?”
“I was going to wake you up, but I couldn’t get in,” said Chen Mengmeng angrily. Then, Chen Yun stuffed something into her mouth.
Oh...
“What’s this? It’s sweet and delicious.”
“It’s even better than those western dishes. Brother, where did you buy these snacks?”
Chen Yun did not say a word, instantly making Chen Mengmeng pout like a hamster.
“You’re already 18 years old, yet you’re still acting like a child.” Chen Yun rubbed Chen Mengmeng’s face. “After you’re done with your art exams, go get a driver’s license.”
“Okay.”
The two of them went downstairs. They found that Han Xue and Wang Menghan had already prepared breakfast and were pouring milk.
“You guys are up early.”
“Yes.” Wang Menghan looked at Chen Yun. “Mengmeng and Xiao Xue, come with me today. I’m going to Jiang City University of the Arts to meet a few juniors. They’re all famous people in school.”
“Really? We’re not students. Can we enter Jiang City University of the Arts?”

“Nowadays, universities are open. Even outsiders can enter,” said Chen Yun. “Hurry up and eat. I have something to do today. Don’t cause trouble for your Sister Menghan today. Don’t run around, don’t...”
“Alright, alright!”
Chen Mengmeng looked impatient. “Brother, you really inherited our mother’s mouth. You can’t do anything else except nag me.”
Hey!
Chen Yun glanced at Chen Mengmeng and finally sighed. “Call me if you get lost. You look like you have no sense of direction. It’s as if you’ll wander off and get lost.”
“I have Xiao Xue, so I won’t lose my way.” Chen Mengmeng hugged Han Xue’s arm, making Han Xue look helpless.

After packing up, Chen Yun looked at his watch and decided to make a trip to Motor City. After all, he and Zhou Jingyi had decided on those good cars the day before yesterday. The procedures should be almost done, so he could go and retrieve them.
Chen Yun drove the McLaren toward Motor City.
At this moment, many people were watching a scene in the payment hall of Motor City.
Standing in the middle were Zhou Jingyi and a man.
Zhou Jingyi looked at the man in front of her. “Why did you give me 20,000 yuan for the commission? Are you trying to get rid of a beggar?!”

“With my results this month, I’ve sold more than ten luxury cars. The total value is close to 50 million. According to the commission you promised previously, I should be able to get at least hundreds of thousands! What do you mean by giving me 20,000 yuan now?!”

“Jingyi, what are you doing? Aren’t you ruining the image of Motor City?” The middle-aged man looked at the increasing crowd and felt a little embarrassed. “The commission was decided by the directors of Motor City together. Moreover, your reward is not just 20,000 yuan.”

“The directors said that due to your outstanding performance, your base salary will be increased by 2,000 yuan every month from next month. You will also become a management trainee and have a chance to be promoted to an executive in Motor City. How about that?”
Haha!
Zhou Jingyi looked at the manager in front of her. “A base salary increase of 2,000 yuan every month? How dare you!”
A management trainee? A chance to be promoted to an executive in Motor City? These were all empty words. How could she have such a good opportunity?
Moreover, the most detestable thing was that they only said this after she had completed all the procedures and handed over the money Chen Yun had transferred to her.

Initially, she thought that this was a place for her to showcase her abilities. She did not expect that the executives and directors here were a group of blood-sucking bugs that crazily sucked the blood of low-level employees like her!
They burned the bridges after crossing them!
They kicked others to the curb when they’ve outlived their usefulness!
“I’ll ask you again. Are you going to give me the commission I deserve?” Zhou Jingyi asked coldly.

The middle-aged man looked at Zhou Jingyi’s angry face. Then, he looked at the people who kept surrounding him. “Manager Zhou, the directors have already made it very clear. You can take the 20,000 yuan bonus if you want it. If you don’t want it, you won’t even get a single cent!”
“What do you think this place is? How dare you!”
This made Zhou Jingyi’s face turn green with anger!
Her eyes turned red. She knew that there was nothing she could do about the other party getting rid of her once she had done her job!
Motor City would keep the contracts of their employees and only issue them three years later.
It was obvious that they were bullying the newcomers, so Zhou Jingyi could not do anything about Motor City.
She took off the name tag on her chest and threw it to the ground. “I’m not serving you anymore!”
With that, she walked towards the McLaren shop. She was prepared to change her clothes and leave!

In the McLaren shop, many of the lower-level employees felt indignant when they heard about Zhou Jingyi’s matter. Meanwhile, those who were competing with Zhou Jingyi looked like they were watching a joke.

After all, now that Zhou Jingyi had left, they had a higher chance of climbing up the ranks. After all, Zhou Jingyi’s rise was too fierce. Even old people like them were a little afraid that they would not be able to win against this little girl.
“Hehe, she’s still young but has such a bad temper. Does she think she’s so great just because she sold a few cars?”
“That’s right. She even dared to embarrass the board of directors now.”
“Such a person dares to go against the board of directors now. If she becomes an executive in the future, won’t she overturn the entire Motor City?”

They had been jealous for the past few days. In just half a month, Zhou Jingyi had already sold ten luxury cars. If not for the board of directors, the commission Zhou Jingyi received would have been enough to make them jealous!
They watched as Zhou Jingyi walked out with her bag.
“Manager Zhou, take care. I won’t send you off.”
“Why are you still calling her manager? The board of directors didn’t fire her. She fired the board of directors. Who has such ability?”
The words fell into Zhou Jingyi’s ears, making her eyes turn red. She clenched her fists, but there was nothing she could do.
She had no one to rely on in Jiang City.
The managers were chatting happily when they saw a black McLaren sports car approaching them.
“Oh my god! It’s a 720S! It’s worth more than three million yuan. Don’t snatch it away from me. I’ll go and receive it.” A woman quickly stood up and walked forward with her signature smile.
“I saw it first. I’ll do it!”
For a moment, many people walked towards the door.
Who would be willing to let go of such an important guest?

sentences.text: Burning the Bridge After Crossing the River!
Early the next morning, Chen Mengmeng got up and went to Chen Yun’s door, ready to wake him up with her loving little fists.
After all, she had done the same thing to him back at home.
She pressed her finger against the doorknob.
“I’m sorry, but you don’t have the highest authority.”
Chen Mengmeng was speechless.
Inside, Chen Yun had already woken up.
[Host, please check in on time.]
There was finally a check-in mission.
He pressed the check-in button.
[Check-in successful.]
[Reward: 100,000,000 yuan.]
[A Beautifying Pill has been given to you.]
Then, the Random Double eight-sided dice appeared.
In the end, it steadily landed on the number eight.
[Reward: 800,000,000 yuan.]
[Eight Beautifying Pills have been given to you.]
An amount of 800 million could only cause a small ripple in Chen Yun’s heart.
Then, Chen Yun looked at a small bottle in front of him.
After opening it, golden pills rolled out.
“Is this the Beautifying Pill?
What does it do?”
[This pill is not as good as the host’s immortal-like appearance, but it can increase the user’s appearance by five points.]
Oh, this thing was not bad either.
After all, none of the cosmetics on the market had such an effect.
If such a thing was auctioned off, wouldn’t those upper-class ladies fight for it?
Chen Yun took out a pill and walked outside.
When he opened the door, he saw Chen Mengmeng standing outside.
“What’s wrong?
Why are you looking for me so early?”
“I was going to wake you up, but I couldn’t get in,” said Chen Mengmeng angrily.
Then, Chen Yun stuffed something into her mouth.
Oh...
“What’s this?
It’s sweet and delicious.”
“It’s even better than those western dishes.
Brother, where did you buy these snacks?”
Chen Yun did not say a word, instantly making Chen Mengmeng pout like a hamster.
“You’re already 18 years old, yet you’re still acting like a child.” Chen Yun rubbed Chen Mengmeng’s face.
“After you’re done with your art exams, go get a driver’s license.”
“Okay.”
The two of them went downstairs.
They found that Han Xue and Wang Menghan had already prepared breakfast and were pouring milk.
“You guys are up early.”
“Yes.” Wang Menghan looked at Chen Yun.
“Mengmeng and Xiao Xue, come with me today.
I’m going to Jiang City University of the Arts to meet a few juniors.
They’re all famous people in school.”
“Really?
We’re not students.
Can we enter Jiang City University of the Arts?”
“Nowadays, universities are open.
Even outsiders can enter,” said Chen Yun.
“Hurry up and eat.
I have something to do today.
Don’t cause trouble for your Sister Menghan today.
Don’t run around, don’t...”
“Alright, alright!”
Chen Mengmeng looked impatient.
“Brother, you really inherited our mother’s mouth.
You can’t do anything else except nag me.”
Hey!
Chen Yun glanced at Chen Mengmeng and finally sighed.
“Call me if you get lost.
You look like you have no sense of direction.
It’s as if you’ll wander off and get lost.”
“I have Xiao Xue, so I won’t lose my way.” Chen Mengmeng hugged Han Xue’s arm, making Han Xue look helpless.
After packing up, Chen Yun looked at his watch and decided to make a trip to Motor City.
After all, he and Zhou Jingyi had decided on those good cars the day before yesterday.
The procedures should be almost done, so he could go and retrieve them.
Chen Yun drove the McLaren toward Motor City.
At this moment, many people were watching a scene in the payment hall of Motor City.
Standing in the middle were Zhou Jingyi and a man.
Zhou Jingyi looked at the man in front of her.
“Why did you give me 20,000 yuan for the commission?
Are you trying to get rid of a beggar?!”
“With my results this month, I’ve sold more than ten luxury cars.
The total value is close to 50 million.
According to the commission you promised previously, I should be able to get at least hundreds of thousands!
What do you mean by giving me 20,000 yuan now?!”
“Jingyi, what are you doing?
Aren’t you ruining the image of Motor City?” The middle-aged man looked at the increasing crowd and felt a little embarrassed.
“The commission was decided by the directors of Motor City together.
Moreover, your reward is not just 20,000 yuan.”
“The directors said that due to your outstanding performance, your base salary will be increased by 2,000 yuan every month from next month.
You will also become a management trainee and have a chance to be promoted to an executive in Motor City.
How about that?”
Haha!
Zhou Jingyi looked at the manager in front of her.
“A base salary increase of 2,000 yuan every month?
How dare you!”
A management trainee?
A chance to be promoted to an executive in Motor City?
These were all empty words.
How could she have such a good opportunity?
Moreover, the most detestable thing was that they only said this after she had completed all the procedures and handed over the money Chen Yun had transferred to her.
Initially, she thought that this was a place for her to showcase her abilities.
She did not expect that the executives and directors here were a group of blood-sucking bugs that crazily sucked the blood of low-level employees like her!
They burned the bridges after crossing them!
They kicked others to the curb when they’ve outlived their usefulness!
“I’ll ask you again.
Are you going to give me the commission I deserve?” Zhou Jingyi asked coldly.
The middle-aged man looked at Zhou Jingyi’s angry face.
Then, he looked at the people who kept surrounding him.
“Manager Zhou, the directors have already made it very clear.
You can take the 20,000 yuan bonus if you want it.
If you don’t want it, you won’t even get a single cent!”
“What do you think this place is?
How dare you!”
This made Zhou Jingyi’s face turn green with anger!
Her eyes turned red.
She knew that there was nothing she could do about the other party getting rid of her once she had done her job!
Motor City would keep the contracts of their employees and only issue them three years later.
It was obvious that they were bullying the newcomers, so Zhou Jingyi could not do anything about Motor City.
She took off the name tag on her chest and threw it to the ground.
“I’m not serving you anymore!”
With that, she walked towards the McLaren shop.
She was prepared to change her clothes and leave!
In the McLaren shop, many of the lower-level employees felt indignant when they heard about Zhou Jingyi’s matter.
Meanwhile, those who were competing with Zhou Jingyi looked like they were watching a joke.
After all, now that Zhou Jingyi had left, they had a higher chance of climbing up the ranks.
After all, Zhou Jingyi’s rise was too fierce.
Even old people like them were a little afraid that they would not be able to win against this little girl.
“Hehe, she’s still young but has such a bad temper.
Does she think she’s so great just because she sold a few cars?”
“That’s right.
She even dared to embarrass the board of directors now.”
“Such a person dares to go against the board of directors now.
If she becomes an executive in the future, won’t she overturn the entire Motor City?”
They had been jealous for the past few days.
In just half a month, Zhou Jingyi had already sold ten luxury cars.
If not for the board of directors, the commission Zhou Jingyi received would have been enough to make them jealous!
They watched as Zhou Jingyi walked out with her bag.
“Manager Zhou, take care.
I won’t send you off.”
“Why are you still calling her manager?
The board of directors didn’t fire her.
She fired the board of directors.
Who has such ability?”
The words fell into Zhou Jingyi’s ears, making her eyes turn red.
She clenched her fists, but there was nothing she could do.
She had no one to rely on in Jiang City.
The managers were chatting happily when they saw a black McLaren sports car approaching them.
“Oh my god!
It’s a 720S!
It’s worth more than three million yuan.
Don’t snatch it away from me.
I’ll go and receive it.” A woman quickly stood up and walked forward with her signature smile.
“I saw it first.
I’ll do it!”
For a moment, many people walked towards the door.
Who would be willing to let go of such an important guest?

chapters.title: Chapter 38
paragraphs: Can You Give Me an Explanation Now?
Everyone moved out at the same time. Those who didn’t know better would think that a director of Motor City had arrived.
Ordinary people would not be able to enjoy such a scene.
Chen Yun looked at Zhou Jingyi, stopped the car, and rolled down the window.
“Jingyi, isn’t it your working hours? Why did you change into your usual clothes? Where are you going?”
Chen Yun’s words made Zhou Jingyi, who was holding back her tears, suddenly cry. No matter how she covered her mouth, she could not stop her crying and sobbing.
When Chen Yun saw Zhou Jingyi’s actions, his eyes turned cold.
He got out of the car and slammed the door.
This muffled sound stunned the people who were preparing to welcome Chen Yun.
“Is he Manager Zhou’s friend?” A salesperson looked at the girl beside him.
“That’s right. This handsome man bought this McLaren 720S from Manager Zhou. I heard that he was also the one who placed those orders with Manager Zhou.”
What?
These words shocked everyone.
In particular, those sales managers were shocked. After all, they knew how big a deal Zhou Jingyi had taken on recently!
She had closed a deal for almost ten luxury cars!
The total value was close to 50 million!
Initially, they thought that some company had ordered these cars. They did not expect it to be such a rich young master!
At that moment, they looked at Chen Yun’s angry expression when he got out of the car. They were simply shocked and their legs could not help but tremble.
Some of the salespeople thought about how they had mocked Zhou Jingyi just now and cold sweat broke out on their foreheads.
They didn’t know that Zhou Jingyi actually knew such a person!
What kind of person was this?
With a wave of his hand, he bought ten luxury cars and threw out 50 million yuan!
How could they afford to offend him?
At this moment, Chen Yun held Zhou Jingyi’s shoulders. “What’s wrong? Did someone bully you?”
“No, no.” Zhou Jingyi looked at Chen Yun and lowered her head, trying her best not to let Chen Yun see her current expression.
“Where’s your work pass? Have you been fired?”
Zhou Jingyi suddenly clutched her chest. She could no longer hold it in. She looked at Chen Yun, bit her lips, and spoke simply.
As time passed, Chen Yun’s expression became more and more livid.
“These people are so good at playing now.”
“How dare they bully my friend?”
“Get in the car and come with me.”
Zhou Jingyi held Chen Yun’s hand. “Where are we going?”
“We’re going to where you were bullied.” Chen Yun pulled her into the car and drove to Motor City.
As the sound wave faded away, the stunned crowd gradually heaved a sigh of relief. “That’s too terrifying. I didn’t expect Zhou Jingyi to have hooked up with such a person.”
Although the others did not say anything, they had the same thoughts.
At this moment, in the central hall of Motor City.
Three middle-aged men in suits were sitting on the sofa at the side, drinking coffee and eating snacks. There were two salesmen accompanying them.
“CEO Nie, are the snacks to your liking?” A salesperson looked at the man in the lead and asked softly.
The middle-aged man did not even look at the girl who spoke. He looked at Sun Wen, who had just quarreled with Zhou Jingyi. “Xiao Sun, what does Zhou Jingyi mean?”
“She cursed and left. Look, she threw away her name tag.”
Sun Wen took out a name tag from his pocket. It was Zhou Jingyi’s.
“Heh!”
Nie Haiyun sneered.
Sun Wen also shook his head. “She was making a ruckus in the exhibition hall just now and many customers heard it. She embarrassed Motor City.”
“Why? Is she dissatisfied with the 20,000 yuan we offered?” Nie Haiyun took a sip of coffee. “But what can she do, Xiao Sun?”
“CEO Nie, please speak.”
“Let’s talk to a few managers of the sales departments in Jiang City. I don’t think such a girl is suitable for the sales industry anymore.”
“Moreover, she signed an employment contract with us, right? Since she left without permission before the contract expired, can we ask for the penalty fee?”
These two sentences made the two salespeople beside them tremble. They had seen the scene of Zhou Jingyi arguing here just now and were already dissatisfied with the upper echelons of Motor City.
Now...
They were already feeling indignant for Zhou Jingyi, but there was nothing they could do. They were just the lowest-ranking salesmen among all the employees in Motor City.
Everything depended on the discretion of the higher-ups.
When Sun Wen heard Nie Haiyun’s words, he also had a smile on his face. “Of course, CEO Nie. I don’t need your personal guidance to deal with such a person. I know what to do.”
“Don’t worry. As long as Zhou Jingyi still wants to work in the sales industry, she has to get out of Jiang City!”
Just as they were laughing smugly, Chen Yun had already stepped into the hall.
“Where are the executives here? Come out!”
Chen Yun’s voice immediately reverberated throughout the entire hall, attracting the attention of many people. Naturally, it also attracted the attention of Nie Haiyun and the others.
“CEO Nie, look. It’s true that unruly people come from poor and adverse environments. Before we could find Zhou Jingyi, she brought her people back.” Sun Wen stood up with a cold expression.
He really didn’t expect that Zhou Jingyi would dare to bring people to the center of Motor City and cause trouble!
How bold!
A few people immediately strolled over.
The customers who were looking at cars were also attracted by Chen Yun. They looked over, wanting to see what was going on.
“Sir, please don’t be like this.” A sales lady looked at Chen Yun and said to her.
“Call your manager out. I want to see the executives of Motor City. I want to see if there’s no law now!”
As soon as he said this, a voice sounded from the side.
“Young man, don’t be so angry. Do you know what this place is?” Sun Wen came to the two of them. “Why? Are you here to seek justice for your girlfriend?”

When Sun Wen saw the two of them holding hands, he naturally misunderstood. However, the smile on his face became even colder. They came to their place to cause trouble just like that. Did they think that they were in a market and could come as they pleased?
He looked at Chen Yun and really did not take him seriously. After all, Zhou Jingyi was just a low-level salesperson, not some rich young lady. What kind of boyfriend could she have?
Chen Yun’s cold eyes shot towards the few people in front of him. “You guys are right. I’m here today to seek an explanation.”
“If you don’t give me an explanation today, I don’t want those cars anymore. Refund me 50 million.”
Hm?
The few of them frowned.
“What 50 million?” Sun Wen was stunned. “Are you the person who bought ten luxury cars?”
He reacted in an instant. For a moment, even he was at a loss!
He was wondering why Zhou Jingyi, a small salesperson, could have such a big order. It turned out that she had someone behind her!
This was her boyfriend helping her with her performance!
The people at the side looked at Chen Yun and were also shocked!
He was so young!
Yet, he could buy ten luxury cars worth 50 million?!
“That’s me! Can you give me an explanation now?!”

chapters.title: Chapter 39
paragraphs: I Only Joke With My Friends!
“That’s me! Can you give me an explanation now?!”
Chen Yun’s eyes were cold as he looked at Sun Wen in front of him. As a result, Sun Wen was speechless for a long time and could only look at Nie Haiyun.
“Little brother, don’t be agitated. Manager Zhou resigned on her own accord. It has nothing to do with us.” Nie Haiyun sneered.
Chen Yun nodded. “The commission of hundreds of thousands turned into 20,000 yuan. Are you trying to dismiss a beggar? Huh?”
His interrogation was much more forceful than Zhou Jingyi’s.
After all, Chen Yun’s identity was that of a rich man who could fork out 50 million yuan to buy luxury cars!
At this moment, more and more people gathered.
Nie Haiyun adjusted his glasses. “In that case, what do you want to do?”
“I’ll make it clear to you today. First, I’ll return the cars. Return my money to me.”
“Second, give her double the commission.”
Haha.

Nie Haiyun chuckled. “Sir, it’s true that you bought our cars, but you don’t seem to understand the situation. You’ve already paid and completed the procedures. It’s impossible for you to return the cars.”
“Also, the amount of commission we give is our company’s internal business. I’m afraid you don’t have the right to ask.”
“Was I clear enough for you to understand?”
As he spoke, his face was filled with ridicule, as if Chen Yun was already in his hands.
“Good! Very good! I’ve given you a chance. Don’t regret it.”
“Young man, let me remind you that this is a lawful society. If you want to cause trouble, my security guards are not to be trifled with.” Nie Haiyun looked at Chen Yun.
However, Chen Yun turned around and took out his phone. “Destroy Jiang City’s Motor City as soon as possible.”
What?!
Destroy Motor City?!
For a moment, everyone was shocked. Who did this young man think he was?
He must be crazy!
“Did you hear what he said?”
“Oh my god, are all young people so arrogant these days? Destroy Motor City as soon as possible? Interesting.”
“Tsk tsk, I’m going to take a good look.”
Many customers were talking at the side and looking at Chen Yun. However, their gazes were mocking and full of ridicule!
Even Nie Haiyun chuckled and looked at Chen Yun as if Chen Yun was saying nonsense.
“Young man, don’t make claims that are too big. Otherwise, it won’t be easy to clean up.”
“It won’t end well. Just wait.” Chen Yun stood there, ready to fight with Nie Haiyun.
In the next moment, there was a sound wave. Then, a few figures walked in.
“Dad, why are you here?”
“Huh? Uncle Nie, what are you guys doing?”
The young men looked at the scene in front of them in confusion.
Then, they looked at Chen Yun and their eyes widened!
This person!
“Oh my God!”
“Director Chen, I didn’t expect you to come to my family’s business. You’re really an honor to our humble dwelling.”
“Hello, Director Chen.”

“Director Chen, don’t just stand there. Please sit down.” A young man quickly moved the sofa over. Then, he pointed at the salespeople. “What are you all waiting for? Hurry up and serve Director Chen some drinks. You don’t even know how to look.”
Everyone was stunned when they saw this scene.
These young people were all wearing luxury goods. Any one of them cost tens of thousands. Furthermore, they had just driven sports cars here.
They were all young masters from the upper circle of Jiang City!
“What are you guys doing?” Nie Haiyun frowned when he saw his son lowering his head and bending his back.
“Dad, why aren’t you serving Director Chen well? Why are you scolding us?”
“Director Chen? Which Director Chen?”
Hm?
The young men were momentarily stunned.
“Uncle Nie, don’t you know? This is Director Chen of Sacred Heaven Entertainment. He holds 80% of their shares.”
“You didn’t see it yesterday. Director Chen crippled Gai Lingjie. Gai Tianyuan from Nanshan Industry didn’t even dare to do anything.”
The people beside them were stunned when they heard the young people talking. Good lord!
He was the director of Sacred Heaven Entertainment!
He controlled 80% of their shares!
After crippling Gai Lingjie, Gai Tianyuan did not even dare to do anything!
Who was Gai Tianyuan? He was the CEO of Nanshan Industry and had a net worth of one billion yuan!
What kind of person was this?
For a moment, even Nie Haiyun’s face quickly turned pale. Was this the Director Chen that his son had told him about last night?
This!
This!
Nie Haiyun trembled and smiled awkwardly. “Oh, it’s Director Chen. I really didn’t expect you to order our cars.”
“I failed to recognize a familiar person. I didn’t know that Manager Zhou was on your side either.”
“I’ll promote Manager Zhou to an executive in Motor City now. The commission will be double, no, three times the original amount. What do you think?”
However, Chen Yun’s cold face answered him.
“It’s not like I didn’t give you a chance before. You didn’t take it, so don’t blame me.”

Nie Haiyun was stunned and anger rose in his heart. He had already given in, but Chen Yun still refused to give up. He really didn’t believe that Chen Yun could cripple him on the spot, or that he could really destroy the huge Motor City!
“CEO Nie, bad news, bad news!”
Just as Nie Haiyun was feeling indignant, the manager of the Public Relations Department rushed down from above. “CEO Nie, bad news!”
“What’s wrong? What happened? Why are you like this?”
Nie Haiyun chided the manager.
However, the manager of the Public Relations Department gulped.
“All the dirt that we spent money to suppress has been exposed!”
“Moreover, everything has already been fully exposed. It’s so fast that we can’t even do emergency PR!”
“Now, all the users in Jiang City should have received relevant browser notifications on their phones.”
Nie Haiyun quickly took out his phone. As expected, there were a few browser notifications on it. They were the ones that exposed Motor City.
When a new Mercedes-Benz was sold, oil started to leak out!
There was no way for the car owners to defend their rights!
The car dealership store deliberately raised the price of their parts!
Defective parts were used during repairs!
Motor City had previously hired fake reviewers to push down these notifications.
For a moment, Nie Haiyun’s heart turned cold. He looked at Chen Yun and almost couldn’t breathe.
Chen Yun looked at Nie Haiyun and sneered. “CEO Nie, don’t tell me you thought that I was joking?”
“I only joke with my friends.”

It has nothing to do with us.” Nie Haiyun sneered.
Chen Yun nodded.
“The commission of hundreds of thousands turned into 20,000 yuan.
Are you trying to dismiss a beggar?
Huh?”
His interrogation was much more forceful than Zhou Jingyi’s.
After all, Chen Yun’s identity was that of a rich man who could fork out 50 million yuan to buy luxury cars!
At this moment, more and more people gathered.
Nie Haiyun adjusted his glasses.
“In that case, what do you want to do?”
“I’ll make it clear to you today.
First, I’ll return the cars.
Return my money to me.”
“Second, give her double the commission.”
Haha.
Nie Haiyun chuckled.
“Sir, it’s true that you bought our cars, but you don’t seem to understand the situation.
You’ve already paid and completed the procedures.
It’s impossible for you to return the cars.”
“Also, the amount of commission we give is our company’s internal business.
I’m afraid you don’t have the right to ask.”
“Was I clear enough for you to understand?”
As he spoke, his face was filled with ridicule, as if Chen Yun was already in his hands.
“Good!
Very good!
I’ve given you a chance.
Don’t regret it.”
“Young man, let me remind you that this is a lawful society.
If you want to cause trouble, my security guards are not to be trifled with.” Nie Haiyun looked at Chen Yun.
However, Chen Yun turned around and took out his phone.
“Destroy Jiang City’s Motor City as soon as possible.”
What?!
Destroy Motor City?!
For a moment, everyone was shocked.
Who did this young man think he was?
He must be crazy!
“Did you hear what he said?”
“Oh my god, are all young people so arrogant these days?
Destroy Motor City as soon as possible?
Interesting.”
“Tsk tsk, I’m going to take a good look.”
Many customers were talking at the side and looking at Chen Yun.
However, their gazes were mocking and full of ridicule!
Even Nie Haiyun chuckled and looked at Chen Yun as if Chen Yun was saying nonsense.
“Young man, don’t make claims that are too big.
Otherwise, it won’t be easy to clean up.”
“It won’t end well.
Just wait.” Chen Yun stood there, ready to fight with Nie Haiyun.
In the next moment, there was a sound wave.
Then, a few figures walked in.
“Dad, why are you here?”
“Huh?
Uncle Nie, what are you guys doing?”
The young men looked at the scene in front of them in confusion.
Then, they looked at Chen Yun and their eyes widened!
This person!
“Oh my God!”
“Director Chen, I didn’t expect you to come to my family’s business.
You’re really an honor to our humble dwelling.”
“Hello, Director Chen.”
“Director Chen, don’t just stand there.
Please sit down.” A young man quickly moved the sofa over.
Then, he pointed at the salespeople.
“What are you all waiting for?
Hurry up and serve Director Chen some drinks.
You don’t even know how to look.”
Everyone was stunned when they saw this scene.
These young people were all wearing luxury goods.
Any one of them cost tens of thousands.
Furthermore, they had just driven sports cars here.
They were all young masters from the upper circle of Jiang City!
“What are you guys doing?” Nie Haiyun frowned when he saw his son lowering his head and bending his back.
“Dad, why aren’t you serving Director Chen well?
Why are you scolding us?”
“Director Chen?
Which Director Chen?”
Hm?
The young men were momentarily stunned.
“Uncle Nie, don’t you know?
This is Director Chen of Sacred Heaven Entertainment.
He holds 80% of their shares.”
“You didn’t see it yesterday.
Director Chen crippled Gai Lingjie.
Gai Tianyuan from Nanshan Industry didn’t even dare to do anything.”
The people beside them were stunned when they heard the young people talking.
Good lord!
He was the director of Sacred Heaven Entertainment!
He controlled 80% of their shares!
After crippling Gai Lingjie, Gai Tianyuan did not even dare to do anything!
Who was Gai Tianyuan?
He was the CEO of Nanshan Industry and had a net worth of one billion yuan!
What kind of person was this?
For a moment, even Nie Haiyun’s face quickly turned pale.
Was this the Director Chen that his son had told him about last night?
This!
This!
Nie Haiyun trembled and smiled awkwardly.
“Oh, it’s Director Chen.
I really didn’t expect you to order our cars.”
“I failed to recognize a familiar person.
I didn’t know that Manager Zhou was on your side either.”
“I’ll promote Manager Zhou to an executive in Motor City now.
The commission will be double, no, three times the original amount.
What do you think?”
However, Chen Yun’s cold face answered him.
“It’s not like I didn’t give you a chance before.
You didn’t take it, so don’t blame me.”
Nie Haiyun was stunned and anger rose in his heart.
He had already given in, but Chen Yun still refused to give up.
He really didn’t believe that Chen Yun could cripple him on the spot, or that he could really destroy the huge Motor City!
“CEO Nie, bad news, bad news!”
Just as Nie Haiyun was feeling indignant, the manager of the Public Relations Department rushed down from above.
“CEO Nie, bad news!”
“What’s wrong?
What happened?
Why are you like this?”
Nie Haiyun chided the manager.
However, the manager of the Public Relations Department gulped.
“All the dirt that we spent money to suppress has been exposed!”
“Moreover, everything has already been fully exposed.
It’s so fast that we can’t even do emergency PR!”
“Now, all the users in Jiang City should have received relevant browser notifications on their phones.”
Nie Haiyun quickly took out his phone.
As expected, there were a few browser notifications on it.
They were the ones that exposed Motor City.
When a new Mercedes-Benz was sold, oil started to leak out!
There was no way for the car owners to defend their rights!
The car dealership store deliberately raised the price of their parts!
Defective parts were used during repairs!
Motor City had previously hired fake reviewers to push down these notifications.
For a moment, Nie Haiyun’s heart turned cold.
He looked at Chen Yun and almost couldn’t breathe.
Chen Yun looked at Nie Haiyun and sneered.
“CEO Nie, don’t tell me you thought that I was joking?”
“I only joke with my friends.”

chapters.title: Chapter 40
paragraphs: Give Me My Forty-Meter Broadsword
For a moment, Nie Haiyun truly understood Chen Yun’s power.
What did Sacred Heaven Entertainment have in their hands?
They had a stronger public relations team!
They had smoother promotional channels!
They had an even stronger copywriting team!
With just a few words, they could pull people’s hatred to the peak!
Now, the entire Jiang City knew what they had done previously. If this continued, the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China would come to investigate!
Moreover, this was an irreversible blow to their reputation.
It could be foreseen that even if Motor City cleaned up the mess, they would not be able to recover within half a year or even a year.
Everyone present looked at Chen Yun and then at their phones, as if they had been splashed by icy water.
That’s right!
In front of Sacred Heaven Entertainment, Motor City was nothing!
The Nie Family was nothing!
Nie Haiyun’s heart turned cold as he read the explosive comments under the news.

“Director Chen, I know I was wrong. How about this? I’ll personally send your cars to your villa and return the money. I won’t take a single cent. As for Manager Zhou, I’ll personally compensate you by three times, no, no five times your commission. What do you think...”
At this moment, Nie Haiyun was simply making losses. As the CEO of Motor City, how much liquid assets could he have? He was already vomiting blood by giving Chen Yun so much.
Chen Yun looked at Zhou Jingyi beside him. “You don’t have to ask me. She has the final say.”
Zhou Jingyi looked at Nie Haiyun, then at the huge Motor City and sighed.
If this continued, it was true that Nie Haiyun would be taught a lesson in the end. However, those low-level employees who sold cars would also suffer.
The innocent people would suffer.
She immediately pulled Chen Yun’s hand. “Chen Yun, that’s enough.”
“I’ll give you half a day to settle everything,” said Chen Yun to Nie Haiyun before pulling Zhou Jingyi away.
“Okay, okay. I’ll definitely do it well. I’ll definitely do it well.”
At this moment, Nie Haiyun was extremely dispirited.
After driving out of Motor City, Zhou Jingyi’s face was still red. It was too satisfying!
She even held Chen Yun’s hand.
It felt really good. There was a heavy feeling, giving people a different sense of security.
“If only I could stretch it out for longer.” Zhou Jingyi thought as she bit her lower lip.
“Let’s go and have a meal.” Chen Yun looked at Zhou Jingyi. “Jingyi, are you still going back to Motor City to work?”
“I’m not going back. A good man doesn’t backtrack. I’ll find another job. I’m not just a pretty face, so I don’t have to worry about finding a job.” Zhou Jingyi revealed a reassuring smile.
As she said, she was top-notch in both business and social skills. Otherwise, she wouldn’t have become the youngest manager of the McLaren car dealership store.
Chen Yun thought for a moment. “How about this? After lunch in the afternoon, you can report to Sacred Heaven and become a junior apprentice to train yourself.”
This!
Zhou Jingyi’s eyes widened!
Sacred Heaven Entertainment!
That was a large entertainment company with a market value of tens of billions!
Eight out of ten employees had graduated from universities under the 985 Project.

Even though she had also graduated from a university under the 985 Project, she didn’t have the crazy idea of applying for a job in Sacred Heaven. After all, it was too difficult to enter Sacred Heaven!
This time, even if she was just an apprentice, it would be good if she could enter such a big place.
“Okay.”
After the meal, Zhou Jingyi reported to Sacred Heaven in the afternoon. After reporting her name to the receptionist, the receptionist brought her to the top floor.
“Miss Zhou, this is our CEO, CEO Ma Ke.”
“Hello, CEO Ma.”
Zhou Jingyi’s heart skipped a beat when she heard that he was the CEO.
“Hello, Miss Zhou.” Ma Ke reached out and shook hands with Zhou Jingyi.

“Director Chen told me about the situation. You can be my secretary for now, but you don’t have to come into contact with business related to Sacred Heavens yet. Go and learn about business management first. We have relevant training courses.”
“After that, we have a large-scale project. You can get started quickly.”
When the receptionist heard this, the way she looked at Zhou Jingyi immediately changed.

In Sacred Heavens, only the upper echelons had the opportunity to learn about business management. They invited foreign experts or executives of world-class companies to teach. Ma Ke would also teach one or two lessons from time to time.
“Alright, I’ll learn well, CEO Ma.”
After settling Zhou Jingyi down, Chen Yun returned to Villa No. 3. With Ma Ke in control of Sacred Heaven, he was more at ease.
He took a nap and woke up at night. Wang Menghan and the others had already returned. The three girls were busy in the kitchen.
“Mengmeng, you’re back? How do you feel?”
“It was so big and beautiful.” Chen Mengmeng recalled with a melancholic expression.

“That’s not right. I’ve also been to the Jiang City University of the Arts. It’s not big, and it’s also an old campus. What’s so beautiful about it?” Chen Yun chuckled, but she also came to a realization.

This little girl was only a high school student and had never seen a university. Compared to the high school campus, the Jiang City University of the Arts could be described as huge. Moreover, it had an antique beauty and a different style. He did not expect this little girl of the new era to be able to appreciate this taste. It was rare.
Without waiting for Chen Yun to think further, Chen Mengmeng sighed. “It’s also white and long.”
Chen Yun was speechless.
Wang Menghan was confused.
The two of them were dumbfounded. Only Han Xue covered Chen Mengmeng’s mouth.
She was being too explicit!
What was she describing by saying that it was big? What was she describing by saying that it was white and long?!
Han Xue ignored Chen Mengmeng’s cries and refused to let her say another word.

Today, they had really broadened their horizons. Originally, Han Xue and Chen Mengmeng thought that they were both very beautiful and had good physical conditions, so they were prepared to become actors and enter the Acting Department. At the very least, they had a natural advantage.
However, when they arrived at Jiang City University of the Arts, their worldview was almost overturned.
They were all beautiful women and handsome men!

All the beauties were good-looking to begin with. In addition, all of the beauties in Jiang City University of the Arts were experts in makeup. After putting on makeup, any one of them would be extremely beautiful.
Moreover, each of them had a cup size of at least C!
They also had long legs!
Recently, the weather had turned warmer and they had started to wear short skirts. At a glance, everything was white. It was no wonder that boys were willing to go to art universities!
Anyway, Han Xue and the others had suffered a blow this time. Furthermore, Chen Mengmeng was just average. If she was thrown in, she would not have any natural advantage!
This was Han Xue’s first time seeing Chen Mengmeng’s inferiority.

“It’s fine, it’s fine. When we get back, I’ll bring you guys to my university to take a look. When the two of you walk on the road, you’ll definitely attract a lot of attention.” Chen Yun patted Chen Mengmeng’s head.
Then, Chen Yun flipped through his phone and found a few photos of his grade.
It was hard to explain the appearances of the girls from the Institute of Technology.
“Take a look and recover your health.”
Chen Mengmeng hugged his phone and looked at it for a while. Her face was red and she held her head high, looking like she was the boss.
She felt as if her blood was about to explode!
She felt as if she was alive again!
She could be arrogant again!
Hurry up and bring my forty-meter broadsword!
