chapters.title: Chapter 41: The Garage Is Full of Luxury Cars!
paragraphs: Wang Menghan looked at Chen Mengmeng and knocked her head lightly.
“You still want to rely on your looks. Those who rely on their looks are all vases. Can you rely on your abilities?”
Why were there so many rumors about actresses?

It was because they were beautiful. It was fine if someone like Wang Menghan had the corresponding strength, but if she did not have the corresponding strength, people would definitely say that she relied on her looks and skills to climb up the ranks at night.
Therefore, now, Wang Menghan had to completely change the mindsets of these two little girls.
Otherwise, if they relied on their looks, they would definitely age in the future!
“Got it.” Chen Mengmeng looked aggrieved.

Chen Yun could tell that it did not seem to be effective for him to educate Chen Mengmeng. This girl did not dare to refute him, but she was unconvinced in her heart. She had to listen to Wang Menghan, her senior.
He had been worried sick about this little girl since she was young.
The next moment, Chen Yun’s phone rang.
“Director Chen, this is Nie Cheng. Is it convenient for you now? Shall I bring someone to send your car over?”
“Okay.”
“Brother, what’s wrong?” Chen Mengmeng asked out of habit.
“It’s a car delivery. They’re sending my new car over later.”
At this point, the three girls were stunned, especially Chen Mengmeng. Her eyes widened. “Brother, you’re so prodigal. Your McLaren sports car is so new, yet you want to buy a car.”
Prodigal?
There was no such thing.
“Someone gave me a car. I didn’t spend any money. Besides, the McLaren only has two seats. It’s not convenient to bring you guys out to play in the future.”
“Alright.” Chen Mengmeng’s eyes darted around and she became mischievous.
It was no wonder her brother asked her to get a driver’s license this morning. It turned out that he had bought a new car.
In that case, would he give the McLaren to her?
Even if he didn’t give it to her, she could just drive it normally.
As Chen Mengmeng thought about this, she could not help but smile.
The others could tell what she was thinking at a glance.
Meanwhile, Wang Menghan sighed and couldn’t help but sigh at how good it was to be rich. This car hadn’t broken down yet, but he had already bought a new car.
No! Not only was his existing car not broken, but it was also a new car. It had probably been replaced in less than a month after being bought.

After a while, the sound of a truck sounded outside. If not for the fact that it was a delivery truck, the security guard at the entrance would not have let such a truck in. Even so, the truck had undergone a serious inspection before taking a long detour and turning around from the edge of the district.
This was the property management of the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion. They were responsible to every owner.
Hearing the sound of the truck, Chen Yun stood up. “They’re here.”

“It’s here, it’s here!” Chen Mengmeng also suddenly jumped up, making Chen Yun glance at her. He said, “Look at how anxious you are. When you and Xiao Xue get your driver’s license, I’ll give you two cars.”
“Okay ~” Chen Mengmeng hugged Chen Yun’s arm and walked out together.

“Director Chen, I’ve brought the car to you. There’s also my father’s apology letter here. I hope you won’t take offense and forgive us this time.” As Nie Cheng spoke, he had already bowed 90 degrees.
Chen Yun did not say anything and took the apology letter.
When Nie Cheng saw Chen Yun’s action, he was delighted. He turned around and shouted, “What are you waiting for? Hurry up and unload the car.”

It was no wonder that the employees were stunned. They had never seen such a luxurious villa. Of course, not to mention them, even Nie Cheng had never seen such a luxurious villa. It was not just luxurious. It could simply be described as extravagant!
This villa would probably cost hundreds of millions to buy!
As expected of the director of Sacred Heaven Entertainment. He was definitely the person who controlled the company. The house that he lived in was the largest and the most expensive!
Ordinary people would probably only be able to buy a corner of this villa’s garden in their entire lives.

Wang Menghan looked at the stunned employees and chuckled. People nowadays only knew how to make an empty show of strength. They had only delivered a car, yet they delivered it using such a long truck.
They slowly put down a car.
It was a Mercedes-Benz G! It was the limited edition bulletproof version!
The moment this car appeared, the eyes of the three girls lit up. This Mercedes-Benz G was wider and bigger than the ones running on the road. Its weight was simply shocking!
At the side, Nie Cheng introduced the car. When he mentioned the price of seven million yuan, everyone was shocked!
However, Chen Yun was calm.
“Drive this into the garage first.” Chen Yun waved his hand.
“Aren’t we going to the garage to take a look?” Chen Mengmeng pulled Chen Yun. “Brother, I want to take a look at the garage.”
“Why? Have you taken a fancy to that car? Aren’t you going to continue watching?” Chen Yun looked at Chen Mengmeng’s anxious expression and smiled.
“Huh?”
Chen Yun’s words stunned Chen Mengmeng. Didn’t they come to deliver one car?
Why did she need to continue watching?
Just as she was in a daze, another car was unloaded.
It was a Bentley Flying Spur!
It was a top-notch item worth four million yuan!
“Wow! A Bentley!”
“It’s so handsome!” Han Xue couldn’t help but cover her mouth.
Wang Menghan also felt a little numb. Did they give him two cars in one go?
As expected of the director of Sacred Heaven Entertainment!
However, the unloaders had yet to finish their work.
It was another sports car!
There was a Maserati GT!
There was a sedan!
There was a Maserati Quattroporte!
There was a Ferrari F12!
There was an Aston Martin supercar!
Each car stimulated the nerves of the three girls.

Those who knew what was happening understood that someone had come to deliver cars. However, those who didn’t know what was happening would think that they were going to hold a luxury car exhibition in the villa!
There were a total of nine cars!
They were all luxury cars worth more than three million yuan!
The entire underground garage was sparkling with starlight!
Coupled with Chen Yun’s McLaren, it was really like a car show!

Moreover, the photos of these cars were all made up of numbers like five, six, eight, and nine. Every one of them had a rare and good license plate. Although they were not as eye-catching as the Jiang A66666 on Chen Yun’s McLaren sports car, they were still shocking enough!
It was enough to show his identity!
“Chen Yun, can I... can I take a photo?”
Even Wang Menghan, who had seen many big scenes, asked with a trembling voice.
“Of course.”
Chen Yun looked at the two stunned little girls beside him and held the set of car keys Nie Cheng had given him.
It was really just a bunch of luxury car keys!
“Here, go up and feel the cars, but don’t touch the accelerator.” Chen Yun handed the keys to the two of them, who rushed out like wild horses that had escaped their reins.
“Let’s go and take a look too.”

Chen Yun had never touched these cars before. He could go and take a look together. Otherwise, he would really be worried about these two girls. They did not even have driver’s licenses. If they got into the car, they would break the pillars in his underground garage.

Therefore, now, Wang Menghan had to completely change the mindsets of these two little girls.
Otherwise, if they relied on their looks, they would definitely age in the future!
“Got it.” Chen Mengmeng looked aggrieved.
Chen Yun could tell that it did not seem to be effective for him to educate Chen Mengmeng.
This girl did not dare to refute him, but she was unconvinced in her heart.
She had to listen to Wang Menghan, her senior.
He had been worried sick about this little girl since she was young.
The next moment, Chen Yun’s phone rang.
“Director Chen, this is Nie Cheng.
Is it convenient for you now?
Shall I bring someone to send your car over?”
“Okay.”
“Brother, what’s wrong?” Chen Mengmeng asked out of habit.
“It’s a car delivery.
They’re sending my new car over later.”
At this point, the three girls were stunned, especially Chen Mengmeng.
Her eyes widened.
“Brother, you’re so prodigal.
Your McLaren sports car is so new, yet you want to buy a car.”
Prodigal?
There was no such thing.
“Someone gave me a car.
I didn’t spend any money.
Besides, the McLaren only has two seats.
It’s not convenient to bring you guys out to play in the future.”
“Alright.” Chen Mengmeng’s eyes darted around and she became mischievous.
It was no wonder her brother asked her to get a driver’s license this morning.
It turned out that he had bought a new car.
In that case, would he give the McLaren to her?
Even if he didn’t give it to her, she could just drive it normally.
As Chen Mengmeng thought about this, she could not help but smile.
The others could tell what she was thinking at a glance.
Meanwhile, Wang Menghan sighed and couldn’t help but sigh at how good it was to be rich.
This car hadn’t broken down yet, but he had already bought a new car.
No!
Not only was his existing car not broken, but it was also a new car.
It had probably been replaced in less than a month after being bought.
After a while, the sound of a truck sounded outside.
If not for the fact that it was a delivery truck, the security guard at the entrance would not have let such a truck in.
Even so, the truck had undergone a serious inspection before taking a long detour and turning around from the edge of the district.
This was the property management of the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion.
They were responsible to every owner.
Hearing the sound of the truck, Chen Yun stood up.
“They’re here.”
“It’s here, it’s here!” Chen Mengmeng also suddenly jumped up, making Chen Yun glance at her.
He said, “Look at how anxious you are.
When you and Xiao Xue get your driver’s license, I’ll give you two cars.”
“Okay ~” Chen Mengmeng hugged Chen Yun’s arm and walked out together.
“Director Chen, I’ve brought the car to you.
There’s also my father’s apology letter here.
I hope you won’t take offense and forgive us this time.” As Nie Cheng spoke, he had already bowed 90 degrees.
Chen Yun did not say anything and took the apology letter.
When Nie Cheng saw Chen Yun’s action, he was delighted.
He turned around and shouted, “What are you waiting for?
Hurry up and unload the car.”
It was no wonder that the employees were stunned.
They had never seen such a luxurious villa.
Of course, not to mention them, even Nie Cheng had never seen such a luxurious villa.
It was not just luxurious.
It could simply be described as extravagant!
This villa would probably cost hundreds of millions to buy!
As expected of the director of Sacred Heaven Entertainment.
He was definitely the person who controlled the company.
The house that he lived in was the largest and the most expensive!
Ordinary people would probably only be able to buy a corner of this villa’s garden in their entire lives.
Wang Menghan looked at the stunned employees and chuckled.
People nowadays only knew how to make an empty show of strength.
They had only delivered a car, yet they delivered it using such a long truck.
They slowly put down a car.
It was a Mercedes-Benz G!
It was the limited edition bulletproof version!
The moment this car appeared, the eyes of the three girls lit up.
This Mercedes-Benz G was wider and bigger than the ones running on the road.
Its weight was simply shocking!
At the side, Nie Cheng introduced the car.
When he mentioned the price of seven million yuan, everyone was shocked!
However, Chen Yun was calm.
“Drive this into the garage first.” Chen Yun waved his hand.
“Aren’t we going to the garage to take a look?” Chen Mengmeng pulled Chen Yun.
“Brother, I want to take a look at the garage.”
“Why?
Have you taken a fancy to that car?
Aren’t you going to continue watching?” Chen Yun looked at Chen Mengmeng’s anxious expression and smiled.
“Huh?”
Chen Yun’s words stunned Chen Mengmeng.
Didn’t they come to deliver one car?
Why did she need to continue watching?
Just as she was in a daze, another car was unloaded.
It was a Bentley Flying Spur!
It was a top-notch item worth four million yuan!
“Wow!
A Bentley!”
“It’s so handsome!” Han Xue couldn’t help but cover her mouth.
Wang Menghan also felt a little numb.
Did they give him two cars in one go?
As expected of the director of Sacred Heaven Entertainment!
However, the unloaders had yet to finish their work.
It was another sports car!
There was a Maserati GT!
There was a sedan!
There was a Maserati Quattroporte!
There was a Ferrari F12!
There was an Aston Martin supercar!
Each car stimulated the nerves of the three girls.
Those who knew what was happening understood that someone had come to deliver cars.
However, those who didn’t know what was happening would think that they were going to hold a luxury car exhibition in the villa!
There were a total of nine cars!
They were all luxury cars worth more than three million yuan!
The entire underground garage was sparkling with starlight!
Coupled with Chen Yun’s McLaren, it was really like a car show!
Moreover, the photos of these cars were all made up of numbers like five, six, eight, and nine.
Every one of them had a rare and good license plate.
Although they were not as eye-catching as the Jiang A66666 on Chen Yun’s McLaren sports car, they were still shocking enough!
It was enough to show his identity!
“Chen Yun, can I... can I take a photo?”
Even Wang Menghan, who had seen many big scenes, asked with a trembling voice.
“Of course.”
Chen Yun looked at the two stunned little girls beside him and held the set of car keys Nie Cheng had given him.
It was really just a bunch of luxury car keys!
“Here, go up and feel the cars, but don’t touch the accelerator.” Chen Yun handed the keys to the two of them, who rushed out like wild horses that had escaped their reins.
“Let’s go and take a look too.”
Chen Yun had never touched these cars before.
He could go and take a look together.
Otherwise, he would really be worried about these two girls.
They did not even have driver’s licenses.
If they got into the car, they would break the pillars in his underground garage.

chapters.title: Chapter 42: Return Our Tears to Us
paragraphs: “Xiao Xue, come and look at this Mercedes-Benz G!”
“And this Aston Martin, it’s so handsome!”
Han Xue was pulled everywhere by Chen Mengmeng.
Who said that women didn’t like cars? They said that they didn’t like cars because they had never encountered such luxury cars! These were top-notch luxury cars!
The two little girls looked at the cars for an hour before gradually calming down.
“Let’s go back and wash up. Are you tired?” Chen Yun sat on the hood of the Maserati sports car and looked at the two little girls.
“Here, Brother.” Chen Mengmeng returned the car keys to Chen Yun.
“Huh? Aren’t you going to select a car in advance?” Chen Yun shook the keys as if he was tempting a child with sweets.
Chen Mengmeng gritted her teeth. “I’ll earn money to buy them myself in the future! When the time comes, I’ll buy cars for Xiao Xue and you! And Mom and Dad!”
“Good!”
Chen Yun patted Chen Mengmeng’s head. “You’re finally sensible. Let’s go, the two future movie queens.”

After returning to the main villa, Wang Menghan looked at Chen Yun. “Chen Yun, I’m going back to the company tomorrow. Xiaozi rushed me today. Coincidentally, I’ve written a few songs over the past few days. It’s time to go back and integrate them before releasing a new album.”

Over the past few days in the villa, Wang Menghan had simply experienced a different life. Coupled with the fact that she was with the two little girls, Chen Mengmeng and Han Xue, she had a lot of inspiration.
Now that she was leaving, she suddenly felt uncomfortable.

“Sister Menghan, don’t leave.” Chen Mengmeng pulled Wang Menghan and looked reluctant. “Sister Menghan, you still have to teach us how to make pastries and how to compose lyrics, compose songs, and sing. I won’t let you leave!”
As she spoke, Chen Mengmeng’s eyes turned red.
Wang Menghan hugged the two little girls. “I can’t bear to part with you either, but the company is urging me. I have no choice.”
“Then you have to visit us often. By the way, where is your company? Is it still in Jiangbei Province? Or is it outside the province...” As they spoke, the two little girls choked.
“It’s in Jiang City.”
Chen Mengmeng was speechless.
Han Xue was also speechless.
They thought, “Give us back our tears!”
Wang Menghan was confused. Why did they leave? Why did the two of them leave? Wasn’t this an affectionate farewell?
“Then don’t move out,” said Chen Mengmeng.
“I still have to move back. I usually work overtime until it’s very late. This place isn’t in the city center, so it’s inconvenient to go back and forth.”
“Alright then. We can interact often anyway.”
“Yes, let me know if you have any difficulties,” said Chen Yun to Wang Menghan.
Wang Menghan wiped the corners of her eyes. “Okay.”
However, she only treated Chen Yun’s words as words of courtesy. Besides, she was not someone who liked to trouble others.
Anyway, she had carried all kinds of things along the way.
Tonight, everyone had a good time.
They played Truth or Dare!
However, they were rather restrained. Halfway through, Chen Mengmeng wanted to look at Wang Menghan and her brother. Just as she chuckled, Chen Yun glared at her.
Then, they returned to their rooms.
Wang Menghan looked at the room and the screen at the entrance. After logging in with her fingerprint, she logged out of her biological information.
She released the authority of this room.
She packed her things before lying down.
Meanwhile, Chen Yun also entered his room and lay on the bed. He looked at the message Ma Ke had sent him. Tonight, they could fully promote the news of the Desert Island Survival variety show.
He looked at the time. It was past nine o’clock.
Ma Ke was still working. He was not the only one. He believed that many people in Sacred Heaven were working overtime tonight.
In fact, in such a large company, it was true that the salary was high, but it was common to work overtime.
However, there was overtime pay.
Since he was bored, Chen Yun opened the Flying Fish video platform and saw that Xiao Xin’s live-stream was at the top of the front page.
Yoho!
As soon as he opened the platform, Xiao Xin’s live-stream was recommended on the home page!
Not bad. She had become a big streamer now!

Chen Yun knew this position. This position was reserved for the big streamers of Flying Fish. There was no need for much. It was not a problem to earn tens of thousands of yuan as a gift by staying in this recommendation spot for a few hours.
Looking at the popularity rankings, Xiao Xin was currently ranked first, far surpassing the streamer in second place. Moreover, she already had three million fans!
What had she done?
For a moment, Chen Yun was also interested and clicked on it.
When Xiao Xin, who was still live-streaming, saw Chen Yun enter, her eyes widened and her heart instantly skipped a few beats.
“Brother Yun, you haven’t been here for a long time.” Xiao Xin smiled. “Brother Yun, what song do you want to listen to? Shall I sing it for you?”
Before Chen Yun could speak, he was suddenly stunned when he saw that there were many people making wishes on the public chat and worshiping the God of Luck.
What were they doing?
“Why have you become the God of Luck now?” Chen Yun typed a sentence on the public chat. He even added a laughing emoji.
Then, a few comments floated past.
“Wow, where did this country bumpkin come from? He doesn’t even recognize the God of Luck and still dares to ask.”
“That’s right. Hurry up and worship the God of Luck. Otherwise, the God of Luck will draw a circle and curse you.”
As soon as the voices suppressing Chen Yun appeared, many comments swarmed over.
“Are the previous users blind? Go and see who set the record for a single tip on Flying Fish!”

“That’s right. Young Master Yun is the legend of the entire Flying Fish. He tipped 11 million yuan in a short period of time! You guys don’t even have two coins in your pants, yet you still dare to badmouth Young Master Yun here!”
“You’re like a group of country bumpkins who have never seen the world!”
The few of them looked at the comments and exited the live-stream to look at the rewards record. Their eyes widened. The record was 11 million!
It was really 11 million yuan!
It was simply too shocking!
They immediately blushed to their ears and felt inferior.

Xiao Xin saw that the voices were no longer mocking Chen Yun and scratched her head with a smile. “Brother Yun, to be honest, after I went out to sea with you that time, I realized that I had superpowers when I returned.”
Chen Yun was speechless. Superpowers?
What the f*ck!
Was there such a thing in this day and age?
In that case, he also had superpowers to make money!
Chen Yun suppressed his laughter. “Tell me, what superpowers do you have?”
“I think I might have been possessed by the God of Luck or the reincarnation of the God of Luck.”
Wasn’t this f*cking nonsense?
Did she think that she was Chen Yun?
“How can you prove it?” Chen Yun asked.

“Hey, Brother Yun, I can lie to everyone else except you. Wait a moment, I’ll log in.” Xiao Xin logged into her Honor of Kings1 account. As soon as she logged in, she said, “I’ve really been especially lucky since I came back from the sea. Recently, not only have I won the second prize in the lottery, but I’ve also won the best prize once or twice in various in-game lucky draws.”
“Don’t tell me you think that my title as the God of Luck is for nothing?”
Chen Yun was about to say something.
He saw the comments on the public chat of the live-stream fly past.
“Host, is it time for the lucky draw again?!”
“Oh my god, the streamer actually wants to challenge TiMi Studio Group2 today. I’ll call someone over. Wait for me!”
“Someone, come quickly. The streamer is going to challenge TiMi one-on-one! She’s challenging Brother Ma3!”
Chen Yun was speechless.
Did the audience nowadays have a halo of intelligence reduction? How could they believe such nonsense?

chapters.title: Chapter 43: F*ck, Are You Using My Skill?
paragraphs: Not long after, nearly a million people surged into the live-stream!
It was as if the entire screen was filled with snowflakes. It was very similar to the terrifying scene when he farmed gifts for Xiao Xin.

The comments were mostly divided into three categories. The first category of comments cheered her on, the second category of comments promised to give rewards, while the third category of comments fulfilled these promises.
There were all kinds of tips, making the entire public screen bloom.
Chen Yun had no choice but to turn off the comments and watch Xiao Xin’s live broadcast.
Xiao Xin rubbed her hands and looked at her phone.
“In the past few days, we have challenged Dungeon Fighter Online1 and obtained top-grade equipment.”
“After winning in GKart2, I created the S-Breaking Dawn after attempting the workshop 15 times.”
“Today, let’s challenge the damned Honor of Kings.”
When Chen Yun heard Xiao Xin’s words, he was stunned. What?
Had she obtained top-grade equipment in Dungeon Fighter Online?
Had she obtained the S-Breaking Dawn in GKart?

It had to be known that when forging items in the GKart workshop, one had to fill up ten slots. The higher one went, the harder it was to succeed. The probability of successfully forging the last slot was even lower than 1%!
Otherwise, how could the developers earn money? If everyone had a top-notch A-car, who would spend money on the game?
At that moment, Chen Yun looked at his hands. Could it be that his luck could affect the people around him?
Meanwhile, Xiao Xin had already opened the points lottery in the mall.

“I believe everyone has challenged this before. If you can get a Glory Crystal for a few hundred yuan, you’ll be considered lucky. Everyone, take a look. I only have five luck points now. Now, I want to challenge the lottery and get a Glory Crystal.”
As soon as these words were spoken, the screen exploded again. Many people were filled with anticipation, waiting to see Xiao Xin’s performance.
There were also passers-by who mocked her.
“What? I thought it was some special skill. She’s just pulling for a Glory Crystal. There are many live-streams of lottery draws like this. It’s boring.”
“That’s right. Let’s go, let’s go.”
Some people were about to leave the live-stream when Xiao Xin had already started the lottery.
Deng deng deng deng...
Crack!
It was a Glory Crystal!
Everyone fell silent. Even Chen Yun raised his eyebrows.
Then, because there were too many comments on the public screen, the frame rate fell crazily!
“F*ck! The streamer is awesome! She simply obtained a Glory Crystal with just five value points!”
“As expected of the God of Luck!”
“I worship her. I worship her!”
“You’re flattering me. Everyone, you’re flattering me.” Xiao Xin chuckled. “I was lucky this time. Let me see what I should exchange it for.”
“I’ll exchange for King Jiji’s Holographic Broken Shadow Skin! It’ll make it easier for King Jiji to kill randomly.” After Xiao Xin exchanged for the item, she clicked on the lottery again.
It was a Glory Crystal!
It was another Glory Crystal!
Just now, there were still some voices saying that Xiao Xin was just lucky. How could there be the reincarnation of the God of Luck?
But now, they had all shut up.
They all worshiped the screen.
This was too terrifying!
She drew from the point lottery twice and obtained two Glory Crystals!
“This time, let’s switch to Starry Sky Dream.” Xiao Xin looked at the screen and chuckled. Then, she placed the cursor on the button for five consecutive draws.
At that moment, everyone widened their eyes!
Even Chen Yun was staring at the screen.
Deng deng deng deng...
She obtained three Glory Crystals from five consecutive draws!!!
She also obtained two heroes!!!
This...
Even Chen Yun was stunned now. He was 100% sure that this girl had really benefited from his Full of Luck skill!
Could she also freeload on this skill?!
Most importantly, she actually used such a heaven-defying skill to do this!
Damn it, it was fine to be a streamer who streamed lucky draws.
However, this girl was also capable of doing it to this extent.
At this moment, Xiao Xin pressed her palms together and thanked the audience for the tips.
“Thank you. Thank you, everyone.”
“Thank you for your gifts. Thank you for a few super rockets.”
“I don’t know how to thank everyone. I wish everyone a happy year.”
As soon as Xiao Xin said this, the entire live-stream was filled with tips!
Now, Xiao Xin was like a money turtle in the Free Life Pond3 of a temple. Anyone who saw her would throw money in.
Who cared if she was the God of Luck!
It was fine as long as they thought she was the God of Luck!
Chen Yun opened the comments and saw that many people had come from the Huoyin short video platform. He immediately opened the Huoyin short video platform.
Good God!
She had a million fans!
She also had three million likes!
She didn’t hide her name at all. She simply put her name as “God of Luck!”
She also had many fans on Weibo!
The current Xiao Xin had completely become an internet celebrity.
She was also a popular internet celebrity!
“Xiao Xin, I have something to discuss with you.” Chen Yun sent a comment.
“Brother Yun, tell me. It’s all thanks to you that I can become like this. Tell me, I’ll definitely do what I can.”
“There’s an event that I want to invite you to be a host.” Due to Chen Yun’s special identity, his comments were at the top and everyone could see it.
Right after that, Chen Yun explained the plan for the Desert Island Survival show.
After he mentioned the one billion yuan that had been invested into the show and the allocation of the prize money, the comments instantly floated past the screen.
“Are you serious? A program worth a billion yuan? Just the prize money alone is worth 300 million yuan, while the first prize is worth 100 million yuan?!”
“It must be fake. How can there be such a good thing? If there is, I’ll be the first to sign up!”
“You’re just bragging. Why don’t you find someone more reliable?”
“Are the prizes that good? Why haven’t I heard of it?”

“In the past few days, we have challenged Dungeon Fighter Online1 and obtained top-grade equipment.”
“After winning in GKart2, I created the S-Breaking Dawn after attempting the workshop 15 times.”
“Today, let’s challenge the damned Honor of Kings.”
When Chen Yun heard Xiao Xin’s words, he was stunned.
What?
Had she obtained top-grade equipment in Dungeon Fighter Online?
Had she obtained the S-Breaking Dawn in GKart?
It had to be known that when forging items in the GKart workshop, one had to fill up ten slots.
The higher one went, the harder it was to succeed.
The probability of successfully forging the last slot was even lower than 1%!
Otherwise, how could the developers earn money?
If everyone had a top-notch A-car, who would spend money on the game?
At that moment, Chen Yun looked at his hands.
Could it be that his luck could affect the people around him?
Meanwhile, Xiao Xin had already opened the points lottery in the mall.
“I believe everyone has challenged this before.
If you can get a Glory Crystal for a few hundred yuan, you’ll be considered lucky.
Everyone, take a look.
I only have five luck points now.
Now, I want to challenge the lottery and get a Glory Crystal.”
As soon as these words were spoken, the screen exploded again.
Many people were filled with anticipation, waiting to see Xiao Xin’s performance.
There were also passers-by who mocked her.
“What?
I thought it was some special skill.
She’s just pulling for a Glory Crystal.
There are many live-streams of lottery draws like this.
It’s boring.”
“That’s right.
Let’s go, let’s go.”
Some people were about to leave the live-stream when Xiao Xin had already started the lottery.
Deng deng deng deng...
Crack!
It was a Glory Crystal!
Everyone fell silent.
Even Chen Yun raised his eyebrows.
Then, because there were too many comments on the public screen, the frame rate fell crazily!
“F*ck!
The streamer is awesome!
She simply obtained a Glory Crystal with just five value points!”
“As expected of the God of Luck!”
“I worship her.
I worship her!”
“You’re flattering me.
Everyone, you’re flattering me.” Xiao Xin chuckled.
“I was lucky this time.
Let me see what I should exchange it for.”
“I’ll exchange for King Jiji’s Holographic Broken Shadow Skin!
It’ll make it easier for King Jiji to kill randomly.” After Xiao Xin exchanged for the item, she clicked on the lottery again.
It was a Glory Crystal!
It was another Glory Crystal!
Just now, there were still some voices saying that Xiao Xin was just lucky.
How could there be the reincarnation of the God of Luck?
But now, they had all shut up.
They all worshiped the screen.
This was too terrifying!
She drew from the point lottery twice and obtained two Glory Crystals!
“This time, let’s switch to Starry Sky Dream.” Xiao Xin looked at the screen and chuckled.
Then, she placed the cursor on the button for five consecutive draws.
At that moment, everyone widened their eyes!
Even Chen Yun was staring at the screen.
Deng deng deng deng...
She obtained three Glory Crystals from five consecutive draws!!!
She also obtained two heroes!!!
This...
Even Chen Yun was stunned now.
He was 100% sure that this girl had really benefited from his Full of Luck skill!
Could she also freeload on this skill?!
Most importantly, she actually used such a heaven-defying skill to do this!
Damn it, it was fine to be a streamer who streamed lucky draws.
However, this girl was also capable of doing it to this extent.
At this moment, Xiao Xin pressed her palms together and thanked the audience for the tips.
“Thank you.
Thank you, everyone.”
“Thank you for your gifts.
Thank you for a few super rockets.”
“I don’t know how to thank everyone.
I wish everyone a happy year.”
As soon as Xiao Xin said this, the entire live-stream was filled with tips!
Now, Xiao Xin was like a money turtle in the Free Life Pond3 of a temple.
Anyone who saw her would throw money in.
Who cared if she was the God of Luck!
It was fine as long as they thought she was the God of Luck!
Chen Yun opened the comments and saw that many people had come from the Huoyin short video platform.
He immediately opened the Huoyin short video platform.
Good God!
She had a million fans!
She also had three million likes!
She didn’t hide her name at all.
She simply put her name as “God of Luck!”
She also had many fans on Weibo!
The current Xiao Xin had completely become an internet celebrity.
She was also a popular internet celebrity!
“Xiao Xin, I have something to discuss with you.” Chen Yun sent a comment.
“Brother Yun, tell me.
It’s all thanks to you that I can become like this.
Tell me, I’ll definitely do what I can.”
“There’s an event that I want to invite you to be a host.” Due to Chen Yun’s special identity, his comments were at the top and everyone could see it.
Right after that, Chen Yun explained the plan for the Desert Island Survival show.
After he mentioned the one billion yuan that had been invested into the show and the allocation of the prize money, the comments instantly floated past the screen.
“Are you serious?
A program worth a billion yuan?
Just the prize money alone is worth 300 million yuan, while the first prize is worth 100 million yuan?!”
“It must be fake.
How can there be such a good thing?
If there is, I’ll be the first to sign up!”
“You’re just bragging.
Why don’t you find someone more reliable?”
“Are the prizes that good?
Why haven’t I heard of it?”

chapters.title: Chapter 44: This Is Publicity!
paragraphs: Meanwhile, many comments flew up. Most people were in disbelief.
After all, that was a billion yuan!
Which variety show would do this?!
However, in the next moment.
The scene suddenly changed.
“Wow! There’s really such a variety show!”
“That’s right. The publicity has already begun. When you open other apps, their landing pages are all introducing the show.”
“Oh my god! The prize money is worth a total of 300 million yuan! The first prize is 100 million yuan!”
“I suddenly feel like I can do it again. This is the closest I’ve ever been to becoming a billionaire!”
Any app that they opened was filled with introductions of the event!
It was on the Huoyin short video platform! It was in the headlines! It was on Weibo! It was also on various browsers!
At the same time, they were publicizing the Desert Island Survival variety show!
Who else could spend so much money and possess such publicity abilities? Only a large entertainment company like Sacred Heaven Entertainment could do such a thing!
In the live-stream.
“As expected of a tycoon. He actually has first-hand information.”
“That’s right. With such publicity, such allocation of prize money, and Xiao Xin’s commentary, I’m going to love it.”
“I’ll definitely go and watch it!”
The show had yet to begin, yet everyone was filled with anticipation. Many people even announced that they wanted to participate in the audition.
Indeed, no one could resist the temptation of money.
For this check-in mission, Chen Yun wanted these 500 people to be extremely willing!
Even Xiao Xin was stunned. She stammered, “Brother Yun, I... Do I really have a chance to be the commentator for such a large-scale show?”
“I’ve never done a commentary.”
“I’m a little worried. If I cause trouble for you...”

“Don’t worry. You have so many fans now. Be more confident.” Now that Xiao Xin could be said to be popular on the Internet, and there were so many hardcore fans who called themselves the guardians of the God of Luck, it was simply perfect for her to host the show.

Those popular hosts were all veterans. Other than having a solid foundation and being proficient in their business, they did not have their own fans. This was also the reason why many esports competitions would invite some celebrities to commentate.
It was more fun and attractive.
“Okay!” Xiao Xin nodded. “I’ll practice my commentary over the next few days.”

“I’ll arrange for you to go to Sacred Heaven Entertainment tomorrow. Sacred Heaven Entertainment has more professional commentary training. It’s much better than you working alone.” Chen Yun sent a WeChat message.
“Alright, Brother Yun.”

Xiao Xin looked at Chen Yun’s WeChat message and stuck out her tongue. According to Chen Yun, he was also a member of Sacred Heaven Entertainment. What kind of company was Sacred Heaven Entertainment?
It could be considered one of the top leaders in Jiang City. The taxes they paid in a year were also the highest in Jiang City.
However, Xiao Xin did not expect Chen Yun to obtain the news about the Desert Island Survival variety show in advance and have the right to arrange for her to be the commentator.
In that case, he should be an executive in Sacred Heaven.
Xiao Xin thought about this, but she did not know that this Desert Island Survival variety show. was proposed by Chen Yun and funded by him.
After streaming for a while, Xiao Xin went offline.
When Xiao Xin walked out of the room, Zhang Jing and Lin Yu were discussing fervently.
Ever since Xiao Xin produced some results on the live broadcast, she had moved out of school and rented a house with Zhang Jing and Lin Yu.
At this moment, Zhang Jing was sitting cross-legged on the sofa in her Totoro pajamas. She held her phone and looked like a money-grubber.
“Xiao Xin, you’re offline. Look, the news has gone crazy.”
“What is it?” Xiao Xin took a sip of water and came over.

“Don’t you know? It’s this Desert Island Survival variety show.!” Lin Yu could not hide her shock. “Look, a billion yuan was invested into the show. Sacred Heaven Entertainment did their best to produce it. Furthermore, the prize money is worth a lot!”
“The first audition is tomorrow, and it’s in Jiang City. I must go and take a look!” Zhang Jing then took out her laptop and began to prepare the relevant knowledge.
Lin Yu looked at Zhang Jing. “Are you really going? You’re a girl and it’s a deserted island. If anything happens...”

“It’s fine. Take a look. This time, Cauldron Dragon Security has also done their best. They’ve already gone to Clear Sky Island to clean up the ferocious beasts. Moreover, there’s news online that the security guards will also be armed when the show actually starts. If there’s an accident, they’ll come to rescue the participants.”

“In addition, everyone has a large insurance policy. Moreover, when filming, hundreds of drones will follow and take videos. The helicopters will also be on standby at all times. There’s no problem with this setup at all!” Zhang Jing looked at Xiao Xin. “Xiao Xin, are you going?”
“I’m probably going to Clear Sky Island too, but not as a participant.”
Hm?
The two of them were stunned by her words. What did she mean?
Not as a participant?
“Brother Yun arranged for me to participate in the commentary for this show.”
For a moment, the two of them were instantly stunned. They looked at Xiao Xin and could not believe what she had said!
One had to know that this was such a large-scale variety show!
Just the number of participants alone amounted to 500!
There were probably more than a thousand staff members!
Those who could be commentators on such a large-scale program were either professional commentators or big-name celebrities!
“Brother Yun actually has such ability.” Zhang Jing stuck out her tongue. Brother Yun was simply like a rich husband. He was top-notch, rich, and handsome!
Lin Yu also became jealous. “Xiao Xin, do you think Brother Yun likes you?”

“Huh?” Xiao Xin blushed when she heard Lin Yu’s words. Then, she became melancholic. “How am I worthy of Brother Yun? I’m just a live-streamer. I’m not presentable... Moreover, I’m just a student. I’m not from a wealthy family.”
As she spoke, Xiao Xin bit her lips and clenched her fists, looking unhappy.

“Alright, alright. You have to pursue your own happiness. Hmph, I remember that the last time you went to the sea with Brother Yun, there were two other beauties in the photo. If you don’t hurry up, Brother Yun might leave with someone else. At that time, you will regret it!” Zhang Jing flicked Xiao Xin’s forehead.

“That’s right. Besides, how are you not worthy? You’re now a popular streamer on the Flying Fish live-streaming platform with millions of fans. Moreover, you’re popular on the Internet now. If Brother Yun thinks that you’re not worthy, he won’t invite you to be a host, right?”
“That’s right!” Xiao Xin was enlightened by this, and her bad mood was swept away.

After regrouping, the three of them began to study. Zhang Jing and Lin Yu were learning about survival, while Xiao Xin was watching some variety shows and competitions to see how the commentators worked.
At the same time, this program quickly became popular online.
The promotional videos on the Huoyin short video app alone had more than 200 million views!
Just the allocation of the prize money and the investment were shocking enough!
The number of likes and comments even exceeded the 50 million mark!
There were countless headlines and suggested articles in the various browsers!
For the entire night, people everywhere, especially the young people, were discussing this super huge variety show!

chapters.title: Chapter 45: Piles of Money!
paragraphs: Early the next morning, Chen Yun woke up. Today, he wanted to go to the audition venue to take a look.
[Host, please complete the check-in mission.]
Chen Yun pressed the check-in button.
[Check-in successful.]
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining the opportunity to convert and bind skills.]
Hm?
The opportunity to convert and bind skills?
[Detected that the host’s current skills are Full of Luck and Random Double. Providing the host with two proposals.]
[Proposal 1: Choose the Full of Luck skill. After conversion and binding, it will become the Unlucky/God of Luck Skill. The host can switch between the God of Luck Mode and the Unlucky Mode.]
[Unlucky Mode: You can choose a candidate and reduce them to an unlucky person.]

[Proposal 2: Choose the Random Double skill. After conversion and binding, the Random Distribution Skill will be added. Every time the consumption value reaches 100,000,000, there will be a chance for a random distribution. There is no limit to the type of items.]

When faced with these two options, Chen Yun was more inclined to the second option. Why did he need the Unlucky Skill? He now had superpowers. If he wanted to mess with anyone, did he still need the Unlucky Skill?
“I choose the second option.”
[Conversion and binding was successful.]

[From now on, the consumption value of the Random Double skill and the Random Distribution skill will be shared, but not used. In other words, every time the consumption value reaches 100,000,000, there will be a random distribution, but the consumption value will not be deducted.]
[Attention, the Random Distribution Skill cannot be used together with the Random Double Skill.]
Oh?
This was equivalent to a skill upgrade.

Every time his consumption value reached 100 million, there would be a chance for a random distribution. However, it did not decrease the consumption value that was used to upgrade the Random Double Skill. It was quite profitable.
He just did not know what skills would be distributed randomly.
After getting up and packing, Chen Yun drove the Ferrari sports car to the audition venue.
“F*ck!”
Even Chen Yun was shocked by such a sea of people.
Before the audition even started, thousands of people had already gathered at the audition venue!
There was still an endless stream of people rushing over!

Some people rubbed their palms together in excitement, some did push-ups on the spot, and some were still reading up on knowledge about survival on a deserted island. They were all carefully preparing.
They had no choice!
After all, the first place winner would receive a prize of 100 million yuan!
If they could pass the audition, there was a 50% chance of obtaining 100 million yuan!
The probability was too high!
At the very least, the probability of earning at least 100 million was relatively high.
Typically, if the people at the bottom wanted to earn 100 million yuan with their own hands, they could set a small goal first and strive to live for 200 years.
Then, they would borrow another 500 years from the heavens.

Moreover, this event was organized by Sacred Heaven Entertainment. Sacred Heaven Entertainment was called the star creation factory. Many capable celebrities of the current era were nurtured by Sacred Heaven Entertainment. If they performed well in this show, they could step into the entertainment industry in the future!
Who wouldn’t want to enter the entertainment industry with such a high starting point?
“Director Chen, you’re here.” When Ma Ke heard his secretary’s report, he quickly came over to welcome Chen Yun.
Chen Yun turned around and moved his attention away from the crowd. Then, he looked at Ma Ke. “Have you confirmed the audition procedures? Don’t let anything go wrong.”
“Don’t worry, Director Chen.”
Then, Chen Yun followed Ma Ke into the audition area. At this moment, all kinds of equipment had been prepared in the audition area. Everyone was ready to go.
The audition began. Chen Yun looked at the programs and nodded. The execution of Sacred Heaven Entertainment was indeed extraordinary.
In the first round of the qualifiers, only 60 people were chosen from among the thousands of people!
After the selection, Chen Yun brought the staff to a place to eat. Ma Ke reported the progress of the entire project.
Now, Jiang Shouheng had already swept through the entire Clear Sky Island with Cauldron Dragon Security and marked out the dangerous areas.
Previously, there were people online who said that there was no need to eliminate danger. After all, exploring the unknown was the most exciting.
This was simply brainless talk.
There was no need for elaboration. As long as one person died, this program would be cut short and they would lose everything!
Sacred Heaven’s reputation would also be damaged because of this.
Furthermore, no one in front of the screen would know whether they had swept away the danger.
In the next few days, Chen Yun had been holding the fort at the audition venue. Zhou Jingyi was also beside him.
Zhou Jingyi had already taken over part of the Desert Island Survival project. Her abilities had just begun to show and she had arranged everything in an orderly manner.
Chen Yun looked at her ability and nodded in affirmation.
Finally, it was time to start recording.
This time, the Desert Island Survival show was a live broadcast. The entire process was filmed.
The staff had already taken their positions on Clear Sky Island a few days in advance.
The participants arrived at Clear Sky Island on the day of the competition.
This was also arranged by Chen Yun. He wanted these contestants to endure and endure to the limit. Only then would they have the greatest desire.
At the same time, the entire Internet was broadcasting this unprecedented live-action adventure variety show!
It was Saturday. According to incomplete statistics, it was the moment of the broadcast.
On the phone, television, and computer, the total number of viewers reached 60 million!
Moreover, it was still rising!
Seeing that it was almost time, Ma Ke looked at the camera and walked onto the stage.

“Hello, everyone in front of the screen and the contestants at the venue. I’m the general manager of Sacred Heaven Entertainment, Ma Ke...” Ma Ke introduced the things to take note of for this segment. Then, the corners of his mouth curled into a cold smile. “I’ve recently seen many netizens online doubting the high value of the prizes. Today, let’s show our sincerity in doing this project well.”
The next moment, the camera was aimed at a spot not far from Ma Ke. All the contestants turned around at the same time.
A few armed security guards slowly untied the rope and pulled down the black cloth.
In an instant, be it the contestants or the staff!
Or the people in front of the screens!
Everyone’s hearts skipped a beat!
What was revealed under the black cloth was a pile of money that covered an area of a few square meters!
Under the sunlight, it bloomed with a red light that was as dazzling as a gem!
It was as if it was attracting everyone’s souls!
“This is 300 million yuan! They’re all brand new notes from the fifth series. One note weighs 1.15 grams. There are a total of 3.45 tons worth of money placed here! Contestants, these are all yours!”
“If you have the ability, bring the first prize home! Become a multi-millionaire!”
Ma Ke was sonorous and powerful. The three tons of money and Ma Ke’s powerful voice simply made one’s heart feel like it had been hit by a hammer!
Adrenaline surged!
No matter who it was, their faces turned red!
After all, there was so much money! There were so many banknotes!
Who had seen this before?!
In particular, when the contestants at the scene looked at these banknotes, they almost went crazy!
As long as they defeated the 499 people around them, they could become multi-millionaires!
There was no need to worry for the rest of their lives!
He could buy a few sets of luxury cars and houses!
Not to mention boyfriends and girlfriends!
With money, there were simply too many things they could do!
At this moment, everyone looked at Clear Sky Island in front of them with shining eyes. They wanted to rush in immediately and snatch the resources for survival!

Typically, if the people at the bottom wanted to earn 100 million yuan with their own hands, they could set a small goal first and strive to live for 200 years.
Then, they would borrow another 500 years from the heavens.
Moreover, this event was organized by Sacred Heaven Entertainment.
Sacred Heaven Entertainment was called the star creation factory.
Many capable celebrities of the current era were nurtured by Sacred Heaven Entertainment.
If they performed well in this show, they could step into the entertainment industry in the future!
Who wouldn’t want to enter the entertainment industry with such a high starting point?
“Director Chen, you’re here.” When Ma Ke heard his secretary’s report, he quickly came over to welcome Chen Yun.
Chen Yun turned around and moved his attention away from the crowd.
Then, he looked at Ma Ke.
“Have you confirmed the audition procedures?
Don’t let anything go wrong.”
“Don’t worry, Director Chen.”
Then, Chen Yun followed Ma Ke into the audition area.
At this moment, all kinds of equipment had been prepared in the audition area.
Everyone was ready to go.
The audition began.
Chen Yun looked at the programs and nodded.
The execution of Sacred Heaven Entertainment was indeed extraordinary.
In the first round of the qualifiers, only 60 people were chosen from among the thousands of people!
After the selection, Chen Yun brought the staff to a place to eat.
Ma Ke reported the progress of the entire project.
Now, Jiang Shouheng had already swept through the entire Clear Sky Island with Cauldron Dragon Security and marked out the dangerous areas.
Previously, there were people online who said that there was no need to eliminate danger.
After all, exploring the unknown was the most exciting.
This was simply brainless talk.
There was no need for elaboration.
As long as one person died, this program would be cut short and they would lose everything!
Sacred Heaven’s reputation would also be damaged because of this.
Furthermore, no one in front of the screen would know whether they had swept away the danger.
In the next few days, Chen Yun had been holding the fort at the audition venue.
Zhou Jingyi was also beside him.
Zhou Jingyi had already taken over part of the Desert Island Survival project.
Her abilities had just begun to show and she had arranged everything in an orderly manner.
Chen Yun looked at her ability and nodded in affirmation.
Finally, it was time to start recording.
This time, the Desert Island Survival show was a live broadcast.
The entire process was filmed.
The staff had already taken their positions on Clear Sky Island a few days in advance.
The participants arrived at Clear Sky Island on the day of the competition.
This was also arranged by Chen Yun.
He wanted these contestants to endure and endure to the limit.
Only then would they have the greatest desire.
At the same time, the entire Internet was broadcasting this unprecedented live-action adventure variety show!
It was Saturday.
According to incomplete statistics, it was the moment of the broadcast.
On the phone, television, and computer, the total number of viewers reached 60 million!
Moreover, it was still rising!
Seeing that it was almost time, Ma Ke looked at the camera and walked onto the stage.
“Hello, everyone in front of the screen and the contestants at the venue.
I’m the general manager of Sacred Heaven Entertainment, Ma Ke...” Ma Ke introduced the things to take note of for this segment.
Then, the corners of his mouth curled into a cold smile.
“I’ve recently seen many netizens online doubting the high value of the prizes.
Today, let’s show our sincerity in doing this project well.”
The next moment, the camera was aimed at a spot not far from Ma Ke.
All the contestants turned around at the same time.
A few armed security guards slowly untied the rope and pulled down the black cloth.
In an instant, be it the contestants or the staff!
Or the people in front of the screens!
Everyone’s hearts skipped a beat!
What was revealed under the black cloth was a pile of money that covered an area of a few square meters!
Under the sunlight, it bloomed with a red light that was as dazzling as a gem!
It was as if it was attracting everyone’s souls!
“This is 300 million yuan!
They’re all brand new notes from the fifth series.
One note weighs 1.15 grams.
There are a total of 3.45 tons worth of money placed here!
Contestants, these are all yours!”
“If you have the ability, bring the first prize home!
Become a multi-millionaire!”
Ma Ke was sonorous and powerful.
The three tons of money and Ma Ke’s powerful voice simply made one’s heart feel like it had been hit by a hammer!
Adrenaline surged!
No matter who it was, their faces turned red!
After all, there was so much money!
There were so many banknotes!
Who had seen this before?!
In particular, when the contestants at the scene looked at these banknotes, they almost went crazy!
As long as they defeated the 499 people around them, they could become multi-millionaires!
There was no need to worry for the rest of their lives!
He could buy a few sets of luxury cars and houses!
Not to mention boyfriends and girlfriends!
With money, there were simply too many things they could do!
At this moment, everyone looked at Clear Sky Island in front of them with shining eyes.
They wanted to rush in immediately and snatch the resources for survival!

chapters.title: Chapter 46: He Might Be Single
paragraphs: In front of the screen, many people jumped up from their sofa or beds.
“F*ck! I’ve really opened my eyes. That’s 300 million yuan in cash! They’re really rich!” In a dormitory of Jiang City Institute of Technology, Jiang Chengwu directly roared.
However, the remaining three people in the dormitory did not seem to mind that he was noisy. They were also immersed in shock.

“F*ck! I thought it was a lie. They really have prizes worth 300 million yuan!” After a long time, a boy slowly turned around. “If I had known, I would have participated too! The first place winner will obtain 100 million yuan!”
Such a scene was happening all over China.
It was crazy!
Almost everyone went crazy!
Ma Ke waved his hand. “Disburse the money!”
Then, each person received 100,000 yuan, and ten stacks of red notes landed in the hands of the people who passed the audition.
This was 100,000 yuan! It was the reward for passing the audition!
However, how could these participants be satisfied with 100,000 yuan now?
What they wanted was that pile of money!

“Next, let us invite Director Chen of Sacred Heaven Entertainment to Clear Sky Island to distribute survival cards and reward cards from our various sponsors.” As Ma Ke spoke, the camera immediately focused on the helicopters above them. In the lead helicopter, Chen Yun was sitting on it.
Then, Chen Yun led the helicopter fleet into Clear Sky Island and scattered the survival cards.
The helicopters behind split up and distributed the respective reward cards.
All of this was arranged by Chen Yun.
At this moment, he turned on the screen and looked at the time.
[Host, please complete the check-in.]
Chen Yun pressed the button.
[Check-in successful!]
[Obtained a supreme-grade spinner wheel! Two free spins will be added!]
The next moment, a light screen appeared, and an illusory spinner wheel appeared in front of Chen Yun.
There were not many slots. There were only four slots!
The first slot contained the Gun King Skill Pack.
The second slot contained the Full Brain Development Skill.
The third slot was an item, which was an antioxidant chlorella.
The fourth slot contained the Tenfold Return Skill.
Chen Yun looked at these four slots covetously.
He opened the introduction of the items.
[Gun King Skill Pack: Contains a full set of the Full Firearm Skill and muscle memory. The Skill Pack will give you a Desert Eagle with unlimited bullets.]

[Full Brain Development: Now, only a small portion of the human brain has been developed. Full Brain Development can fully develop the brain, increasing one’s memory and intelligence to an unprecedented level.]

[Antioxidant Chlorella: Human deaths are caused by free radicals. The liquid produced by the photosynthesis of the antioxidant chlorella can resist oxidation and extend life. Continuous consumption can extend lifespan to 180 years.]
[Tenfold Return: The amount spent will be returned tenfold.]
Chen Yun looked at these things. As expected of a supreme-grade spinner wheel!
Any one of them made Chen Yun want to obtain them.
However, he only had two chances to draw the lottery now, and the Random Double dice did not appear. This meant that he could not use the Random Double Skill and could not double the chances.
Damn it.
“Let’s draw the lottery.”
These were all top-grade rewards. There was no difference between good and bad.
The needle turned.
Finally, it stopped on the slot containing the antioxidant chlorella.
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining the antioxidant chlorella.]
Oh?
He actually obtained this thing.
Then, he drew again.
[Congratulations to the host for obtaining the Gun King Skill Pack!]
The next moment, a strange feeling filled Chen Yun’s body. A lot of knowledge about firearms and marksmanship entered his mind.
After tidying up, Chen Yun realized that he had not just obtained this knowledge. It also increased his investigative ability, insight, and many indescribable changes.

“Is this the change brought about by the Gun King Skill Pack?” Chen Yun smiled and touched the inner pocket of his suit. A Desert Eagle was placed upside down inside. Chen Yun touched the grip of the Desert Eagle.
With a gun in hand, he was the king of the world! Such a disdainful feeling made Chen Yun, who was slow to react, smile bitterly.
After two lottery draws, the supreme-grade spinner wheel disappeared.

Then, Chen Yun looked to his side. A bottle had inexplicably appeared. There were small algae inside, and every one of them emitted a blue light. The water in the entire bottle was also blue, as dazzling as the light emitted by radium.
After distributing the rewards and survival cards, the helicopter fleet returned and the competition officially began.
“Director Chen, you’ve worked hard.”
When Ma Ke saw Chen Yun return, he quickly went up to him.
At this moment, Chen Yun had received his rewards and was in a good mood. He led Ma Ke towards the live-stream.
Meanwhile, Xiao Xin was looking at the screen and explaining to the three guests beside her.
The director on the other side would switch between the contestants’ scenes from time to time.
“Oh? This contestant is advancing very quickly. He’s already more than 300 meters into the rainforest.” Xiao Xin looked at the screen and slowly said, “He seems to have seen something.”
The camera zoomed in.
“It’s a reward card! This contestant is the first among all the contestants to pick up a reward card. Let’s see what he got.” Xiao Xin looked at the words on the card through the camera.
“A box of sports protection products provided by the well-known sports protection brand JISSBON1...”
Xiao Xin was silent.
Um, she felt a little awkward.
When Chen Yun, who had just entered the live-stream, heard Xiao Xin’s words, he saw the contestant throw the card away and run forward.
Xiao Xin was confused.
The JISSBON sponsor who was in the live-stream was speechless.
The director was also in despair. He gave Xiao Xin a look and pouted to the side.
Xiao Xin looked at the sponsor beside the director. Her face was ashen. She immediately understood what the director meant.
“Ahem, this contestant might... erm... Yes, he’s single. It’s useless for him to keep the JISSBON around.”
“Thus, he gave it up and left it for the contestants behind.”
“What a noble contestant! Let us applaud him!”
Chen Yun was speechless.
This contestant was really pitiful. He was actually labeled as a single man.
In front of the screen, many people listened to Xiao Xin’s explanation and directly spat water.
“Damn, this is too hardcore.”
“Good use of words!”
“I feel the mockery from the world towards single people. Fortunately, I’m not single.”
“I’m dying of laughter, but this commentator is really beautiful.”
“Don’t you know her? She’s the God of Luck! The news about her has gone viral.”
For a moment, Xiao Xin attracted many fans again.

In a temporary wooden house on Clear Sky Island, Zhou Jingyi was reporting to Ma Ke. “CEO Ma, Sacred Heaven Entertainment’s share price has risen by 6% since the opening of the market today, and it’s still rising.”
“Now, the number of viewers watching the Desert Island Survival segment online has already reached 80 million. It’s heading towards the 100 million mark!”

chapters.title: Chapter 47: It’s Too Difficult to Be Handsome!
paragraphs: Sacred Heaven Entertainment relied on the Desert Island Survival segment to become popular again in the entire China. All the entertainment companies could not help but be envious and jealous.

However, that being said, Sacred Heaven Entertainment was doing their best to create the Desert Island Survival variety show this time. Moreover, Chen Yun had invested a billion yuan into the show and 300 million yuan in prize money!
Furthermore, the related promotions were also a classic example of violent marketing.
They were rich!

Almost no company was willing to spend money without a cost. The effect was indeed good, but if there was any mistake along the way, they might lose everything and cause the entire company’s reputation to be severely damaged!
However, Sacred Heaven Entertainment was not afraid. It was now controlled by Chen Yun and did not treat money as money at all.
Many entertainment companies were envious when they saw the huge influence and brand effect of Sacred Heaven Entertainment.
However, no one could stop them.
They could not imitate them either!

“He’s really amazing. This wave of operations created the first wilderness survival program in the entire China. Moreover, they did not hesitate to spend a lot of money to create it. It’s inevitable that they have such results.”
“Although they invested a lot in the early stages, the profits in the future are indeed huge. The film and television impact on the entire company and related variety shows is also relevant.”
“At this rate, the strength of the entire Sacred Heaven Entertainment can go up another level. In a few years, it might become one of the top entertainment companies in China.”

In the industry, many marketing experts and managers sighed when they saw Sacred Heaven Entertainment’s success. They also wanted to do this, but firstly, they did not have the capital. Secondly, they did not have the guts.
From the looks of it, Sacred Heaven Entertainment’s success this time was a coincidence, but it was also inevitable.

Chen Yun did not pay attention to these things. After all, his check-in mission had been completed and he had obtained two supreme-grade rewards. It was completely worth it to throw out a billion yuan for nothing, let alone now.
Instead, it made the entire Sacred Heaven rise to another level!
After instructing Ma Ke, Chen Yun went back. With Ma Ke here, he was more at ease.
In less than an hour by helicopter, Chen Yun returned to Jiang City.

Then, he made a trip to school. Chen Yun did not go to school much ever since he had the system. After all, he was already in his third year of university and could be considered a senior student. The teacher knew very well that he was only in charge of teaching and could not be bothered to take attendance.

After all, there were many people in their third year who took postgraduate examinations, looked for jobs, and looked for internships. Therefore, the teachers were not surprised that one-third of the class was empty.

It had been a long time since he went to the classroom. Chen Yun realized that in the classroom, while the teacher was teaching, almost all the students were watching the Desert Island Survival segment.
This shocked Chen Yun.
After all, they were also a school under the 211 Project. The students had a certain level of self-control, but...
Such a situation happened.
It could only mean that Sacred Heaven’s publicity this time was too good. The attraction of this program and the prize money was too strong!
After listening in the classroom for a while, Chen Yun felt extremely bored. What the teacher taught him had been taught during his first and second years of university. He had long learned it.
Before school ended at noon, a call came. He took out his phone and looked at it. “Auntie Song!”

Auntie Song was his mother’s childhood friend and best friend. After university, she married and moved into Jiang City before opening her own lighting company. It was a company with dozens of people and was not small.

When he was in his first and second year of university, Auntie Song would call him to her home from time to time to cook delicious food for him. Alternatively, she would personally send him some good stewed vegetables, such as sea cucumbers and abalones, to school to give him. This made him feel the warmth of home in a foreign land.
“Auntie Song?”
“Xiao Yun, come over for dinner today. Yuanyuan and I will pick you up from your school later.”
“Auntie Song, there’s no need to trouble yourself.” Chen Yun smiled bitterly. “I have another class later.”

“It’s fine. We’ll wait for you at the entrance of your school. You’re not allowed to refuse. Don’t be so polite. Alright, let’s not talk about it. I’m driving.” Auntie Song did not give Chen Yun a chance to refuse.
This...
Auntie Song was still so swift and decisive. She was really a strong woman.
After class, he walked out of the school gate.
At this moment, a bright red E-Class Mercedes-Benz was parked at the school gate. Two beauties, one big and one small, were sitting in the driver’s seat and the passenger seat respectively.

The older one looked to be in her thirties. She had a pretty face and was wearing a professional suit, which accentuated her slender figure. Her exquisite makeup showed that she was intellectual and dressed like an urban beauty.
Meanwhile, the younger one looked like she was in his twenties. Her appearance was even more outstanding. At this moment, her face was still a little cold, giving off a cold and arrogant feeling.
They were Auntie Song and her daughter, Wang Yuanyuan.
At this moment, Wang Yuanyuan was looking at her phone and replying to her best friend.
“Mom, can I not eat at home today? My best friend asked me to go out.” Wang Yuanyuan looked impatient. They had agreed to go out to play today.
In the end, her mother called Chen Yun and cut her off.
Seriously!
At the side, Auntie Song rolled down the car window and looked outside. “Why isn’t Xiao Yun out yet? Did he pass by us? I’ll get out of the car and wait.”
Chen Yun was the child of her best friend and childhood friend. He was alone in this city. As his aunt, how could she be at ease?
“Hey! Listen to me!” Wang Yuanyuan got out of the car angrily when she saw her mother like this.
Seriously!
“Mom, why isn’t he here yet? I have to go out in the afternoon. If not, Fanfan will be unhappy.”
Auntie Song’s face instantly turned stiff. “What’s there to be impatient about? He’s a guest. Besides, where are you going this afternoon?”

“A fighting fitness club has opened in Jiang City. Fanfan asked me to go out and play there,” said Wang Yuanyuan. Then, she recalled Chen Yun. She had seen him a few times, but Chen Yun did not give her a good impression. He was dressed simply. Although he was quite clean-looking, he did not have much in common with her.

After all, the two of them had different circles and levels. It was too difficult to talk to each other. If they were placed together, the two of them would probably not be able to speak for a long time. In such a situation, she still had to accompany the guest. Wasn’t this making things difficult for her? Moreover, it was extremely boring.
“Do you know how to fight? Or do you know how to work out? Besides, why would a girl go there? You’re not allowed to go.”
“Mom! Fanfan’s boyfriend and the others are also there. They all went together. What’s there to worry about?”
Wang Yuanyuan was about to act cute when she heard many exclamations from afar.
“Look at that handsome man. He’s so handsome!”

“This must be a handsome man from Jiang City University of the Arts. If he debuts, I’ll definitely be his fan for the rest of my life. Look, he’s looking over!” A girl pulled her best friend beside her and spoke excitedly.
There were even girls who walked forward. “Brother, add me on WeChat.”
Chen Yun looked at the girls who came up to ask for his WeChat and was on the brink of tears. He just wanted to see Auntie Song as soon as possible. Why was it so difficult?!
It was simply too difficult to be too handsome!
