We’ll wait for you at the entrance of your school.
You’re not allowed to refuse.
Don’t be so polite.
Alright, let’s not talk about it.
I’m driving.” Auntie Song did not give Chen Yun a chance to refuse.
This...
Auntie Song was still so swift and decisive.
She was really a strong woman.
After class, he walked out of the school gate.
At this moment, a bright red E-Class Mercedes-Benz was parked at the school gate.
Two beauties, one big and one small, were sitting in the driver’s seat and the passenger seat respectively.
The older one looked to be in her thirties.
She had a pretty face and was wearing a professional suit, which accentuated her slender figure.
Her exquisite makeup showed that she was intellectual and dressed like an urban beauty.
Meanwhile, the younger one looked like she was in his twenties.
Her appearance was even more outstanding.
At this moment, her face was still a little cold, giving off a cold and arrogant feeling.
They were Auntie Song and her daughter, Wang Yuanyuan.
At this moment, Wang Yuanyuan was looking at her phone and replying to her best friend.
“Mom, can I not eat at home today?
My best friend asked me to go out.” Wang Yuanyuan looked impatient.
They had agreed to go out to play today.
In the end, her mother called Chen Yun and cut her off.
Seriously!
At the side, Auntie Song rolled down the car window and looked outside.
“Why isn’t Xiao Yun out yet?
Did he pass by us?
I’ll get out of the car and wait.”
Chen Yun was the child of her best friend and childhood friend.
He was alone in this city.
As his aunt, how could she be at ease?
“Hey!
Listen to me!” Wang Yuanyuan got out of the car angrily when she saw her mother like this.
Seriously!
“Mom, why isn’t he here yet?
I have to go out in the afternoon.
If not, Fanfan will be unhappy.”
Auntie Song’s face instantly turned stiff.
“What’s there to be impatient about?
He’s a guest.
Besides, where are you going this afternoon?”
“A fighting fitness club has opened in Jiang City.
Fanfan asked me to go out and play there,” said Wang Yuanyuan.
Then, she recalled Chen Yun.
She had seen him a few times, but Chen Yun did not give her a good impression.
He was dressed simply.
Although he was quite clean-looking, he did not have much in common with her.
After all, the two of them had different circles and levels.
It was too difficult to talk to each other.
If they were placed together, the two of them would probably not be able to speak for a long time.
In such a situation, she still had to accompany the guest.
Wasn’t this making things difficult for her?
Moreover, it was extremely boring.
“Do you know how to fight?
Or do you know how to work out?
Besides, why would a girl go there?
You’re not allowed to go.”
“Mom!
Fanfan’s boyfriend and the others are also there.
They all went together.
What’s there to worry about?”
Wang Yuanyuan was about to act cute when she heard many exclamations from afar.
“Look at that handsome man.
He’s so handsome!”
“This must be a handsome man from Jiang City University of the Arts.
If he debuts, I’ll definitely be his fan for the rest of my life.
Look, he’s looking over!” A girl pulled her best friend beside her and spoke excitedly.
There were even girls who walked forward.
“Brother, add me on WeChat.”
Chen Yun looked at the girls who came up to ask for his WeChat and was on the brink of tears.
He just wanted to see Auntie Song as soon as possible.
Why was it so difficult?!
It was simply too difficult to be too handsome!

chapters.title: Chapter 48: The Coldness and Warmth of Human Nature
paragraphs: “I’m sorry, I have an emergency.”
“Excuse me.”
“We’ll add each other on WeChat in the future, in the future.”
As Chen Yun explained, he walked forward. Only when he walked out of the school gate did he see Auntie Song and Wang Yuanyuan, who was beside her.
“Auntie Song, Yuanyuan, sorry to keep you waiting.” Chen Yun greeted them.
Even Auntie Song was stunned.

“Are... are you Xiao Yun? Aiya, I didn’t recognize you before you spoke. I’ve been busy recently and haven’t seen you in a long time. I didn’t expect you to lose so much weight. Alright, you look good after losing weight.” Auntie Song couldn’t stop smiling.
Even Wang Yuanyuan’s eyes lit up.
This set of clothes was too suitable for Chen Yun. Or rather, it was tailor-made for Chen Yun.

Coupled with Chen Yun’s face, his entire disposition suddenly improved. If she didn’t know Chen Yun’s family background and how poor he used to be, she would really think that he was the young master of a wealthy family.
Actually, she had not guessed wrong. This was a suit that Chen Yun had specially customized for an important occasion.
One set cost 800,000 yuan!
He had hired a famous European designer to customize it. There was only one piece in the world. He would not encounter a situation where he wore the same outfit as someone else.

“You’re clearly not capable, and you’re still dressed like this in school.” Wang Yuanyuan glanced at Chen Yun and snorted. She did not have a good impression of Chen Yun to begin with, and she resisted her mother’s intention to let them interact more. In addition, Chen Yun’s family matters and the fact that she had waited for so long made her only greet Chen Yun before turning around and getting into the car.
“Xiao Yun, get in the car quickly.” Auntie Song pulled Chen Yun into the car.
Chen Yun sat in the back and looked at the woman in the driver’s seat. He was still extremely grateful.
Ever since he went to university, Auntie Song had been taking care of him.

“It just so happens that Uncle is also at home today, and I also managed to get an off day in time. Since we don’t have anything to do, we just gathered together. We didn’t delay your matters, right?” Auntie Song asked.
“No, Auntie Song. Thank you for your trouble.” Chen Yun smiled.
“Mom, I still have something to do in the afternoon. Can you let me go?” Wang Yuanyuan turned around and said when she heard her mother’s words.

Auntie Song pinched Wang Yuanyuan’s leg and shut her up. Then, she looked at Chen Yun. “Child, why are you being so polite with me? Your mother and I grew up together. Since you came to Jiang City, how can I not take care of you?”

“By the way, Xiao Yun, since you don’t have anything to do in the afternoon, go out to play with Yuanyuan. She said that she wants to go to the fighting fitness club. I’ll be at ease if you accompany her.”

“Alright.” Chen Yun nodded. Although he was quite helpless towards Wang Yuanyuan and knew that she did not have a good impression of him, she was Auntie Song’s child after all. They had to have a passable relationship on the surface.
However, if one asked them to become close friends, then forget it. He could not afford to offend such a princess-like young lady.
The car crossed the bridge and headed north.
Wang Yuanyuan rolled down the car window and looked outside. “Mom, look at the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion. It’s really beautiful.”

“Every time we drive past this place, you’ll look at it. I don’t have the ability to buy it for you in my life. If you’re capable, buy it yourself. If possible, let me live in it. I want to see such a high-end neighborhood too.” Auntie Song teased Wang Yuanyuan.
However, there was also yearning and envy in her eyes.
After all, that was the most luxurious neighborhood in Jiang City or even the entire Jiangbei.
Any one villa cost tens of millions. Legend had it that a few of the buildings were worth nearly a billion yuan!
Only the high-ranking officials and nobles of Jiang City were qualified to live there. In fact, they were the highest-ranking officials and nobles!

When Wang Yuanyuan heard this, she shrugged. It was easier said than done to live here. Among the boys she knew, although their families were not bad, it was still a fantasy to buy a house in the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion.
From time to time, she would joke with her best friend. If anyone had a house in the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion, she would definitely stick to them.
There was no need to comment on her materialism. After all, the current society was like this.
If there was no love, it could be nurtured slowly. However, if one didn’t have material wealth, when love dissipated, there would really be nothing.
“Auntie Song, when I buy a house here, I’ll let you and my mother move in.” Chen Yun looked at the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion and chuckled.
“Alright, Xiao Yun. If you earn money in the future, be sure to bring your mother over.”

At the side, Wang Yuanyuan could not help but purse her lips when she heard Chen Yun’s words. He was from the suburban area and did not have any connections. Yet, he wanted to buy a villa in the Imperial Dragon Heaven Pavilion?
He should work hard for a house in Jiang City first.

“I originally thought that he was a simple and slow person. I didn’t expect him to like to brag now. Such a person is hopeless.” Wang Yuanyuan shook her head and put on her earphones alone to listen to songs.

When they arrived at the district, Chen Yun looked at this district. The layout was simple and elegant. It could be considered a school district. He had previously heard that a square meter here cost close to 40,000 yuan.
To Chen Yun back then, it was simply an astronomical price. However, it was not much now. After all, he had investments worth a billion yuan. A billion yuan was enough to buy a few buildings here!
After entering the house, he saw that Auntie Song’s house was decorated in a classic European style. When he entered, he felt a gentle light shining on her body.
In the living room opposite them, a middle-aged man was reading a report on the sofa.
He was Wang Yuanyuan’s father, Wang Qing.
When the middle-aged man saw Chen Yun, he looked up slightly. “You’re here?”
“Hello, Uncle Wang.”

“Xiao Yun, go watch TV for a while. I’ll go cook. I’ll be done in a while.” Auntie Song looked at Wang Yuanyuan, who was about to leave, and grabbed her. “Yuanyuan, go and watch TV with Xiao Yun. We have a guest over. Why don’t you know anything?”
Wang Yuanyuan sighed and pouted. “Alright, alright, alright. I understand.”

After Chen Yun sat down, Wang Yuanyuan still poured tea for him. She took some dried fruits, made a fruit plate, and placed it in front of him. “Chen Yun, eat some fruits. I’ll prepare more after you’re done.”
Like Chen Yun, she had to at least live up to her reputation.
It was a matter of pride, but she was helpless.
“Alright, thank you.” Chen Yun nodded.
On the other side, Wang Qing finished reading the report and tidied up before turning around to observe Chen Yun. “How have your parents been recently?”
“It’s alright. They’re preparing to resign recently and are doing some business at home,” replied Chen Yun.
“Yes, even at this age, we have to buy and sell to earn money.”
Chen Yun said humbly, “My parents don’t do big business either. They can’t compare to Auntie Song at all. She has dozens of subordinates and her career is improving day by day.”

Wang Qing looked at Chen Yun and shook his head. He also knew what his wife meant, but the two sides were not compatible. The other party was only from a small county, and his family background was average.

Moreover, he was now at the department level and his wife earned hundreds of thousands of yuan every year. They were both famous figures. No matter what, it was impossible for both sides to get along.
The difference was too great.

chapters.title: Chapter 49: They’re Not a Good Match
paragraphs: “You’re in your third year of university now, right? How is it? Have you thought of a job?”
“I don’t have any plans.”
The smile on Wang Qing’s face dimmed even more. How could Chen Yun not have plans for the future?
Chen Yun didn’t know that Wang Qing had taken his words seriously, causing Wang Qing’s impression of him to decrease again and again.
“I thought you’d gone to some interview when I saw how well you were dressed.”
“No, I just went out to attend an event and rushed back.”
“Now, you still have to prioritize your studies. You’re going to graduate from an Institute of Technology under the 211 Project, so it’s not a problem for you to get a salary of more than 10K.”
Chen Yun nodded. A salary of more than 10K, which was more than 10,000 yuan a month, was not bad for ordinary people, but for the current Chen Yun, hehe.
Then, Wang Qing chatted with Chen Yun for a while and realized that he did not know much about national matters and policies. His smile immediately disappeared.
In his opinion, Chen Yun would only develop in his job in the future. The ceiling was too low, which completely disappointed him.

“They’re not a good match.” Wang Qing sighed in his heart. Then, he thought of the boys in Wang Yuanyuan’s circle. Although those children’s families were not very good, they were compatible with their family.
He would forget about the boy in front of him.
Then, Wang Qing did not say anything to Chen Yun.
Chen Yun was also happy to be free. As he ate, he had to admit that Auntie Song’s culinary skills were on point. They were not much different from the food at East Sea City.
During the meal, only Auntie Song spoke a lot to Chen Yun. Wang Qing and Wang Yuanyuan were cold to Chen Yun.
After the meal.
“Mom, I’m leaving. Shu Fan is looking for me.” Wang Yuanyuan was about to walk out when Auntie Song suddenly pulled her back. “Go with Xiao Yun. Otherwise, I’ll be worried.”
“Oh my god, it’s not like I’m going alone.” Wang Yuanyuan was in complete despair. “Alright, alright, alright. Chen Yun, let’s go.”
How could she dare to disobey? Otherwise, her living expenses for the next month would definitely be halved.
She could not afford to offend her mother.
The two of them went out. Wang Qing sat on the sofa and continued to read the report until Auntie Song was done cleaning up.

“Don’t bring this child back in the future. The difference in class is too great.” Wang Qing’s words made Auntie Song’s expression change. She said, “I also came from a small county. Wang Qing, are you saying that I’m not worthy of you?”
“After becoming a section chief, you talk about class all day long. If you had a higher position, you would have forgotten who planted the crops for you.”
Wang Qing also threw the report aside. “Am I wrong? Now that our class has been solidified, do you still think that it’s the same as back then? Is only relying on hard work useful?”
Discordant voices immediately came from the house.
Meanwhile, just as Chen Yun and Wang Yuanyuan left the district, someone got out of the two cars beside them.
“Yuanyuan!”
Two girls came over and looked at Wang Yuanyuan. Wang Yuanyuan also quickly ran over.
The two of them were Wang Yuanyuan’s childhood friends, Shu Fan and Ye Xinyu.
“Hey, why are you bringing a handsome man? Is he your boyfriend?”
The two of them looked at Chen Yun and their eyes lit up. Ye Xinyu could not help but ask.

Wang Yuanyuan waved her hand and lowered her voice. “Aiya, stop talking. I’m so annoyed. My mother’s best friend’s child is called Chen Yun. He came from a small county and is studying in Jiang City. From my mother’s point of view, she wants me to give him a try. Urgh!”
“He doesn’t have any ability, but he still likes to exaggerate. Tsk!” Wang Yuanyuan pursed her lips and lowered her voice even further, afraid that Chen Yun would hear her.
“That doesn’t mean that he has no potential,” said Shu Fan slowly as she stole a glance at Chen Yun.
“What’s the use of having potential?” Ye Xinyu waved her hand. “Since you don’t like him, I’ll deal with him. I’ll show him how difficult it is and make him retreat.”
Wang Yuanyuan glanced at Ye Xinyu. “Come on, what can you do?”
At this moment, Chen Yun slowly walked over.
Chen Yun looked at the two girls in front of him. These two girls were especially beautiful, especially the tall and thin girl beside him.

The two girls had different expressions. The shorter girl was dressed in branded clothes. Even the Louis Vuitton logo on her bag was especially eye-catching. She wore earrings and had a butterfly tattoo on her exposed collarbone.
Although Chen Yun did not know the exact price of her clothes, that bag alone was definitely worth more than ten thousand yuan.

Compared to this girl, the tall and thin girl beside her was much simpler. She wore a beige top and denim shorts, which revealed two slender and straight legs. She was 1.7 meters tall and had a beautiful figure. Coupled with her outstanding looks, she was enough to compete with Xiao Xin from the modeling department.
At this moment, Ye Xinyu, who was dressed in branded clothes, had her arms crossed over her chest. She even had a Louis Vuitton bag hanging on her arm as she sized up Chen Yun.
How strange!
Chen Yun’s clothes were interesting. They looked quite exquisite, but there was not even a logo.
There was no trademark, which meant that his clothes weren’t even branded.
Those luxury brands wished they could expand their logo infinitely. How could they produce such clothes?
She snorted and glanced at Chen Yun.

“Are you Chen Yun? Do you want to pursue our Yuanyuan?” Ye Xinyu raised her chin proudly. “As a person, you have to recognize your status. Don’t always reach outside of your league. Aren’t you afraid of hurting your teeth? If you know your place, give up early.”
“Xiao Yu!” Shu Fan glanced at her. These words were too much.
Beside her, Wang Yuanyuan also explained to Chen Yun, “Chen Yun, don’t misunderstand. That’s not what she meant.”
Wasn’t that what she meant? Was there another way to interpret her words just now?
Moreover, if Wang Yuanyuan had not said anything to Ye Xinyu just now, she would not have said such things.
Chen Yun smiled. “Don’t worry. I’m just listening to Auntie Song and accompanying her for the afternoon.”
“I hope so.” Ye Xinyu snorted.
Shu Fan looked at the scene and walked up to Chen Yun. They introduced themselves, including Ye Xinyu.
“Chen Yun, Xiao Yu is that kind of person. Don’t take it to heart. Don’t be angry,” Shu Fan explained, making Chen Yun nod.

At this moment, two more cars arrived. One was a Cadillac, and the other was a Lincoln. Many young men and women got out of the car. Every one of them was wearing branded clothes. It was obvious that they were children from rich families.
“Zhouning, you’re here!”
Ye Xinyu looked at the tall young man walking towards her and pounced on him like a little bird.
“Xiao Yu, who is this?” Wang Zhouning looked in Chen Yun’s direction and asked.
“He’s a poor boy from another city. Yuanyuan’s mother insisted that he accompany her. Yuanyuan is so annoyed.”
Wang Zhouning glanced at Chen Yun and sneered. He was quite handsome, but was it useful to only have a handsome face?
He waved his arm and allocated the people into each car.
In the end, he looked at Chen Yun. “Eh? Yuanyuan, is your friend going too?”
After receiving an affirmative answer, Wang Zhouning slapped his forehead. “Aiya, aiya, brother, I didn’t expect you to go too. The cars are full.”
“How about this? The place we’re going isn’t far from here. Sorry to trouble you, but why don’t you get a shared bike and ride over?”
“I’ll pay for all the other expenses today. Can you just pay for the bicycle?”
As soon as he said this, many young men and women beside him roared with laughter.
Chen Yun’s eyes suddenly turned cold.

Now that our class has been solidified, do you still think that it’s the same as back then?
Is only relying on hard work useful?”
Discordant voices immediately came from the house.
Meanwhile, just as Chen Yun and Wang Yuanyuan left the district, someone got out of the two cars beside them.
“Yuanyuan!”
Two girls came over and looked at Wang Yuanyuan.
Wang Yuanyuan also quickly ran over.
The two of them were Wang Yuanyuan’s childhood friends, Shu Fan and Ye Xinyu.
“Hey, why are you bringing a handsome man?
Is he your boyfriend?”
The two of them looked at Chen Yun and their eyes lit up.
Ye Xinyu could not help but ask.
Wang Yuanyuan waved her hand and lowered her voice.
“Aiya, stop talking.
I’m so annoyed.
My mother’s best friend’s child is called Chen Yun.
He came from a small county and is studying in Jiang City.
From my mother’s point of view, she wants me to give him a try.
Urgh!”
“He doesn’t have any ability, but he still likes to exaggerate.
Tsk!” Wang Yuanyuan pursed her lips and lowered her voice even further, afraid that Chen Yun would hear her.
“That doesn’t mean that he has no potential,” said Shu Fan slowly as she stole a glance at Chen Yun.
“What’s the use of having potential?” Ye Xinyu waved her hand.
“Since you don’t like him, I’ll deal with him.
I’ll show him how difficult it is and make him retreat.”
Wang Yuanyuan glanced at Ye Xinyu.
“Come on, what can you do?”
At this moment, Chen Yun slowly walked over.
Chen Yun looked at the two girls in front of him.
These two girls were especially beautiful, especially the tall and thin girl beside him.
The two girls had different expressions.
The shorter girl was dressed in branded clothes.
Even the Louis Vuitton logo on her bag was especially eye-catching.
She wore earrings and had a butterfly tattoo on her exposed collarbone.
Although Chen Yun did not know the exact price of her clothes, that bag alone was definitely worth more than ten thousand yuan.
Compared to this girl, the tall and thin girl beside her was much simpler.
She wore a beige top and denim shorts, which revealed two slender and straight legs.
She was 1.7 meters tall and had a beautiful figure.
Coupled with her outstanding looks, she was enough to compete with Xiao Xin from the modeling department.
At this moment, Ye Xinyu, who was dressed in branded clothes, had her arms crossed over her chest.
She even had a Louis Vuitton bag hanging on her arm as she sized up Chen Yun.
How strange!
Chen Yun’s clothes were interesting.
They looked quite exquisite, but there was not even a logo.
There was no trademark, which meant that his clothes weren’t even branded.
Those luxury brands wished they could expand their logo infinitely.
How could they produce such clothes?
She snorted and glanced at Chen Yun.
“Are you Chen Yun?
Do you want to pursue our Yuanyuan?” Ye Xinyu raised her chin proudly.
“As a person, you have to recognize your status.
Don’t always reach outside of your league.
Aren’t you afraid of hurting your teeth?
If you know your place, give up early.”
“Xiao Yu!” Shu Fan glanced at her.
These words were too much.
Beside her, Wang Yuanyuan also explained to Chen Yun, “Chen Yun, don’t misunderstand.
That’s not what she meant.”
Wasn’t that what she meant?
Was there another way to interpret her words just now?
Moreover, if Wang Yuanyuan had not said anything to Ye Xinyu just now, she would not have said such things.
Chen Yun smiled.
“Don’t worry.
I’m just listening to Auntie Song and accompanying her for the afternoon.”
“I hope so.” Ye Xinyu snorted.
Shu Fan looked at the scene and walked up to Chen Yun.
They introduced themselves, including Ye Xinyu.
“Chen Yun, Xiao Yu is that kind of person.
Don’t take it to heart.
Don’t be angry,” Shu Fan explained, making Chen Yun nod.
At this moment, two more cars arrived.
One was a Cadillac, and the other was a Lincoln.
Many young men and women got out of the car.
Every one of them was wearing branded clothes.
It was obvious that they were children from rich families.
“Zhouning, you’re here!”
Ye Xinyu looked at the tall young man walking towards her and pounced on him like a little bird.
“Xiao Yu, who is this?” Wang Zhouning looked in Chen Yun’s direction and asked.
“He’s a poor boy from another city.
Yuanyuan’s mother insisted that he accompany her.
Yuanyuan is so annoyed.”
Wang Zhouning glanced at Chen Yun and sneered.
He was quite handsome, but was it useful to only have a handsome face?
He waved his arm and allocated the people into each car.
In the end, he looked at Chen Yun.
“Eh?
Yuanyuan, is your friend going too?”
After receiving an affirmative answer, Wang Zhouning slapped his forehead.
“Aiya, aiya, brother, I didn’t expect you to go too.
The cars are full.”
“How about this?
The place we’re going isn’t far from here.
Sorry to trouble you, but why don’t you get a shared bike and ride over?”
“I’ll pay for all the other expenses today.
Can you just pay for the bicycle?”
As soon as he said this, many young men and women beside him roared with laughter.
Chen Yun’s eyes suddenly turned cold.

chapters.title: Chapter 50: Rules
paragraphs: Everyone was following Wang Zhouning. Even if there were still seats, they would not let Chen Yun get into the cars.
Moreover, it would be quite fun for him to ride a shared bike there.
A person riding a bicycle in a suit had a different flavor.
Chen Yun sneered and looked at Wang Zhouning with an extremely cold gaze.
Beside them, Wang Yuanyuan also frowned when she saw this scene. After all, Chen Yun had followed her out.
It was not good for Chen Yun to be bullied like this. It was her mother’s idea and had nothing to do with Chen Yun.
Now, he was treated as a joke. It could be said that she was the one who caused it.
Just as she was about to speak, Shu Fan, who was standing beside Chen Yun, looked at him. “Chen Yun, there’s still room in my car. You can take my car.”
Everyone was stunned.
Ye Xinyu pulled Shu Fan over. “What are you doing? Have you taken a fancy to this kid?”

“Don’t talk nonsense. Do you think it’s fun to bully people like this? I just can’t stand you going overboard.” Shu Fan pinched Ye Xinyu, making her roll her eyes. “Alright, alright, alright. You’re the embodiment of justice.”
“You, Chen Yun, right? Come with us. Let’s go.” After Ye Xinyu finished speaking, Wang Zhouning and the others also looked at Shu Fan in confusion.
“Chen Yun, let’s go. Get in the car.” Shu Fan brought Chen Yun into the car. Wang Yuanyuan, who was left, was stunned. An indescribable feeling suddenly rose in her heart.
Why did it feel like her friends were toxic? It was as if someone had taken her things.
This was despite the fact that she didn’t want it. No, it didn’t seem to be hers at all.
Shu Fan rolled down the car window and looked at Wang Yuanyuan. “Yuanyuan, why aren’t you getting into the car?”
“Coming, coming.”

Everyone got out of the car and arrived at the Mountain Road Fitness Fighting Club. They looked at the configuration in front of them and their eyes widened. This area was probably a few thousand square meters large. Moreover, the exterior was luxuriously decorated. It was not inferior to a high-end club.
“Tsk tsk, I didn’t expect this place to be so big and decorated so luxuriously.”
“Yes, I heard that it’s Young Master Zheng’s place.”
“Young Master Zheng? Which Young Master Zheng?” When she heard Wang Zhouning’s words, Ye Xinyu asked.
“There’s no other Young Master Zheng in Jiang City. Of course, it’s the Young Master of the Qingshan Group, Zheng Jianghao.”
As soon as these words were spoken, everyone was stunned.
This!
Zheng Jianghao!
He was the top young master of Jiang City!
The Qingshan Group had already been listed and was worth more than a billion yuan. Moreover, its net worth was getting higher and higher. Zheng Jianghao was the Young Master of the Qingshan Group.
His father was a hero, but he was the same. Zheng Jianghao’s father had single-handedly established the Qingshan Group. Zheng Jianghao had also taken over the company’s matters early and did well.
Among the young masters and young ladies of Jiang City, he was considered outstanding. Some CEOs even predicted that Zheng Jianghao could lead the Qingshan Group to another level.
It was all because of Zheng Jianghao’s connections and skills.

Wang Zhouning looked at everyone’s reaction and immediately felt proud. “I heard that Young Master Zheng didn’t open this fighting fitness club alone. There were also a few young masters who invested in it.”
“Alright, alright. Let’s go in.”
Wang Zhouning smiled and walked in. Inside, the deputy manager saw Wang Zhouning and the others and quickly welcomed them with a smile.
“Business is not bad today, Brother Zhao.” Wang Zhouning looked at the man in front of him. “Brother Zhao, arrange a place for me. Is there anyone else in Hall One?”
“This...” The man suddenly looked troubled. “I’m really sorry. Hall One has been booked for a month. Why don’t you change halls?”
“Who is it? They’re so rich.” Wang Zhoning was surprised to hear that someone had booked Hall One for a month. Hall One was not cheap. The price alone was close to 80,000 yuan per day!
“It’s Young Master Tan Zekun. Look, our manager went in to accompany him.”
“Oh my god, is Young Master Tan here?” Wang Zhouning was extremely shocked when he heard this.
Looking at the puzzled expressions of the people beside him, Wang Zhouning explained, “Young Master Tan is Tan Zekun. He’s the eldest son of the Director of Zhiyuan Trade, Tan Zhiyuan.”

Ye Xinyu and the young people beside her looked at Wang Zhouning with admiration in their eyes. Although their families had some financial power, they had never come into contact with such an upper-class person.
Wang Zhouning looked at everyone with pride in his eyes. “Do you know about Zhiyuan Trade? It’s the first foreign trade company in Jiang City. Its market value is close to two billion yuan.”
“Speaking of which, I’ve met Young Master Tan a few times.”
As soon as these words were spoken, Ye Xinyu’s face was filled with admiration. Even Wang Yuanyuan’s eyes were filled with surprise. The others worshiped Wang Zhouning even more.

When Wang Zhouning said this, he originally felt a little guilty. His so-called few encounters were actually just a few glances from afar. Even at his father’s level, he had to bow and scrape in front of Tan Zekun.
On the other hand, when Chen Yun heard about Zhiyuan Trade, he felt that it was very familiar.
Oh!
He had once met the manager of the Human Resources Department at Zhiyuan Trade.
At that moment, he did not have a good impression of Zhiyuan Trade.

“Let’s go and visit Young Master Tan. Otherwise, he will think that we’re being rude.” Wang Zhouning waved his hand and looked at the deputy manager in front of him. “Brother Zhao, will you accompany us?”

“Alright.” Brother Zhao looked at these young men and women. All of them were wearing branded clothes. Coupled with what Wang Zhouning said, he thought that they were really Young Master Tan’s friends. He also wanted to take this opportunity to chat with Young Master Tan. He immediately brought them to Hall One.
Everyone thought that they could see the top young master of Jiang City, so they followed suit and quickly followed.
When they arrived at Hall One and opened the door, everyone was shocked.

It was a large space of hundreds of square meters with all kinds of fitness facilities. On the north and south sides, there was a boxing ring and an octagonal cage respectively. There was a resting area with a huge screen and sofas, as well as a dining area in the middle.
Just this set of configurations was worth this price!
At this moment, a few burly men in black and a few people holding briefcases stood together with the manager and looked into the octagonal cage.
Two figures were fighting inside.
One of them locked the other tightly. No matter how hard he shouted, it was useless.
Wang Zhouning looked at the one who was being trapped and his heart skipped a beat.
It was Young Master Tan!
“Hey! Stop!”
The men holding briefcases were stunned. They looked at the manager. “Are you blind? Hurry up and open the octagonal cage!”
The manager also hurried forward and opened the octagonal cage. Only then did the burly man in black separate the two of them.
“Young Master, are you alright?” A man with a briefcase looked at Tan Zekun, who was panting heavily, and handed him the thermos flask in his hand. “Young Master, have some water.”

On the other side, the manager pulled the tall man over. “How can you fight Young Master Tan? Will you make losses if you let him hit you a few times?! Really! Do you think you’re the trump card of the provincial team? You’re just a worker and sparring partner now.”
“Don’t you know what you look like? You blind thing!”
“Hurry up and apologize to Young Master Tan with me.”
“What are you waiting for? Apologize!”
The manager couldn’t help but shout anxiously.

“Why should he apologize?!” Tan Zekun turned around and walked over with a thermos flask in his hand. He looked at the silent sparring partner. “The rule in the octagonal cage is to beat your opponent up at all costs.”
“Right?”
“Yes, yes, yes, you’re right,” said the manager as he quickly bowed. The next moment, the young man smashed the thermos flask in his hand at the man’s temple.
Thud!
With a muffled sound, the man was directly knocked down and lay on the ground like a dead dog.
In an instant, everyone was stunned. They did not expect such a situation.
Tan Zekun spat on the ground and sneered as he waved to the side. The burly men in black immediately understood. Then, they took out an iron rod and handed it to Tan Zekun.
